item.title: ००१ नित्यात्मुडै यण्डि नित्युडै
item.description:
Nityātmuḍai Yuṇḍi Nityuḍai
नित्यात्मुडै यण्डि नित्युडै वॆलुगॊन्दु
सत्यात्मुडै यण्डि सत्यमै तानुण्डु ॥॥नित्या॥
प्रत्यक्षमै यण्डि ब्रह्ममै यण्डु सं
स्तुत्युडी तिरुवेङ्कटाद्रिविभुडु
एमूर्ति लोकम्बुलॆल्ल नेलॆडु नात
डेमूर्ति ब्रह्मादुलॆल्ल वॆदकॆडु नात
डेमूर्ति निजमोक्ष मिय्यजालॆडु नात
डेमूर्ति लोकैकहितुडु
एमूर्ति निजमूर्ति येमूर्तियनुगाडु
येमूर्ति त्रैमूर्तु लेकमैन यात
डेमूर्ति सर्वात्मु डेमूर्ति परमात्मु
डामूर्ति तिरुवेङ्कटाद्रि विभुडु॥॥नित्या॥
ए देवु देहमुन निन्नियनु जन्मिञ्चॆ
ने देवु देहमुन निन्निय नणङ्गॆ मरि
ये देवु विग्रहं बीसकल मिन्तयनु
ए देवु नेत्रम्बु लिन चन्द्रुलु,
ए देवु डीजीवु लिन्निण्टिलो नुण्डु
नेदेवु चैतन्य मिन्निटिकि नाधार
मेदेवु डव्यक्तुडे देवुडद्वन्द्वु
डा देवुडी वेङ्कटाद्रिविभुडु॥॥नित्या॥
ए वेल्पु पाधयग मिलय नाकाशम्बु
ए वेल्पु पादके शान्तं बनन्तम्बु
ए वेल्पु निश्वास मी महामारुतमु
ए वेल्पु निजदासुली पुण्युलु
ए वेल्पु सर्वेशुडे वेल्पु परमेशु
डे वेल्पु भुवनैक हितमनोभावकुडु
ए वेल्पु कडु सूक्ष्म मेवेल्पु कडु घनमु
आ वेल्पु तिरुवेङ्कटाद्रिविभुडु ॥॥नित्या॥
nityātmuḍai yuṇḍi nityuḍai velugondu
satyātmuḍai yuṇḍi satyamai tānuṇḍu ..
pratyakṣamai yuṇḍi brahmamai yuṇḍu saṃ
stutyuḍī tiruvēṅkaṭādrivibhuḍu..nityā..
ēmūrti lōkambulella nēleḍu nāta
ḍēmūrti brahmādulella vedakeḍu nāta
ḍēmūrti nijamōkṣa miyyajāleḍu nāta
ḍēmūrti lōkaikahituḍu
ēmūrti nijamūrti yēmūrtiyunugāḍu
yēmūrti traimūrtu lēkamaina yāta
ḍēmūrti sarvātmu ḍēmūrti paramātmu
ḍāmūrti tiruvēṅkaṭādri vibhuḍu….nityā..
ē dēvu dēhamuna ninniyunu janmiñce
nē dēvu dēhamuna ninniyu naṇaṅge mari
yē dēvu vigrahaṃ bīsakala mintayunu
23
Who is the Lord from whose body everything emanated ,
Who is the Lord into whose body everything finally merges,
Who is the Lord whose form constitutes everything,
Who is the Lord who has sun and moon as eyes,
Who is the Lord existing within all Jivas,
Who is the Lord whose vitality supports all,
Who is the Lord who is unmanifest,
Who is the Lord who has none as a second?
That Lord is the Lord of Venkatadri!
Who is the God whose feet are the earth and sky,
Who is the God whose entire form is limitless,
Who is the God whose exhalation is the powerful wind,
Who is the God whose true servants are the meritorious ones,
Who is the God who is the ruler of all,
Who is the God existing as the Supreme Overlord,
Who is the God who eternally thinks about the welfare of this world,
Who is the God who is most subtle and also the most extraordinary?
That God is the Lord of Tiru Venkatadri!
ē dēvu nētrambu lina candrulu,
ē dēvu ḍījīvu linniṇṭilō nuṇḍu
nēdēvu caitanya minniṭiki nādhāra
mēdēvu ḍavyaktuḍē dēvuḍadvandvu
ḍā dēvuḍī vēṅkaṭādrivibhuḍu….nityā..
ē vēlpu pādhayuga milayu nākāśambu
ē vēlpu pādakē śāntaṃ banantambu
ē vēlpu niśvāsa mī mahāmārutamu
ē vēlpu nijadāsulī puṇyulu
ē vēlpu sarvēśuḍē vēlpu paramēśu
ḍē vēlpu bhuvanaika hitamanōbhāvakuḍu
ē vēlpu kaḍu sūkṣma mēvēlpu kaḍu ghanamu
ā vēlpu tiruvēṅkaṭādrivibhuḍu ….nityā..
Being the eternal indweller, shining effulgently as the eternal being,
being the true self, and existing as the truth,
being manifest, and being the Supreme Brahman,
He is the one who is the most adorable, this Lord of Tiru Venkatadri!
Who is the deity who rules over all worlds,
Who is the deity sought by Brahma and others,
Who is the deity who can bestow true salvation,
Who is the deity who is the sole well wisher of the Universe,
Who is the deity who possesses a true form,
Who is the deity who cannot be described in any form,
Who is the deity whose form includes the trinity,
Who is the deity existing as the inner self of all,
Who is the deity who is the Paramatma?
That deity is the Lord of Venkatadri!
45

item.title: ००२ आदिमपूरुषु डच्युतु डचलु
item.description:
Ādimapūruṣu Ḍacyutu Ḍacalu
आदिमपूरुषु डच्युतु डचलु डनन्तुं डमलुडु
आदेवु डीतडेपो हरि वेङ्कटविभुडु ॥॥ आदि ॥
एकार्णवमै उदकमुलेचिन ब्रह्माण्डमुलो
बैकॊनियण्डग नॊकवटपत्रमुलोपलनु
चेकॊनि पवळिम्पुचु नॊकशिशुवै वडि देलाडिन -
श्रीकान्तु डीतडेपो श्रीवेङ्कटविभुडु ॥॥ आदि ॥
अरुदुग बलिमद मडपग नाकसमण्टिनरूपमु
सरुगन भूमिन्तय नॊकचरणम्बुन गॊलचि
परगिनपादाङ्गुटमुन ब्रह्माण्डमु नगिलिञ्चिन
परमात्मु डीतडेपो पति वेङ्कटविभुडु ॥॥ आदि ॥
क्षीरपयोनिधिलोपल शेषुडु पर्यङ्कमुगा
धारुणियनु सिरियनु बादमु लॊत्तगनु
चेरुव दनु ब्रह्मादुलु सेविम्पग जॆलुवॊन्दॆडि
नारायणु डितडे वुन्नत वेङ्कटविभुडु ॥॥ आदि ॥
ādimapūruṣu ḍacyutu ḍacalu ḍanantuṃ ḍamaluḍu
ādēvu ḍītaḍēpō hari vēṅkaṭavibhuḍu …. ādi ..
ēkārṇavamai udakamulēcina brahmāṇḍamulō
baikoniyuṇḍaga nokavaṭapatramulōpalanu
cēkoni pavaḷimpucu nokaśiśuvai vaḍi dēlāḍina -
śrīkāntu ḍītaḍēpō śrīvēṅkaṭavibhuḍu …. ādi ..
aruduga balimada maḍapaga nākasamaṇṭinarūpamu
sarugana bhūmintayu nokacaraṇambuna golaci
paraginapādāṅguṭamuna brahmāṇḍamu nagiliñcina
paramātmu ḍītaḍēpō pati vēṅkaṭavibhuḍu …. ādi ..
kṣīrapayōnidhilōpala śēṣuḍu paryaṅkamugā
dhāruṇiyanu siriyunu bādamu lottaganu
cēruva danu brahmādulu sēvimpaga jeluvondeḍi
nārāyaṇu ḍitaḍē vunnata vēṅkaṭavibhuḍu …. ādi ..
The Adi-Purusha, Achyutha, the firm one, the limitless one, the sinless one
That Lord himself is Hari, this Lord of Venkata!
During the apocalypse, when the waters inundated
the entire universe, the Lord who was afloat, reclining upon
a tiny banyan leaf, as a baby,
that Lord of Sree is the Lord of Venkata!
To destroy the arrogance of king Bali, taking a form which reached
up to the sky, the Lord who measured the entire earth in one step,
and shook the entire universe with the powerful big toe,
that Paramatma is the Lord of Venkata!
In the milky ocean, with Sesha as the couch,
as Sree devi and Bhu devi press His feet lovingly,
with Brahma and others serving Him closely, the Lord who
rejoices thus, that Narayana Himself is this Supreme Lord of Venkata!
67

item.title: ००३ देवरवैति
item.description:
Dēvaravaiti
देवरवैति विन्निटा देवुलायॆनापॆ नीकु
आवल मिम्मिद्दरि नेमनि पॊगडेमय्या ॥॥देवर ॥
पुन्नम वॆन्नॆलजोडु पूवुललोन वासन
उन्नति मीरि नी पुरमॆक्कॆनु
मन्नन सम्पदराशि मदनुनि पुट्टिनिल्लु
वन्नॆतो नीकु राणिवासमायॆनु ॥॥देवर ॥
पालजलनिधितेट बङ्गारु लोपलि कळ
कीलितमुगा नी कॆङ्गेलु वट्टॆनु
मेलुलो साकारमु मिञ्चु लोकमु भाग्यमु
तालिमितो नीकु मूलधनमायॆनु ॥॥देवर ॥
अन्दरिनि गन्नतल्लि आदिमूलमैन लक्ष्मि
कन्दुव नीमुञ्जेति कङ्कण मायनु
यिन्दुन श्री वेङ्कटेश यीपॆ सर्वमोहनमु
कन्दु वाय निन्नु गूडॆ (डि?) कलिमॆल्ला मॆरसॆ ॥॥देवर ॥
dēvaravaiti vinniṭā dēvulāyenāpe nīku
āvala mimmiddari nēmani pogaḍēmayyā ….dēvara ..
punnama vennelajōḍu pūvulalōna vāsana
unnati mīri nī puramekkenu
mannana sampadarāśi madanuni puṭṭinillu
vannetō nīku rāṇivāsamāyenu….dēvara ..
pālajalanidhitēṭa baṅgāru lōpali kaḷa
kīlitamugā nī keṅgēlu vaṭṭenu
mēlulō sākāramu miñcu lōkamu bhāgyamu
tālimitō nīku mūladhanamāyenu ….dēvara ..
aṃdarini gannatalli ādimūlamaina lakṣmi
kanduva nīmuñjēti kaṅkaṇa māyanu
yinduna śrī vēṅkaṭēśa yīpe sarvamōhanamu
kandu vāya ninnu gūḍe (ḍi?) kalimellā merase ….dēvara ..
You are the God in everything! Befitting Goddess You have as Your consort!
In what manner can we praise you both?
Like a pair of the full moon and its light, like the flowers and their fragrance!
Attaining supremacy, She made Your bosom her abode!
A treasure of glorious wealth, the birth place of Madana
She has beautifully become Your royal abode!
Like the milky ocean and its purity, like the gold and its inherent glow!
She united herself with You, holding Your palm!
An embodiment of highest virtues, the supreme fortune of the worlds
She has abidingly become Your precious wealth!
The mother who created everyone, that Lakshmi who is the ‘Adimoola’
Eagerly She adorned Your body as a sacred ornament!
In this manner, Sree Venkatesha, She-the supremely bewitching one,
As she joined You, Your prosperity dazzled in effulgence!
89

item.title: ००४ वाडॆ वॆङ्कटाद्रि मीद
item.description:
Vāḍe Veṅkaṭādri Mīda
वाडॆ वेङ्कटाद्रिमीद वरदैवमु
पोडिमितो पॊडचूपॆ पॊडवैन दैवमु ॥॥ वाडॆ ॥
वॊक्कॊक्करोमकूपान नॊगि ब्रह्माण्डकोट्लु
पिक्कटिल्ल वॆलुगॊन्दे पॆनुदैवमु
पक्कननु तनलोनि पदुनालुगुलोकालु
तॊक्कि पादानगॊलचेदॊड्डदैवमु ॥॥ वाडॆ ॥
वेदशास्त्रालु नुतिञ्चि वेसरि कानगलेनि -
मोदपु पॆक्कुगुणाल मूलदैवमु
पोदि देवतलनॆल्ल पुट्टिञ्च रक्षिञ्च
आदिकारणम्बैन अजुगन्न दैवमु ॥॥ वाडॆ ॥
सरुस शङ्खचक्रालु सरिबट्टि असुरुल
तरगि पडवेसिन दण्डिदयिवमू
सिरि वुरमुन निञ्चि श्रीवेङ्कटेशुडयि
शरणागतुलगाचे सतमयिनदैवमु ॥॥ वाडॆ ॥
vāḍe vēṅkaṭādrimīda varadaivamu
pōḍimitō poḍacūpe poḍavaina daivamu …. vāḍe ..
vokkokkarōmakūpāna nogi brahmāṇḍakōṭlu
pikkaṭilla velugondē penudaivamu
pakkananu tanalōni padunālugulōkālu
tokki pādānagolacēdoḍḍadaivamu …. vāḍe ..
vēdaśāstrālu nutiñci vēsari kānagalēni -
mōdapu pekkuguṇāla mūladaivamu
pōdi dēvatalanella puṭṭiñca rakṣiñca
ādikāraṇambaina ajuganna daivamu …. vāḍe ..
sarusa śaṅkhacakrālu saribaṭṭi asurula
taragi paḍavēsina daṇḍidayivamū
siri vuramuna niñci śrīvēṅkaṭēśuḍayi
śaraṇāgatulagācē satamayinadaivamu …. vāḍe ..
He is the boon bestowing Lord who resides on Venkatadri!
The gloriously manifested tall God!!
The one from whose every hair follicle burst forth the crores of Universes,
He is that splendidly resplendent gigantic Lord!
With the fourteen worlds that are within Him, and yet outside Him,
He is that great Lord who measured them with His feet!
Praising whose qualities, the Veda-Shastras never get exhausted,
He is that Primal Lord who is the repository of many great attributes!
To create and protect the multitude of demigods,
He is the Primal cause, the father of Manmatha!
Joyously wielding the Shanka-Chakra, the one who cuts asunder demons,
that many-formed Lord He is!
By placing Sree on His chest, becoming Sree Venkatesha
He is that eternal God who protects Sharanagathas!
1011

item.title: ००५ तॊल्लियनु मऱ्ऱाकु
item.description:
Tolliyunu Maṟṟāku
तॊल्लियनु मऱ्ऱाकु तॊट्टलनॆ यूगॆ गन
चॆल्लुबडि नूगीनि श्रीरङ्ग शिशुवु ॥॥ तॊल्लि ॥
कलिकि कावेरि तरगल बाहु लतलने
तलगकिटु रङ्गमध्यपु तॊट्टॆलन्
पलुमारु तनु जाचि पाडगा नूगीनि
चिलुपाल सॆलवितो श्रीरङ्ग शिशुवु ॥॥ तॊल्लि ॥
अदिवॊ कमलजुनि तिरुवारधनं बनग
अदन कमलभवाण्डमनु तॊट्टॆलुन्
उदधुलु तरङ्गमुलु नूचगा नूगीनि
चॆदरनि सिरुलतोड श्रीरङ्ग शिशुवु ॥॥ तॊल्लि ॥
वेदमुलॆ चेरुलै वॆलयङ्ग शेषुडे
पादुकॊनु तॊट्टॆलै परगगानु
श्रीदेवितो गूडि श्री वेङ्कटेशुडे
सेददेरडि वाडॆ श्रीरङ्ग शिशुवु ॥॥ तॊल्लि ॥
tolliyunu maṟṟāku toṭṭalane yūge gana
cellubaḍi nūgīni śrīraṅga śiśuvu …. tolli ..
kaliki kāvēri taragala bāhu latalanē
talagakiṭu raṅgamadhyapu toṭṭelan
palumāru tanu jūci pāḍagā nūgīni
cilupāla selavitō śrīraṅga śiśuvu …. tolli ..
adivo kamalajuni tiruvāradhanaṃ banaga
adana kamalabhavāṇḍamanu toṭṭelun
udadhulu taraṅgamulu nūcagā nūgīni
cedarani sirulatōḍa śrīraṅga śiśuvu …. tolli ..
vēdamule cērulai velayaṅga śēṣuḍē
pādukonu toṭṭelai paragagānu
śrīdēvitō gūḍi śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍē
sēdadēraḍi vāḍe śrīraṅga śiśuvu …. tolli ..
Since, at the very beginning, He was swinging in the banyan leaf cradle
So, with supreme authority, He is swinging, this baby of Srirangam!
On the waves of the beautiful damsel Kaveri’s encircling arms,
in the middle of the cradle like island,
as she sang beholding Him again and again, He is swinging
with milk drooling from the corner of His smiling lips, this baby of Srirangam!
Behold! As though Lord Brahma was performing the Tiruvaradhanam1,
in the cradle of the lotus like Universe,
when the waves of the ocean were swaying,
with undisturbed glory, is swinging this baby of Srirangam!
With the Vedas as the ropes of the cradle,
with Sesha spreading out firmly as the cradle,
Along with Sree-Devi, Sree Venkatesha Himself
is the one who is relaxing as the baby of Srirangam!!!
1 Tiruvaradhanam: The propitious daily worship.
1213

item.title: ००६ वन्दे वासुदेवं
item.description:
Vandē Vāsudēvaṃ
वन्दे वासुदेवं
बृन्दारकाधीशवन्दितपदाब्जम् ॥॥ वन्दे ॥
इन्दीवरश्याम मिन्दिराकुचतटी -
चन्दनाङ्कितलसच्चारुदेहं
मन्दारमालिकामकुटसंशोभितं
कन्दर्पजनक मरविन्दनाभम् ॥॥ वन्दे ॥
धगधगितकौस्तुभा धरण वक्षस्थलं
खगराजवाहनं कमलनयनं
निगमाधिसेवितं निजरूपशेषप -
न्नगराजशायिनं घननिवासम् ॥॥ वन्दे ॥
करिपुरनाथसंरक्षणे तत्परं
करिराजवरदसङ्गतकराब्जं
सरसीरुहाननं चक्रविभ्राजितं
तिरुवेङ्कटाचला देवं भजे ॥॥ वन्दे ॥
vandē vāsudēvaṃ
bṛndārakādhīśavanditapadābjaṃ …. vandē ..
iṃdīvaraśyāma mindirākucataṭī -
candanāṅkitalasaccārudēhaṃ
mandāramālikāmakuṭasaṃśōbhitaṃ
kandarpajanaka maravindanābhaṃ …. vandē ..
dhagadhagitakaustubhā dharaṇa vakṣasthalaṃ
khagarājavāhanaṃ kamalanayanaṃ
nigamādhisēvitaṃ nijarūpaśēṣapa -
nnagarājaśāyinaṃ ghananivāsaṃ …. vandē ..
karipuranāthasaṃrakṣaṇē tatparaṃ
karirājavaradasaṅgatakarābjaṃ
sarasīruhānanaṃ cakravibhrājitaṃ
tiruvēṅkaṭācalā dēvaṃ bhajē …. vandē ..
I worship Vasudeva!
That one who is revered by the head of all demigods!
The one like a black cloud, who from the confines of Lakshmi’s bosom
gets smeared by sandal paste, that one with an immaculate body
who is garlanded with Mandara flowers, who shines with a crown,
the father of Kandarpa1, the lotus navelled one!
The one whose chest is adorned by the glittering Kaustubha jewel,
the one who has the king of birds as His vehicle, the lotus eyed one
the one praised by the Vedas, the one who in His true form reclines on
Sesha - the king of serpents, and the one who is the refuge of all divinities!
The Lord of Karipura, the one who is always engaged in protection
the one who blessed the elephant king at the time of need, with His lotus like hands,
the one with Lotus eyes, the one who shines brilliantly with the discus,
On that Lord of Tiru Venkatachala, I meditate!
This Sankirtana is composed on Kanchi Varadaraja Perumal!

item.title: ००७ भावमुलोन
item.description:
Bhāvamulōna
भावमुलोना बाह्यमु नन्दुनु
गोविन्द गोविन्द यनि कॊलुववो मनसा ॥॥ भावमु ॥
हरियवतारमुले अखिल देवतलु
हरिलोनिवे ब्रह्माण्डम्बुलु
हरि नाममुले अन्नि मन्त्रमुलु
हरि हरि हरि हरि हरि यनवो मनसा ॥॥ भावमु ॥
विष्टुनि महिमले विहित कर्ममुलु
विष्टुनि पॊगडॆडि वेदम्बुलु
विष्टुडॊक्कडे विश्वान्तरात्मुडु
विष्टुवु विष्टुवनि वॆदकवो मनसा ॥॥ भावमु ॥
अच्युतु डितडे आदिय नन्त्यमु
अच्युतुडे असुरान्तकुडु
अच्युतुडु श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रि मीद निदॆ
अच्युत अच्युत शरणनवो मनसा ॥॥ भावमु ॥
bhāvamulōnā bāhyamu nandunu
gōvinda gōvinda yani koluvavō manasā .. ..bhāvamu ..
hariyavatāramulē akhila dēvatalu
harilōnivē brahmāṇḍambulu
hari nāmamulē anni mantramulu
hari hari hari hari hari yanavō manasā …. bhāvamu ..
viṣṭuni mahimalē vihita karmamulu
viṣṭuni pogaḍeḍi vēdambulu
viṣṭuḍokkaḍē viśvāntarātmuḍu
viṣṭuvu viṣṭuvani vedakavō manasā …. bhāvamu ..
acyutu ḍitaḍē ādiyu nantyamu
acyutuḍē asurāntakuḍu
acyutuḍu śrīvēṅkaṭādri mīda nide
acyuta acyuta śaraṇanavō manasā …. bhāvamu ..
O mind! In your thought and also outwardly,
say ‘Govinda’, ‘Govinda’ and pay reverence!
All deities are but Hari’s Incarnations
Within Hari are the numerous vast universes
All divine incantations are but Hari’s names
O mind! Say ‘Hari’ ‘Hari’ ‘Hari’ ‘Hari’ and pay reverence!
Vishnu’s omnipotent miracles are our ordained deeds
The entire Vedas are but praises of Vishnu
Vishnu alone is the inner self of the entire universe
O mind! Saying ‘Vishnu’ ‘Vishnu’, continue to seek Him!
Achyuta alone is the beginning and the end
Achyuta Himself has put all diabolical demons to end
Achyuta is the one on Sri Venkatadri Hill,
O mind! Take refuge in that Achyuta!
1617

item.title: ००८ ब्रह्म कडिगिन पादमु
item.description:
Brahma Kaḍigina Pādamu
ब्रह्म कडिगिन पादमु
ब्रह्ममु तानॆ नी पादमु॥ ब्रह्म ॥
चॆलगि वसुध गॊलिचिन नी पादमु
बलितल मोपिन पादमु
तलकक गगनमु तन्निन पादमु
बलरिपु गाचिन पादमु॥ ब्रह्म ॥
कामिनि पापमु कडिगिन पादमु
पामु तलनिडिन पादमु
प्रेमपु श्रीपति पिसिकॆडि पादमु
पामिडि तुरगपु पादमु॥ ब्रह्म ॥
परम योगुलकु परिपरि विधमुल
परमॊसगॆडि नी पादमु
तिरु वेङ्कटगिरि तिरमनि चूपिन
परम पदमु नी पादमु॥ ब्रह्म ॥
brahma kaḍigina pādamu
brahmamu tāne nī pādamu.. brahma ..
celagi vasudha golicina nī pādamu
balitala mōpina pādamu
talakaka gaganamu tannina pādamu
balaripu gācina pādamu.. brahma ..
kāmini pāpamu kaḍigina pādamu
pāmu talaniḍina pādamu
prēmapu śrīpati pisikeḍi pādamu
pāmiḍi turagapu pādamu.. brahma ..
parama yōgulaku paripari vidhamula
paramosageḍi nī pādamu
tiru vēṅkaṭagiri tiramani cūpina
parama padamu nī pādamu.. brahma ..
The feet which Lord Brahma washed with reverence,
they are the Supreme Brahman themselves!
The feet which Vasudha1 joyfully worshipped,
On king Bali’s head this foot was placed,
Valiantly, this foot had measured the entire sky,
Indra was protected by the grace of these feet!
Kamini’s2 sins were washed away by these feet
These are the feet that were placed on Kaliya’s head
With love, Sree-sati massages these feet
These are the feet of the extraordinary horse (Lord Hayagreeva)
For the highest of sages in very many ways
these divine feet grant salvation!
Proving that ‘Tiru Venkatagiri’ is eternal,
the Parama-Padam3 is at your feet!
1.Vasudha is mother earth, the consort of Vishnu
2.The reference here is to Ahalya, whose sins were absolved by the touch of Lord
Rama’s feet
3.The supreme realm
1819

item.title: ००९ ऎन्त मात्रमुन
item.description:
Eṃta Mātramuna
ऎन्त मात्रमुन ऎव्वरु दलचिन अन्त मात्रमे नीवु
अन्तरान्तरमु लॆञ्चि चूड पिण्डन्ते निप्पटि यन्नट्लु ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
कॊलुतुरु मिमु वैष्टवुलु कूरिमितो विष्टुडनि
पलुकुदुरु मिमु वेदान्तुलु परब्रह्मम्बनुचु
तलतुरु मिमु शैवुलु तगिन भक्तुलुनु शिवुडनुचु
अलरि पॊगडुदुरु कापालिकु लादिभैरवुण्डनुचु ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
सरि नॆन्नुदुरु शाक्तेयलु शक्तिरूपु नीवनुचु
दरिशनमुलु मिमु नानाविधुलनु तलपुल कॊलदुल भजिन्तुरु
पिरुल मिमु ने यल्पबुद्धि दलचिन वारिकि अल्पम्बवुदु
गरिमल मिमु ने घनमनि दलचिन घन बुद्धुलकु घनुडवु॥ ॥ ऎन्त ॥
नीवलन कॊरते लेदु मरि नीरु कॊलदि तामॆरवु
आवल भागीरधि दरि बावुल आ जलमे ऊरियन्नट्लु
श्रीवेङ्कटपति नीवैते ममु चेकॊनि वुन्न दैवमनि
ईवल ने नी शरणननॆदनु इदिये पर तत्त्वमु नाकु ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
eṃta mātramuna evvaru dalacina aṃta mātramē nīvu
aṃtarāntaramu leñci cūḍa piṇḍantē nippaṭi yannaṭlu ..eṃta ..
koluturu mimu vaiṣṭavulu kūrimitō viṣṭuḍani
palukuduru mimu vēdāntulu parabrahmambanucu
talaturu mimu śaivulu tagina bhaktulunu śivuḍanucu
alari pogaḍuduru kāpāliku lādibhairavuṇḍanucu …. eṃta ..
sari nennuduru śāktēyulu śaktirūpu nīvanucu
dariśanamulu mimu nānāvidhulanu talapula koladula bhajinturu
pirula mimu nē yalpabuddhi dalacina vāriki alpambavudu
garimala mimu nē ghanamani dalacina ghana buddhulaku
ghanuḍavu.. .. eṃta ..
nīvalana koratē lēdu mari nīru koladi tāmeravu
āvala bhāgīradhi dari bāvula ā jalamē ūriyunnaṭlu
śrīvēṅkaṭapati nīvaitē mamu cēkoni vunna daivamani
īvala nē nī śaraṇananedanu idiyē para tattvamu nāku ..eṃta ..
You are that, what one perceives you as
If appraised rightly, however the dough is, so turns out the pancake!
Vaishnavas serve You with love as ‘Vishnu’
Vedantins call You the ‘Para Brahman’
Shaivaites and some devotees say You are ‘Shiva’
Kapalikas praise You as ‘Adi Bhairava’!
Shakteyas worship You as the ‘Divine Sakti’
Perceiving You in various ways, people worship You as their thoughts run
In affluence with pride, to those who take You as nothing, to them You are nothing
To the wise ones who take You as the superior most, You are the most magnificent!
In You there are no short comings, as the lotus rises just to the level of water
Around river Bhagirathi it is the same water that springs in the wells,
If You are Sree Venkatapathi, the Lord who accepts us,
right here I surrender unto You totally! For me this is the highest truth!
2021

item.title: ०१० पॊडगण्टिमय्य मिम्मु
item.description:
Poḍagaṇṭimayya Mimmu
पॊडगण्टिमय्य मिम्मु पुरुषोत्तमा मम्मु
नॆडयकवय्य कोनेटिरायडा ॥॥ पॊडगण्टि ॥
कोरि मम्मु नेलिनट्टि कुलदैवमा! चाला
नेरचि पॆद्दलिच्चिव निधानमा
गारविञ्चि दप्पिदीर्चु कालमेघमा! माकु
चेरुव चित्तमुलोनि श्रीनिवासुडा! ॥॥ पॊडगण्टि ॥
भाविम्पकैवसमैन पारिजातमा! मम्मु
चेवदेर गाचिनट्टि चिन्तामणी
काविञ्चि कोरिकलिच्चे कामधेनुवा! मम्मु
तावै रक्षिञ्चेटि धरणीधरा! ॥॥ पॊडगण्टि ॥
चॆडनीक ब्रतिकिञ्चे सिद्धमन्त्रमा! रोगा -
लडचि रक्षिञ्चे दिव्यौषधमा!
बडिबायक तिरिगे प्राणबन्धुडा! मम्मु
गडियिञ्चिवट्टि श्री वेङ्कटनाधुडा ॥॥ पॊडगण्टि ॥
poḍagaṇṭimayya mimmu puruṣōttamā mammu
neḍayakavayya kōnēṭirāyaḍā …. poḍagaṇṭi ..
kōri mammu nēlinaṭṭi kuladaivamā! cālā
nēraci peddalicciva nidhānamā
gāraviñci dappidīrcu kālamēghamā! māku
cēruva cittamulōni śrīnivāsuḍā! …. poḍagaṇṭi ..
bhāvimpakaivasamaina pārijātamā! mammu
cēvadēra gācinaṭṭi cintāmaṇī
kāviñci kōrikaliccē kāmadhēnuvā! mammu
tāvai rakṣiñcēṭi dharaṇīdharā! …. poḍagaṇṭi ..
ceḍanīka bratikiñcē siddhamantramā! rōgā -
laḍaci rakṣiñcē divyauṣadhamā!
baḍibāyaka tirigē prāṇabandhuḍā! mammu
gaḍiyiñcivaṭṭi śrī vēṅkaṭanādhuḍā …. poḍagaṇṭi ..
We beheld your presence, O Purushottama!
Do not let go of us, O Konetiraayaa!1
You ruled over us lovingly by your own wish, O family deity!
You are the real treasure our fore-fathers bestowed upon us after realizing!
You are the dark blue cloud who quenches our thirst in a loving manner!
You are Srinivasa, seated in our minds!
You are the Parijatha2 which we have gained by mere thought!
You are the Chintamani3 who protects us to our hearts’ content!
You are the Kamadhenu4 who blesses us and grants desired boons!
Being our only refuge, You protect us, O Dharanidhara5!
O life saving powerful incantation,
O disease destroying divine medication,
O inseparable soul – relation,
You won over us, O Lord Sree Venkatanatha!!
1.Konetiraya means ‘The Lord of the Koneru’. Koneru is the holy Pushkarini tank.
2.The Parijatha flower
3.The wish fulfilling gem
4.The wish yielding cow
5.The Lord who bore the earth
2223

item.title: ०११ मुद्दुगारे यशोद
item.description:
Muddugārē Yaśōda
मुद्दुगारे यशोद मुङ्गिट मुत्तॆमु वीडु
तिद्दरानि महिमल देवकी सुतुडु ॥॥ मुद्दु ॥
अन्त निन्त गॊल्लॆतल अरचेति माणिकमु
पन्तमाडे कंसुनि पालि वज्रमु
कान्तुल मूडु लोकाल गरुड पच्च पूस
चॆन्तल मालोनुन्न चिन्निकृष्टुडु ॥॥ मुद्दु ॥
रतिकेळि रुक्मिणिकि रङ्गुमोवि पगडमु
मिति गोवर्धनपु गोमेधिकमु
सतमै शङ्खचक्राल सन्दुल वैडूर्यमु
गतियै मम्मु गाचे कमलाक्षुडु ॥॥ मुद्दु ॥
काळिङ्गुनि तललपै कप्पिन पुष्यरागमु
एलेटि श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रि इन्द्रनीलमु
पाल जलनिधिलोन पायनि दिव्यरत्नमु
बालुनि वलॆ तिरिगी पद्मनाभुडु ॥॥ मुद्दु ॥
muddugārē yaśōda muṅgiṭa muttemu vīḍu
tiddarāni mahimala dēvakī sutuḍu …. muddu ..
aṃta ninta golletala aracēti māṇikamu
pantamāḍē kaṃsuni pāli vajramu
kāntula mūḍu lōkāla garuḍa pacca pūsa
centala mālōnunna cinnikṛṣṭuḍu …. muddu ..
ratikēḷi rukmiṇiki raṅgumōvi pagaḍamu
miti gōvardhanapu gōmēdhikamu
satamai śaṅkhacakrāla sandula vaiḍūryamu
gatiyai mammu gācē kamalākṣuḍu …. muddu ..
kāḷiṅguni talalapai kappina puṣyarāgamu
ēlēṭi śrīvēṅkaṭādri iṃdranīlamu
pāla jalanidhilōna pāyani divyaratnamu
bāluni vale tirigī padmanābhuḍu …. muddu ..
Overflowing with sweetness, in Yashoda’s courtyard, He is the Pearl,
The possessor of great glories, the child of Devaki!
For the Gopika women, He is the easily accessible Ruby
For Kamsa the obstinate, He is the tough Diamond
Illuminating the three worlds, He is a green Emerald
He is closely within us, this little Krishna!
When engaged in love making with Rukmini, He is the Coral of her red lips
While lifting the huge Govardhana hill, He is the yellow Sapphire
In between the Conch and the Discus, He shines eternally as the Vaidurya
Being our only means, He protects us, this Lotus eyed Lord!
On the hoods of Kaliya, He shone as the Pushyaraga
Ruling over Sree Venkatadri, He is the blue Sapphire
Residing in the milky ocean eternally, He is the divine gem
He moved about like a small boy, this Lotus naveled Lord!
2425

item.title: ०१२ कॊण्डललो नॆलकॊन्न
item.description:
Koṇḍalalō Nelakonna
कॊण्डललो नॆलकॊन्न कोनेटि रायडु वाडु
कॊण्डलन्त वरमुलु गुप्पॆडुवाडु ॥॥ कॊण्डललो ॥
कुम्मर दासुडैन कुरुवरत्तिनम्बि
इम्मन्न वरमुलॆल्ल इच्चिनवाडु
दॊम्मुलु चेसिनयट्टि तॊण्डमान् जक्कुरवर्ति
रम्मन्न चोटिकि वच्चि नम्मिन वाडु ॥॥ कॊण्डललो ॥
अच्चपु वेडुकतो अनन्ताळुवारिकि
मुच्चिलि वॆट्टिकि मन्नुमोचिन वाडु
मच्चिक दॊलक तिरुमल नम्बि तोडुत
इच्चनिच्च माटलाडि नच्चिनवाडु ॥॥ कॊण्डललो ॥
कञ्चिलोन वुण्ड तिरुक्कच्चि नम्बि मीद करु
णिञ्चि तव यॆडकु रप्पिञ्चिन वाडु
ऎञ्चनॆक्कुडैन वेङ्कटेशुडु मनलकु
मञ्चिवाडै करुण पालिञ्चिनवाडु ॥॥ कॊण्डललो ॥
koṇḍalalō nelakonna kōnēṭi rāyaḍu vāḍu
koṇḍalanta varamulu guppeḍuvāḍu …. koṇḍalalō ..
kummara dāsuḍaina kuruvarattinambi
immanna varamulella iccinavāḍu
dommulu cēsinayaṭṭi toṇḍamān jakkuravarti
rammanna cōṭiki vacci nammina vāḍu …. koṇḍalalō ..
accapu vēḍukatō anantāḷuvāriki
muccili veṭṭiki mannumōcina vāḍu
maccika dolaka tirumala nambi tōḍuta
iccanicca māṭalāḍi naccinavāḍu ..koṇḍalalō ..
kañcilōna vuṇḍa tirukkacci nambi mīda karu
ṇiñci tava yeḍaku rappiñcina vāḍu
eṃcanekkuḍaina vēṅkaṭēśuḍu manalaku
mañcivāḍai karuṇa pāliñcinavāḍu ..koṇḍalalō ..
Residing in the hills, He is the Konetiraaya !
He is the one who can bestow boons as huge as mountains!
To ‘Kuruvaratti Nambi’ the potter,
He bestowed all that he asked for!
To the king ‘Tondamaan’ who was waging wars,
He appeared wherever he had promised!
To ‘Anantalvar’ with utmost delight,
sharing his drudgery, He carried the sand weight!
With ‘Tirumalanambi’, in the form of friendly gestures,
He joyfully shared some banter and gossips!
On ‘Tirukachhinambi’ who was in Kanchi,
He showered His grace and made him come to His place!
Lord Venkatesha cannot be measured by us,
with His bounteous compassion, the benevolent Lord graces us!!
1.Kuruvaratti Nambi was a potter by profession residing at Tirumala, and was the
great devotee of the Lord.
2.Tondaman was an emperor
3.Anantalvar was a disciple of Ramanujacharya, who was sent to Tirumala by the
Acharya to maintain a flower garden for Lord Venkateswara’s daily worship.
4.Tirumala Nambi was the maternal uncle of Ramanuja, who taught him the Ramayan
at Tirumala.
5.Tirukachhi Nambi (Kanchipurna) was a disciple of Yamunacharya, and it was he who
instructed Ramanuja according to the Lord’s wishes.
2627

item.title: ०१३ नारयणते नमो नमो
item.description:
Nārayaṇatē Namō Namō
नारयणते नमो नमो
नारद सन्नुत नमो नमो ॥॥ नारायण ॥
मुरहर भवहर मुकुन्द माधव
गरुडगमन पङ्कजनाभ
परमपुरुष भवबन्ध विमोचन
नरमृग शरीर नमो नमो ॥॥ नारायण ॥
जलधिशयन रविचन्द्र विलोचन
जलरुहभव नुत चरणयग
बलिबन्धन गोपवधू वल्लभ
नलिनोदर ते नमो नमो ॥॥ नारायण ॥
आदिदेव सकलागम पूजित
यादवकुल मोहन रूप
वेदोद्धर तिरुवेङ्कट नायक
नादप्रियते नमो नमो ॥॥ नारायण ॥
nārayaṇatē namō namō
nārada sannuta namō namō …. nārāyaṇa ..
murahara bhavahara mukunda mādhava
garuḍagamana paṅkajanābha
paramapuruṣa bhavabandha vimōcana
naramṛga śarīra namō namō …. nārāyaṇa ..
jaladhiśayana ravicandra vilōcana
jalaruhabhava nuta caraṇayuga
balibandhana gōpavadhū vallabha
nalinōdara tē namō namō …. nārāyaṇa ..
ādidēva sakalāgama pūjita
yādavakula mōhana rūpa
vēdōddhara tiruvēṅkaṭa nāyaka
nādapriyatē namō namō …. nārāyaṇa ..
To Narayana, many salutations!
To the one who is praised by sage Narada, many salutations !
To the Vanquisher of Mura, the destroyer of mortal ills, Mukunda, Madhava!
to the one who moves mounted on Garuda, that lotus naveled one,
the Supreme being who releases us from earthly ties,
the one with a body of human and beast, Salutations to Him!
The one who reclines on the ocean, the one with sun and moon as the eyes,
the one whose feet are praised by Brahma,
the one who controlled King Bali, the Lord of the Gopa-bride
the one who has a lotus like navel, Salutations to Him !
The Primal Lord unto whom all treatises pray,
the bewitchingly handsome one of the Yadava clan,
the one who protected the Vedas, Tiru Venkatanayaka,
to the lover of music, many salutations!!
2829

item.title: ०१४ नानाटि बदुकु नाटकमु
item.description:
Nānāṭi Baduku Nāṭakamu
नानाटि बदुकु नाटकमु
कानक कन्नदि कैवल्यमु॥॥नानाटि॥
पुट्टुटय निजमु पोवुटय निजमु
नट्टनडिमि पनि नाटकमु
यॆट्टनॆदुटगल दी प्रपञ्चमुनु
कट्टगडपटिदि कैवल्यमु॥॥नानाटि॥
कुडिचे दन्नमु कोक चुट्टॆडिदि
नडु मन्त्रपु पनि नाटकमु
वॊडिगट्टुकॊनिन वुभयकर्ममुलु
गडि दाटिनपुडॆ कैवल्यमु॥॥नानाटि॥
तॆगदु पापमुनु तीरदु पुण्यमु
नगिनगि कालमु नाटकमु
यॆगुवनॆ श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरु डेलिक
गगनमु मीदिदि कैवल्यमु॥॥नानाटि॥
nānāṭi baduku nāṭakamu
kānaka kannadi kaivalyamu….nānāṭi..
puṭṭuṭayu nijamu pōvuṭayu nijamu
naṭṭanaḍimi pani nāṭakamu
yeṭṭaneduṭagala dī prapañcamunu
kaṭṭagaḍapaṭidi kaivalyamu….nānāṭi..
kuḍicē dannamu kōka cuṭṭeḍidi
naḍu mantrapu pani nāṭakamu
voḍigaṭṭukonina vubhayakarmamulu
gaḍi dāṭinapuḍe kaivalyamu….nānāṭi..
tegadu pāpamunu tīradu puṇyamu
naginagi kālamu nāṭakamu
yeguvane śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaru ḍēlika
gaganamu mīdidi kaivalyamu….nānāṭi..
The day to day existence is mere play,
The one which is perceived without being seen is salvation!
Birth is a truth, death is a truth,
in-between, our doings are but a play!
Right in front exists the world,
but the final destination is only salvation!
Food we consume, clothes we wear,
the deeds in-between are mere play!
The self acquired dual-karmas,
if we cross, only then is the salvation!
Binding are sins, inexhaustible are merits,
in-between, the passing time is but mere play!
High up is Sree Venkateshwara, the ruling deity,
there beyond the sky is the salvation!!
3031

item.title: ०१५ चक्कनि तल्लिकि छाङ्गु भळा
item.description:
Cakkani Talliki Chāngu Bhaḷā
चक्कनि तल्लिकि छाङ्गु भळा तन
चक्कॆर मोविकि छाङ्गु भळा॥॥चक्कनि॥
कुलिकेटि मुरिपॆपु गुम्मरिम्पु दन
सळपु जापुलकु छाङ्गु भळा
पलुकुल सॊलपुल बतितो गसरॆडि
चलमुल यलुककु छाङ्गु भळा॥॥चक्कनि॥
किन्नॆरतो बतिकॆलन निलुचु दव
चन्नु मॆऱुगुलकु छाङ्गु भळा
उन्नति बतिपै नॊरगि निलुचु दन
सन्नपु नडिमिकि छाङ्गु भळा॥॥चक्कनि॥
जन्दॆपु मुत्यपु सरुलहरमुल
चन्दन गन्धिकि छाङ्गु भळा
विन्दयि वेङ्कट विभुबॆनञ्चिन तन
सन्दि दण्डलकु छाङ्गु भळा॥॥चक्कनि॥
cakkani talliki chāngu bhaḷā tana
cakkera mōviki chāngu bhaḷā….cakkani..
kulikēṭi muripepu gummarimpu dana
saḷapu jūpulaku chāngu bhaḷā
palukula solapula batitō gasareḍi
calamula yalukaku chāngu bhaḷā….cakkani..
kinneratō batikelana nilucu dava
cannu meṟugulaku chāngu bhaḷā
unnati batipai noragi nilucu dana
sannapu naḍimiki chāngu bhaḷā….cakkani..
jandepu mutyapu sarulaharamula
candana gandhiki chāngu bhaḷā
vindayi vēṅkaṭa vibhubenañcina tana
sandi daṇḍalaku chāngu bhaḷā….cakkani..
Praises and encomiums many, to the beautiful mother!
Praises to Her face as sweet as sugar!
Filled with all the graceful coquettery,
to those penetrating looks of Hers, many praises!
When taunting her Lord with languishing words,
to Her pretense of anger and tantrums, many praises!
When standing beside Her Lord, with a lute in her hand,
to the lustre of Her bounteous bosom, many praises!
When leaning on to Her majestic consort,
to Her slender waist, many praises!
To the one with a cross belt and pearl strings,
to that one with a bodily fragrance of sandal, many praises!
To those arms of Hers which surround Her consort
Lord Venkata with great delight, many praises!
3233

item.title: ०१६ क्षीराब्धि कन्यककु श्री महालक्ष्मिकिनि
item.description:
Kṣīrābdhi Kanyakaku Śrī Mahālakṣmikini
क्षीराब्धि कन्यककु श्री महालक्ष्मिकिनि
नीरजालयकुनु नीराजनं॥॥क्षीराब्धि॥
जलजाक्षि मोमुनकु जक्कव कुचम्बुलकु
नॆलकॊन्न कप्पुरपु नीराजनं
अलिवेणि तुरुमुनकु हस्तकमलम्बुलकु
निलुवु माणिक्यमुल नीराजनं॥॥क्षीराब्धि॥
चरण किसलयमुलकु सकिय रम्भोरुलकु
निरतमगु मुत्तेल नीराजनं
अरिदि जघनम्बुनकु नतिवनिजनाभिकिनि
निरति नानावर्ण नीराजनं॥॥क्षीराब्धि॥
पगटु श्री वेङ्कटेशु पट्टपुराणियै
नॆगडु सतिकळलकुनु नीराजनं
जगति नलमेल्मङ्ग चक्कदनमुल कॆल्ल
निगुडु निजशोभनपु नीराजनं॥॥क्षीराब्धि॥
kṣīrābdhi kanyakaku śrī mahālakṣmikini
nīrajālayakunu nīrājanaṃ….kṣīrābdhi..
jalajākṣi mōmunaku jakkava kucambulaku
nelakonna kappurapu nīrājanaṃ
alivēṇi turumunaku hastakamalambulaku
niluvu māṇikyamula nīrājanaṃ….kṣīrābdhi..
caraṇa kisalayamulaku sakiya rambhōrulaku
niratamagu muttēla nīrājanaṃ
aridi jaghanambunaku nativanijanābhikini
nirati nānāvarṇa nīrājanaṃ….kṣīrābdhi..
pagaṭu śrī vēṅkaṭēśu paṭṭapurāṇiyai
negaḍu satikaḷalakunu nīrājanaṃ
jagati nalamēlmaṅga cakkadanamula kella
niguḍu nijaśōbhanapu nīrājanaṃ….kṣīrābdhi..
To the daughter of the milky ocean, to Sree Mahalakshmi,
to the one who resides in lotus, “Neerajanam”!
To Her lotus-eyed countenance, to Her attractive bosom,
with green camphor, “Neerajanam”!
To the one with braided black tresses, to Her lotus hands,
with dazzling gems, “Neerajanam”!
To Her feet as tender as sprouts, to Her great thighs,
with utmost eagerness, we offer with pearls, “Neerajanam”!
To Her attractive hips, to Her very pretty navel,
with great ardor, we offer an all colourful “Neerajanam”!
To the brilliant Lord Sree Venkateshwara’s reigning queen,
to Her ever increasing charm, “Neerajanam”!
To Alamelumanga’s all-pervading magnificence,
we offer an ever growing auspicious “Neerajanam”* !!
Neerajanam : means the waving of light or camphor, or the Aarati
3435

item.title: ०१७ वीडुगदे शेषुडु श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि
item.description:
Vīḍugadē Śēṣuḍu Śrī Vēṅkaṭādri
वीडुगदे शेषुडु श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि शेषुडु
वेडुक गरुडनितो बॆन्नुद्दैन शेषुडु॥॥वीडु॥
वेयि वडिगॆल तोड वॆलसिन शेषुडु
चायमेनि तळुकु वज्राल शेषुडु
मायनि शिरसुलपै माणिकाल शेषुडु
येयॆड हरिकि नीडै येगेटि शेषुडु॥॥वीडु॥
पट्टपु वाहनमैन बङ्गारु शेषुडु
चुट्टु चुट्टुकॊनिन मिञ्चुल शेषुडु
नट्टुकॊन्न रॆण्डुवेलु नालुकल शेषुडु
नॆट्टन हरि बॊगड नेरुपरि शेषुडु॥॥वीडु॥
कदिसि पनुलकॆल्ल गाचुकॊन्न शेषुडु
मॊदल देवतलॆल्ला मॊक्कॆ शेषुडु
अदॆ श्री वेङ्कटपति कलिमेलु मङ्गकुनु
पदरक ये पॊद्दू पानुपैन शेषुडु॥॥वीडु॥
vīḍugadē śēṣuḍu śrī vēṅkaṭādri śēṣuḍu
vēḍuka garuḍanitō bennuddaina śēṣuḍu….vīḍu..
vēyi vaḍigela tōḍa velasina śēṣuḍu
cāyamēni taḷuku vajrāla śēṣuḍu
māyani śirasulapai māṇikāla śēṣuḍu
yēyeḍa hariki nīḍai yēgēṭi śēṣuḍu….vīḍu..
paṭṭapu vāhanamaina baṅgāru śēṣuḍu
cuṭṭu cuṭṭukonina miñcula śēṣuḍu
naṭṭukonna reṇḍuvēlu nālukala śēṣuḍu
neṭṭana hari bogaḍa nērupari śēṣuḍu….vīḍu..
kadisi panulakella gācukonna śēṣuḍu
modala dēvatalellā mokke śēṣuḍu
ade śrī vēṅkaṭapati kalimēlu maṅgakunu
padaraka yē poddū pānupaina śēṣuḍu….vīḍu..
He is Sesha! Sree Venkatadri Sesha!
The one who is equal to Garuda in every respect, that Sesha!
Manifested with a thousand hoods, this Sesha
With a resplendent body like that of dazzling diamonds, this Sesha
With precious gems upon his eternal hoods, this Sesha
Constantly he provides the shade to Hari, this Sesha!
He is the royal Vahana (Vehicle), this golden Sesha
He has coiled into circles, this dazzling Sesha
With a thousand tongues is this Sesha
He is adept in praising Hari, this Sesha!
He always waits eagerly to perform duties, this Sesha
Worshipped first by all Gods is this Sesha
For Sree Venkatapathi and Alamelumanga,
he is the firm eternal couch, this Sesha!
3637

item.title: ०१८ इटु गरुडनि नी वॆक्किननु
item.description:
Iṭu Garuḍani Nī Vekkinanu
इटु गरुडनि नी वॆक्किननु
पटपट दिक्कुलु बग्गन बगिलॆ॥॥इटु॥
ऎगसिन गरुडनि येपुन “धा’ यनि
जिगि दॊलक चबुकु चेसिननु
निगमान्तम्बुलु निगम सङ्घमुलु
गगनमु जगमुलु गडगड वडकॆ॥॥इटु॥
बिरुसुग गरुडनि पेरॆमु दोलुचु
बॆरसि नीवु गोपिञ्चिननु
सरस नखिलमुलु जर्जरितमुलै
तिरुपुन नलुगड दिरदिर दिरिगॆ॥॥इटु॥
पल्लिञ्चिन नीपसिडि गरुडनिनि
कॆल्लुन नी वॆक्किनयपुडु
झल्लनॆ राक्षस समिति नी महिम
वॆल्लिमुनु गुदुरु वेङ्कटरमणा॥॥इटु॥
iṭu garuḍani nī vekkinanu
paṭapaṭa dikkulu baggana bagile….iṭu..
egasina garuḍani yēpuna “dhā’ yani
jigi dolaka cabuku cēsinanu
nigamāntambulu nigama saṅghamulu
gaganamu jagamulu gaḍagaḍa vaḍake….iṭu..
birusuga garuḍani pēremu dōlucu
berasi nīvu gōpiñcinanu
sarasa nakhilamulu jarjaritamulai
tirupuna nalugaḍa diradira dirige….iṭu..
palliñcina nīpasiḍi garuḍanini
kelluna nī vekkinayapuḍu
jhallane rākṣasa samiti nī mahima
vellimunu guduru vēṅkaṭaramaṇā….iṭu..
In this manner, when You mounted Garuda,
the four directions broke apart!
When Garuda flew up, with a deafening sound
emitting bright flashes of light,
the Vedanta and the Veda,
the sky and the worlds, all trembled!
When You rode on Garuda at great speed,
with great rage,
all the worlds became subdued
and whirled in the four directions!
Onto the saddle of the golden Garuda of Yours,
when You mounted,
the groups of Rakshasas, startled in fear,
got inundated in Your divine glory, O Venkataramana!
3839

item.title: ०१९ नीवेका चॆप्पजाप नीवॆ नीवेका
item.description:
Nīvēkā Ceppajūpa Nīve Nīvēkā
नीवेका चॆप्पजाप नीवॆ नीवेका
श्रीविभुप्रतिनिधिवि सेनमॊदलारि ॥॥नीवेका॥
नीवेका कट्टॆदुर निलुचुण्डि हरिवद्द
देवतलगनिपिञ्चे देवुडवु
येवङ्क विच्चेसिनानु यिन्दिरापतिकि निज-
सेवकुडवु नीवेका सेनमॊदलारि ॥॥नीवेका॥
पसिडिबद्दलवारु पदिगोट्टु गॊलुव
दॆसल बम्पुलु वम्पे धीरुडवु
वसमुगा मुज्जगालवारि निन्दऱिनि नी-
सिसुवुलगा नेलिन सेनमॊदलारि ॥॥नीवेका॥
दॊरलैन यसुरुल दुत्तुमुरु सेसि जग-
मिरवुगा नेलिति वेकराज्यमै
परगु सूत्रवतिपतिवै वेङ्कटविभु-
सिरुल पॆन्निधि नीवॆ सेनमॊदलारि ॥॥नीवेका॥
nīvēkā ceppajūpa nīve nīvēkā
śrīvibhupratinidhivi sēnamodalāri ….nīvēkā..
nīvēkā kaṭṭedura nilucuṇḍi harivadda
dēvatalaganipiñcē dēvuḍavu
yēvaṅka viccēsinānu yindirāpatiki nija-
sēvakuḍavu nīvēkā sēnamodalāri ….nīvēkā..
pasiḍibaddalavāru padigōṭṭu goluva
desala bampulu vampē dhīruḍavu
vasamugā mujjagālavāri nindaṟini nī-
sisuvulagā nēlina sēnamodalāri ….nīvēkā..
doralaina yasurula duttumuru sēsi jaga-
miravugā nēliti vēkarājyamai
paragu sūtravatipativai vēṅkaṭavibhu-
sirula pennidhi nīve sēnamodalāri ….nīvēkā..
You are the one to be proclaimed! You are the one, you are the one!
The representative of the Lord of Sree, O Sena Mudalari!
Standing right in front of Lord Hari,
You are the God who allows all other Gods to see Him!
In which ever manner perceived, for the Lord of Lakshmi,
you are the true servant, O Sena Mudalari!
As thousands of servants with golden batons serve you
sending orders in all directions, you are the courageous one!
You reign over the inhabitants of the three worlds
as your own children, O Sena Mudalari!
Crushing the ruling Asuras into smithereens in a valorous way,
you ruled over the entire universe as one kingdom!
O Lord of Sootravathi1, you are the great treasure of
Lord Venkatapathi, O Sena Mudalari!

item.title: ०२० ओ पवनात्मज ओ घनुड
item.description:
Ō Pavanātmaja Ō Ghanuḍa
ओ पवनात्मज ओ घनुड
बापु बापनग बरगितिगा॥॥ओ॥
वो हनुमन्तुड वुदयाचल नि
र्वाहक निजसर्व प्रबल
देहमु मोचिन तॆगुवकु निटुवलॆ
साहसमिटुवलॆ जाटितिगा॥॥ओ॥
वो रवि ग्रहण वो दनुजान्तक
मारुलेक मति मलसितिगा
दारुणपु विनतातन यादुलु
गारविम्प निटु गलिगितिगा॥॥ओ॥
वो दशमुखहर वो वेङ्कटपति
पादसरोरुहपालकु डा
यीदेहमुतो निन्नि लोकमुलु
नी देहमॆक्क निलिचितिगा॥॥ओ॥
ō pavanātmaja ō ghanuḍa
bāpu bāpanaga baragitigā….ō..
vō hanumantuḍa vudayācala ni
rvāhaka nijasarva prabala
dēhamu mōcina teguvaku niṭuvale
sāhasamiṭuvale jāṭitigā….ō..
vō ravi grahaṇa vō danujāntaka
mārulēka mati malasitigā
dāruṇapu vinatātana yādulu
gāravimpa niṭu galigitigā….ō..
vō daśamukhahara vō vēṅkaṭapati
pādasarōruhapālaku ḍā
yīdēhamutō ninni lōkamulu
nī dēhamekka nilicitigā….ō..
O Pavanatmaja1! O great one!
In a wonderful way your prowess dazzled!
O Hanumantha! O one who is capable of reaching
the eastern mountain, O one with true effulgence,
expanding your body, you showed what
courage and bravery really is!
O one who caught hold of the sun! O destroyer of demons!
you carried on with a matchless wisdom!
The mighty Garuda and others
pay their respects unto you!
O destroyer of the ten headed Ravana,
O servant of Sree Venkatapathi’s lotus like feet,
When He mounted onto you with all the worlds within His body,
you could stand supporting Him!!

item.title: ०२१ चक्रमा हरिचक्रमा
item.description:
Cakramā Haricakramā
चक्रमा हरिचक्रमा
वक्रमैन दनुजुल वक्कलिञ्चवो॥॥चक्र॥
चुट्टिचुट्टि पाताळमु चॊच्चि हिरण्याक्षुनि -
चट्टलु चीरिन वो चक्रमा
पट्टिन श्रीहरिचेत बायक यी जगमुलु
वॊट्टुकॊनि कावगदवो वो चक्रमा॥॥चक्र॥
पानुकॊनि दनुजुल बलुकिरीटमणुल
सीनल दीरिन वो चक्रमा
नाना जीवमुल प्राणमुलु गाचि धर्म -
मूनि निलुप गदवो वो चक्रमा॥॥चक्र॥
वॆऱचि ब्रह्मादुलु वेदमन्त्रमुल नी -
वुऱुट्लु गॊनियाडे रो चक्रमा
अऱिमुऱि दिरुवेकटाद्रीशु वीथुल
वॊऱवुल मॆऱयदुवो वो चक्रमा॥॥चक्र॥
cakramā haricakramā
vakramaina danujula vakkaliñcavō….cakra..
cuṭṭicuṭṭi pātāḷamu cocci hiraṇyākṣuni -
caṭṭalu cīrina vō cakramā
paṭṭina śrīharicēta bāyaka yī jagamulu
voṭṭukoni kāvagadavō vō cakramā….cakra..
pānukoni danujula balukirīṭamaṇula
sīnala dīrina vō cakramā
nānā jīvamula prāṇamulu gāci dharma -
mūni nilupa gadavō vō cakramā….cakra..
veṟaci brahmādulu vēdamantramula nī -
vuṟuṭlu goniyāḍē rō cakramā
aṟimuṟi diruvēkaṭādrīśu vīthula
voṟavula meṟayuduvō vō cakramā….cakra..
O Discus! Hari’s Discus!
Do encounter and annihilate the evil demons!
Turning and spinning, reaching the nether worlds
you tore open the hips of Hiranyaksha, O Discus!
Being wielded by Sree Hari’s hands,
as a vow, do protect these worlds, O divine Discus!
By cutting off the gems from the crowns of demons
you have become further sharpened, O Discus!
Saving the lives of various Jivas
you establish ‘Dharma’, O Discus!
Out of fear, Brahma and others, and also the Veda-mantras
praise your powerful rotations, O Discus!
Whirling about when Sree Venkataadisha is being taken
around the streets in procession, You shine splendidly, O Discus!
4445

item.title: ०२२ नमो नमो दानव विनाश चक्रमा
item.description:
Namō Namō Dānava Vināśa Cakramā
नमो नमो दानव विनाश चक्रमा
समर विजयमैन सर्वेशु चक्रमा॥॥नमो॥
अट्टॆ पदारु भुजाल नमरिन चक्रमा
पट्टिन आयधमुल बलु चक्रमा
नॆट्टन मूडु गन्नुल निलिचिन चक्रमा
ऱट्टुगा मन्निञ्चवे मॆऱयचु चक्रमा॥॥नमो॥
आरय नारुगोणाल नमरिन चक्रमा
धारलु वेयिटितोडितगु चक्रमा
आरक मीदिकि वॆळ्ळे अग्निशिखल चक्रमा
गारवान नी दासुल गाववे चक्रमा॥॥नमो॥
रविचन्द्र कोटि तेजरासियैन चक्रमा
दिविज सेवितमैन दिव्य चक्रमा
तविलि श्री वेङ्कटेशु दक्षिण कर चक्रमा
यिवल नी दासुलमु येलुकोवे चक्रमा॥॥नमो॥
namō namō dānava vināśa cakramā
samara vijayamaina sarvēśu cakramā….namō..
aṭṭe padāru bhujāla namarina cakramā
paṭṭina āyudhamula balu cakramā
neṭṭana mūḍu gannula nilicina cakramā
ṟaṭṭugā manniñcavē meṟayucu cakramā….namō..
āraya nārugōṇāla namarina cakramā
dhāralu vēyiṭitōḍitagu cakramā
āraka mīdiki veḷḷē agniśikhala cakramā
gāravāna nī dāsula gāvavē cakramā….namō..
ravicandra kōṭi tējarāsiyaina cakramā
divija sēvitamaina divya cakramā
tavili śrī vēṅkaṭēśu dakṣiṇa kara cakramā
yivala nī dāsulamu yēlukōvē cakramā….namō..
Salutations to you, O divine Discus who destroys demons!
O victorious one in battle, O Discus of the great Lord!
O divine Discus with sixteen arms
Holding divine weapons, O strong Discus
O Discus who stands with three eyes
Do forgive me completely, O shining Discus!
O eternal Discus with the six angular corners
With thousands of sharp cutting edges, O divine Discus
O Discus emitting flames of eternal fires that reach upwards
With affection, do protect your devotees, O Discus!
O Discus with the effulgence of crores of suns and moons
O Discus worshipped even by demigods
O Discus resplendently wielded by the right hand of Sree Venkatesha
Here, do rule over us, who are the servants of yours, O Discus!!!
4647

item.title: ०२३ अदिवो अल्लदिवो श्रीहरिवासमु
item.description:
Adivō Alladivō Śrīharivāsamu
अदिवो अल्लदिवो श्रीहरिवासमु
पदिवेल शेषुल पडगलमयमु ॥॥अदिवो॥
अदॆ वेङ्कटाचल मखिलोन्नतमु
अदिवो ब्रह्मादुल कपुरूपमु
अदिवो नित्यनिवास मखिलमुनुलकु
अदॆ चूडुडदॆ म्रॊक्कुडानन्दमयमु ॥॥अदिवो॥
चॆङ्गट नल्लदिवो शेषाचलमु
निङ्गि नुन्नदेवतल निजवासमु
मुङ्गिट नल्लदिवो मूलनुन्नधनमु
बङ्गारु शिखराल बहु ब्रह्ममयमु ॥॥अदिवो॥
कैवल्यपदमु वेङ्कटनगमदिवो
श्री वेङ्कटपतिकि सिरुलैनवि
भाविम्प सकलसम्पदरूपमदिवो
पावनमुलकॆल्ल पावनमयमु ॥॥अदिवो॥
adivō alladivō śrīharivāsamu
padivēla śēṣula paḍagalamayamu ….adivō..
ade vēṅkaṭācala makhilōnnatamu
adivō brahmādula kapurūpamu
adivō nityanivāsa makhilamunulaku
ade cūḍuḍade mrokkuḍānandamayamu ….adivō..
ceṅgaṭa nalladivō śēṣācalamu
niṅgi nunnadēvatala nijavāsamu
muṅgiṭa nalladivō mūlanunnadhanamu
baṅgāru śikharāla bahu brahmamayamu ….adivō..
kaivalyapadamu vēṅkaṭanagamadivō
śrī vēṅkaṭapatiki sirulainavi
bhāvimpa sakalasampadarūpamadivō
pāvanamulakella pāvanamayamu ….adivō..
There! O there is Sri Hari’s abode!
It is but Sesha’s ten thousand hoods!
That is Venkatachala, the superior most,
It is rare and precious to even Brahma and others,
It is the eternal abode of all sages,
Behold it! Salute it! It is filled with eternal bliss!
Right ahead is the Seshachala Mountain!
The true living abode of all heavenly deities,
Just a threshold away is the real treasure,
those golden cliffs, full of supreme bliss !
Bestower of eternal beatitude, there it is, the Lords city,
It is Sree Venkata’s bounteous prosperity
If you can perceive it, it is your fortune in all its entirety,
and the purest of all purity!
4849

item.title: ०२४ ऎट्टु नेरिचितिवय्य यिन्नि
item.description:
Eṭṭu Nēricitivayya Yinni
ऎट्टु नेरिचितिवय्य यिन्नि वाहनमुलॆक्क
गटिगा निंवुके हरि कडु मॆच्चेमय्या॥॥ऎट्टु॥
गरुडुनि मीद नॆक्कि गमनिञ्चितिवि नाडु
अरुदैन पारिजातहरणानकु
गरिमतो रथमॆक्कि कदलिति वल्लनाडु
सॊरदि ब्राह्मणपडुचुल नुद्धरिञ्चनु॥॥ऎट्टु॥
चक्कगा गुबेरुनि पुष्पक मॆक्कि कदलिति
मक्कुव सीतादेवि मरलिञ्चनु
तक्कक वायजु नॆक्कि दाडि Ќवॆट्टितिवि नाडु
चॊक्कपु वानरुल पौजुलु चूडनु॥॥ऎट्टु॥
कॊट्टगन नीवु राति गुऱ्ऱमु नॆक्कि तोलिति
पट्टियॆड न धर्ममु नडचगनु
मॆट्टुक श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि मीद बल्लकि यॆक्किति
विट्टॆ यिन्दिर गूडि येगु बॆण्ड्लि येगनु॥॥ऎट्टु॥
eṭṭu nēricitivayya yinni vāhanamulekka
gaṭigā niṃvukē hari kaḍu meccēmayyā….eṭṭu..
garuḍuni mīda nekki gamaniñcitivi nāḍu
arudaina pārijātaharaṇānaku
garimatō rathamekki kadaliti vallanāḍu
soradi brāhmaṇapaḍucula nuddhariñcanu….eṭṭu..
cakkagā gubēruni puṣpaka mekki kadaliti
makkuva sītādēvi maraliñcanu
takkaka vāyuju nekki dāḍi vetṭitivi nāḍu
cokkapu vānarula paujulu cūḍanu….eṭṭu..
koṭṭagana nīvu rāti guṟṟamu nekki tōliti
paṭṭiyeḍa na dharmamu naḍacaganu
meṭṭuka śrī vēṅkaṭādri mīda ballaki yekkiti
viṭṭe yindira gūḍi yēgu beṇḍli yēganu….eṭṭu..
How did You learn, O Lord, the skill of mounting so many Vahanas?
This is the reason O Hari, we appreciate You immensely!
You mounted onto Garuda on that day,
when You wanted to lift off the Parijatha tree!
With greatness, You mounted the chariot on that day,
when You blessed the Brahmin ladies with deliverance!
Beautifully, You mounted onto ‘Pushpaka’, the flying chariot of Kubera,
to lovingly bring back Sita-devi!
Befittingly, You mounted onto Hanuman to wage a battle,
and to see the mighty array of the vanara forces!
At the end, You mounted onto the might horse
to counter Adharma and destroy it!
And upon Sree Venkatadri, You mounted the palanquin
along with Lakshmi, to proceed for Your wedding!!!
5051

item.title: ०२५ सकल लोकेश्वरुलु सरुस
item.description:
Sakala Lōkēśvarulu Sarusa
सकल लोकेश्वरुलु सरुस चेकॊनुवाडु
अकलङ्कमुग पुष्प यागम्बु ॥॥ सकल ॥
विविध मन्त्रमुलतो वेदफॆूषमुलतो
अवल तिरुवामुडिय अङ्गनल आटतो
कविवन्दिनुतुलतो कम्म पूजलतोड -
नवधरिञ्ची पुष्प यागम्बु ॥॥ सकल ॥
कप्पुरपुटारतुल घनचन्दनमु तोड
तॆप्पल धूपमुल तिरुवन्दि कापुतो
ऒप्पु(ग) पण्यारमुलु वॊगि पॆक्कुवगलतो
अप्पडन्दी पुष्प यागम्बु ॥॥ सकल ॥
तगु छत्र चामर ताम्बुलमुलतोड
पगटुतो नीरीति पदिपूजलन्दुकॊनि
जिगिमीरॆ चूडरे श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरुनि
अगणितम्बगु पुष्प यागम्बु ॥॥ सकल ॥
sakala lōkēśvarulu sarusa cēkonuvāḍu
akalaṅkamuga puṣpa yāgambu …. sakala ..
vividha mantramulatō vēdaghōṣamulatō
avala tiruvāmuḍiyu aṃganala āṭatō
kavivandinutulatō kamma pūjalatōḍa -
navadhariñcī puṣpa yāgambu …. sakala ..
kappurapuṭāratula ghanacandanamu tōḍa
teppala dhūpamula tiruvandi kāputō
oppu(ga) paṇyāramulu vogi pekkuvagalatō
appaḍandī puṣpa yāgambu …. sakala ..
tagu chatra cāmara tāmbulamulatōḍa
pagaṭutō nīrīti padipūjalandukoni
jigimīre cūḍarē śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaruni
agaṇitambagu puṣpa yāgambu …. sakala ..
He, the Lord of all the worlds, receives gracefully,
in a pristine manner, the Pushpayagam1!
Along with various mantras, along with the Veda Goshas
with the recitation of Tiruvaimozi2, along with dancing damsels
along with praises sung by poets, along with pleasing worship,
He is adorned by the Pushpayagam!
Along with camphor arathi, along with pure sandal paste,
along with plentiful incense, along with the Tirumandikapu3
along with agreeable Paniyarams4, with duly offered abundant luxuries,
the Almighty receives the Pushpayagam!
Along with the umbrellas, with the fans, with beetle leaf offerings,
joyously receiving in this manner the various kinds of worship,
Behold! He excelled in brilliance, this Lord Sree Venkateshwara,
in the glorious Pushpayagam!
1.10th day of Brahmotsavam
2.Nammalwar’s work of one thousand Prabandhams
3.Waving of the lamp
4.Food offerings
5253

item.title: ०२६ मरिगि वीरॆपो मादैवम्बुलु
item.description:
Marigi Vīrepō Mādaivambulu
मरिगि वीरॆपो मादैवम्बुलु
कॆरलिन हरि सङ्कीर्तनपरुलु ॥॥ मरिगि ॥
विनियॆडिवीनुलु विष्णुकथलके
पनिगॊन्दुरु माप्रपन्नुलु
कवियॆडिकन्नुलु कमलाक्षुनिलयं -
दनुवु परतु रटु हरि सेवकुलु ॥॥ मरिगि ॥
पलिकॆडिपलुकुलु परमात्मुनिकै
यलवरतुरु शरणागतुलु
तलचेटि तलपुलु धरणीधरुपै
तलकॊलुपुदु रातदिय्यलु ॥॥ मरिगि ॥
करमुल श्रीपतिकैङ्कर्यमुले
मुरियचु जेतुरु मुमुक्षुलु
यिरवुग श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुमतमे
सिरुल नम्मुदुरु श्रीवैष्णवुलु ॥॥ मरिगि ॥
marigi vīrepō mādaivambulu
keralina hari saṅkīrtanaparulu …. marigi ..
viniyeḍivīnulu viṣṇukathalakē
panigonduru māprapannulu
kaviyeḍikannulu kamalākṣunilayaṃ -
danuvu paratu raṭu hari sēvakulu …. marigi ..
palikeḍipalukulu paramātmunikai
yalavaraturu śaraṇāgatulu
talacēṭi talapulu dharaṇīdharupai
talakolupudu rātadiyyulu …. marigi ..
karamula śrīpatikaiṅkaryamulē
muriyucu jēturu mumukṣulu
yiravuga śrīvēṅkaṭēśvarumatamē
sirula nammuduru śrīvaiṣṇavulu …. marigi ..
They themselves are like our Gods!
Those great ones who praise Hari ardently!
The ears that can hear, they use them only to listen to
the glories of Vishnu, our Prapannas!
The eyes that can see, they fix them only upon
the Lotus eyed Lord, the servants of Hari!
The words they utter, they are accustomed to use them
only to praise Paramatma, the Sharanagathas!
The thoughts that they think of, they concentrate them upon
Lord Dharanidhara, these Tadeeyas1!
Their hands, they joyously offer in the service of
Sree-Pathi, these Mumukshus2!
They resolutely consider SreeVenkateshwaras doctrine
as the true treasure, these Sree Vaishnavas!
1.Tadeeyas are ‘Those who belong to Him’ (i.e those who surrender to Lord Hari)
2.Those who aspire for Moksha, i.e Salvation
5455

item.title: ०२७ दैवमा नीकु वॆलिता
item.description:
Daivamā Nīku Velitā
दैवमा नीकु वॆलिता तलपुवॆलितेकाक
वेवेलुकर्माल वेसारग वलसॆ ॥॥ दैवमा ॥
हरियण्टे बापेटि अन्नि पापालु सेसिन
पॊरि नन्दुपै नम्मिक पुट्टदुगाक
नरसिंहयण्टे वच्चेनानापुण्यालकु
तिरमुगा ऋणमुलु दीर्चुकॊनगलना ॥॥ दैवमा ॥
देव जगन्नाथयण्टे तॆगनि जन्ममु लेवि
कैवशमु नामनसु गादुगाक
गोविन्दयनियण्टे गूडनिपदवु लेवि
काविरि गाल मूरकॆ कडपेमु नेमु ॥॥ दैवमा ॥
वेदनारायणयण्टे वीडेटिबन्धमुलु
आदिगा मूडुलोकालनैना नुन्नदा
श्रीदेविपतियैन श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुडा
येदॆसा नीवे नन्नु यीडेर्तुवुगाक ॥॥ दैवमा ॥
daivamā nīku velitā talapuvelitēkāka
vēvēlukarmāla vēsāraga valase …. daivamā ..
hariyaṇṭē bāpēṭi anni pāpālu sēsina
pori nandupai nammika puṭṭadugāka
narasiṃhayaṇṭē vaccēnānāpuṇyālaku
tiramugā ṛṇamulu dīrcukonagalanā …. daivamā ..
dēva jagannāthayaṇṭē tegani janmamu lēvi
kaivaśamu nāmanasu gādugāka
gōvindayaniyaṇṭē gūḍanipadavu lēvi
kāviri gāla mūrake kaḍapēmu nēmu …. daivamā ..
vēdanārāyaṇayaṇṭē vīḍēṭibandhamulu
ādigā mūḍulōkālanainā nunnadā
śrīdēvipatiyaina śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruḍā
yēdesā nīvē nannu yīḍērtuvugāka …. daivamā ..
O Lord, is there any shortcoming in You? Our thoughts alone are deficient!
Getting caught in thousands of Karmas, we become vexed!
Though by saying ‘Hari’ even once, all accrued sins get destroyed,
yet strong faith never originates in us!
By saying ‘Narasimha’ we acquire various merits
how can we ever repay for it?
By saying ‘Deva! Jagannatha!’ will not the cycle of births be severed!
But my mind is never under my own control!
By saying ‘Govinda!’ though there are no posts that cannot be attained,
yet we while away our time aimlessly!
‘Veda-Narayana!’ if we say, our attachments will let go
Is there anything greater than this in the three worlds, from ever before?
O consort of Sree Devi! O Sree Venkatesha!
You alone save us in every way!
5657

item.title: ०२८ पट्टिनदॆल्ला ब्रह्ममु
item.description:
Paṭṭinadellā Brahmamu
पट्टिनदॆल्ला ब्रह्ममु
दट्टपुजडुनिकि दैवम्बेला ॥॥ पट्टिन ॥
घनयाचकुनकु कनकमे ब्रह्ममु
तनुवे ब्रह्ममु तरुवलिकि
यॆनय गामुकुन किन्तुले ब्रह्ममु
तनलो वॆलिगेटि तत्वं बेला ॥॥ पट्टिन ॥
आकटिवानिकि नन्नमे ब्रह्ममु
लोकमे ब्रह्ममु लोलुनिकि
कै कॊनि कर्मिकि कालमे ब्रह्ममु
श्रीकान्तुनिपै जिं तदि येला ॥॥ पट्टिन ॥
भुवि संसारिकि पुत्रुलॆ ब्रह्ममु
नव मिन्दरि किदि नडचेदि
यिवलनु श्री वेङ्कटेशुदासुलकु
भव मतनिकृपे ब्रह्ममु ॥॥ पट्टिन ॥
paṭṭinadellā brahmamu
daṭṭapujaḍuniki daivambēlā …. paṭṭina ..
ghanayācakunaku kanakamē brahmamu
tanuvē brahmamu taruvaliki
yenaya gāmukuna kintulē brahmamu
tanalō veligēṭi tatvaṃ bēlā …. paṭṭina ..
ākaṭivāniki nannamē brahmamu
lōkamē brahmamu lōluniki
kai koni karmiki kālamē brahmamu
śrīkāntunipai jiṃ tadi yēlā …. paṭṭina ..
bhuvi saṃsāriki putrule brahmamu
nava mindari kidi naḍacēdi
yivalanu śrī vēṅkaṭēśudāsulaku
bhava matanikṛpē brahmamu …. paṭṭina ..
All that which is acquired is the Supreme,
for the highly ignorant one. Why at all a God for him?
For a lowly beggar, gold is the Supreme
The body is Supreme for one who is aroused
For a lustful one, women are the Supreme
The inner effulgent eternal truth, why for them?
For a hungry one, food is the Supreme
The world is Supreme for one who is enamored by it
For a diligent worker, time itself is Supreme
Why for them, the thought upon the Lord of Sree!
For an earthly Samsarin, progeny is the Supreme
For these people, this alone is the ever-fresh way of life!
Whereas, for the dasas of Sree Venkatesha,
in worldly existence, His grace alone is the Supreme!
5859

item.title: ०२९ परमवैष्णवुल भाग्यं बिदिवो
item.description:
Paramavaiṣṇavula Bhāgyaṃ Bidivō
परमवैष्णवुल भाग्यं बिदिवो
निरतिवारलकॆ ने मॊक्कॆदनु ॥॥ परम ॥
तलच रॊकप्पुडु धरणि भोगमुलु
तलच रितरमतदैवमुल
तलतु रॊकटि हरिदासुलदास्यमु
तलपु मोक्षमुलतगुलमि (मॆ?) गान ॥॥ परम ॥
कोररु ब्रह्मदिगुरुतरपदमुलु
कोररु मेरवुकॊन सुखमु
कोरुदुरु तदिय्यकोट्लसङ्गमु
कोरिक भक्तितो गूडीगान ॥॥ परम ॥
वॊल्लरु कर्ममु लॊल्लरु पुण्यमु
लॊल्लरहङ्कार मॊकपरिय
वुल्लमे श्रीवेङ्कटोत्तमु शरणनि
यॆल्लन्दु दुदिपद मॆक्किरिगान ॥॥ परम ॥
paramavaiṣṇavula bhāgyaṃ bidivō
nirativāralake nē mokkedanu …. parama ..
talaca rokappuḍu dharaṇi bhōgamulu
talaca ritaramatadaivamula
talatu rokaṭi haridāsuladāsyamu
talapu mōkṣamulatagulami (me?) gāna …. parama ..
kōraru brahmadigurutarapadamulu
kōraru mēravukona sukhamu
kōruduru tadiyyakōṭlasaṅgamu
kōrika bhaktitō gūḍīgāna …. parama ..
vollaru karmamu lollaru puṇyamu
lollarahaṅkāra mokapariyu
vullamē śrīvēṅkaṭōttamu śaraṇani
yellandu dudipada mekkirigāna …. parama ..
This is the fortune of Parama-Vaishnavas!
Constantly I pay my salutations to them!
They don’t think even once of earthly comforts,
they don’t think of the Gods of other philosophies!
But they think of being the servants of the servants of Hari,
because their thoughts are towards Moksha!
They don’t desire for posts like that of Brahma and others,
they do not even desire the pleasure of the highest kind!
But they desire the company of crores of Tadeeyas1,
because their desires are coupled with Bhakti!
They do not accept Karmas, not even merits,
they do not accept arrogance even once!
Offering their hearts in surrender to the Supreme Venkatesha,
they have already attained the highest post!

item.title: ०३० नीवु नासॊम्मवु नेनु नीसॊम्मु
item.description:
Nīvu Nāsommavu Nēnu Nīsommu
नीवु नासॊम्मवु नेनु नीसॊम्मु
यीवल नीवॆपुडु मायिण्ट नुण्ड दगवा ॥॥ नीवु ॥
हरि नीरूपमु नाकु नाचार्युडु मुन्नॆ
कॆरलि नापाल नप्पगिञ्चिनाडु
नरहरि निनु ने नन्यायमुन दॆलियनु
पॊरबडि नी वॆन्दु बोदगुना ॥॥ नीवु ॥
जननि नीदेवि लक्ष्मि जनकुडवु नीवॆ
तनुवुलु नात्मबान्धवमु नीवे
अनयमु नेनॆन्त यपराधिनैनानु
पनिवडि नीवु नन्नु बायदगुना ॥॥ नीवु ॥
बहुवेदमुलु निन्नु भक्तवत्सलुडवनि
सहजबिरुदु भुवि जाटीनि
यिहमुन श्रीवेङ्कटेश यिदि दलचैन
विहितमै नाकडकु विच्चेयवे ॥॥ नीवु ॥
nīvu nāsommavu nēnu nīsommu
yīvala nīvepuḍu māyiṇṭa nuṇḍa dagavā …. nīvu ..
hari nīrūpamu nāku nācāryuḍu munne
kerali nāpāla nappagiñcināḍu
narahari ninu nē nanyāyamuna deliyanu
porabaḍi nī vendu bōdagunā …. nīvu ..
janani nīdēvi lakṣmi janakuḍavu nīve
tanuvulu nātmabāndhavamu nīvē
anayamu nēnenta yaparādhinainānu
panivaḍi nīvu nannu bāyadagunā …. nīvu ..
bahuvēdamulu ninnu bhaktavatsaluḍavani
sahajabirudu bhuvi jāṭīni
yihamuna śrīvēṅkaṭēśa yidi dalacaina
vihitamai nākaḍaku viccēyavē …. nīvu ..
You are my property, and I am Your property!
For this reason, why don’t You stay in my house for ever?
O Hari! My Acharya bestowed Your perceivable form
unto me long ago, with abounding joy!
O Nara-Hari! I did not know You by any unjust means
Is it right then for You to go away even by mistake?
Your consort Lakshmi is my mother, You are my father
You alone are my physical existence and soul-relation!
However great a sinner I am,
can You ever let go of me intentionally?
The many Vedas conferred on You the appropriate title of
‘Bhakta Vatsala’1, and proclaimed the same on this earth!
Now, O Sree Venkatesha, remembering that,
do come to me in a befitting way!
This is the song that Annamacharya sang to his personal deity!

item.title: ०३१ चदिवि बतुकरो सर्वजनुलु मीरु
item.description:
Cadivi Batukarō Sarvajanulu Mīru
चदिवि बतुकरो सर्वजनुलु मीरु
कदिसि नारायणाष्टाक्षर मिदिये ॥॥ चदिवि ॥
सादिञ्चि मुन्नु शुकुडु चदिविनट्टि चदुवु
वेदव्यासुलु चदिविन चदुवु
आदिकालपु वैष्णवुलन्दरि नोटि चदुवु
गादलि नारायणाष्टाक्षर मिदिये ॥॥ चदिवि ॥
सततमु मुनुलॆल्ल चदिविनट्टि चदुवु
वॆतदीर ब्रह्म चदिविन चदुवु
जतनमै प्रह्लादुडु चदिविनट्टि चदुवु
गतिगा नारायणाष्टाक्षर मिदिये ॥॥ चदिवि ॥
चलपट्टि देवतलु चदिविनट्टि चदुवु
वॆलय विप्रुलु चदिवेटि चदुवु
पलुमारु श्रीवेङ्कटपतिनाममै भुवि
गलुगु नारायणाष्टाक्षर मिदिये ॥॥ चदिवि ॥
cadivi batukarō sarvajanulu mīru
kadisi nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣara midiyē …. cadivi ..
sādiñci munnu śukuḍu cadivinaṭṭi caduvu
vēdavyāsulu cadivina caduvu
ādikālapu vaiṣṇavulandari nōṭi caduvu
gādali nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣara midiyē …. cadivi ..
satatamu munulella cadivinaṭṭi caduvu
vetadīra brahma cadivina caduvu
jatanamai prahlāduḍu cadivinaṭṭi caduvu
gatigā nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣara midiyē …. cadivi ..
calapaṭṭi dēvatalu cadivinaṭṭi caduvu
velaya viprulu cadivēṭi caduvu
palumāru śrīvēṅkaṭapatināmamai bhuvi
galugu nārāyaṇāṣṭākṣara midiyē …. cadivi ..
Recite this and live, all of you, O people!
Dwell upon it, this is the Narayana Astakshari!
Having obtained it, this is the one that was recited by Shuka previously
This is the one that was recited by Veda-Vyasa
This is the one that was recited by the Vaishnavas during the ancient times
This is the adorable Narayana Astakshari!
This is the one eternally studied by the sages
This is the one recited by Lord Brahma to win over troubles
This is the one ardently recited by Prahalada
This is the only means, the Narayana Astakshari!
This is the one that is recited by the Devas diligently
This is the one recited by the Brahmin clan
Time and again, becoming Sree Venkateshwaras name
it exists on this earth, this Narayana Astakshari!
6465

item.title: ०३२ नरुलार नेडुवो नरसिंहजयन्ति
item.description:
Narulāra Nēḍuvō Narasiṃhajayanti
नरुलार नेडुवो नरसिंहजयन्ति
सुरलकु नानन्दमै शुभमुलॊसगॆनु ॥॥ नरुलार ॥
सन्दिञ्चि वैशाखशुद्धचतुर्दशि शनिवार -
मन्दु सन्ध्याकालमुन नौभळेशुडु
पॊन्दुगा गम्भमुलोन बॊडमि कडपमीद
कन्दुव गोळ्ळजिञ्चॆ गनककशिवुनि ॥॥ नरुलार ॥
नरमृगरूपमु नानाहस्तमुल
अरिदि शङ्खचक्रादि आयधालतो
गरिम ब्रह्लादुनि गाचिरक्षिञ्चि निलिचॆ
गुरुतरब्रह्माण्ड गुहलोननु ॥॥ नरुलार ॥
काञ्चनपुगद्दॆमीद गक्कन गॊलुवैयण्डि
मिञ्चुग निन्दिर दॊडमीद बॆट्टुक
अञ्चॆ श्रीवेङ्कटगिरि नादिमपुरुषुण्डै
वञ्चनसेयक मञ्चिवरालिच्चीनदिवो ॥॥ नरुलार ॥
narulāra nēḍuvō narasiṃhajayanti
suralaku nānandamai śubhamulosagenu …. narulāra ..
sandiñci vaiśākhaśuddhacaturdaśi śanivāra -
mandu sandhyākālamuna naubhaḷēśuḍu
pondugā gambhamulōna boḍami kaḍapamīda
kanduva gōḷḷajiñce ganakakaśivuni …. narulāra ..
naramṛgarūpamu nānāhastamula
aridi śaṅkhacakrādi āyudhālatō
garima brahlāduni gācirakṣiñci nilice
gurutarabrahmāṇḍa guhalōnanu …. narulāra ..
kāñcanapugaddemīda gakkana goluvaiyuṇḍi
miñcuga nindira doḍamīda beṭṭuka
aṃce śrīvēṅkaṭagiri nādimapuruṣuṇḍai
vañcanasēyaka mañcivarāliccīnadivō …. narulāra ..
O people, today is Narasimha Jayanthi!
Bringing happiness to all divinities, it bestowed propitious-ness!
On Vaishaka Suddha Chaturdashi, a Saturday,
during the twilight hours, the Lord of Ahobilam
emerged magnificently from the pillar
and on the threshold, ripped apart Hiranyakasipu with His nails!
The one in the form of a man-beast, with many hands
holding the Shanka-Chakra and other weapons,
He stood after having rescued and blessed Prahalada
inside the great ‘Brahmanda’1 like cave!
Upon a golden throne, in the royal court,
placing Lakshmi on his thigh, He exists!
Behold! Upon Sree Venkatagiri, as the Adi-Purusha
He unfailingly bestows great boons!

item.title: ०३३ गुट्टुन गोरिकलॆल्ला गॊल्लवट्टी
item.description:
Guṭṭuna Gōrikalellā Gollavaṭṭī
गुट्टुन गोरिकलॆल्ला गॊल्लवट्टी नी
पट्टपुदेविकि नीकु पल्लाण्डु पल्लाण्डु ॥॥ गुट्टुन ॥
पच्चल सन्दिदण्डलु बाहुपुरुलु मॆरय
नॆच्चलिपै मेनु सोक निलुचुण्डि
पच्चविलुकानितल्लि बङ्गारु दोसिट नीपै
बच्चकप्पुरमु चल्ली पल्लाण्डु पल्लाण्डु॥॥ गुट्टुन ॥
मन्तनपु माटलतो माटुग निन्नु सॊलसि
कॊन्तपु गोळ्ळनिग्गु गुम्मरिम्पुचु
चॆन्तल जॆङ्गलुवलु चॆलुलु चेनन्दिय्यग
पन्तमुन नीपै वेसि पल्लाण्डु पल्लाण्डु ॥॥ गुट्टुन ॥
अलरुल मेडलोन अलमेलु मङ्ग नी
यलयक दीर ब्रेम नलरजेसि
कलसि वेङ्कटेश नीकौगिलि चेकॊनी निदे
पलुमारु मीकु मीकु पल्लाण्डु पल्लाण्डु ॥॥ गुट्टुन ॥
guṭṭuna gōrikalellā gollavaṭṭī nī
paṭṭapudēviki nīku pallāṇḍu pallāṇḍē …. guṭṭuna ..
paccala sandidaṇḍalu bāhupurulu meraya
neccalipai mēnu sōka nilucuṇḍi
paccavilukānitalli baṅgāru dōsiṭa nīpai
baccakappuramu callī pallāṇḍu pallāṇḍē…. guṭṭuna.
mantanapu māṭalatō māṭuga ninnu solasi
kontapu gōḷḷaniggu gummarimpucu
centala jeṅgaluvalu celulu cēnandiyyaga
pantamuna nīpai vēsi pallāṇḍu pallāṇḍē …. guṭṭuna
alarula mēḍalōna alamēlu maṅga nī
yalayaka dīra brēma nalarajēsi
kalasi vēṅkaṭēśa nīkaugili cēkonī nidē
palumāru mīku mīku pallāṇḍu pallāṇḍē …. guṭṭuna
All your secretive desires, do enjoy to the fullest!
To Your reigning Queen, and to You, Pallandu! Pallandu!
With shining thighs and arms adorned by emerald studded ornaments,
leaning onto Her companion, the mother of the one who wields
the green bow2, sprinkles from her golden like cupped palms,
the green camphor upon You! Pallandu! Pallandu!
With Her sweet secret words, in privy, she made You faint in ecstasy
with the glow radiating from Her tender nails,
when Her companions offered the water lilies to Her hands,
She showered them upon You intentionally! Pallandu! Pallandu!
In the magnificent mansion, Alamelumanga,
in order to pacify Your anger, gratifies You with Her Love
and unites with You in an embrace, O Venkatesha!
Many times over, for the two of You, Pallandu! Pallandu!

item.title: ०३४ ऎट्टयिना जेसुको इक नी चित्तमु
item.description:
Eṭṭayinā Jēsukō Ika Nī Cittamu
ऎट्टयिना जेसुको इक नी चित्तमु नन्नु
पट्टिच्चॆ मागुरुडु नीपादालु विडुवनु ॥॥ ऎट्टयिना ॥
पोडिमि ना नाममुलु पॊद्दुवॊद्दु नुडिगीनि
वीडेमडुगुनोयनि वॆऱवकुमी
नाडे नायाचार्युडु नाकु नन्नी यिच्चिनाडु
ने डिदेलण्टे नतनिनेममु ने माननु ॥॥ ऎट्टयिना ॥
प्रेमतो वीडु नन्निण्ट बॆट्टुक पूजिञ्चीनि
येमिगारणमोयनि यॆञ्चुकोकुमी
कामिञ्चि याचार्यडे कारणमु नीकु नाकु
यी मरुलेलण्टे नातडिच्चिनसॊम्मे नेनु ॥॥ ऎट्टयिना ॥
पलुमारु वीडु नापै बत्ति चेसि नेटिकिनि
वॆलय श्री वेङ्कटेश वेसरकुमी
यॆलमि नाचार्युडिदेपनि चेसिनाडु
निलचॆ गलकालमु नीकु नाकु बोदु ॥॥ ऎट्टयिना ॥
eṭṭayinā jēsukō ika nī cittamu nannu
paṭṭicce māguruḍu nīpādālu viḍuvanu …. eṭṭayinā ..
pōḍimi nā nāmamulu podduvoddu nuḍigīni
vīḍēmaḍugunōyani veṟavakumī
nāḍē nāyācāryuḍu nāku nannī yiccināḍu
nē ḍidēlaṇṭē nataninēmamu nē mānanu …. eṭṭayinā ..
prēmatō vīḍu nanniṇṭa beṭṭuka pūjiñcīni
yēmigāraṇamōyani yeñcukōkumī
kāmiñci yācāryaḍē kāraṇamu nīku nāku
yī marulēlaṇṭē nātaḍiccinasommē nēnu …. eṭṭayinā
palumāru vīḍu nāpai batti cēsi nēṭikini
velaya śrī vēṅkaṭēśa vēsarakumī
yelami nācāryuḍidēpani cēsināḍu
nilace galakālamu nīku nāku bōdu …. eṭṭayinā ..
Do what You want with me! It is up to You!
My guru made me hold You feet, I will not let go!
Thinking “he chants my name at all times,
what may he ask of me?”, do not get worried.
Earlier itself, my Acharya blessed me with everything
today when questioned ‘Why this?’, I will never let go of his principles!
“With love he worships me, placing me in his house,
what might be the reason?”- do not think in this manner.
My devout Acharya is the very reason between You and me!
If asked ‘why this love?’, my Acharya offered me unto You!
“Repeatedly why he worships me?”
do not get vexed in this manner, O Sree Venkatesha!
Joyously my Acharya did the same thing,
this remains for eternity, You and I will never be separated!
7071

item.title: ०३५ ऎव्वरु दिक्किङ्क नाकु
item.description:
Evvaru Dikkiṅka Nāku
ऎव्वरु दिक्किङ्क नाकु नेदि बुद्धि
यिव्वल विचारिञ्चवे इन्दिरारमणा ॥॥ ऎव्वरु ॥
वॆण्टबॆट्टि कामक्रोधविततुलु चुट्टि नन्नु
तॊण्टि मी सेवकु नन्नु दूरमु सेसॆ
कण्टकपुटिन्द्रियालु कडुहितशत्रुलै
अण्टिन मोक्षमुत्रोव नण्टकुण्डा जेसॆनु ॥॥ ऎव्वरु ॥
तिप्पि तिप्पि नायासलु तॆगि वैष्णवधर्मान
दॆप्पल देलकुण्डानु तीदीपु सेसॆ
वॊप्पगुसंसार मिदि वुन्नति नाचार्यसेव
चॊप्पु मापि पुण्यानकु जॊरकुण्डा जेसॆनु ॥॥ ऎव्वरु ॥
मच्चरपुदेह मिदिमनसिट्टॆ पण्डनीक
तच्चि यज्ञानमुनकु दावुसेसॆ
इच्चल श्रीवेङ्कटेश इन्तलो नन्नु नेलग
निच्चलु नीकृपे नन्नु निर्मलमु सेसॆनु ॥॥ ऎव्वरु ॥
evvaru dikkiṅka nāku nēdi buddhi
yivvala vicāriñcavē iṃdirāramaṇā …. evvaru ..
veṇṭabeṭṭi kāmakrōdhavitatulu cuṭṭi nannu
toṇṭi mī sēvaku nannu dūramu sēse
kaṇṭakapuṭindriyālu kaḍuhitaśatrulai
aṃṭina mōkṣamutrōva naṇṭakuṇḍā jēsenu …. evvaru ..
tippi tippi nāyāsalu tegi vaiṣṇavadharmāna
deppala dēlakuṇḍānu tīdīpu sēse
voppagusaṃsāra midi vunnati nācāryasēva
coppu māpi puṇyānaku jorakuṇḍā jēsenu …. evvaru ..
maccarapudēha midimanasiṭṭe paṇḍanīka
tacci yajñānamunaku dāvusēse
iccala śrīvēṅkaṭēśa iṃtalō nannu nēlaga
niccalu nīkṛpē nannu nirmalamu sēsenu …. evvaru ..
Who is the refuge for me? Where is the right knowledge?
Do think about it, O Indira-Ramana!
Not letting go, the overpowering Kama and Krodha have surrounded me,
and have refrained me from performing service unto You!
The troublesome senses, becoming the foes to my well being,
have not allowed me to take the path to the attainable Moksha!
Over and over again, my desires have prevented me from enjoying
blissfully the Sree-Vaishnava dharma, causing me immense distress!
This attractive Samsara has obstructed me from
gaining the merits of the superior service of Acharya!
This body full of malice has obstructed the mind from mellowing,
and has made way for ignorance by deceiving me!
Here, O Sree Venkatesha, as You rule over me,
eternally Your grace alone has made me pure and pristine!
7273

item.title: ०३६ काकुण्टे यीशून्यवाद
item.description:
Kākuṇṭē Yīśūnyavāda
काकुण्टे यीशून्यवादकठिनचित्तुलचेत
पै कॊनि विवेकुलकु ब्रदुकगवच्चुना ॥॥ काकुण्टे ॥
अल्लनाडु निराकारमनॆडि माटलचेत
वॆल्लिबोय लोकमुलो विज्ञानमॆल्ला
कल्लनि मीत्रिविक्रमाकारमु चूपि मीरु
चॆल्लबॆट्टितिरि वेदशिखलन्दु मरिय ॥॥ काकुण्टे ॥
आलकिञ्चि यहम्ब्रह्ममनॆडिबुद्धुलचेत
गालिबोय भक्तियल्ला कालमन्दे
येलि प्रह्लादुनिकिगा हिरण्यकशिपुनॊद्द
येलिकबण्टुवरुस लिन्दॆ चूपितिरि ॥॥ काकुण्टे ॥
अन्ता नॊक्कटियने अधर्मविधुलचेत
गुन्तबडॆ बुण्यमॆल्ला गॊल्लबोयि
इन्तट श्री वेङ्कटेश यॆक्कुडु नेननि कॊण्ड
विन्तगाग बॊडवॆक्कि विऱ्ऱवीगितिवि ॥॥ काकुण्टे ॥
kākuṇṭē yīśūnyavādakaṭhinacittulacēta
pai koni vivēkulaku bradukagavaccunā …. kākuṇṭē ..
allanāḍu nirākāramaneḍi māṭalacēta
vellibōya lōkamulō vijñānamellā
kallani mītrivikramākāramu cūpi mīru
cellabeṭṭitiri vēdaśikhalandu mariyu …. kākuṇṭē ..
ālakiñci yahambrahmamaneḍibuddhulacēta
gālibōya bhaktiyallā kālamandē
yēli prahlādunikigā hiraṇyakaśipunodda
yēlikabaṇṭuvarusa linde cūpitiri …. kākuṇṭē ..
aṃtā nokkaṭiyanē adharmavidhulacēta
guntabaḍe buṇyamellā gollabōyi
iṃtaṭa śrī vēṅkaṭēśa yekkuḍu nēnani koṇḍa
vintagāga boḍavekki viṟṟavīgitivi …. kākuṇṭē ..
If not for You, how under the influence of the rigid minded Sunyavadins1,
could the wise people rise above and survive!
In the past, the worlds were filled with
the doctrine of ‘Nirakara’2!
Proving that it is untrue, by showing Your form of Trivikrama,
You established the authority of the Vedas!
Hearing the words of those who proclaim ‘Aham Brahmasmi’3,
all devotion had been blown away into the winds!
During that time itself, You showed to Prahalada, in front of Hiranyakasipu,
the difference between the ‘Ruler’ and the ‘Servant’!
Because of the unrighteous injunctions that proclaim ‘Everything is one’
all merit was lost and people became lowly!
Then, saying “I am the Highest”, O Sree Venkatesha,
You manifested Yourself and prospered as the wonder on the mountain!
1.The Buddhists
2.The doctrine of the formless God, the Nirguna Brahman
3.The doctrine which holds that the Jiva itself is the Lord (Advaita)
7475

item.title: ०३७ अय्यो विकल्पवादुलन्तटा
item.description:
Ayyō Vikalpavādulantaṭā
अय्यो विकल्पवादुलन्तटा सिग्गुवडरु
यिय्यॆड नॆट्टुगलिगॆ नीयसुरमतमु ॥॥ अय्यो ॥
नीमुद्रलू नॊल्लरु नीदासोहमु नॊल्लरु
कामिञ्चि नीमीदिभक्ति कडु नॊल्लरु
नाममन्त्रमु नॊल्ल रनामयण्ड वनॆन्दुरु
तामु वैष्णवुल मण्टा दर्किन्तुरु ॥॥ अय्यो ॥
पैतृकवेळ नी प्रसादमू नॊल्लरु
घातलनूर्ध्वपुण्ड्रमु गादन्दुरु
जातरदैवाल निन्नु सरिगा बूजिन्तुरु
आतल वैष्णवुलु दामनुकॊन्दुरु ॥॥ अय्यो ॥
श्री वैष्णवुल गण्टे जेतुलॆत्ति मॊक्करु
भाविन्तुरु पगवारिवलॆ गन्नट्टु
आवल वैकुण्ठमू अनित्यमन्दुरु
काविञ्चि वैष्णवुलमू कामा मे मन्दुरु ॥॥ अय्यो ॥
वरुस रावणादुलवलॆ नॆज्ञालु सेतुरु
सरुस नट्टे वेदमू जदुवुदुरु
निरति श्रीवेङ्कटेश नीमहिम लॆरगक
अरिदि वैष्णवुलमे यनि याडुकॊन्दुरु ॥॥ अय्यो ॥
ayyō vikalpavādulantaṭā sigguvaḍaru
yiyyeḍa neṭṭugalige nīyasuramatamu …. ayyō ..
nīmudralū nollaru nīdāsōhamu nollaru
kāmiñci nīmīdibhakti kaḍu nollaru
nāmamantramu nolla ranāmayuṇḍa vanenduru
tāmu vaiṣṇavula maṇṭā darkinturu …. ayyō ..
paitṛkavēḷa nī prasādamū nollaru
ghātalanūrdhvapuṇḍramu gādanduru
jātaradaivāla ninnu sarigā būjinturu
ātala vaiṣṇavulu dāmanukonduru …. ayyō ..
śrī vaiṣṇavula gaṇṭē jētuletti mokkaru
bhāvinturu pagavārivale gannaṭṭu
āvala vaikuṇṭhamū anityamanduru
kāviñci vaiṣṇavulamū kāmā mē manduru …. ayyō ..
varusa rāvaṇādulavale nejñālu sēturu
sarusa naṭṭē vēdamū jaduvuduru
nirati śrīvēṅkaṭēśa nīmahima leragaka
aridi vaiṣṇavulamē yani yāḍukonduru …. ayyō ..
7677
Alas! Those who argue perversely never feel ashamed!
How did this wicked doctrine of demons come to exist?
They don’t accept to wear Your mudras, they don’t accept to be Your servants,
the desirable devotion for You, they don’t accept at all!
They don’t accept the chanting of Your name, they call You as a nameless one
Yet they argue that they are Vaishnavas!
Even during the Pitru-Karmas, they don’t accept Your prasadam,
they refuse to wear the Urdhva-pundaras as though it is harmful!
They worship You alongside the other inferior Gods
Yet they think that they are Vaishnavas!
When they come across Sree Vaishnavas, they don’t greet them with
folded hands, and they feel that they have seen their enemies!
Also they say that Vaikunta is impermanent
Yet they say “Are we not Vaishnavas”!
Like Ravana and others they perform Yagnas
and they also study the Vedas!
Eternally O Sree Venkatesha! Without knowing Your glories
they proclaim themselves as Vaishnavas and pretend to be so!
Having studied extensively the inner truths of the Srutis and Smritis, Ramanuja laid down the
rules for prapannas. One of the basic duties of a true Vaishnava is to undergo the Pancha -
Samskara rituals. This involves the wearing of the Mudras, that is the permanent marks of
Shanka-Chakra, and also applying regularly the marks of the Tiruman - Sree Choornam at the
twelve appropriate places on the body. Sree Vedanta Desika quotes the authority for the wearing
of the Mudras in his work Saccharitra-raksha.
प्र ते विष्णोरब्जचक्रे पवित्रे जन्माम्भोधिं तर्तवे चर्षणीन्द्रा-।
मूले बाह्वोर्दधतेऽन्य पुराण लिङ्गान्यङ्गे तावकान्यर्पयन्ति॥
The best among men wear the pure insignia of Vishnu’s lotus and discus on their arms to cross
the ocean of Samsara. Some wear those insignia on the body.
एभिर्वयमुरूक्रमस्य चिह्नै रङ्किता लोके सुभगा भवाम-।
तद्विष्णो- परमं पदं येऽधिगच्छन्ति लाञ्छिता-॥
Like those who go to the abode of Vishnu, being marked by the insignia of the discs and conch,
we too shall be impressed by the emblems of Vishnu and gain affluence here and hereafter.
उपवीतादिवढ्ढंर्या- शङ्कचक्रादयस्तथा।
ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषेण वैष्णवस्य विशेषत-॥
The Brahmanas, particularly the Vaishnavas, should wear the marks of the conch and
discus as they wear the sacred thread.
हरे- पदाकृतिं आत्मनो हिताय मध्ये च्छिद्रमूघ्वपुण्ड्रम्
यो धारयति स परस्य प्रियो भवति स पुण्यवान् भवति स मुक्तिमान् भवति॥
He who for the good of himself, wears the Urdhva-pundra resembling the footprints of Hari,
becomes the favourite of the Paramatman, virtous and liberated.
Some of the other rules for Prapannas as laid down by Ramanuja are
(1) Never consider Lord Sriman Narayana as just one among the host of other deities. He is the
overlord of all, the sole ruler of the entire universe. He is the one who has no equal.
(2) True devotees of Vishnu are as respectable as the Lord Himself. Only by worshipping the
holy feet of Sree Vaishnavas, one can attain Him easily.
(3) Always have a desire to partake Tirta-Prasadam.
(4) Chant the Dvayam constantly.
True Sree Vaishnavas are those who follow whole heartedly the injunctions of the scriptures and
the commandments of Acharya Ramanuja. They never hesitate to wear the mudras or the
Tiruman-Sree Choornams. Only such people who innately follow the Vaishnava code of
conduct are true Sree Vaishnavas.
7879

item.title: ०३८ भूमिलोन गॊत्तलाय
item.description:
Bhūmilōna Gottalāya
भूमिलोन गॊत्तलाय बुत्रोत्सव मिदिवो
नेमपु कृष्णजयन्ति नेडे यम्मा ॥॥ भूमि ॥
काविरि ब्रह्माण्डमु कडुपुलोनुन्नवानि
देवकि गर्भमुन नद्दिर मोचॆनु
देवतलॆल्ल वॆदकि तॆलिसि काननिवानि
यीवल वसुदेवुडु यॆट्टु गनॆनम्मा ॥॥ भूमि ॥
पॊडवुकु बॊडवैन पुरुषोत्तमुडु नेडु
अडरि तॊट्टॆलबालुडाय नम्म
वुडुगक यज्ञभागमॊगि नारगिञ्चेवाडु
कॊडुकै तल्लीचन्नुगुडिचीनम्मा ॥॥ भूमि ॥
पालजलधियल्लुण्डॆ(डै?) पायकुण्डेयीतनिकि
पालपुट्लपण्डुग बाते(ता?) यनटे
आलरि श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रि नाटलाडने मरिगि
पेलरियै कडु पॆच्चुवॆरिगेनम्मा ॥॥ भूमि ॥
bhūmilōna gottalāya butrōtsava midivō
nēmapu kṛṣṇajayanti nēḍē yammā …. bhūmi ..
kāviri brahmāṇḍamu kaḍupulōnunnavāni
dēvaki garbhamuna naddira mōcenu
dēvatalella vedaki telisi kānanivāni
yīvala vasudēvuḍu yeṭṭu ganenammā …. bhūmi ..
poḍavuku boḍavaina puruṣōttamuḍu nēḍu
aḍari toṭṭelabāluḍāya namma
vuḍugaka yajñabhāgamogi nāragiñcēvāḍu
koḍukai tallīcannuguḍicīnammā …. bhūmi ..
pālajaladhiyalluṇḍe(ḍai?) pāyakuṇḍēyītaniki
pālapuṭlapaṇḍuga bātē(tā?) yanaṭē
ālari śrīvēṅkaṭādri nāṭalāḍanē marigi
pēlariyai kaḍu peccuverigēnammā …. bhūmi ..
This is the famed Putrotsavam1 on this earth!
Today is Krishna Jayanthi, O folks!
The one who has the entire Brahmanda within His stomach,
amazingly He was borne by Devaki in her womb!
The one who could not be perceived by the Devathas even upon searching,
here, how could Vasudeva see Him, O folks!
The Highest of the highest Lord Purushottama, today
has amazingly become a baby in a cradle, O folks!
The one who partakes all the Yagna-offerings eternally,
as a baby son, He is suckling on the breasts of His mother, O folks!
Being the son-in-law of the milky ocean and never being separated from it,
here, how is it that the festival of breaking the milk pots hung high up
has become his passion!
Being used to sporting upon the Sree Venkatadri hill,
His baby like prattles are ever increasing, O folks!
8081
1.Putrotsavam : The celebrations of begetting a son

item.title: ०३९ भक्तसुलभुडनु परतन्त्रुडु हरि
item.description:
Bhaktasulabhuḍanu Paratantruḍu Hari
भक्तसुलभुडनु परतन्त्रुडु हरि
यक्तिसाध्य मिदॆ यॆकरिकी गाडु ॥॥ भक्त ॥
निनुपगुलोकमुल निण्डिनविष्णुडु
मनुजुड नालो मनिकियय्यॆ
मुनुकॊनि वेदमुल नुडिगिनमन्त्रमु
कॊननालिकललो गुदुरै निलिचॆ ॥॥ भक्त ॥
यॆलमि देवतलनेलिनदेवुडु
नलुगड नधमुनि ननु नेलॆ
बलुपगु लक्ष्मीपतियगु श्रीहरि
यिल मायिण्टनु यिदिवो निलिचॆ ॥॥ भक्त ॥
पॊडवकु बॊडवगुपुरुषोत्तमु डिदॆ
बुडिबुडि माचेत बूजगॊनॆ
विडुव किदिवो श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुडु
बडिवायडु मा पालिट निलिचि ॥॥ भक्त ॥
bhaktasulabhuḍanu paratantruḍu hari
yuktisādhya mide yokarikī gāḍu …. bhakta ..
ninupagulōkamula niṇḍinaviṣṇuḍu
manujuḍa nālō manikiyayye
munukoni vēdamula nuḍiginamantramu
konanālikalalō gudurai nilice …. bhakta ..
yelami dēvatalanēlinadēvuḍu
nalugaḍa nadhamuni nanu nēle
balupagu lakṣmīpatiyagu śrīhari
yila māyiṇṭanu yidivō nilice …. bhakta ..
poḍavaku boḍavagupuruṣōttamu ḍide
buḍibuḍi mācēta būjagone
viḍuva kidivō śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruḍu
baḍivāyaḍu mā pāliṭa nilici …. bhakta ..
The one affable to devotees, the one under the control of devotees, Hari!
He is attainable with resolve, He does not belong to anyone!
Vishnu who is pervading the wholesome worlds,
He exists within me who am a mere human!
That mantra which is proclaimed by the Vedas,
Has become established permanently on the tip of the tongue!
The Lord who ruled over the demigods,
He ruled over me who am a lowly one in all respects!
The powerful consort of Lakshmi, Sree Hari,
here, He himself stands in our house!
The higher than the highest Purushottama,
accepted the trivial worship offered by our hands!
Not letting go of us, and remaining ever inseparable,
He is there with us, this Sree Venkateshwara!
8283

item.title: ०४० ऎक्कडि नरकमुलु यॆक्कडि मृत्युवु
item.description:
Ekkaḍi Narakamulu Yekkaḍi Mṛtyuvu
ऎक्कडि नरकमुलु यॆक्कडि मृत्युवु माकु
दक्कि नीदिव्यनामामृतमु चूरगॊण्टिमि ॥॥ ऎक्कडि ॥
तमितो श्रीपति नीदासुल जेरिनप्पुडे
यमकिङ्करभयमु लणगिपोय
जमळि नीयायधलाञ्छनमु मोचिनप्पुडे
अमर गालदण्डमु लवियॆल्ल बॊलिसॆ ॥॥ ऎक्कडि ॥
मुनु नीनगरित्रोवमॊगमैनयप्पुडे
घनयाम्यमार्गमु गट्टुवडिय
वॊनर नीतिरुपति नॊकरात्रि वुन्नपुडे
कनलु कालसूत्रादिघातलॆल्ल बूडॆ ॥॥ ऎक्कडि ॥
यॆडरै नीमन्त्रजप मॆञ्चुकॊन्नयपुडे
कडु जित्रगुप्तुनिलॆक्कलु गडचॆ
वडिगा श्री वेङ्कटेश्वर मीशरणनगा
अडरि वैकुण्ठमु मायरचेत निलिचॆ ॥॥ ऎक्कडि ॥
ekkaḍi narakamulu yekkaḍi mṛtyuvu māku
dakki nīdivyanāmāmṛtamu cūragoṇṭimi …. ekkaḍi
tamitō śrīpati nīdāsula jērinappuḍē
yamakiṅkarabhayamu laṇagipōya
jamaḷi nīyāyudhalāñchanamu mōcinappuḍē
amara gāladaṇḍamu laviyella bolise …. ekkaḍi ..
munu nīnagaritrōvamogamainayappuḍē
ghanayāmyamārgamu gaṭṭuvaḍiya
vonara nītirupati nokarātri vunnapuḍē
kanalu kālasūtrādighātalella būḍe …. ekkaḍi ..
yeḍarai nīmantrajapa meñcukonnayapuḍē
kaḍu jitraguptunilekkalu gaḍace
vaḍigā śrī vēṅkaṭēśvara mīśaraṇanagā
aḍari vaikuṇṭhamu māyaracēta nilice …. ekkaḍi ..
Where is hell? Where is death for us?
We have drunk in abundance the nectar of Your name!
Eagerly, O Sree-pathi, when we associated with Your dasas,
the fear of Yama’s attendants got suppressed!
Joyously, the moment we wore the impressions of Your Shanka-Chakra,
all the punishments of eternal time were destroyed!
The moment we took the path leading to Your glorious city,
the fierce ‘Southern Path’ leading to hell ended!
When we resided at Your Tirupathi just for a night,
the wounds caused by the hells of Kala-Sutra got healed!
The moment we chose to chant Your divine mantras,
the accounts of Chitragupta got annulled!
O Sree Venkateshwara, the moment we surrendered unto You,
the holy Vaikuntam came onto our palms!
8485

item.title: ०४१ ऎरुगुदु रिन्दरु नॆऱिगीनॆऱगरु
item.description:
Erugudu Rindaru Neṟigīneṟagaru
ऎरुगुदु रिन्दरु नॆऱिगीनॆऱगरु
हरि दाने निजपरमातुमनि ॥॥ ऎरुगुदु ॥
नलिनासनु डॆऱुगु नारदु डॆऱुगु
कॊलदि शिवु डॆऱुगु गुहु डॆऱुगु
यिल गपिलु डॆऱुगु निन्ता मनु वॆऱुगु
तलप विष्णुडे परतत्वमनि ॥॥ ऎरुगुदु ॥
बॆरसि प्रह्लादुडु भीष्मुडु जनकुडु
गुरुतुग बलिय शुकुडु गालुडु
वरुस नॆऱुगुदुरु वडि रहस्यमुग
हरि यितडे परमात्मुडनि ॥॥ ऎरुगुदु ॥
तॆलियदगिन दिदि तॆलियरानि दिदि
तॆलिसिनानु मरि दॆलिय दिदि
यिल निन्दरु दॆलिसि रिदे परममनि
कलवॆल्ल दॆलिपॆ वेङ्कटरायडु ॥॥ ऎरुगुदु ॥
erugudu rindaru neṟigīneṟagaru
hari dānē nijaparamātumani …. erugudu ..
nalināsanu ḍeṟugu nāradu ḍeṟugu
koladi śivu ḍeṟugu guhu ḍeṟugu
yila gapilu ḍeṟugu nintā manu veṟugu
talapa viṣṇuḍē paratatvamani …. erugudu ..
berasi prahlāduḍu bhīṣmuḍu janakuḍu
gurutuga baliyu śukuḍu gāluḍu
varusa neṟuguduru vaḍi rahasyamuga
hari yitaḍē paramātmuḍani …. erugudu ..
teliyadagina didi teliyarāni didi
telisinānu mari deliya didi
yila nindaru delisi ridē paramamani
kalavella delipe vēṅkaṭarāyaḍu …. erugudu ..
All these will know! Though knowing, yet they will not know,
that Hari alone is the true Paramatma!
Brahma who sits in the lotus knows, Narada knows,
His capacity Lord Shiva knows, Guha1 knows,
here, Kapila knows, Manu knows!
All these know in their thought that Vishnu alone is the Paratattva!
Having attained Him, Prahalada, Beeshma, King Janaka,
King Bali, Shuka, and Kaala2,
all these people know the secret that He,
Lord Hari alone is the Paramatma!
This is the one to be known, this is the one that cannot be known!
Even after knowing it, this cannot be known!
Here, these great ones realized that this is the Supreme,
and all of that is made known by Lord Venkataraya!
1.Lord Subramanya
2.Lord Yama
8687

item.title: ०४२ इन्नि लागुलचेतु लिवियपो
item.description:
Inni Lāgulacētu Liviyapō
इन्नि लागुलचेतु लिवियपो कडु
नॆन्निक कॆक्किनचेतु लिवियपो ॥॥ इन्नि ॥
गुनियचु दनुनॆत्तुकॊम्मनि तल्लिपै -
नॆनयजाचिनचेतु लिवियपो
किनिसि गॊवर्धनगिरि पॆल्लगिञ्चिन -
यिनुमुवण्टिजेतु लिवियपो ॥॥ इन्नि ॥
पिसिकि पूतकिचन्नु बिगियिञ्चिपट्टिन -
यिसुमन्तलु चेतु लिवियपो
पसुल गाचुचु गॊल्लपडुचुल यमुनलो
यिसुकचल्लिन चेतु लिवियपो ॥॥ इन्नि ॥
परमचैतन्यमै प्राणुलकॆल्लनु
यॆरवुलिच्चिनचेतु लिवियपो
तिरुवेङ्कटगिरिदेवुडै मुक्तिकि -
निरवुचूपॆडुचेतु लिवियपो ॥॥ इन्नि ॥
inni lāgulacētu liviyapō kaḍu
nennika kekkinacētu liviyapō …. inni ..
guniyucu danunettukommani tallipai -
nenayajācinacētu liviyapō
kinisi govardhanagiri pellagiñcina -
yinumuvaṇṭijētu liviyapō …. inni ..
pisiki pūtakicannu bigiyiñcipaṭṭina -
yisumantalu cētu liviyapō
