pasula gācucu gollapaḍucula yamunalō
yisukacallina cētu liviyapō …. inni ..
paramacaitanyamai prāṇulakellanu
yeravuliccinacētu liviyapō
tiruvēṅkaṭagiridēvuḍai muktiki -
niravucūpeḍucētu liviyapō …. inni ..
In these various ways are these hands!
Eternally glorious are these hands!
When He was sulking and pleading to be carried,
these were the hands that reached onto the mother!
When He was furious, these were the iron like hands
that uprooted the Govardhana mountain!
These are the tiny hands that squeezed and
firmly gripped the breast of Putana!
These are the hands that tended the cattle,
and threw the sands of Yamuna on Shepherd lasses!
He being the supreme consciousness, for all living beings,
these are the hands that bestowed boons!
These are the hands which point out the abode of salvation,
in the form of the Lord of Tiru Venkatagiri!
8889

item.title: ०४३ एमिनॆऱगनिमम्मु नॆक्कुवसेसि
item.description:
Ēmineṟaganimammu Nekkuvasēsi
एमिनॆऱगनिमम्मु नॆक्कुवसेसि
पामरुल दॊड्डजेसॆ भाष्यकारुलु ॥॥ एमी ॥
गतचन्न वेदालु कमलजुनकु निच्चि
अतनिकरुणचेत नन्निय गनि
गतिलेकपोयिन कलियगमुन वच्चि
प्रतिपालिञ्चगलिगॆ भाष्यकारुलु ॥॥ एमी ॥
लोकमॆल्ल वॆल्लिबोगा लोनने सुरल गाचि
आकुमीद देलिनयतनिकृप
काकरिमतमुलॆल्ल गालिबुच्चि पर मिट्टे
पैकॊनग गरुणिञ्चॆ भाष्यकारुलु ॥॥ एमी ॥
पङ्कजपुजेयि चाचि पादपुबरमिच्चिन -
वेङ्कटेशुकृपतोड वॆलय दाने
तॆङ्किने वॊडयवरै तिरुमन्त्रद्वयान
पङ्कमॆल्ल बोगडिगॆ भाष्यकारुलु ॥॥ एमी ॥
ēmineṟaganimammu nekkuvasēsi
pāmarula doḍḍajēse bhāṣyakārulu …. ēmī ..
gatacanna vēdālu kamalajunaku nicci
atanikaruṇacēta nanniyu gani
gatilēkapōyina kaliyugamuna vacci
pratipāliñcagalige bhāṣyakārulu …. ēmī ..
lōkamella vellibōgā lōnanē surala gāci
ākumīda dēlinayatanikṛpa
kākarimatamulella gālibucci para miṭṭē
paikonaga garuṇiñce bhāṣyakārulu …. ēmī ..
paṅkajapujēyi cāci pādapubaramiccina -
vēṅkaṭēśukṛpatōḍa velaya dānē
teṅkinē voḍayavarai tirumantradvayāna
paṅkamella bōgaḍige bhāṣyakārulu …. ēmī ..
We who did not know anything, he elevated us!
He turned the ignorant ones into great ones, Bhasyakara!
The Lord who restored the Vedas to Brahma,
comprehending everything by the grace of that Lord,
and appearing in the forlorn Kali-yuga,
he bestowed protection, Bhasyakara!
The Lord who protected the Gods when the worlds were inundated in water,
by the grace of that Lord who floated on the banyan leaf,
throwing away all other worthless doctrines to the winds,
he blessed us to attain the Supreme easily, Bhasyakara!
The Lord who, with His lotus hands, showed that the Supreme is at His feet,
by the grace of that Lord Venkatesha,
as Udayavar, he became the strong foundation, and with the
Tirumantra and Dvayam he cleansed all sins, Bhasyakara!

item.title: ०४४ गतुलन्नि खिलमैन
item.description:
Gatulanni Khilamaina
गतुलन्नि खिलमैन कलियग मन्दुनु
गति यीतडे चूपॆ घन गुरुदैवमु ॥॥ गतु ॥
यीतनि करुणनेका यिल वैष्णवुल मैति -
मीतनिवल्लने कण्टि मीतिरुमणि
यीतडेका वुपदेश मिच्चॆ नष्टाक्षरि मन्त्र-
मीतडे रामानुजुलु यिहपरदैवमु ॥॥ गतु ॥
वॆलयिञ्चॆ नीतडेका वेदपु रहस्यमुलु
चलिमि नीतडे चूपॆ शरणागति
निलिपिना ईतडेका निजमुद्रधारणमु
मलसि रामानुजुले माटलाडे दैवमु ॥॥ गतु ॥
नियममु लीत डेका निलिपॆ ब्रपन्नुलकु
दयतो मोक्षमु चूपॆ दग नीतडे
नयमै श्री वेङ्कटेशुनग मॆक्के वाकिटनु
दमजाची मम्मु निट्टे तल्लि तण्ड्रि दैवमु ॥॥ गतु ॥
gatulanni khilamaina kaliyuga mandunu
gati yītaḍē cūpe ghana gurudaivamu …. gatu ..
yītani karuṇanēkā yila vaiṣṇavula maiti -
mītanivallanē kaṇṭi mītirumaṇi
yītaḍēkā vupadēśa micce naṣṭākṣari mantra-
mītaḍē rāmānujulu yihaparadaivamu …. gatu ..
velayiñce nītaḍēkā vēdapu rahasyamulu
calimi nītaḍē cūpe śaraṇāgati
nilipinā ītaḍēkā nijamudradhāraṇamu
malasi rāmānujulē māṭalāḍē daivamu …. gatu ..
niyamamu līta ḍēkā nilipe brapannulaku
dayatō mōkṣamu cūpe daga nītaḍē
nayamai śrī vēṅkaṭēśunaga mekkē vākiṭanu
damajūcī mammu niṭṭē talli taṇḍri daivamu …. gatu ..
In the evil ways of Kaliyuga,
he showed ‘The path’, the great divine guru!
Isn’t it out of his compassion, here we are Vaishnavas,
Because of him, we could find the Tiruman1,
It is he who initiated us into the Ashtakshari mantra
He is Ramanuja, the God of here and hereafter!2
Isn’t he the one who revealed the Vedic secrets
With benevolence he showed the path of Sharanagati
Isn’t he the one who established the real Mudhra dharana3
In total, Ramanuja is a ‘Speaking God’!
Isn’t he the one who laid the rules for Prapannas4
With compassion, he is the one who showed us Moksha.
Having beneficially climbed Lord Sree Venkatesha’s hill,
he blesses us at the doorway5, as mother, father and God!
1.Sacred mud worn on the forehead as Naamam
2.When Ramanuja visited Tirumala, the Lord bestowed upon him both the
kingdoms- the spiritual as well as the material. Thus he is called as
‘Ubhaya Vibhuti Pati’ or ‘The God of here and hereafter’!
3.The method of Samashrayanam or Panchasamskara
4.Prapannas are those who have performed Sharanagathi
5.The Ramanuja shrine is at the doorway of the Tirumala temple
9293

item.title: ०४५ उन्नतोन्नतुडु
item.description:
Unnatōnnatuḍu
उन्नतोन्नतुडु वुडयवरु
यॆन्न ननन्तुडे यी यडयवरु ॥॥ उन्न ॥
सर्वलोकमुल शास्त्र रहस्यमु
लुर्वि बॊडयॆ नी यडयवरु
पूर्वपु वेदान्त पुण्य शस्त्रमुलु
निर्वहिञ्चॆ नन्निटा नुडयवरु ॥॥ उन्न ॥
वॆक्कसपु श्री विष्णुभक्तिये
वॊक्करूपमे वुडयवरु
चक्कनैन सुज्ञानमुन किरवै
वुक्कु मीऱॆ निदॆ वुडयवरु ॥॥ उन्न ॥
कदिसॆ मोक्षसाकारमु दानै
वुदुटुन निलिचॆ नी यडयवरु
यिदिगो श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरु यीडै
पॊदलुचु नुन्नाडु भुवि नुडयवरु ॥॥ उन्न ॥
unnatōnnatuḍu vuḍayavaru
yenna nanantuḍē yī yuḍayavaru …. unna ..
sarvalōkamula śāstra rahasyamu
lurvi boḍaye nī yuḍayavaru
pūrvapu vēdānta puṇya śastramulu
nirvahiñce nanniṭā nuḍayavaru …. unna ..
vekkasapu śrī viṣṇubhaktiyē
vokkarūpamē vuḍayavaru
cakkanaina sujñānamuna kiravai
vukku mīṟe nide vuḍayavaru …. unna ..
kadise mōkṣasākāramu dānai
vuduṭuna nilice nī yuḍayavaru
yidigō śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaru yīḍai
podalucu nunnāḍu bhuvi nuḍayavaru …. unna ..
Higher than the highest is Udayavar1!
If understood rightly, he is limitless, this Udayavar!
The secrets of the scriptures of all the worlds,
he spread upon this earth, this Udayavar!
The ancient propitious scriptures of Vedanta,
he carried out in every way, Udayavar!
Of the supreme Vishnu Bhakti,
he is the sole personification, Udayavar!
Being the abode of benevolent ‘right-knowledge’
he attained supremacy, Udayavar!
He himself being the very manifestation of Moksha,
he stood firmly, this Udayavar!
Behold! Being on par with Sree Venkateshwara,
on this earth, he prospers in all glory, Udayavar!
9495
1.Udayavar literally means ‘The one who has been bestowed’. The Lord
Himself bestowed the two worlds, the material and the spiritual, unto
Ramanuja. Thus he is called Udayavar.

item.title: ०४६ सुलभमा मनुजुलकु हरिभक्ति
item.description:
Sulabhamā Manujulaku Haribhakti
सुलभमा मनुजुलकु हरिभक्ति
वलनॊन्दि मरिकदा वैष्णवुडौट ॥॥ सुलभमा ॥
कॊदलेनितपमुलु कोटानगोटुलु
नदन नाचरिञ्चि यटमीद
पदिलमैन कर्मबन्धमु लन्निय
वदलिञ्चुकॊनिकदा वैष्णवुडौट ॥॥ सुलभमा ॥
तनिवोनियागतन्त्रमुलु लक्षलसङ्ख्य
अनघुडै चेसिनयटमीद
जननमुलन्निट जनियिञ्चि परमपा -
वनुडै मरिकदा वैष्णवुडौट ॥॥ सुलभमा ॥
तिरिगितिरिगि पॆक्कुतीर्थमुलन्निय -
नरलेक सेविञ्चिनटमीद
तिरुवेङ्कटाचलाधिपुडैन करिराज -
वरदुनिकृपगदा वैष्णवुडौट ॥॥ सुलभमा ॥
sulabhamā manujulaku haribhakti
valanondi marikadā vaiṣṇavuḍauṭa …. sulabhamā ..
kodalēnitapamulu kōṭānagōṭulu
nadana nācariñci yaṭamīda
padilamaina karmabandhamu lanniyu
vadaliñcukonikadā vaiṣṇavuḍauṭa …. sulabhamā ..
tanivōniyāgatantramulu lakṣalasaṅkhya
anaghuḍai cēsinayaṭamīda
jananamulanniṭa janiyiñci paramapā -
vanuḍai marikadā vaiṣṇavuḍauṭa …. sulabhamā ..
tirigitirigi pekkutīrthamulanniyu -
naralēka sēviñcinaṭamīda
tiruvēṅkaṭācalādhipuḍaina karirāja -
varadunikṛpagadā vaiṣṇavuḍauṭa …. sulabhamā ..
Is this easy for humans, devotion to Hari?
only upon lovingly desiring it, one can become a Vaishnava!
Only after performing crores and crores
of endless penances,
and only after getting freed from the strong
bondages of Karmas, one can become a Vaishnava!
Only after performing lakhs and lakhs of unending
Yagnas and rituals, as a pure hearted one,
only after taking births repeatedly and
becoming sanctified, one can become a Vaishnava!
Only after going on pilgrimages to various sacred teerthas,
and offering whole hearted worship,
only after begetting the grace of the Lord of TiruVenkatachala,
the savior of the elephant king, one can become a Vaishnava!
9697

item.title: ०४७ एदैवमुश्रीपादन्न
item.description:
Ēdaivamuśrīpādanna
एदैवमुश्रीपादन्न (न?)खमुन बुट्टिनगङ्ग
त्रिलोकपावनमु चेयनु त्रिपथगामिनि आयनु
येदैवमुनाभिनलिनम्बुन जनियिञ्चिनअजुण्डु
अखिलाण्डम्बुलु सृजियिम्प नधिपति आयनु
येदैवमुवुरस्थलम्बु दनकुनु मन्दिरमैनयिन्दिर
मातमय्यॆ यीजगम्बुलकॆल्लनु
येदैवमुअवलोकन मिन्द्रादिदिविजगणम्बुल -
कॆल्लप्पुडुनु सुखम्बु लापादिञ्चुनु
येदैवमु देहवस्तु (वस्तु)वनि अनिमिषुलन्दरु गूडि
श्रीनारायणदेवुण्डनि नम्मियण्डुदुरु
आदेवुडे सिरुल कनन्तवरदुडु तिरुवेङ्कट -
गिरिनाथु डुभयविभूतिनाथुडे नानाथुडु ॥॥ एदैवमु ॥
ēdaivamuśrīpādanna (na?)khamuna buṭṭinagaṅga
trilōkapāvanamu cēyanu tripathagāmini āyanu
yēdaivamunābhinalinambuna janiyiñcinaajuṇḍu
akhilāṇḍambulu sṛjiyimpa nadhipati āyanu
yēdaivamuvurasthalambu danakunu mandiramainayindira
mātamayye yījagambulakellanu
yēdaivamuavalōkana mindrādidivijagaṇambula -
kellappuḍunu sukhambu lāpādiñcunu
yēdaivamu dēhavastu (vastu)vani animiṣulandaru gūḍi
śrīnārāyaṇadēvuṇḍani nammiyuṇḍuduru
ādēvuḍē sirula kanantavaraduḍu tiruvēṅkaṭa -
girināthu ḍubhayavibhūtināthuḍē nānāthuḍu .. ēdaivamu
Which Lords sacred toe-nail did Ganga take birth from,
and become divided into three, to sanctify the three worlds?
Which Lords lotus like navel did Brahma originate from,
to create the Universe and become the ruler?
Which Lords majestic chest did Lakshmi make Her abode,
and become the mother of this entire creation?
Which Lords glances bestow eternal bliss to
Indra and the host of other divinities?
Who is the Lord whom the Devas believe as the indweller
in all bodies, in the form of Lord Sree-Narayana?
That Lord alone, who is the eternal benefactor of wealth, the Lord of
Tiru Venkata, the Lord of the Ubhaya-Vibhutis, He alone is my Lord!!!
9899

item.title: ०४८ भावयामि गोपालबालं
item.description:
Bhāvayāmi Gōpālabālaṃ
भावयामि गोपालबालं मन -
स्सेवितं तत्पदं चिन्तयेयं सदा ॥॥ भाव ॥
कटिघटित मेखलाखचितमणिघण्टिका -
पटलनिनदेन विभ्राजमानं
कुटिलपदघटितसङ्कुल शिञ्जिते नतं
चटुलनटनासमुज्ज्वलविलासम् ॥॥ भाव ॥
निरतकरकलितनवनीतं ब्रह्मादि -
सुरनिखरभावनाशोभितपदं
तिरुवेङ्कटाचलस्थित मनुपमं हरिं
परमपुरुषं गोपालबालम् ॥॥ भाव ॥
bhāvayāmi gōpālabālaṃ mana -
ssēvitaṃ tatpadaṃ cintayēyaṃ sadā …. bhāva ..
kaṭighaṭita mēkhalākhacitamaṇighaṇṭikā -
paṭalaninadēna vibhrājamānaṃ
kuṭilapadaghaṭitasaṅkula śiñjitē nataṃ
caṭulanaṭanāsamujjvalavilāsaṃ …. bhāva ..
niratakarakalitanavanītaṃ brahmādi -
suranikharabhāvanāśōbhitapadaṃ
tiruvēṅkaṭācalasthita manupamaṃ hariṃ
paramapuruṣaṃ gōpālabālaṃ …. bhāva ..
I meditate upon the child Gopala, who is constantly worshipped by the mind,
on that Lord who is fit to be contemplated upon at all times!
The one who shines brilliantly with a waist belt which is
decorated with precious gems and jingling bells that
sound musically as He toddles in a crooked way,
on Him who is an adept dancer, the splendidly graceful one, I meditate!
Having played with butter, the one whose hands have become smeared with it,
the one who shines in the thoughts of great divinities like Brahma and others,
that matchless Hari, who resides eternally on TiruVenkatachala,
on that Parama Purusha, Gopala-bala, I meditate!
100101

item.title: ०४९ अलवटपत्रशायिवैनरूप
item.description:
Alavaṭapatraśāyivainarūpa
अलवटपत्रशायिवैनरूप मिट्टिदनि
कॊलुवै पॊडचूपेवा गोविन्दराजा ॥॥ अल ॥
पडतुलिद्दरिमीद बादमुलु चाचुकॊनि
वॊडिकपुराजसान नॊत्तगिलि
कडलेनिनिजनाभिकमलमुन ब्रह्मनु
कॊडुकुगा गण्टि विदॆ गोविन्दराजा ॥॥ अल ॥
सिरुलसॊम्मुलतोड शेषुनिपै बवळिञ्चि
सॊरदि दासुल गृप जाचुकॊण्टानु
परगुदैत्युलमीद पामुवाषमुले नीवु
कुरियिञ्चितिविगा गोविन्दराजा ॥॥ अल ॥
शङ्कुजक्रमुलतोड जाचिनकरमुतोड
अङ्कॆल शिरसुकिन्दि हस्तमुतोड
तॆङ्किनि श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रि दिगुवतिरुपतिलो
कॊङ्कक वरमुलिच्चे गोविन्दराजा ॥॥ अल ॥
alavaṭapatraśāyivainarūpa miṭṭidani
koluvai poḍacūpēvā gōvindarājā …. ala ..
paḍatuliddarimīda bādamulu cācukoni
voḍikapurājasāna nottagili
kaḍalēninijanābhikamalamuna brahmanu
koḍukugā gaṇṭi vide gōvindarājā …. ala ..
sirulasommulatōḍa śēṣunipai bavaḷiñci
soradi dāsula gṛpa jūcukoṇṭānu
paragudaityulamīda pāmuvāṣamulē nīvu
kuriyiñcitivigā gōvindarājā …. ala ..
śaṅkujakramulatōḍa jācinakaramutōḍa
aṃkela śirasukindi hastamutōḍa
teṅkini śrīvēṅkaṭādri diguvatirupatilō
koṅkaka varamuliccē gōvindarājā …. ala ..
Showing that the form of Vatapatrasayi is like this,
You have manifested in this reclining form, Govindaraja!
Lovingly extending Your feet towards the two Goddesses,
sleeping onto one side in a royal posture,
from the endless lotus in Your navel, You had borne
Brahma as Your son, Govindaraja!
Reclining on Sesha with wealth and prosperity,
bestowing grace on Your daasas,
and pouring venom of snakes onto
evil Rakshasas, O Govindaraja!
Wielding the Shanka-Chakra, with one arm extended over the leg,
and the other arm placed under the head,
reclining in Tirupathi, below Sree Venkatadri,
unhesitantly He bestows boons, Govindaraja!
102103

item.title: ०५० नमो नमो रघुकुलनायक
item.description:
Namō Namō Raghukulanāyaka
नमो नमो रघुकुलनायक दिवजवन्द्य
नमो नमो शङ्करनगज (जा?) नुता ॥॥ नमो ॥
विहितधर्मपालक वीरदशरथराम
गगनवासिनी ताटकमर्दन
अहल्य शापमोचन असुरकुलभञ्जन
सहजविश्वामित्रसवनरक्षका ॥॥ नमो ॥
हरकोदण्डहर सीताङ्गनावल्लभ
खरदूषणारि वालिगर्वापह
तरणितनूजादि तरुचरपालक
शरधिलङ्घनकृत सौमित्रिसमेता ॥॥ नमो ॥
बिरुद रावणशिरोभेदक विभीषण -
वरद साकेतपुरवास राघव
निरुपम श्रीवेङ्कटनिलय निजनगर
पुरवरविहार पुण्डरीकाक्ष ॥॥ नमो ॥
namō namō raghukulanāyaka divajavandya
namō namō śaṅkaranagaja (jā?) nutā …. namō ..
vihitadharmapālaka vīradaśaratharāma
gaganavāsinī tāṭakamardana
ahalya śāpamōcana asurakulabhañjana
sahajaviśvāmitrasavanarakṣakā …. namō ..
harakōdaṇḍahara sītāṅganāvallabha
kharadūṣaṇāri vāligarvāpaha
taraṇitanūjādi tarucarapālaka
śaradhilaṅghanakṛta saumitrisamētā …. namō ..
biruda rāvaṇaśirōbhēdaka vibhīṣaṇa -
varada sākētapuravāsa rāghava
nirupama śrīvēṅkaṭanilaya nijanagara
puravaravihāra puṇḍarīkākṣa …. namō ..
Prostrations and salutations to the leader of the Raghu race,
the one who is revered by the residents of the divine worlds!
Prostrations and salutations to the one who is praised by Lord Shiva and Parvathi!
To the one who is the protector of true Dharma, the brave Dasharatha’s Rama,
the one who killed Tataka who resides in the skies,
the one who removed the curse of Ahalya, the one who destroyed the demon race,
the one who protected Vishwamitra from obstacles with much ease!
To the one who destroyed Shiva’s bow, the sole Lord of Sita’s body,
the enemy of Kara and Dushana, the one who destroyed the arrogance of Vali,
the one who protected Sugreeva and the others,
the one who built the bridge on the ocean, the one who is eternally with Lakshmana!
To the one who cut off the head of the illustrious Ravana, who blessed Vibheeshana,
the resident of Saketa pura (Ayodhya), that Raghava,
the matchless one, the one who resides on Sree Venkata,
the one who resides in the true abode of His own, the lotus eyed Lord!
Many salutations and prostrations!
104105

item.title: ०५१ विष्णुडॊक्कडे विश्वात्मकुडु
item.description:
Viṣṇuḍokkaḍē Viśvātmakuḍu
विष्णुडॊक्कडे विश्वात्मकुडु
वैष्णवमे सर्वम्बुनु ॥॥ विष्णु ॥
परमेष्टिसेय ब्रह्माण्डसृष्टिय
हरुनिलोनि संहरशक्ति,
परगग निन्द्रुनि परिपालनमुनु
अरसि चूड श्री हरि महिम ॥॥ विष्णु ॥
इल पञ्चभूतमुललो गुणमुलु
अल नवग्रह विहारमुलु
तलकनु कालत्रय धर्मम्बुनु
अलरग नारायणुनि महिमले ॥॥ विष्णु ॥
अन्तट गल माया विलासमुलु
पॊन्त बरमपद भोगमुलु
मन्तुकु नॆक्किन मरि समस्तमुनु
इन्तय श्रीवेङ्कटेशु महिमले ॥॥ विष्णु ॥
viṣṇuḍokkaḍē viśvātmakuḍu
vaiṣṇavamē sarvambunu …. viṣṇu ..
paramēṣṭisēyu brahmāṇḍasṛṣṭiyu
harunilōni saṃharaśakti,
paragaga nindruni paripālanamunu
arasi cūḍa śrī hari mahima …. viṣṇu ..
ila pañcabhūtamulalō guṇamulu
ala navagraha vihāramulu
talakanu kālatraya dharmambunu
alaraga nārāyaṇuni mahimalē …. viṣṇu ..
aṃtaṭa gala māyā vilāsamulu
ponta baramapada bhōgamulu
mantuku nekkina mari samastamunu
iṃtayu śrīvēṅkaṭēśu mahimalē …. viṣṇu ..
Vishnu alone is the universal indweller!
The philosophy of Vaishnavism is everything!
The creation of the cosmic egg performed by Brahma,
The power of destruction possessed by Lord Shiva,
The efficiency of Indras rulership,
If rightly appraised, they are but Sree Hari’s glory!
The qualities present in the (panchabhutas) five elements
The movements of the (navagrahas) nine planets
The duties of the (trikalas) three time durations
All these are Narayana’s beautiful glories!
The ever present effects of Maya,
The bliss experienced at Parama Padam
All that which is extraordinarily reputed, all that which exists,
and everything, is but Sree Venkatesha’s glory!
106107

item.title: ०५२ नीवु सर्वसमुडवु
item.description:
Nīvu Sarvasamuḍavu
नीवु सर्वसमुडवु नीवु देवदेवुडवु
यीवल नागुणदोषा लॆञ्च निकनेला ॥॥ नीवु ॥
पूवुलपै गासी बॊरि मुण्ड्लपै गासीनि
आवल वॆन्नॆलकेमि हानिवच्चीना
पावनुल नटु गाचि पापपुञ्जमैन नन्नु
गावगा नीकृपकुनु गडमय्यीना ॥॥ नीवु ॥
गोवुमीद विसरी गुक्कमीद विसरीनि
पावनपुगालिकिनि पापमण्टाना
देवतल रक्षिञ्चि दीनुडनैननाकु
दोवचूपि रक्षिञ्चिते दोसमय्यीना ॥॥ नीवु ॥
कुलजुनियिण्टनुण्डी कुलहीनुनियिण्टनुण्डी
यिललो नॆण्डकु नेमि हीनमय्यीना
वलसि श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रि वरमुलु यिच्चि नालो
निलिचि वरमुलिच्चि नेडु गाववे ॥॥ नीवु ॥
nīvu sarvasamuḍavu nīvu dēvadēvuḍavu
yīvala nāguṇadōṣā leñca nikanēlā …. nīvu ..
pūvulapai gāsī bori muṇḍlapai gāsīni
āvala vennelakēmi hānivaccīnā
pāvanula naṭu gāci pāpapuñjamaina nannu
gāvagā nīkṛpakunu gaḍamayyīnā …. nīvu ..
gōvumīda visarī gukkamīda visarīni
pāvanapugālikini pāpamaṇṭānā
dēvatala rakṣiñci dīnuḍanainanāku
dōvacūpi rakṣiñcitē dōsamayyīnā …. nīvu ..
kulajuniyiṇṭanuṇḍī kulahīnuniyiṇṭanuṇḍī
yilalō neṇḍaku nēmi hīnamayyīnā
valasi śrīvēṅkaṭādri varamulu yicci nālō
nilici varamulicci nēḍu gāvavē …. nīvu ..
You view everyone with an equal eye, You are the God of Gods!
Then, why do you see my faulty traits?
Whether on flowers, whether on thorns
when the moon shines, will any harm befall the light?
Just like You save the pious, upon me who is a heap of sins
if you show mercy, will any harm befall Your grace?
The breeze that blows upon a cow, and likewise upon a dog
for the pure breeze, will there be any sin?
You who protects the Devas, to me who is the lowest of beings
if You show the way and protect, will it be a fault?
Entering the house of a ‘high caste’, and also that of a ‘low catse’
will the sunlight in any way become inferior?
O granter of boons, SreeVenkatesha, residing within me
bestowing Your grace, will You not rescue me today??
108109

item.title: ०५३ निन्नू नन्नू नॆञ्चुकोनि
item.description:
Ninnū Nannū Neñcukōni
निन्नू नन्नू नॆञ्चुकोनिनेरमिगाक
पन्निनसूर्युनिकान्ति प्रतिसूर्युडौना ॥॥ निन्नू ॥
जलधिलोपलिमीनु जलधि दा नौना
जलमुलाधारमैनजन्तुवुगाक
नॆलवै नीलोनिवाड नीवे ने नौदुना
पॊलसि नीय्याधरुवुबॊम्म निन्तेकाक ॥॥ निन्नू ॥
राजुवद्दनुन्नबण्टु राजे ता नौना
राजसपुचनवरिरचने काक
साजमै निन्नु गॊलिचि सरिगद्दॆ नुन्दुना
वोजतो निन्नु सेविञ्चि वुन्दु निन्ते काक ॥॥ निन्नू ॥
मुत्तॆपुजिप्पलनीरु मुन्निटिवलॆ नुण्डुना
मुत्तॆमुलै बलिसि लो मॊनयगाक
नित्तॆपुश्रीवेङ्कटेश नीशरणागतुलमु
मॊत्तपुलोकुलमा मुक्तुलमुगाक ॥॥ निन्नू ॥
ninnū nannū neñcukōninēramigāka
panninasūryunikānti pratisūryuḍaunā …. ninnū ..
jaladhilōpalimīnu jaladhi dā naunā
jalamulādhāramainajantuvugāka
nelavai nīlōnivāḍa nīvē nē naudunā
polasi nīyyādharuvubomma nintēkāka …. ninnū ..
rājuvaddanunnabaṇṭu rājē tā naunā
rājasapucanavariracanē kāka
sājamai ninnu golici sarigadde nundunā
vōjatō ninnu sēviñci vundu nintē kāka …. ninnū ..
muttepujippalanīru munniṭivale nuṇḍunā
muttemulai balisi lō monayugāka
nittepuśrīvēṅkaṭēśa nīśaraṇāgatulamu
mottapulōkulamā muktulamugāka …. ninnū ..
Equating You and me, isn’t it a crime!
The sun light which has spread out, can it become the sun itself?
The fish that is inside the ocean, can it become the ocean itself?
Is it not a creature that depends on the water!
Me who is within You, can I ever become You?
A mere puppet with Your support, am I not!
The slave of the King, will he become the king himself?
Isn’t his post one that is created by the King!
Worshipping You naturally, how can I ever become You?
Serving You in an orderly manner, thus I live!
The water in the oyster, will it remain in its former state?
Will it not grow into a pearl and shine!
(So too) Constantly SreeVenkatesha, since we are Your Sharanagathas
we do not belong to any other world, we are but Muktas!!
The purport is:
By considering the Jivatman to be equal to the Lord, nothing can be
achieved. Rather it is a sin to think of oneself as equal to the Lord. Only
by duly Surrendering ourselves unto the Supreme Lord we can attain
the Highest!
110111

item.title: ०५४ तलगरो लोकुलु
item.description:
Talagarō Lōkulu
तलगरो लोकुलु तडवकुरो मम्मु
कलिगिन दिदि माकापुरमु ॥॥ तलगरो ॥
नरहरि कीर्तन नानिनजिह्व
वॊरुल नुतिम्पगनोपदु जिह्व
मुरहरुपदमुल मॊक्किनशिरमु
परुलवन्दनकु बरगदु शिरमु ॥॥ तलगरो ॥
श्रीपतिने पूजिञ्चिन करमुलु
चोपि याचनकु जॊरवु करमुलु
येपुन हरिकड केगिनकाळ्ळु
पापुलयिण्ड्लकु बारवु काळ्ळु ॥॥ तलगरो ॥
श्रीवेङ्कटपति जिन्तिञ्चु मनसु
दावति नितरमु दलचदु मनसु
देवु डतनियाधीनपुतनुवु
येवल नितराधीनमुगादु ॥॥ तलगरो ॥
talagarō lōkulu taḍavakurō mammu
kaliginadi didi mākāpuramu …. talagarō ..
narahari kīrtana nāninajihva
vorula nutimpaganōpadu jihva
muraharupadamula mokkinaśiramu
parulavandanaku baragadu śiramu …. talagarō ..
śrīpatinē pūjiñcina karamulu
cōpi yācanaku joravu karamulu
yēpuna harikaḍa kēginakāḷḷu
pāpulayiṇḍlaku bāravu kāḷḷu …. talagarō ..
śrīvēṅkaṭapati jintiñcumanasu
dāvati nitaramu dalacadu manasu
dēvu ḍataniyādhīnaputanuvu
yēvala nitarādhīnamugādu …. talagarō ..
Move away O commoners! Do not obstruct us!
This is our rich companionship. (Between me and the Lord)
The tongue that is soaked in the praises of Nara-Hari
it will not agree to praise others!
The head that has bowed down to the feet of Mura-Hara
it will not bow down to revere others!
The hands that have worshipped the Lord of Sree,
they will not extend forward to beg others!
The feet that have eagerly paced towards Hari,
they will not proceed to the house of sinners!
The mind that thinks of SreeVenkatapathi
it will not think of any other with any eagerness!
The body that is under the control of the Lord,
will not be under the control of anyone else!!
112113

item.title: ०५५ विष्णुडे यिन्ताननि
item.description:
Viṣṇuḍē yintānani
विष्णुडे यिन्ताननि भाविञ्चुटे बुद्धि
वैष्णवुडै याचार्यसेवसेयटे बुद्धि ॥॥ विष्णुडे ॥
कॊण्डवण्टितनलोनिकोपमु रेग वच्चिते
दण्डने यॆच्चरि वूरकुण्डुटे बुद्धि
मॆण्डुगा बरकान्तल मीदितमि वुट्टितेनु
अण्डुकाचन्दुकु भ्रमयकुण्डुटे बुद्धि ॥॥ विष्णुडे ॥
अट्टॆ यॆव्वरयिना गृहारामादुलपै नास
वुट्टिञ्चिते वानिवॆण्ट बोनिदे बुद्धि
चुट्टपुसम्मन्धान सोकिते परबाधलु
चुट्टुकोक लोनुगाक जनुगुटे बुद्धि ॥॥ विष्णुडे ॥
तप्पदिन्ता दैविकमे तनवद्दनुन्नवारि
दप्पुलुवट्टनिदे तगिनबुद्धि
यॆप्पुडू श्रीवेङ्कटेशु डॆदलोन नुन्नवाडु
चॊप्पॆत्ति यातनिमूर्ति चूचुटे बुद्धि ॥॥ विष्णुडे ॥
viṣṇuḍē yintānani bhāviñcuṭē buddhi
vaiṣṇavuḍai yācāryasēvasēyuṭē buddhi …. viṣṇuḍē ..
koṇḍavaṇṭitanalōnikōpamu rēga vaccitē
daṇḍanē yeccari vūrakuṇḍuṭē buddhi
meṇḍugā barakāntala mīditami vuṭṭitēnu
aṃḍukācanduku bhramayakuṇḍuṭē buddhi …. viṣṇuḍē
aṭṭe yevvarayinā gṛhārāmādulapai nāsa
vuṭṭiñcitē vāniveṇṭa bōnidē buddhi
cuṭṭapusammandhāna sōkitē parabādhalu
cuṭṭukōka lōnugāka januguṭē buddhi …. viṣṇuḍē ..
tappadintā daivikamē tanavaddanunnavāri
dappuluvaṭṭanidē taginabuddhi
yeppuḍū śrīvēṅkaṭēśu ḍedalōna nunnavāḍu
coppetti yātanimūrti cūcuṭē buddhi …. viṣṇuḍē ..
Understanding that Vishnu is everything is the right knowledge
Being a Vaishnava and serving Acharya, is the right knowledge!
The mountain like anger within oneself, when it is aroused
to gain control quickly and remain unmoved, is the right knowledge!
When strong desires arise for women other than ones own
not coming under its sway, is the right knowledge!
When one tries to lure into the pleasures of ‘houses’ and ‘luxuries’
not falling prey to it, is the right knowledge!
The miseries arising out of binding relationships with relatives,
not getting dragged into them, is the right knowledge!
‘Whatever happens is God ordained’, thinking thus
and not finding fault with others, is the right knowledge!
At all times, SreeVenkateshwara who resides in our hearts
to behold his image, is the right knowledge!
114115

item.title: ०५६ इन्तकण्टॆ ने मुन्नदि
item.description:
Iṃtakaṇṭe Nē Munnadi
इन्तकण्टॆ ने मुन्नदि यॆन्त दलपोसिनानु
चिन्तदीर नीसेव सेयटे कलदि ॥॥ इन्त ॥
उपकारमुग देह मॊसगिति विटु नाकु
उपमिञ्चि ने जेसेप्रत्युपकार मिक नेदि
यॆपुडू नीधर्ममुन निटु नीरुणस्थुडनै
प्रपन्नुडनै नेनु ब्रदुकुटे कलदि ॥॥ इन्त ॥
वेवेग वॆऱ्ऱिजेयक विवेकि जेसितिवि
यीविकि ने मारुकुमा रिच्चे दॆक्कड नुन्नदि
यीवल नीकु गीर्तिगा निट्टे नीयाधीनुडनै
भाविञ्चि भयमु लेक ब्रदुकुटे कलदि कलदि ॥॥ इन्त ॥
जडुललो गूर्चक याचार्युनिलो(तो?) गूर्चितिवि
नडपेटिनीसरविकि नासरवि येमुन्नदि
यॆडयक श्रीवेङ्कटेश नीकु बण्टुनै
बडिवाय किट्ला ने ब्रदुकुटे कलदि ॥॥ इन्त ॥
iṃtakaṇṭe nē munnadi yenta dalapōsinānu
cintadīra nīsēva sēyuṭē kaladi …. iṃta ..
upakāramuga dēha mosagiti viṭu nāku
upamiñci nē jēsēpratyupakāra mika nēdi
yepuḍū nīdharmamuna niṭu nīruṇasthuḍanai
prapannuḍanai nēnu bradukuṭē kaladi …. iṃta ..
vēvēga veṟṟijēyaka vivēki jēsitivi
yīviki nē mārukumā riccē dekkaḍa nunnadi
yīvala nīku gīrtigā niṭṭē nīyādhīnuḍanai
bhāviñci bhayamu lēka bradukuṭē kaladi kaladi …. iṃta ..
jaḍulalō gūrcaka yācāryunilō(tō?) gūrcitivi
naḍapēṭinīsaraviki nāsaravi yēmunnadi
yeḍayaka śrīvēṅkaṭēśa nīku baṇṭunai
baḍivāya kiṭlā nē bradukuṭē kaladi …. iṃta ..
What else is there other than this? Even upon thinking!
To get rid of worries, serving You is the right way!
As a favor You gave me this body!
What can I do in return for it, befittingly?
At all times, being righteous and being indebted to You
happily if I live, that is the right way!
Not making me a fool, You made me a wise one!
For this, is there anything I can give in exchange?
Here, bringing You fame if I remain under Your control
and live without any fear, that is the right way!
Not letting me join the ignorant ones, You made me associate with Acharya!
For this noble deed of Yours, what can I give in return?
Without letting go, O SreeVenkatesha, being Your servant
if I live thus, that is the right way!!
116117

item.title: ०५७ ऒडबरचुकॊण्टिवि वुपेन्द्र
item.description:
Oḍabaracukoṇṭivi Vupēndra
ऒडबरचुकॊण्टिवि वुपेन्द्र निन्नु निपुडॆ
चिडिमुडि नीसेवके नॆलवुचेसुकॊम्मी ॥॥ ऒड ॥
कन्नुल ने जाचेदॆल्ला कमलाक्ष नीपादाले
विन्नविनुकुलॆल्ला विफ्णुड नीकथले
तिन्ननिनामाटलॆल्ला त्रिविक्रम नीमन्त्राले
अन्निटा नाभावमु समर्पणमु नीकुनु ॥॥ ऒड ॥
अट्टॆ ने नडचेवॆल्ला हरि नीप्रदक्षिणाले
गुट्टुन नासेतलॆल्ला गोविन्द नीकैङ्कर्याले
मुट्टि नेभुजिञ्चिनवि मुकुन्द नीप्रसादाले
नॆट्टन नाभोगमॆल्ला नीवसमु चेसिति ॥॥ ऒड ॥
यिल ने बण्डबडेवि यीश्वर नीकु मॊक्कुले
तलचे नातलपॆल्ला दमोदर नीध्यानमॆ
नलुवङ्क श्रीवेङ्कटनायक नीयनुज्ञनु
नॆलवै नाभवमुलॆल्ला नीसॊम्मु चेसिति ॥॥ ऒड ॥
oḍabaracukoṇṭivi vupēndra ninnu nipuḍe
ciḍimuḍi nīsēvakē nelavucēsukommī …. oḍa ..
kannula nē jūcēdellā kamalākṣa nīpādālē
vinnavinukulellā viphṇuḍa nīkathalē
tinnanināmāṭalellā trivikrama nīmantrālē
anniṭā nābhāvamu samarpaṇamu nīkunu …. oḍa ..
aṭṭe nē naḍacēvellā hari nīpradakṣiṇālē
guṭṭuna nāsētalellā gōvinda nīkaiṅkaryālē
muṭṭi nēbhujiñcinavi mukunda nīprasādālē
neṭṭana nābhōgamellā nīvasamu cēsiti …. oḍa ..
yila nē baṇḍabaḍēvi yīśvara nīku mokkulē
talacē nātalapellā damōdara nīdhyāname
naluvaṅka śrīvēṅkaṭanāyaka nīyanujñanu
nelavai nābhavamulellā nīsommu cēsiti …. oḍa ..
I seek Your consent O Upendra! Now!
All this haste is but to serve You!
All that I see with my eyes, O Lotus eyed, it is Your divine feet
All that I hear, O Vishnu, are Your glories
All the right words that I speak, O Trivikrama, are Your incantations
All that I think of, I surrender it unto You!
Likewise, wherever I tread, O Hari, it is like circumambulating You
All my esoteric deeds, O Govinda, it is Your ‘Kainkaryam’
All that I partake and eat, O Mukunda, it is Your prasadam
Without fail, all my comforts, under Your control I placed!
Wherever I lie down, O Lord of all, it is prostration unto You
All the thoughts that I think of, O Damodhara, it is contemplation on You
On all four sides, O SreeVenkatanayaka, it is but Your command
Totally my existence, I entrust unto You!!!
118119

item.title: ०५८ इदिये कावलॆननि ता गैकॊनि
item.description:
Idiyē Kāvalenani Tā Gaikoni
इदिये कावलॆननि ता गैकॊनि यिच्चगिञ्चुवाडे घनुडु
वदलकुरो हरिदासुलमत मिदि वर्णिञ्चॆद नोविवेकुलाला ॥॥ इदिये ॥
देवुडुगलडनि मदिलो दॆलियटे जन्मफलम्बु
तावुग नातनि नॆप्पुडु दलचुटे तनभाग्यमु
श्रीवैष्णवधर्ममु दप्पक चॆलगुटये वैभवमु
देवतान्तरम्बुलन्निय मानिनदिये सुकृतम्बु ॥॥ इदिये ॥
कामक्रोधमु लुज्जगिञ्चुटये कल्याणानुभवमु
चेमुञ्चि पापमु सेयकमानुटे चॆप्पग लाभमु
नेममुतोडुत विरक्तुडगुटे निर्मलानन्दमु
वेमरु नाचार्यसेवसेयटे विचारिम्पग दाचिनधनमु ॥॥ इदिये ॥
प्रकृतिविकारमुलकु जॊरकुण्डुटे परममैनसात्विकमु
सकलबन्धमुल बॆडबासिनदे साव्रूज्यपदमु
प्रकटिम्पग नलमेलुमङ्गकुनु पतियगु श्रीवेङ्कटविभुनि
अकलङ्कुडै कॊलिचियण्डुटे यनन्तमहिमातिशयम्बु ॥॥ इदिये ॥
idiyē kāvalenani tā gaikoni yiccagiñcuvāḍē ghanuḍu
vadalakurō haridāsulamata midi varṇiñceda nōvivēkulālā .. idiyē
dēvuḍugalaḍani madilō deliyuṭē janmaphalambu
tāvuga nātani neppuḍu dalacuṭē tanabhāgyamu
śrīvaiṣṇavadharmamu dappaka celaguṭayē vaibhavamu
dēvatāntarambulanniyu māninadiyē sukṛtambu …. idiyē ..
kāmakrōdhamu lujjagiñcuṭayē kalyāṇānubhavamu
cēmuñci pāpamu sēyakamānuṭē ceppaga lābhamu
nēmamutōḍuta viraktuḍaguṭē nirmalānandamu
vēmaru nācāryasēvasēyuṭē vicārimpaga dācinadhanamu .. idiyē ..
prakṛtivikāramulaku jorakuṇḍuṭē paramamainasātvikamu
sakalabandhamula beḍabāsinadē sāmrājyapadamu
prakaṭimpaga nalamēlumaṅgakunu patiyagu śrīvēṅkaṭavibhuni
akalaṅkuḍai koliciyuṇḍuṭē yanantamahimātiśayambu .. .. idiyē ..
The one who desires and accepts saying ‘This is what I want’, he is the great one!
Do not let go, this is the philosophy of Hari-daasas, I shall now describe, O great ones!
To comprehend in the mind that God exists, that itself is the ‘Janma-Phalamu’1
Thinking about Him constantly is one’s fortune
To follow without fail the SreeVaishnava Dharma1 is true glory
Not differentiating between the deities is real virtue!
To abstain form Kaama3 and Krodha4 is an auspicious experience
Not committing sins knowingly is itself a gain
Living righteously and becoming dispassionate is itself pristine joy
Regularly engaging in the service of Acharya is accrued wealth!
Not falling in to the passions of nature is but being supremely Sattvik5
Shirking off all attachments is itself the Kingly post
Worshipping Alamelumanga and Her consort SreeVenkata Vibhu
as a pure hearted one, is itself eternal and highest glory!!
1.The fruit of life
2.The philosophy of Ramanujacharya
3.Desires
4.Anger
5.The mode of goodness
120121

item.title: ०५९ श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि सिङ्गारमु
item.description:
Śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruni Siṅgāramu
श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि सिङ्गारमु वर्णिञ्चिते
येविधान दलचिना यिन्नटिकि दगुनु ॥॥ श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि ॥
करिराजुगाचिन चक्रमु वट्टिन हस्तमु
करितुण्डमनि चॆप्पगा नमरुनु
वरमुलिच्चेयट्टि वरदहस्तमु कल्प -
तरुशाख यनि पोल्पदगु नीकुनु ॥॥ श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि ॥
जलधिबुट्टिन पाञ्चजन्यहस्तमु नीकु
जलधितरगयनि चाटवच्चुनु
बलुकाळिङ्गुनितोकपट्टिनकटि हस्तमु
पॊलुपै फणीन्द्रुडनि पॊगडगदगुनु ॥॥ श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि ॥
नलिनहस्तम्बुलनडुमनुन्न नीयर-
मलुमेलुमङ्ग किरवनदगुनु
बलु श्रीवेङ्कटगिरिपै नॆलकॊन्न निन्नु-
नलरि श्रीवॆङ्कटेशु डनदगुनु ॥॥ श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि ॥
śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruni siṅgāramu varṇiñcitē
yēvidhāna dalacinā yinnaṭiki dagunu ..śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruni
karirājugācina cakramu vaṭṭina hastamu
karituṇḍamani ceppagā namarunu
varamuliccēyaṭṭi varadahastamu kalpa -
taruśākha yani pōlpadagu nīkunu ..śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruni
jaladhibuṭṭina pāñcajanyahastamu nīku
jaladhitaragayani cāṭavaccunu
balukāḷiṅgunitōkapaṭṭinakaṭi hastamu
polupai phaṇīndruḍani pogaḍagadagunu. śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruni
nalinahastambulanaḍumanunna nīyura-
malumēlumaṅga kiravanadagunu
balu śrīvēṅkaṭagiripai nelakonna ninnu-
nalari śrīveṅkaṭēśu ḍanadagunu .śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruni
Sree Venkateshwara’s fascinating beauty if described
in whatever way we perceive, it matches these!
The hand that wields the Chakra which saved the elephant
to say that it is like an elephants trunk, is befitting
The Varada-Hasta1 that bestows boons
can be compared to a branch of the Kalpataru2 tree!
The hand that holds the Panchajanya which was born of the ocean
can be called as the wave of an ocean!
The Kati-Hasta3 which held the tail of the mighty Kalinga
can be agreeably praised as the king of snakes!
The chest that is in-between the two lotus like hands
can be called as the firm abode of Alamelumanga
You, who exist on the top of Venkatagiri
can be gloriously called as SreeVenkatesha!
1.Varada Hasta is the hand that bestows boons, held in a blessing posture
2.Kalpataru tree is a wish yielding tree
3.Kati Hasta is the hand that is placed on the waist
122123

item.title: ०६० सॊरिदिमम्मिट्टे
item.description:
Soridimammiṭṭē
सॊरिदि मम्मिट्टे दयजातुवुगाका
वॆरसि मरि यॆक्कडा नेमि विन्नविञ्चे मिकनु ॥॥ सॊरिदि ॥
तलचिति नी रूपमु तगिलिति नीपादालु
कलसिति नीदासुलगमिलोननु
चलिवासॆ भवमुलु सडिदीरॆ गर्ममुलु
यॆलमि नी महिमलु येमिचॆप्पे मिकनु ॥॥ सॊरिदि ॥
नीमुद्रलु धरिञ्चिति नीगुणालु वॊगडिति
चेमुट्टि पूजिञ्चिति श्रीयङ्गालु
तामसमुलॆल्ला नूडॆ ततिवच्चॆ सात्विकमु
गोमुन मरेमि निन्नु कॊसरे मिकनु ॥॥ सॊरिदि ॥
तिरुमणि धरिञ्चिति तीर्थप्रसादालु गॊण्टि
विरिवैननीकथलु वीनुल विण्टि
परग श्रीवॆङ्कटेश परमु निहमु गण्टि
अरसि यितर मेमि आशपडे मिकनु ॥॥ सॊरिदि ॥
soridi mammiṭṭē dayajūtuvugākā
verasi mari yekkaḍā nēmi vinnaviñcē mikanu …. soridi ..
talaciti nī rūpamu tagiliti nīpādālu
kalasiti nīdāsulagamilōnanu
calivāse bhavamulu saḍidīre garmamulu
yelami nī mahimalu yēmiceppē mikanu …. soridi ..
nīmudralu dhariñciti nīguṇālu vogaḍiti
cēmuṭṭi pūjiñciti śrīyaṅgālu
tāmasamulellā nūḍe tativacce sātvikamu
gōmuna marēmi ninnu kosarē mikanu …. soridi ..
tirumaṇi dhariñciti tīrthaprasādālu goṇṭi
virivainanīkathalu vīnula viṇṭi
paraga śrīveṅkaṭēśa paramu nihamu gaṇṭi
arasi yitara mēmi āśapaḍē mikanu …. soridi ..
In this manner, may You shower Your grace!
Where else can we put forth our pleadings?
I contemplated on Your form, I touched Your feet
I joined the group of Your daasas
My sorrows trembled, my karmas became detached
About Your joyous glories, what more can I say?
I wore Your mudras, I praised Your attributes
With my hands I touched and worshipped Your Sree-Angas1
The Tamasik qualities dropped off, in a timely manner came Saatvik qualities
What more can we ask of You fondly?
I wore the Tiruman, I humbly took teertha and prasadam
I enjoyed listening to the many glorious stories of Yours
SreeVenkatesha! I could perceive ‘now’ and ‘hereafter’
Being totally satisfied, what else can we desire for?!

item.title: ०६१ वारि वारि भाग्यमुलु
item.description:
Vāri Vāri Bhāgyamulu
वारि वारि भाग्यमुलु व्रासि वुन्नवि नॊसळ्ळ
धीरततो नेदि मेलो तॆलुसुकोरो ॥॥ वारि ॥
अट्टे कॊन्दरु मतमुलन्निय नेकमनि
पट्टवर्धनमु नॆत्तिबॆट्टि चूपिरि
जट्टि गॊन्दरु जीवुलु जङ्गमे लिङ्गमुगानि -
पुट्टुगॆल्ला भस्ममनि पूसुक चूपिरि ॥॥ वारि ॥
कॊन्द रेमियनु लेदु कॊट्टगॊन लययनि
अन्दि वट्टिललाटशून्यमु चूपिरि
कन्दुव गॊन्दरु लक्ष्मीकान्तु डन्तरात्मयनि
मुन्दे नाममु श्रीचूर्णमुनु बॆट्टि चूपिरि ॥॥ वारि ॥
चॆलगि दिष्टमिपुडु श्रीवेङ्कटेशुडु
अलमेलुमङ्गपतियै यन्नवाडु
यिलवीर नीदासुल किट्टिभाग्यरेखलु
वलसिनवारिकॆल्ला व्रासिनाडितडु ॥॥ वारि ॥
vāri vāri bhāgyamulu vrāsi vunnavi nosaḷḷa
dhīratatō nēdi mēlō telusukōrō …. vāri ..
aṭṭē kondaru matamulanniyu nēkamani
paṭṭavardhanamu nettibeṭṭi cūpiri
jaṭṭi gondaru jīvulu jaṅgamē liṅgamugāni -
puṭṭugellā bhasmamani pūsuka cūpiri …. vāri ..
konda rēmiyunu lēdu koṭṭagona layayani
aṃdi vaṭṭilalāṭaśūnyamu cūpiri
kanduva gondaru lakṣmīkāntu ḍantarātmayani
mundē nāmamu śrīcūrṇamunu beṭṭi cūpiri …. vāri ..
celagi diṣṭamipuḍu śrīvēṅkaṭēśuḍu
alamēlumaṅgapatiyai yunnavāḍu
yilavīra nīdāsula kiṭṭibhāgyarēkhalu
valasinavārikellā vrāsināḍitaḍu …. vāri ..
It is each ones fortune that is written on the forehead
With courage, do find out which is the superior one!!
Some saying ‘All philosophies are one’
raised and showed their Pattavardhanam1!
Like wise , some others, though saying ‘Jangam is Lingam’2
believe that birth itself is ashes, and smear it visibly!
Some saying ‘There is nothing else except destruction at the end’
showed their empty forehead!
Some others, saying ‘The Lord of Lakshmi is the Antaratma’
applied the marks of Namam and Sreechoornam visibly!
Gloriously, Sree Venkatesha alone is the destiny,
He is the consort of Alamelumanga!
On this earth, these lines of fortune, He has written
only for those daasas who desired them!!

item.title: ०६२ गॊरबै मॊदलुण्डग
item.description:
Gorabai Modaluṇḍaga
गॊरबै मॊदलुण्डग गॊनलकु नी रेल
दॊकदैव मितडे तुदगफलमु ॥॥ गॊरबै ॥
क्रतुवुलु हरिये कर्ममु हरिये
पितरुलकु हरिये पॆनुदृप्ति
सततमन्त्रमुलसारमु हरिये
यितनिसेवे पो यिन्निटिफलमु ॥॥ गॊरबै ॥
अनलमु हरिये आहुति हरिये
जननीजनकुलसरवि हरे
पनिवडि वेदमु ब्रणवमु हरिये
यॆनसितनिपूज यिन्निटिफलमु ॥॥ गॊरबै ॥
येलिकॆ हरिये यरवुनु हरिये
वालायमु सर्वमु हरिये
कालमु श्रीवेङ्कटगिरिहरिये
नेलनीतनिशरणे सफलम्बु ॥॥ गॊरबै ॥
gorabai modaluṇḍaga gonalaku nī rēla
dokadaiva mitaḍē tudagaphalamu …. gorabai ..
kratuvulu hariyē karmamu hariyē
pitarulaku hariyē penudṛpti
satatamantramulasāramu hariyē
yitanisēvē pō yinniṭiphalamu …. gorabai ..
analamu hariyē āhuti hariyē
jananījanakulasaravi harē
panivaḍi vēdamu braṇavamu hariyē
yenasitanipūja yinniṭiphalamu …. gorabai ..
yēlike hariyē yaravunu hariyē
vālāyamu sarvamu hariyē
kālamu śrīvēṅkaṭagirihariyē
nēlanītaniśaraṇē saphalambu …. gorabai ..
When the life force is at the roots, why water the top?
The great Lord is He, who is at the end as the ultimate fruit!
The sacrifices are Hari, the rites are Hari
For the Pithrus1, Hari alone is the great contentment
The essence of all eternal mantras is Hari
Serving Him alone, one attains all these fruits!
The sacred fire is Hari, the oblation is Hari
Like a Father and Mother is Lord Hari
The Vedas and the Pranava2 are but Hari
Performing His Pooja equals all these merits!
The Lord is Hari, our existence is but Hari
Constantly Hari alone is everything!
The eternal Time is SreeVenkatagiri Hari
On this earth, surrendering unto Him alone is fruitful!!!
The essence is that - By serving Hari alone, one can achieve all merits
attained by performing various other deeds.
1.Pithrus are the Manes
2.Pranava means the Omkara
128129

item.title: ०६३ हरिनॆऱुगनिजन्म
item.description:
Harineṟuganijanma
हरि नॆऱुगनिजन्म मदि येला आ -
सरुस नातडु लेनि चदुवेला ॥॥ हरि ॥
दयदॊलगिनयट्टि तपमेला
भयमुलेनियट्टिभक्तेला
प्रियमुमानिनयट्टिपॆनगेला मञ्चि -
क्रियाविरुद्धपु कीर्तनलेला ॥॥ हरि ॥
फलमुलेनियट्टिपनुलेला कडु -
गलिमिलेनियट्टि गर्वमेला
बलिमिलेनियट्टिपन्तमेला शौरि -
दलचलेनियट्टि तनुवदि येला ॥॥ हरि ॥
तन कमरनि दॊरतनमेला
चनुवुलेनियट्टिसलिगॆ येला
यॆनलेना श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि शरणनि
मनगलिगिनमीद मरिचिन्तलेला ॥॥ हरि ॥
hari neṟuganijanma madi yēlā ā -
sarusa nātaḍu lēni caduvēlā …. hari ..
dayadolaginayaṭṭi tapamēlā
bhayamulēniyaṭṭibhaktēlā
priyamumāninayaṭṭipenagēlā mañci -
kriyāviruddhapu kīrtanalēlā …. hari ..
phalamulēniyaṭṭipanulēlā kaḍu -
galimilēniyaṭṭi garvamēlā
balimilēniyaṭṭipantamēlā śauri -
dalacalēniyaṭṭi tanuvadi yēlā …. hari ..
tana kamarani doratanamēlā
canuvulēniyaṭṭisalige yēlā
yenalēnā śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruni śaraṇani
managaliginamīda maricintalēlā …. hari ..
Why that birth, which does not know of Hari?
What is the use of that study which does not concern Him?
Why the penance without compassion?
Why that devotion without any fear for God?
Why that dispute without love for others?
Why sing the praises of Lord when not living righteously?
Why perform the deeds that are fruitless?
Why so much pride without any wealth?
Why be adamant without a strong will?
Why possess a body that does not think of Showri1?
Why the rulership which is not befitting?
Why move about with anyone without affection for them?
Surrendering unto the matchless SreeVenkatesha,
if we can live, why then worry at all?
1. Lord Vishnu
130131

item.title: ०६४ सकलोपासकुलकु नन्दुनु
item.description:
Sakalōpāsakulaku Nandunu
सकलोपासकुलकु नन्दुनु सगुणम्बे प्रमाणमु
सकलमुनीन्द्रुलु पूजिञ्चॆ यीसाकारमॆ प्रमाणमु ॥॥ सकलो ॥
सगुणम्बनि निनु गॊन्दरु सरि निर्गुणमनि कॊन्दरु
वगल बॆक्कुगति जदिविनकॊलदुल वारिकिवारे वादिन्तुरु
अगणितस्वतन्त्रुडवुगान अल वाल्मीकि इट्टिट्टनके
अगु ““निर्गुणाय गुणात्मने’’ यनि आनति इच्चुटे प्रमाणमु ॥ ॥सकलो॥
““सोहं’’ बनि कॊन्दरु ““दासोहं’’ बनि कॊन्दरु
साहसवृत्तुल रॆण्डुदॆरङ्गुल सकलविवेकुलु भजिन्तुरु
देहधारियै ““दासोहं’’ बनि तेरि शुकुडु मीलो गलसॆ
सोहपुभावन सर्वजगत्तुल जापिन देप्रमाणमु ॥॥ सकलो ॥
आरुशास्त्रमुल नारुमतम्बुल नारुगर्ममुलनैनानु
यीरीतिल मिमु शरणनि कॊलुवक यॆव्वरि कुपायमु लेदु
नारदादुलगुभक्तु लिन्दरुनु नानागतु लरसि चूचि
सारपु श्रीवेङ्कटपति मीके शरणनुटे प्रमाणमु ॥॥ सकलो ॥
sakalōpāsakulaku nandunu saguṇambē pramāṇamu
sakalamunīndrulu pūjiñce yīsākārame pramāṇamu …. sakalō
saguṇambani ninu gondaru sari nirguṇamani kondaru
vagala bekkugati jadivinakoladula vārikivārē vādinturu
agaṇitasvatantruḍavugāna ala vālmīki iṭṭiṭṭanakē
agu “nirguṇāya guṇātmanē’’ yani ānati iccuṭē pramāṇamu .. sakalō
“sōhaṃ’’ bani kondaru “dāsōhaṃ’’ bani kondaru
sāhasavṛttula reṇḍuderaṅgula sakalavivēkulu bhajinturu
dēhadhāriyai “dāsōhaṃ’’ bani tēri śukuḍu mīlō galase
sōhapubhāvana sarvajagattula jūpina dēpramāṇamu ..sakalō
āruśāstramula nārumatambula nārugarmamulanainānu
yīrītila mimu śaraṇani koluvaka yevvari kupāyamu lēdu
nāradādulagubhaktu lindarunu nānāgatu larasi cūci
sārapu śrīvēṅkaṭapati mīkē śaraṇanuṭē pramāṇamu .. sakalō
For all those who are constantly engaged in worship, the Saguna form is the authority!
This manifested form which is worshipped by all sages, is alone the authority!
Some say You are ‘Saguna’, some say You are ‘Nirguna’
according to their knowledge acquired by various means, they argue amongst themselves!
Since You are immeasurable and autonomous, Valmiki, without saying anything else,
said “Nirgunaya Gunatmane”1, and this statement alone is the authority!!
“Soham” said some people, “Dasoham” said some others
the two kinds of great expositions, which the wise ones praise!
Having borne a human body, saying “Dasoham”, Shuka attained You
The thought of “Soham”, what proof did it give to the worlds??
Even by following the six shastras, the six mathas2, the six Karmas
without surrendering unto You, there is no other way!
Narada and other such devotees, having examined various other means
surrendered unto You, O Venkatapathi! That itself is the authority!!!
Purport: The Advaitins say that Brahman (Lord) is Nirguna, ie without any attributes, and
that the Jiva itself is the Paramatman-‘Soham’.
The philosophy of Ramanuja (Visistadvaita) says that the Lord is full of auspicious attributes-
Saguna, and that the jiva is the Daasa of the Lord- Daasoham (I am Your Daasa).
Quoting form the scriptures, Annamayya says here that the path of Sharanagati unto the
Saguna form of the Lord, as taught by Ramanuja, is alone the right one!
1.Nirgunaya Gunatmane means : The one who is devoid of all evil qualities
and is the abode of numerous auspicious qualities.
2.The various philosophies
132133

item.title: ०६५ ईतनिमरचिवुण्टि
item.description:
Ītanimaracivuṇṭi
ईतनि मरचिवुण्टि मिन्नाळ्ळुनु
यीतल ने डॆच्चरिञ्चॆ नीतडे पो विष्णुडु ॥॥ ईतनि ॥
तल्लियै पोषिञ्चु तण्ड्रियै रक्षिञ्चु
वुल्लपुबन्धुवुडै वॊड लरय
मॆल्लनॆ दातै इच्चु मॆलुतयै यादरिञ्चु
यॆल्लविधबन्धुवुडु यीतडे पो विष्णुडु ॥॥ ईतनि ॥
येलिकयै मन्निञ्चु निष्टुडै बुद्धिचॆप्पु
चालुमानिसियै यञ्चल दिरुगु
बालुडै मुद्दुचूपु प्राणमै लोन नुण्डु
यीलागुलबन्धु डीतडे पो विष्णुडु ॥॥ ईतनि ॥
देवुडै पूजगॊनु द्रिष्टिगोचरमै
श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रिमीद सिरु लॊसगु
तावै यॆडमिच्चु तलपै फलमिच्चु
यीवलनावल बन्धु डीतडे पो विष्णुडु ॥॥ ईतनि ॥
ītani maracivuṇṭi minnāḷḷunu
yītala nē ḍeccariñce nītaḍē pō viṣṇuḍu …. ītani ..
talliyai pōṣiñcu taṇḍriyai rakṣiñcu
vullapubandhuvuḍai voḍa larayu
mellane dātai iccu melutayai yādariñcu
yellavidhabandhuvuḍu yītaḍē pō viṣṇuḍu …. ītani ..
yēlikayai manniñcu niṣṭuḍai buddhiceppu
cālumānisiyai yañcala dirugu
bāluḍai mudducūpu prāṇamai lōna nuṇḍu
yīlāgulabandhu ḍītaḍē pō viṣṇuḍu …. ītani ..
dēvuḍai pūjagonu driṣṭigōcaramai
śrīvēṅkaṭādrimīda siru losagu
tāvai yeḍamiccu talapai phalamiccu
yīvalanāvala bandhu ḍītaḍē pō viṣṇuḍu …. ītani ..
All these days, we were oblivious of You!
Today , He who cautioned me in my mind, He is Lord Vishnu!!
He nourishes as a Mother, protects as a Father
As one close to the heart, He rules over the body
As a giver He gently bestows, as a gentle lady He looks after
In all ways, He alone is our close relative, that Lord Vishnu!
He forgives as the Lord, as a dear one He advices
As a near one, He moves about closely
As a little boy He shows affection, as the life-force He resides within
In this manner, He alone is our close relative, that Lord Vishnu!
As a God He accepts worship, Being visibly present
on SreeVenkatadri, He bestows prosperity!
As an abode He grants refuge, as the thought He bestows fruits
Here and there, He alone is our close relative, that Lord Vishnu!!!
134135

item.title: ०६६ नी वॊक्कडवे नाकु जालु
item.description:
Nī Vokkaḍavē Nāku Jālu
नी वॊक्कडवे नाकु जालु नीरजाक्ष नारायण
नीवे नाकु गतियनि तॆलिसिति नॆक्कॊनि यितरमु वृथा वृथा ॥ ॥नीवॊक्क॥
मीनामोच्छारणमे मॆरसिन दुःखनिवारणमु
मीनामोच्छारणमे मॆलगु शुभकरमु
नानावेदशास्त्रमुलु नवपुराणेतिहासमुलु
मीनाममुलोने वुन्नवि मिगिलिन विन्निय वृथा वृथा ॥॥नीवॊक्क॥
नीपादमूलमु निङ्गिय भुविय रसातलमु
नीपादमूलमु निखिलजीवपरिणाममुलु
दीपिञ्चिनचराचरम्बुलु दिव्युलु मुनुलनु सर्वमुनु
नी पादमूलमे मरि नॆरि नितरम्बुलु वृथा वृथा ॥॥नीवॊक्क॥
देव मीतिरुमेनु दिक्कुनु ब्रह्माण्डाधारमु
देव मीतिरुमे नुत्पत्तिस्थितिलयमुलकुनु आकरमु
श्रीवेङ्कटपति नाभावमु चित्तमु नीके समर्पण
देव मीशरणमु चॊच्चिति दिक्कुलन्नियनु वृथा वृथा ॥॥नीवॊक्क॥
nī vokkaḍavē nāku jālu nīrajākṣa nārāyaṇa
nīvē nāku gatiyani telisiti nekkoni yitaramu vṛthā vṛthā. nīvokka
mīnāmōcchāraṇamē merasina duḥkhanivāraṇamu
mīnāmōcchāraṇamē melagu śubhakaramu
nānāvēdaśāstramulu navapurāṇētihāsamulu
mīnāmamulōnē vunnavi migilina vinniyu vṛthā vṛthā. nīvokka
nīpādamūlamu niṅgiyu bhuviyu rasātalamu
nīpādamūlamu nikhilajīvapariṇāmamulu
dīpiñcinacarācarambulu divyulu munulanu sarvamunu
nī pādamūlamē mari neri nitarambulu vṛthā vṛthā. nīvokka
dēva mītirumēnu dikkunu brahmāṇḍādhāramu
dēva mītirumē nutpattisthitilayamulakunu ākaramu
śrīvēṅkaṭapati nābhāvamu cittamu nīkē samarpaṇa
dēva mīśaraṇamu cocciti dikkulanniyunu vṛthā vṛthā. nīvokka
You alone are enough for me, O lotus eyed Narayana!
I have realized that You alone are the means, rest all is fruitless!
Pronouncing Your name alone is the remover of sorrows
Pronouncing Your name alone is the one that bestows auspiciousness
The various Vedas, Shastras, the nine Puranas, the Ithihasas
all exist within You name! Rest are all fruitless!
The origin of the sky, earth, and the nether worlds is but Your feet
The evolution of all Jivas originates from Your feet
The sentient beings, non sentient things, the divine beings, the sages,
and everything originate from Your feet alone! Rest are all fruitless!
O Lord, Your divine body is the means and support of the entire Universe
O Lord, Your divine body is the source of creation, sustenance and destruction
SreeVenkatapathi! I surrender my thoughts and my mind unto You
O Lord! I surrendered unto You! All other means are fruitless!!!
136137

item.title: ०६७ कलियग मॆटुलैना
item.description:
Kaliyuga Meṭulainā
कलियग मॆटुलैना गलदुगा नीकरुण
जलजाक्ष हरिहरि सर्वेश्वरा ॥॥ कलियग ॥
पाप मॆन्त गलिगिन बरिहरिञ्चेयन्दुकु
नापाल गलदुगा नीनाममु
कोपमॆन्त गलिगिन कॊच्चि शान्तमिच्चुटकु
चेपट्टि कलवुगा नाचित्तमुलो नीवु ॥॥ कलियग ॥
धर निन्द्रिया लॆन्त तरमुकाडिन नन्नु
सरि गावगद्दुगा नीशरणागति
गरिम गर्मबन्धालु गट्टिनताळ्ळु वूडिञ्च
निरति गलदु गा नीभक्ति नाकु ॥॥ कलियग ॥
हितमैन यिहपरा लिष्टमैनवॆल्ला निय्य
सतमै कलदुगा नीसङ्कीर्तन
तति श्रीवेङ्कटेश नातपमु फलियिम्पिञ्च
गति गलदुगा नीकमलादेवि ॥॥ कलियग ॥
kaliyuga meṭulainā galadugā nīkaruṇa
jalajākṣa harihari sarvēśvarā …. kaliyuga ..
pāpa menta galigina barihariñcēyanduku
nāpāla galadugā nīnāmamu
kōpamenta galigina kocci śāntamiccuṭaku
cēpaṭṭi kalavugā nācittamulō nīvu …. kaliyuga..
dhara nindriyā lenta taramukāḍina nannu
sari gāvagaddugā nīśaraṇāgati
garima garmabandhālu gaṭṭinatāḷḷu vūḍiñca
nirati galadu gā nībhakti nāku …. kaliyuga ..
hitamaina yihaparā liṣṭamainavellā niyya
satamai kaladugā nīsaṅkīrtana
tati śrīvēṅkaṭēśa nātapamu phaliyimpiñca
gati galadugā nīkamalādēvi …. kaliyuga ..
Whatever the ways of Kali yuga, there is always Your compassion!
O lotus eyed Hari! Hari, O Lord of all!
Whatever be the measure of the sin, to absolve it
with me is Your glorious name!
However much be the rage, to bestow peace
You exist within my mind!
On this earth, how much ever my senses chase me
to protect me, there is the path of Sharanagathi unto You!
To untie the binding ropes of great attachments due to Karmas
constantly, there is my devotion for You!
To bestow benevolently, all the desired things ‘here’ and ‘hereafter’
eternally, there is Your Sankirtanam!
To make my penances fruitful easily, O SreeVenkatesha
as ‘the means’, there is Your Kamala-devi1!
1. Godess Lakshmi, who is ever compassionate
138139

item.title: ०६८ परमपुरुष निरुपमान
item.description:
Paramapuruṣa Nirupamāna
परमपुरुष निरुपमान शरणु शरणु रे
इन्दिरा निजमन्दिरा ॥ ॥परम॥
कमलनाभ कमलनयन कमलचरणे रे
अमितसुरमुनिनाथयूथपनायका वरदायका ॥॥परम॥
चतुरमूरिति चतुरबाहुशङ्खचक्रधरा
अतिशय श्री वेङ्कटाधिप अञ्जनाकृतिरञ्जना ॥॥परम॥
paramapuruṣa nirupamāna śaraṇu śaraṇu rē
iṃdirā nijamandirā ….parama..
kamalanābha kamalanayana kamalacaraṇē rē
amitasuramunināthayūthapanāyakā varadāyakā …. parama
caturamūriti caturabāhuśaṅkhacakradharā
atiśaya śrī vēṅkaṭādhipa aṃjanākṛtirañjanā …. parama
O Parama Purusha! O matchless one!
I surrender unto You! O true abode of Lakshmi!
O one with a lotus navel! O lotus eyed!
O Lord with lotus like feet!
O Lord of all demigods and sages!
O lord of the herds! O granter of boons!
O four-formed one! O one with four arms!
O one who wields the conch and discus!
O Supreme Lord of Venkata Hill,
O enjoyer of the praises of Anjana!
I surrender unto You!
140141

item.title: ०६९ धरलो ""नॆद्भावं तद्भव’’ तनॆगान
item.description:
Dharalō “Nedbhāvaṃ Tadbhava’’ Tanegāna
धरलो ““नॆद्भावं तद्भव’’ तनॆगान
हरिमयमे जगमन्तानु ॥॥ धरलो ॥
महि नोदटिवारन्दु मलिनमु दलचिन
तहतह मनसे ता मलिनमु
वहि नॆदिटन्दु भावनमु भाविञ्चिन
बहुविधमुल दानू भावनमे ॥॥ धरलो ॥
यॆक्कुव नॆदिटिपापा लॆञ्चि निन्दिचेटि -
निक्कपुनालुक ताने निन्दितमु
वॊक्कटै यॆदटिपुण्या लुग्गडिञ्चि घन मण्टे
दक्किनपुण्यपुजिह्व तानू घनमे ॥॥ धरलो ॥
सारॆ श्रीवेङ्कटपति सगुणमु दलचिन
सारपुजीवुडु दानु सगुणमे
नेरुपुल नातनिनिर्गुणमु दलचिन
तारतम्यमुलुलेनि तानू निर्गुणमे ॥॥ धरलो ॥
dharalō “nedbhāvaṃ tadbhava’’ tanegāna
harimayamē jagamantānu …. dharalō ..
mahi nōdaṭivārandu malinamu dalacina
tahataha manasē tā malinamu
vahi nediṭandu bhāvanamu bhāviñcina
bahuvidhamula dānū bhāvanamē …. dharalō ..
yekkuva nediṭipāpā leñci nindicēṭi -
nikkapunāluka tānē ninditamu
vokkaṭai yedaṭipuṇyā luggaḍiñci ghana maṇṭē
dakkinapuṇyapujihva tānū ghanamē …. dharalō ..
sāre śrīvēṅkaṭapati saguṇamu dalacina
sārapujīvuḍu dānu saguṇamē
nērupula nātaninirguṇamu dalacina
tāratamyamululēni tānū nirguṇamē …. dharalō ..
On this earth, it is “Yath Bhaavam – Tad Bhavathi”1
Hari alone pervades the whole world!
In this world, if one thinks others to be sinful
that kind of a mind itself is sinful!
In the same way, if one thinks that others are good
in very many ways, that person alone is good!
If one tries to criticize the sinful ways of others
such an ignorant tongue is itself worthy of blame!
Seeing only the meritorious deeds of others, if one praises them to be great
such a virtuous tongue is itself great!
Constantly if one seeks the Saguna form of SreeVenkatapathi,
the Jiva who knows the essence of it, is himself full of qualities!
Out of cleverness, if one thinks of Him as Nirguna,
Such a person without any difference, he himself becomes devoid of all qualities!
1.Literally means: “what one thinks of, that alone he becomes”
The final purport is that what one thinks of, he himself becomes that.
So he who thinks that the Lord is devoid of qualities, himself becomes
devoid of all qualities!!
142143

item.title: ०७० अन्निटिकि हरि यन्तर्यामि
item.description:
Anniṭiki Hari Yantaryāmi
अन्निटिकि हरि यन्तर्यामि मूलमु
विन्नकन्न गतुलॆल्ला वृथा मूलमु ॥॥ अन्निटिकि ॥
लालितवैराग्यमूलमु मोक्षमु
अलरि संसारमूल मतिबन्धमु
मेलिमिशान्तमूलमे सुखमु
वीलि क्रोधमूलमे वॆडदुःखमु ॥॥ अन्निटिकि ॥
कैकॊनुभवमुले कर्म मूलमु
श्रीकान्तुनिपै भक्ति चिन्मूलमु
पैकॊन्न ध्यानमॆल्ल भावमूलमु
दीकॊनि लम्पटमुलु देहमूलमु ॥॥ अन्निटिकि ॥
अरुदै सुज्ञान माचार्यु मूलमु
धरणि जगत्तॆल्ला धनमूलमु
परमु श्रीवेङ्कटपति मूलमु
हरि नाकितनिशरणागति मूलमु ॥॥ अन्निटिकि ॥
anniṭiki hari yantaryāmi mūlamu
vinnakanna gatulellā vṛthā mūlamu …. anniṭiki ..
lālitavairāgyamūlamu mōkṣamu
alari saṃsāramūla matibandhamu
mēlimiśāntamūlamē sukhamu
vīli krōdhamūlamē veḍaduḥkhamu …. anniṭiki ..
kaikonubhavamulē karma mūlamu
śrīkāntunipai bhakti cinmūlamu
paikonna dhyānamella bhāvamūlamu
dīkoni lampaṭamulu dēhamūlamu …. anniṭiki ..
arudai sujñāna mācāryu mūlamu
dharaṇi jagattellā dhanamūlamu
paramu śrīvēṅkaṭapati mūlamu
hari nākitaniśaraṇāgati mūlamu …. anniṭiki ..
For everything, Hari – the Antaryami, is the origin
All other means that are heard of, or seen, are fruitless!
For Moksha, joyful ‘Vairagya’1 is the origin
For strong attachments, Samsara is the origin
For happiness, Supreme peace is the origin
For extreme sorrow, excessive rage is the origin
For all the sorrows that we accrue, Our Karma is the origin
For Supreme bliss, devotion to Sree-Kantha is the origin
For contemplation, thought is the origin
For attachments, body is the origin
For attaining the rare right-knowledge, Acharya is the origin
On this earth, for the material world, money is the origin
For supreme salvation, SreeVenkatapathi is the origin
For me, Sharanagathi unto Hari is the supreme means!
1.Dispassion
144145

item.title: ०७१ ईतनिमूलमॆपो
item.description:
Ītanimūlamepō
ईतनिमूलमॆपो यिलगलधनमुलु
यीतडु माकु गलडु यॆन्त लेदु धनमु ॥॥ ईतनि ॥
विरति माधनमु, विज्ञानमे धनमु
मरिगिनतत्वमे माधनमु
परमु माधनमु, भक्ते माधनमु मा -
करिराजवरदुडे कैवल्यधनमु ॥॥ ईतनि ॥
शान्तमे माधनमु, सङ्कीर्तने धनमु
यॆन्तैना निश्चिन्तमे इहधनमु
अन्तरात्मे माधनमु, हरिदास्यमे धनमु
यिन्तटा लक्ष्मीकान्तु डिण्टि मूलधनमु ॥॥ ईतनि ॥
आनन्दमे धनमु, आचार्युडे धनमु
नानाट बरिपूर्णमे धनमु
ध्यानमे माधनमु, दये माधनमु
पानिन श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रिपतिये माधनमु ॥॥ ईतनि ॥
ītanimūlamepō yilagaladhanamulu
yītaḍu māku galaḍu yenta lēdu dhanamu …. ītani ..
virati mādhanamu, vijñānamē dhanamu
mariginatatvamē mādhanamu
paramu mādhanamu, bhaktē mādhanamu mā -
karirājavaraduḍē kaivalyadhanamu …. ītani ..
śāntamē mādhanamu, saṅkīrtanē dhanamu
yentainā niścintamē ihadhanamu
aṃtarātmē mādhanamu, haridāsyamē dhanamu
yintaṭā lakṣmīkāntu ḍiṇṭi mūladhanamu …. ītani ..
ānandamē dhanamu, ācāryuḍē dhanamu
nānāṭa baripūrṇamē dhanamu
dhyānamē mādhanamu, dayē mādhanamu
pānina śrīvēṅkaṭādripatiyē mādhanamu …. ītani ..
Because of Him alone, here on this earth there is prosperity!
He is there for us! How much wealth we possess!
Dispassion is our wealth, special knowledge is our wealth
The Para-Tattvas1 are our wealth
The supreme is our wealth, devotion is our wealth
Our Kariraja-Varada2 is the wealth of beatitude!
Peace is our wealth, Sankirtana is our wealth
Whatever be it, to remain free from worries is our wealth here
The knowledge of the inner self is our wealth, Serving Hari is our wealth
Everywhere, the Lord of Lakshmi is the glorious treasure of our house!
Happiness is our wealth, Acharya is our wealth
For always, the wholesome Deity is our wealth
Contemplation is our wealth, compassion is our wealth
The all pervading Lord of SreeVenkatadri is our God!!!
1.The supreme truths
2.The Lord who blessed the elephant king
146147

item.title: ०७२ कण्टिरा विण्टिरा कमलनाभुनि
item.description:
Kaṇṭirā Viṇṭirā Kamalanābhuni
कण्टिरा विण्टिरा कमलनाभुनि शक्ति
वॊण्टि नितनिशरण मॊकटे वुपायमु ॥॥ कण्टिरा ॥
यीतनिनाभि बॊडमॆ यॆक्कुवैन ब्रह्मय
यीतडे रक्षिञ्चिनाडु यिन्द्रादुल
यीत डाकुमीद देलॆ नेकार्णवमुनाडु
यीतडे पो हरि मनकन्दरिकि दैवमु ॥॥ कण्टिरा ॥
यीतडे यसुरभाध लिन्निय बरिहरिञ्चॆ
नीतनि मूडडुगुले यीलोकालु
यीतडे मूलमण्टे नेतॆञ्चि करि गाचॆ
नीतनिकण्टॆ वेल्पुलिक मरि कलरा ॥॥ कण्टिरा ॥
यीतडे वैकुन्थनाथु डीतडे रमानाथु -
डीतडे वेदोक्तदैव मिन्निटा दानॆ
यीतडे अन्तर्यामि यी चराचरमुलकु
नीतडे श्रीवेङ्कटेशु डिहपरधनमु ॥॥ कण्टिरा ॥
kaṇṭirā viṇṭirā kamalanābhuni śakti
voṇṭi nitaniśaraṇa mokaṭē vupāyamu …. kaṇṭirā ..
yītaninābhi boḍame yekkuvaina brahmayu
yītaḍē rakṣiñcināḍu yindrādula
yīta ḍākumīda dēle nēkārṇavamunāḍu
yītaḍē pō hari manakandariki daivamu …. kaṇṭirā ..
yītaḍē yasurabhādha linniyu barihariñce
nītani mūḍaḍugulē yīlōkālu
yītaḍē mūlamaṇṭē nēteñci kari gāce
nītanikaṇṭe vēlpulika mari kalarā …. kaṇṭirā ..
yītaḍē vaikunthanāthu ḍītaḍē ramānāthu -
ḍītaḍē vēdōktadaiva minniṭā dāne
yītaḍē aṃtaryāmi yī carācaramulaku
nītaḍē śrīvēṅkaṭēśu ḍihaparadhanamu …. kaṇṭirā ..
Have you perceived or heard, the powers of the Lotus naveled one?
Surrendering unto Him alone is the means!
From His navel originated the supreme Brahma,
He alone rescued Indra and others
He alone floated upon the leaf during the apocalypse
He alone is Hari, the Lord of all!
He alone destroyed the miseries caused by the demons
His three steps are the three worlds
When called upon as the ‘Adimoola’1, He alone saved the elephant
Above Him, can there be any other deities?
He alone is the Lord of Vaikunta, He alone is the Lord of Sree
He alone is the Lord proclaimed by the Vedas, He pervades all
For the sentient and the non-sentient, He alone is the ‘Antaryami’
He alone is Venkatesha, the wealth of here and hereafter!!!
1.The Primal cause
148149

item.title: ०७३ चेपट्टि मम्मु गावु
item.description:
Cēpaṭṭi Mammu Gāvu
चेपट्टि मम्मु गावु श्रीनरसिंहा नी -
श्रीपादमुले दिक्कु श्रीनरसिंहा ॥॥ चेपट्टि ॥
चॆलगुवेयि चेतुल श्रीनरसिंहा
चिलिकेटिनगवुल श्रीनरसिंहा
सिलुगुलेनिमञ्चि श्रीनरसिंहा नी -
चॆलि दॊडॆक्किञ्चुकॊन्न श्रीनरसिंहा ॥॥ चेपट्टि ॥
क्षीरसमुद्रमुवण्टि श्रीनरसिंहा दैत्यु
जीरिन वज्रपुगोळ्ळ श्रीनरसिंहा
चेरि प्रह्लादुनिमॆच्चे श्रीनरसिंहा नुतिं -
चेरु देवतलु निन्नु श्रीनरसिंहा ॥॥ चेपट्टि ॥
श्रीवनिततो मॆलपु(गु?) श्रीनरसिंहा
चेवदेरॆ नीमहिम श्रीनरसिंहा
श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रिमीदि श्रीनरसिंहा सर्व
जीवदयापरुड वो श्रीनरसिंहा ॥॥ चेपट्टि ॥
cēpaṭṭi mammu gāvu śrīnarasiṃhā nī -
śrīpādamulē dikku śrīnarasiṃhā …. cēpaṭṭi ..
celaguvēyi cētula śrīnarasiṃhā
cilikēṭinagavula śrīnarasiṃhā
silugulēnimañci śrīnarasiṃhā nī -
celi doḍekkiñcukonna śrīnarasiṃhā …. cēpaṭṭi ..
kṣīrasamudramuvaṇṭi śrīnarasiṃhā daityu
jīrina vajrapugōḷḷa śrīnarasiṃhā
cēri prahlādunimeccē śrīnarasiṃhā nutiṃ -
cēru dēvatalu ninnu śrīnarasiṃhā …. cēpaṭṭi ..
śrīvanitatō melapu(gu?) śrīnarasiṃhā
cēvadēre nīmahima śrīnarasiṃhā
śrīvēṅkaṭādrimīdi śrīnarasiṃhā sarva
jīvadayāparuḍa vō śrīnarasiṃhā …. cēpaṭṭi ..
Holding us, do protect us, Sree Narasimha
Your ‘Sree Paadas’ are the only means, Sree Narasimha
You are splendid with a thousand arms, Sree Narasimha
With benevolent smiles, Sree Narasimha
Flawless You are, O glorious Sree Narasimha
You placed Your beloved on your thigh, Sree Narasimha!
O one like the milky ocean, Sree Narasimha
O one with strong nails that tore open the demons, Sree Narasimha
O one who blessed Prahalada, Sree Narasimha
The devathas praise You, O Sree Narasimha!
You reside with Goddess Sree, Sree Narasimha
Valorous are Your deeds, Sree Narasimha
You who reside on Sree Venkatadri, Sree Narasimha
O one who is full of compassion towards all Jivas, Sree Narasimha!!
150151

item.title: ०७४ नेमे ब्रह्ममनु
item.description:
Nēmē Brahmamanu
नेमे ब्रह्ममनु कोनेरमुप नेमु -
कामिञ्चिन स्वतन्त्रमु गडु लेदुगान ॥॥ नेमे ॥
क्षणमुलोपलनॆ सर्वजीवावस्थलूनु
गणुतिञ्चेवा डॊकडु गलडु वेरे
अणुमहत्त्वमुलन्दु नन्तर्यामैनवानि
प्रणुतिञ्चि दासुलमै ब्रदिकेमुगानि ॥॥ नेमे ॥
पनिगॊनि येलुटकु ब्रह्मादिदेवतल
गनिपिञ्चेवा डॊकडु गलडु वेरे
ननिचि सिरुल लक्ष्मीनाथुडैन वानि -
पनुलवारमु नेमु ब्रदिकेमुगानि ॥॥ नेमे ॥
सततरक्षकुडयि शङ्खचक्रधरुडयि
गति श्रीवेङ्कटपति गलडु वेरे
अतनिमऱगु चॊच्चि यानन्दपरवशान
ब्रतिलेक यिन्दरिलो ब्रदिकेमु गानि ॥॥ नेमे ॥
nēmē brahmamanu kōnēramupa nēmu -
kāmiñcina svatantramu gaḍu lēdugāna …. nēmē ..
kṣaṇamulōpalane sarvajīvāvasthalūnu
gaṇutiñcēvā ḍokaḍu galaḍu vērē
aṇumahattvamulandu nantaryāmainavāni
praṇutiñci dāsulamai bradikēmugāni …. nēmē ..
panigoni yēluṭaku brahmādidēvatala
ganipiñcēvā ḍokaḍu galaḍu vērē
nanici sirula lakṣmīnāthuḍaina vāni -
panulavāramu nēmu bradikēmugāni …. nēmē ..
satatarakṣakuḍayi śaṅkhacakradharuḍayi
gati śrīvēṅkaṭapati galaḍu vērē
atanimaṟagu cocci yānandaparavaśāna
bratilēka yindarilō bradikēmu gāni …. nēmē ..
We cannot think of ourselves as Brahman!
We do not even have the independence that we desire!
To create, in a moment, the multitude of all Jivas
there is one who exists separately!
The one who exists in the most subtle to the highest as the ‘Antaryamin’
To Him we offer our worship and exist as His daasas!
Perceivable to Brahma and other Gods, to rule over autonomously
there is one who exists separately!
He is that one who is the prosperous Lord of Lakshmi
We exist as those who work as ordained by Him!
Being the eternal protector, being the wielder of the Shanka-Chakra
there exists Sree Venkatapathi , separately as the Lord!
Coming unto His fold, with joyful ecstasy,
in a matchless way, we live amongst all !!!
152153

item.title: ०७५ नाटिकि नाडे ना चदुवु
item.description:
Nāṭiki Nāḍē Nā Caduvu
नाटिकि नाडे ना चदुवु
माटलाडुचुनु मऱचेटि चदुवु ॥॥ नाटिकि ॥
ऎनय नीतनि नॆऱुगुटके पो
वॆनकवारु चदिविन चदुवु
मनसुन नीतनि मऱचुटके पो
पनिवडि इप्पटि फ्रौढल चदुवु॥॥ नाटिकि ॥
तॆलिसि यितनिने तॆलियटके पो
तॊलुत गृतयगादुल चदुवु
कलिगिन यीतनि गादनने पो
कलियगम्बुलो गलिगिन चदुवु ॥॥ नाटिकि ॥
परमनि वेङ्कटपति गनुटकॆ पो
दॊरलगु ब्रह्मादुल चदुवु
सिरुल नितनि मऱचॆडि कॊरके पो
विरसपु जीवुल विद्यल चदुवु ॥॥ नाटिकि ॥
nāṭiki nāḍē nā caduvu
māṭalāḍucunu maṟacēṭi caduvu …. nāṭiki ..
enaya nītani neṟuguṭakē pō
venakavāru cadivina caduvu
manasuna nītani maṟacuṭakē pō
panivaḍi ippaṭi phrauḍhala caduvu…. nāṭiki ..
telisi yitaninē teliyuṭakē pō
toluta gṛtayugādula caduvu
kaligina yītani gādananē pō
kaliyugambulō galigina caduvu …. nāṭiki ..
paramani vēṅkaṭapati ganuṭake pō
doralagu brahmādula caduvu
sirula nitani maṟaceḍi korakē pō
virasapu jīvula vidyala caduvu …. nāṭiki ..
My daily studies are but for the day!
Even as I utter anything, I tend to forget such studies!
The people in the past studied
only to understand Him!
While the egoistic people of today engage in studies
only to forget Him!
In the earlier Yugas like the Kruta-Yuga, though He was known
yet the studies were only to know Him fully!
In the kali-Yuga, though He exists for us,
the studies are only to deny His presence!
Lords like Brahma and others engage in studies
only to perceive Lord TiruVenkatapathi as the Supreme!
Being affluent, the academic studies of materialistic Jivas
are only to forget Him!!
154155

item.title: ०७६ नीवेमि सेतुवय्य नीवु
item.description:
Nīvēmi Sētuvayya Nīvu
नीवेमि सेतुवय्य नीवु दयानिधि वौदुवु
भाविम्पलेनिवारि पापमिन्ते कानि ॥॥ नीवेमि ॥
परमपदमॊसगि पापमडचेननि
चरमश्लोकमुनन्दु चाटितिवि तॊलुतने
निरति नीभूमिलोन नीवल्ल तप्पु लेदु
परगनम्मनि वारि पापमिन्ते कानि ॥॥ नीवेमि ॥
नी पादमुलकु नाकु नॆय्यमैन लङ्कॆनि
येपुन द्वयारमुन निय्यकॊण्टिवि तॊलुत
दापुगा नीवल्ल निङ्क तप्पु लेदु यॆञ्चिचूचि
पैपैनम्मनिवारि पापमिन्ते कानि ॥॥ नीवेमि ॥
बन्तिपुराणमुलनु भक्तसुलभुडननि
अन्तरात्म वीमाट आडितिवि तॊलुतने
इन्तट श्री वेङ्कटेश येमि सेतुवय्य नीवु
पन्तान नम्मनिवारि पापमिन्ते कानि ॥॥ नीवेमि ॥
nīvēmi sētuvayya nīvu dayānidhi vauduvu
bhāvimpalēnivāri pāpamintē kāni …. nīvēmi ..
paramapadamosagi pāpamaḍacēnani
caramaślōkamunandu cāṭitivi tolutanē
nirati nībhūmilōna nīvalla tappu lēdu
paraganammani vāri pāpamintē kāni …. nīvēmi ..
nī pādamulaku nāku neyyamaina laṅkeni
yēpuna dvayāramuna niyyakoṇṭivi toluta
dāpugā nīvalla niṅka tappu lēdu yeñcicūci
paipainammanivāri pāpamintē kāni …. nīvēmi ..
bantipurāṇamulanu bhaktasulabhuḍanani
aṃtarātma vīmāṭa āḍitivi tolutanē
iṃtaṭa śrī vēṅkaṭēśa yēmi sētuvayya nīvu
pantāna nammanivāri pāpamintē kāni …. nīvēmi ..
What more can You do, O Lord? You are the treasury of compassion!
For those who are unable to comprehend, it is their ill-luck !
“I shall bestow Parama Pada1 by destroying the sins”
Thus You proclaimed in the ‘Charama Sloka’2 at the very beginning
Eternally on this earth, from Your side there are no shortcomings
It is the ill-luck of those who lack total faith in You!
The loving relationship between Your feet and me, in a supreme manner
You proclaimed it as the essence of the Dvayam3 at the very beginning
If rightly appraised, from Your side there is no fault
It is the ill-luck of those who do not believe!
In the many Puranas, declaring “I am easily attainable by Bhaktas”
O inner self, You spoke thus at the very beginning
O Venkatesha! What more can You do?
It is the ill-luck of the adamant people who lack faith!
1.Parama Padam : The Supreme Realm
2.Charama Sloka : The 66th verse of chapter 18 of Bagavad Gita
3.Dvayam : The Dvaya mantra which shows the relationship between God
and the Jiva to be that of a Lord and servant
156157

item.title: ०७७ परुसमॊक्कटे कादा
item.description:
parusamokkaṭē kādā
परुसमॊक्कटे कादा पयिडिगाजेसेदि
अरयलोहमॆट्टुन्ना अन्दुकेमी ॥॥ वरुस ॥
वनजनाभुनि भक्तिवदलकुण्डिन जालु
मनसु ऎन्दु तिरिगिना मरियेमि
मॊनसि मुद्रलु भुजमुल नुण्डिते जालु
तनुवॆन्त हेयमैना दानिकेमि ॥॥ वरुस ॥
श्रीकान्तुनाममु जिह्वदगिलिते जालु
ए कुलजुडैनानु हीनमेमि
साकारुडैन हरि शरणुजॊच्चिन जालु
चेकॊनिपापमुलॆन्नि चेसिनानेमि ॥॥ वरुस ॥
जीवुडॆट्टुन्नानेमि जीवुनिलो अन्तरात्म
श्रीवेङ्कटेशुनिका चिन्तयेमि
येवलन परमैन यिहमैन माकु जालु
कैवशमाय नीतडु कडमलिङ्केला ॥॥ वरुस ॥
parusamokkaṭē kādā payiḍigājēsēdi
arayalōhameṭṭunnā aṃdukēmī …. varusa ..
vanajanābhuni bhaktivadalakuṇḍina jālu
manasu eṃdu tiriginā mariyēmi
monasi mudralu bhujamula nuṇḍitē jālu
tanuventa hēyamainā dānikēmi …. varusa ..
śrīkāntunāmamu jihvadagilitē jālu
ē kulajuḍainānu hīnamēmi
sākāruḍaina hari śaraṇujoccina jālu
cēkonipāpamulenni cēsinānēmi …. varusa ..
jīvuḍeṭṭunnānēmi jīvunilō aṃtarātma
śrīvēṅkaṭēśunikā cintayēmi
yēvalana paramaina yihamaina māku jālu
kaivaśamāya nītaḍu kaḍamaliṅkēlā …. varusa ..
Isnt the process of Alchemy the only one which can turn any metal into gold?
Whatever the metal is how does it matter?
If we do not let go of ‘Bhakti’ for the lotus naveled one, it is enough
wherever the mind roams, how does it matter?
If the marks of the mudras1 are present on my shoulders, it is enough
however lowly the body is, how does it matter?
If SreeKanthas2 name is present upon the tongue, it is enough
whatever caste one belongs to, how is it inferior?
If one surrenders to the manifest Lord Hari, it is enough
how many ever sins one commits, how does it matter?
However the Jiva is, how does it matter?
When SreeVenkatesha is the inner most self, what is the worry?
Whether it is here or hereafter, how does it matter
when we have attained Him, what else is lacking?!
1.Mudras are the permanent marks of the Conch and Discus worn on the
shoulders
2.SreeKantha: The consort of Sree (Vishnu)
158159

item.title: ०७८ दासवर्गमुल कॆल्ला दरिदापु
item.description:
Dāsavargamula Kellā Daridāpu
दासवर्गमुल कॆल्ला दरिदापु मीरे कान
वासिकि नॆक्किञ्चरादा वसुधलो मम्मुनु ॥॥ दास ॥
सेनाधिपति नीवु चेरि विन्नविञ्चरादा
श्रीनाथुनिकि नेमुसेसे विन्नपमु
आनुक भाष्यकारुलु अट्टॆ मीरु जेयरादा
मानक विन्नपमु मा मनवि चनवुलु ॥॥ दास ॥
वेययनोळ्ळ भोगि नीवु विन्नपमु सेयरादा
वेयेसि माविन्नपालु विष्णुनिकिनि
आयितमै गरुडड अट्टॆ मीरु जेयरादा
येयॆड विन्नपमु मा केमि वलसिनानु ॥॥ दास ॥
देवुलम्म यिन्दिर मादिक्कै विन्नविञ्चरादा
श्रीवेङ्कटपतिकि चित्तमन्दुनु
आवेळ शेषाचलम अट्टॆ मीरु जेयरादा
यीवेळ माविन्नपमु लीडेरॆ निकनु ॥॥ दास ॥
dāsavargamula kellā daridāpu mīrē kāna
vāsiki nekkiñcarādā vasudhalō mammunu …. dāsa ..
sēnādhipati nīvu cēri vinnaviñcarādā
śrīnāthuniki nēmusēsē vinnapamu
ānuka bhāṣyakārulu aṭṭe mīru jēyarādā
mānaka vinnapamu mā manavi canavulu …. dāsa ..
vēyayanōḷḷa bhōgi nīvu vinnapamu sēyarādā
vēyēsi māvinnapālu viṣṇunikini
āyitamai garuḍaḍa aṭṭe mīru jēyarādā
yēyeḍa vinnapamu mā kēmi valasinānu …. dāsa ..
dēvulamma yindira mādikkai vinnaviñcarādā
śrīvēṅkaṭapatiki cittamandunu
āvēḷa śēṣācalama aṭṭe mīru jēyarādā
yīvēḷa māvinnapamu līḍēre nikanu …. dāsa ..
For all those who belong to the clan of Dasas, since you are the ones who
are very close, will you not elevate us to a higher state, in this world?
O Senadipathi!1 Will you not approach on our behalf,
the Lord of Sree, with our requests?
After which, O Bhasyakarulu2, will you not do the same,
without fail, presenting our requests and pleadings?
O thousand mouthed Sesha! Will you not put forth
thousands of our requests to Lord Vishnu?
Readily O Garuda, will you not do the same,
pleading for our requests and desires?
O Goddess Indira! Being our refuge, will You not appeal
to SreeVenkatapathi, so that it reaches unto His heart?
At that very time, O Seshachala hill, will you not do the same?
Now our requests will be duly fulfilled!
1.Vishwaksenar, the commander of Vishnu’s mighty army
2.Sree Ramanujacharya
160161

item.title: ०७९ कोटिकि बडगयॆत्ति कॊङ्कनेल
item.description:
Kōṭiki Baḍagayetti Koṅkanēla
कोटिकि बडगयॆत्ति कॊङ्कनेल
यीटुलेनॊ पद मॆक्कि यिक नेल चिन्त ॥॥ कोटिकि ॥
पॆट्टिनदि नॊसलनु पॆद्द पॆद्द तिरुमणि
कट्टिनदि मॊल जिन्न कौपीनमु
पट्टिनदि श्रीहरिपादपद्म मूलमु
यॆट्टयिना माकु मेले यिक नेल चिन्त ॥॥ कोटिकि ॥
चिक्कि ना लोनैनदि श्रीवैष्णवधर्ममु
तॊक्किनदि भवमुल तुदिपदमु
यॆक्किनदि हरिभक्ति यिदि पट्ट पेनुग
यॆक्कुव कॆक्कुवे काक यिक नेल चिन्त ॥॥ कोटिकि ॥
चित्तमुलो निण्डिनदि श्रीपतिरूपमु
हत्तिनदि वैराग्य मात्मधनमु
यॆत्तल जाचिन माकु निदिवो श्रीवेङ्कटेशु -
डॆत्ति ममु गावगानु यिक नेल चिन्त ॥॥ कोटिकि ॥
kōṭiki baḍagayetti koṅkanēla
yīṭulēno pada mekki yika nēla cinta …. kōṭiki ..
peṭṭinadi nosalanu pedda pedda tirumaṇi
kaṭṭinadi mola jinna kaupīnamu
paṭṭinadi śrīharipādapadma mūlamu
yeṭṭayinā māku mēlē yika nēla cinta …. kōṭiki ..
cikki nā lōnainadi śrīvaiṣṇavadharmamu
tokkinadi bhavamula tudipadamu
yekkinadi haribhakti yidi paṭṭa pēnuga
yekkuva kekkuvē kāka yika nēla cinta …. kōṭiki ..
cittamulō niṇḍinadi śrīpatirūpamu
hattinadi vairāgya mātmadhanamu
yettala jūcina māku nidivō śrīvēṅkaṭēśu -
ḍetti mamu gāvagānu yika nēla cinta …. kōṭiki ..
Having attained the highest, why fear?
Having reached the state that is eternal, why worry?
Having worn the Tiruman on the forehead prominently,
Having tied a small loin cloth over the waist,
Having caught hold of SreeHari’s supreme lotus feet,
Whatever happens to us is for the good, why worry at all?
Having obtained and having imbibed fully the SreeVaishnava Dharma1
Having trampled over the end of the cycles of birth and death,
Having mounted onto the royal elephant called ‘Hari-Bhakti’,
Is it not higher than the highest? Why worry at all?
Having the glorious form of Sree-pathi within our hearts,
Having embraced the wealth of the soul called ‘Vairagya’2
Wherever we see, there is SreeVenkatesha,
who uplifts and protects us! Why then worry at all?
1.The philosophy of Ramanuja
2.Dispassion
162163

item.title: ०८० प्रपन्नुलकु निदि परमाचारमु
item.description:
Prapannulaku Nidi Paramācāramu
प्रपन्नुलकु निदि परमाचारमु
विपरीताचारमु विडुवग वलय ॥॥ प्रपन्नु ॥
भगवदपचारमु भागवतापचारमु
दगुलक देवतान्तरमु मानि
नगधरु शरणमु नम्मि याचार्युनि
बगि वायनिदे परमवैष्णवमु ॥॥ प्रपन्नु ॥
दुरहङ्कारमु दःखमु सुखमुनु
बॊरयक प्राकृतुल पॊन्त बोवक
दरिशनाभिमानान धर्ममु वदलक
परिशुद्धि नुण्डुटे परमवैष्णवमु ॥॥ प्रपन्नु ॥
उपायान्तरमु लॊल्लक भक्ति चेपट्टि
यॆपुडू दीर्थप्रसादेच्छतोड
निपुणत श्रीवेङ्कट निलयडॆ गतियनि
प्रपत्ति गलुगुटे परमवैष्णवमु ॥॥ प्रपन्नु ॥
prapannulaku nidi paramācāramu
viparītācāramu viḍuvaga valayu …. prapannu ..
bhagavadapacāramu bhāgavatāpacāramu
dagulaka dēvatāntaramu māni
nagadharu śaraṇamu nammi yācāryuni
bagi vāyanidē paramavaiṣṇavamu …. prapannu ..
durahaṅkāramu daḥkhamu sukhamunu
borayaka prākṛtula ponta bōvaka
dariśanābhimānāna dharmamu vadalaka
pariśuddhi nuṇḍuṭē paramavaiṣṇavamu …. prapannu ..
upāyāntaramu lollaka bhakti cēpaṭṭi
yepuḍū dīrthaprasādēcchatōḍa
nipuṇata śrīvēṅkaṭa nilayuḍe gatiyani
prapatti galuguṭē paramavaiṣṇavamu …. prapannu ..
For Prapannas, this is the highest way of life.
Perverse ways must be definitely shunned.
Not committing Bhagavath apachara and Bh
āgavatha apachara,
Abstaining from differentiating between deities
Believing in the refuge of the one who lifted the mountain (Lord Vishnu)
Not caviling against our Acharyas, is itself the highest Vaishnavism!
Not coming in contact with arrogance, sorrow or joy
Not seeking the company of the materialistic ones
Out of pride of knowledge, not letting go of Dharma
Being pure, is itself the highest Vaishnavism!
Having true devotion, not accepting any other means,
Always having a desire to partake Tirtha and Prasadam
Wisely taking the Lord of Sree Venkata as the sole means,
and performing Prapatti, is alone the highest Vaishnavism!!
164165

item.title: ०८१ देव नीदय यॆन्तुनो
item.description:
Dēva Nīdaya Yentunō
देव नीदय यॆन्तुनो दिव्यसुलभ मॆन्तुनो
काविञ्चि गण्टगटुक काचुकुण्डे विदिवो ॥॥ देव ॥
वॆदक नावसमा वेगुदाका निन्नु नेनु
कदिसि नीमूर्ति कानवसमा
यॆदुट शङ्खुचक्राल यॆट्टिदैवम नेननि
पॊदुगुचु नीकुनीवे पॊडचूपेवुगाक ॥॥ देव ॥
पॊगड नावसमा पुरुणिञ्चि नीगुणालु
तगुल नावसमा नीतलपॆऱिगि
निगिडि वेदशास्त्राल निन्नु नीवे चॆप्पुकॊनि
पगटुमायज्ञानमु पापे विन्तेकाक ॥॥ देव ॥
कॊलुव नावसमा गुऱुतॆऱिगि नीवॆण्ट
चॆलगि नाचेतुल बूजिञ्चवसमा
निलिचि श्रीवेङ्कटेश नीवे नायदलो नुण्डि
मलसि पॆररेपुचु मन्निञ्चेवुगाक ॥॥ देव ॥
dēva nīdaya yentunō divyasulabha mentunō
kāviñci gaṇṭagaṭuka kācukuṇḍē vidivō …. dēva ..
vedaka nāvasamā vēgudākā ninnu nēnu
kadisi nīmūrti kānavasamā
yeduṭa śaṅkhucakrāla yeṭṭidaivama nēnani
podugucu nīkunīvē poḍacūpēvugāka …. dēva ..
pogaḍa nāvasamā puruṇiñci nīguṇālu
tagula nāvasamā nītalapeṟigi
nigiḍi vēdaśāstrāla ninnu nīvē ceppukoni
pagaṭumāyajñānamu pāpē vintēkāka …. dēva ..
koluva nāvasamā guṟuteṟigi nīveṇṭa
celagi nācētula būjiñcavasamā
nilici śrīvēṅkaṭēśa nīvē nāyadalō nuṇḍi
malasi perarēpucu manniñcēvugāka …. dēva ..
O Lord! How great Your compassion is! How divinely affable You are!
You eagerly wait to protect us at all times!
Is it possible for me to search for You?
Is it possible for me to behold Your form?
Until You say ‘I am the Lord who wields the Shanka-Chakra’
and manifest Yourself by your own will!
Is it possible for me to praise You? Or emulate your gunas?
Can I reach You without knowing You in thoughts?
Until You Yourself proclaim Your glories through the Veda-Shastras
and destroy my illusion born of Maya!
Is it possible to worship You by comprehending You?
Is it possible to move about with You and worship You with my hands?
By being present firmly within my heart, O Sree Venkatesha,
until you yourself incite me and grace me!!!
166167

item.title: ०८२ मुदमलर कालमुल मीरिटु मोसपोक
item.description:
Mudamalara Kālamula Mīriṭu Mōsapōka
मुदमलर कालमुल मीरिटु मोसपोक
हृदय मलर भजिम्परोमी
रिटु धनुर्मासमुल विधुलन् ॥॥मुद॥
वेग नालुगु घडिय लनगा
वेदवेद्युलु लेचि सरगुन
नागमोक्त विधुलनु तम देहानु गुणमुलुगा
वेगमुन सन्ध्यादुलॊगि गा
विञ्चि विमलाम्भोधि शयनुनि
बागुगा बूजिञ्चरो यॆड
पक धनुर्मासमुल विधुलनॆ घनुलु ॥॥मुद॥
परगु चीनाम्बरमुलनु नति
परिमळम्मुल बुष्पमुल कडु
वॆरवुगा वेङ्कटपति (किनै) वेद्य सङ्गतुल
अरुदुगा धूपमुल बहु दी
पादुलनु ताम्बूल विधुलनु
परग बूजिम्पुडु समस्त
प्रभु धनुर्मासमुन विधुलन् घनुलु ॥॥मुद॥
mudamalara kālamula mīriṭu mōsapōka
hṛdaya malara bhajimparōmī
riṭu dhanurmāsamula vidhulan ….muda..
vēga nālugu ghaḍiya lanagā
vēdavēdyulu lēci saraguna
nāgamōkta vidhulanu tama dēhānu guṇamulugā
vēgamuna sandhyādulogi gā
viñci vimalāmbhōdhi śayanuni
bāgugā būjiñcarō yeḍa
paka dhanurmāsamula vidhulane ghanulu ….muda..
paragu cīnāmbaramulanu nati
parimaḷammula buṣpamula kaḍu
veravugā vēṅkaṭapati (kinai) vēdya saṅgatula
arudugā dhūpamula bahu dī
pādulanu tāmbūla vidhulanu
paraga būjimpuḍu samasta
prabhu dhanurmāsamuna vidhulan ghanulu ….muda..
168169
O people, do not be fooled by the pleasurable times!
For the heart to rejoice, worship the Lord,
with the Dhanurmasa rituals!
Promptly during the early hours of the day,
the knowers of the Veda wake up,
perform the duties according to the injunctions of the Agamas,
and perform the Sandhyavandana, according to their bodily gunas!
The Lord who reclines on the pure ocean,
worship Him devoutly,
without breaking the routine,
of the Dhanurmasa rituals, O great ones!
Offering beautiful silk robes
sweet scented flowers
in a very fine manner, to Venkatapathi, along with the Naivedyam
and also with unique incense, lighting many lamps
with betel-leaf offerings
worship in a beautiful manner
the Lord of all entirety
with the Dhanurmasa rituals, O great ones!
नित्युलु मुक्तुलु निर्मल चित्तुलु
Nityulu Muktulu Nirmala Cittulu
नित्युलु मुक्तुलु निर्मल चित्तुलु निगमान्तविदुलु वैष्णवुलु
सत्यमु वीरल शरणनि ब्रदुकरॊ साटिकि बॆनगक जडुलाल!॥ नित्युलु ॥
सकलोपाय शून्युलु सम्यज् ज्ञान पूर्णुलु
अकलङ्कुलु शङ्खचक्रलाञ्छनुलन्निट बूज्युलु वैष्णवुलु
वॊकटि गोररु वॊरुल गॊलुवरु वॊल्लरु ब्रह्मादि पट्टमुलु
अकटा वीरलसरि यन बापं बाऱुमतम्बुल पूतकोकिल्!॥ नित्युलु ॥
मन्त्रान्तर साधनान्तरम्बुलु मानिन पुण्युलु विरक्तुलु
यन्त्रपुमायल बॊरलु परुलकु यॆन्तैना मॊक्करु वैष्णवुलु
तन्त्रपु कामक्रोध विदूरुलु तमनिज धर्ममु वदलरु
जन्त्रपु संसारुलतो वीरल सरियनि यॆञ्चग बापमय्य! ॥ नित्युलु ॥
तप्परु तमपट्टिन व्रतमॆप्पुडु दैवमॊक्कडे गतियनुचु
वॊप्पगु तम पातिव्रत्यम्बुन नुन्दुरु सुखमुन वैष्णवुलु
कप्पिन श्रीवेङ्कटपतिदासुलु कर्मविदूरुलु सात्विकुलु
चॆप्पकु डितरुल सरिगा वीरिकि सेविञ्चगने धन्युडनैति!॥ नित्युलु ॥
nityulu muktulu nirmala cittulu nigamāntavidulu vaiṣṇavulu
satyamu vīrala śaraṇani bradukaro sāṭiki benagaka jaḍulāla!.. nityulu ..
sakalōpāya śūnyulu samyaj jñāna pūrṇulu
akalaṅkulu śaṅkhacakralāñchanulanniṭa būjyulu vaiṣṇavulu
vokaṭi gōraru vorula goluvaru vollaru brahmādi paṭṭamulu
akaṭā vīralasari yana bāpaṃ bāṟumatambula pūtakōkil!.. nityulu ..
170171
mantrāntara sādhanāntarambulu mānina puṇyulu viraktulu
yantrapumāyala boralu parulaku yentainā mokkaru vaiṣṇavulu
tantrapu kāmakrōdha vidūrulu tamanija dharmamu vadalaru
jantrapu saṃsārulatō vīrala sariyani yeñcaga bāpamayya!.. nityulu ..
tapparu tamapaṭṭina vratameppuḍu daivamokkaḍē gatiyanucu
voppagu tama pātivratyambuna nunduru sukhamuna vaiṣṇavulu
kappina śrīvēṅkaṭapatidāsulu karmavidūrulu sātvikulu
ceppaku ḍitarula sarigā vīriki sēviñcaganē dhanyuḍanaiti!.. nityulu ..
The Nityas, the Muktas, the pure hearted ones,
the knowers of the Vedas, the Vaishnavas!
Truly surrender unto them and live!
Do not equate yourselves with them, O irrational fools!
Those who do not resort to any other means,
who are endowed fully with right knowledge,
who are flawless, who wear the symbols of Shanka-Chakra,
who are revered everywhere, who do not desire anything,
who do not worship others, who do not even desire the post of
Brahma and other gods, they are the Vaishnavas!
Beware! Equating them with those of the six-mathas of
superficial knowledge is a sin!
Those who give up all other mantras and sadhanas,
who are meritorious, who are dispassionate,
who do not believe in the influence of Yantras,
who never bow down to others at any cost,
who stay away from the sway of Kama and Krodha,
who never let go of their true dharma, they are the Vaishnavas!
Comparing them to ordinary householders is a great sin!
Those who never go against their vows,
who agree that God is the only means,
who remain chaste, who are ever happy,
the devotees of the all pervading Lord Sree Venkatapathi,
who are not bound by Karmas, the Satvik ones,
they are the Vaishnavas!
Do not ever say that they are equaled by anybody!
By serving them I am blessed!
172173

item.title: ०८३ शरणं बितडे सकलमु नाकुनु
item.description:
Śaraṇaṃ Bitaḍē Sakalamu Nākunu
शरणं बितडे सकलमु नाकुनु
वॆरपुन मनसा वॆतकवॊ यितनि ॥॥शरणं॥
अभयं बॊसगेटि यतडॆव्वडु मुनु
इभ रक्षकु डतडॆव्वडु
उभय विभूतुल कॊडयं डॆव्वडु
प्रभुवतडे ना पालि देवुडु॥॥शरणं॥
शरणागतुलकु सरिदापॆव्वडु
यिरवुग श्रीपति यॆव्वडु
अरि दुष्ट दैत्य हन्तकु डॆव्वडु
वरमुनु नतडॆ ना पालि देवुडु ॥॥शरणं॥
आदि शङ्ख चक्रायधु डॆव्वडु
ये दॆस बूर्णुडॆव्वडु
वेदमयडु श्री वेङ्कटपतियै
पादाय निदॆ ना पालिदेवुडु ॥॥शरणं॥
śaraṇaṃ bitaḍē sakalamu nākunu
verapuna manasā vetakavo yitani ….śaraṇaṃ..
abhayaṃ bosagēṭi yataḍevvaḍu munu
ibha rakṣaku ḍataḍevvaḍu
ubhaya vibhūtula koḍayaṃ ḍevvaḍu
prabhuvataḍē nā pāli dēvuḍu….śaraṇaṃ..
śaraṇāgatulaku saridāpevvaḍu
yiravuga śrīpati yevvaḍu
ari duṣṭa daitya hantaku ḍevvaḍu
varamunu nataḍe nā pāli dēvuḍu ….śaraṇaṃ..
ādi śaṅkha cakrāyudhu ḍevvaḍu
yē desa būrṇuḍevvaḍu
vēdamayuḍu śrī vēṅkaṭapatiyai
pādāya nide nā pālidēvuḍu ….śaraṇaṃ..
He alone is the refuge and everything for me
Wisely O mind, search for Him!
The one who bestows refuge, who is He?
Previously the savior of the elephant, who is He?
The ultimate Lord of the Ubhaya Vibhutis, who else is He?
He alone is the Lord, and my worshippable God!
