The one who is close to Sharanagatas, who is He?
The eternal Lord of Sree, who else is He?
The destroyer of the evil demons, who is He?
As a boon to me, He alone is my Lord!!
The primal one who wields the Shanka-Chakra weapons, who is He?
The one who is perfect is every respect, who else is He?
The one who fills the Vedas, SreeVenkatapathi,
forever, He alone is my Lord!!!
174175

item.title: ०८४ इदियॆ साधन
item.description:
Idiye Sādhana
इदियॆ साधन मिहपरमुलकुनु
पदिलमु मापालि परमपु नामम् ॥॥इदियॆ॥
कलिदोषहरमु कैवल्यकरमु
अलरिन मा श्रीहरि नामं
सुलभमु सौख्यमु शोभन तिलकमु
पलुमारुनु श्रीपतिनामम् ॥॥इदियॆ॥
पापनाशनमु बन्ध विमोक्षमु
पैपैनिदि भूपति नामं
स्थापितधन मिदि सर्व रक्षकमु
दापि रमिदि माधवनामम् ॥॥इदियॆ॥
नेममु दीममु नित्य कर्ममिदि
दोमटि गोविन्दुनि नामं
हेममु शरणमु यिन्निट माकुनु
येमेर श्री वेङ्कटेश्वर नामम् ॥॥इदियॆ॥
idiye sādhana mihaparamulakunu
padilamu māpāli paramapu nāmaṃ ….idiye..
kalidōṣaharamu kaivalyakaramu
alarina mā śrīhari nāmaṃ
sulabhamu saukhyamu śōbhana tilakamu
palumārunu śrīpatināmaṃ ….idiye..
pāpanāśanamu bandha vimōkṣamu
paipainidi bhūpati nāmaṃ
sthāpitadhana midi sarva rakṣakamu
dāpi ramidi mādhavanāmaṃ ….idiye..
nēmamu dīmamu nitya karmamidi
dōmaṭi gōvinduni nāmaṃ
hēmamu śaraṇamu yinniṭa mākunu
yēmēra śrī vēṅkaṭēśvara nāmaṃ ….idiye..
This alone is the means for here and hereafter
It is safe and secure for us, this Name-Supreme!
Destroyer of the sins of Kali, bestower of eternal beatitude
is the splendid name of our Sree Hari!
The affable one, the bestower of well being, the propitious mark
if repeatedly chanted, this name of Sree-Pathi!
The annihilator of sins, the one which releases from bondage,
high above it is, the name of Bhu-Pathi!
The proven established wealth is this, the all-protector is this,
if ardently sought, this name of Madhava!
The one to be followed with diligence, the divine bait, the daily ritual,
the nourishing name of Govinda!
The precious refuge amongst all, is for us,
the omnipotent name of Sree Venkateshwara!
176177

item.title: ०८५ श्रीपतियॆकडे
item.description:
Śrīpatiyokaḍē
श्रीपति यॆकडे शरणमु माकुनु
तेप यितडे मऱि तॆरगेदि ॥॥श्रीपति॥
आसलु मिगुला नातुम नुन्नवि
यीसुलेनि सुख मॆक्कडिदि
चेसिन पापमु चेतुल नुन्नदि
मोसपोनि गति मुन्दर नेदि ॥॥श्रीपति॥
कोपमु गॊन्दुल गुणमुल नुन्नदि
येपुन निजसुख मिक नेदि
दीपनाग्नितो दिरिगेटि देहमु
पैपै विरतिकि बट्टेदि ॥॥श्रीपति॥
पञ्चेन्द्रियमुल पालिटि बदुकिदि
यिञ्चुक निलुकड कॆड येदि
यॆञ्चग श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरु डॊकडे
पञ्चिन विधुलनु पालिञ्चुगाक ॥॥श्रीपति॥
śrīpati yokaḍē śaraṇamu mākunu
tēpa yitaḍē maṟi teragēdi ….śrīpati..
āsalu migulā nātuma nunnavi
yīsulēni sukha mekkaḍidi
cēsina pāpamu cētula nunnadi
mōsapōni gati mundara nēdi ….śrīpati..
kōpamu gondula guṇamula nunnadi
yēpuna nijasukha mika nēdi
dīpanāgnitō dirigēṭi dēhamu
paipai viratiki baṭṭēdi ….śrīpati..
pañcēndriyamula pāliṭi badukidi
yiñcuka nilukaḍa keḍa yēdi
yeñcaga śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaru ḍokaḍē
pañcina vidhulanu pāliñcugāka ….śrīpati..
The Lord of Sree alone is the refuge for us!
The means is He alone, what else is?
There are many desires within oneself,
where then is the pleasure without any jealousy?
The sins committed are in ones own hands,
which then is the path devoid of any deceit?
Anger is hidden within ones own nature
where then is the true happiness?
The body moves about carrying the fires of passion,
how then, can one adhere to dispassion?
The life is under the sway of the five senses,
how can there be even a little steadiness?
If understood rightly, Sree Venkatesha alone
rules over all the ordained duties!
178179

item.title: ०८६ निगमनिगमान्त
item.description:
Nigamanigamānta
निगम निगमान्त वर्णित मनोहर रूप
नगराजधरुड श्री नारायणा ॥॥निग॥
दीपिञ्चु वैराग्य दिव्य सौख्यं बिय्य-
नोपक कदा नन्नु नॊडबरुचु
पैपैनॆ संसार बन्धमुल गट्टेवु
ना पलुकु चॆल्लुना नारायणा ॥॥निग॥
चीकाकु पडिन नाचित्त शान्तमु सेय -
लेकका नीवु बहुलील नन्नु
काकु सेसॆदवु बहु कर्ममुल बडुवारु
ना कॊलदि वारला नारायणा ॥॥निग॥
विविध निर्भन्धमुल वॆडलद्रोयक नन्नु
भवसागरमुल दड बड जेतुरा
दिविजेन्द्रवद्य श्री तिरुवेङ्कटाद्रीश
नवनीतचोर श्री नारायणा ॥॥निग॥
nigama nigamānta varṇita manōhara rūpa
nagarājadharuḍa śrī nārāyaṇā ….niga..
dīpiñcu vairāgya divya saukhyaṃ biyya-
nōpaka kadā nannu noḍabarucu
paipaine saṃsāra bandhamula gaṭṭēvu
nā paluku cellunā nārāyaṇā ….niga..
cīkāku paḍina nācitta śāntamu sēya -
lēkakā nīvu bahulīla nannu
kāku sēsedavu bahu karmamula baḍuvāru
nā koladi vāralā nārāyaṇā ….niga..
vividha nirbhandhamula veḍaladrōyaka nannu
bhavasāgaramula daḍa baḍa jēturā
divijēndravadya śrī tiruvēṅkaṭādrīśa
navanītacōra śrī nārāyaṇā ….niga..
O one whose bewitching form is praised by the Vedas and Vedanta!
O Lord who lifted up the mountain! Sree Narayana!
The bright divine happiness of Vairagya, since You
do not wish to bestow, You make me consent
and bind me again and again in the attachments of samsara!
Will my words ever prevail, O Narayana!
To my mind which is under turmoil, since You do not wish
to bestow peace, by Your various Leelas You make me feel fatigued!
Those who undergo various karmas,
are they comparable to me, O Narayana!
Instead of destroying all my various strong attachments,
You overwhelm me in the ocean of existence!
O one who is revered by Indra and other divinities,
O Lord Sree TiruVenkatesha! O butter thief, Narayana!
180181

item.title: ०८७ वैष्णवुलुगानि वारलॆव्वरु
item.description:
Vaiṣṇavulugāni Vāralevvaru
वैष्णवुलु गानि वारलॆव्वरु लेरु
विष्णुप्रभाव मी विश्वमन्तय गान॥॥वैष्णवु॥
अन्तय विष्णुमयम्बट मरि देव-
तान्तरमुलु गलवननेला
भ्रान्तिबॊन्दि यी भावमु भाविञ्चि
नन्तने पुण्यलवुट दप्पॆदु गान ॥॥वैष्णवु॥
यॆव्वरि गॊलिचिन नेमि गॊरत मरि
यॆव्वरि दलचिन नेमि
अव्वलिव्वल श्री हरि रूपुगानि वा -
रॆव्वरु लेरनि यॆरुकदोचिन जालु ॥॥वैष्णवु॥
अति चञ्चलम्बै नयातुम गलिगिञ्चु -
कतमुन बहुचित्त गतुलै
यितरुल गॊलिचिन यॆडयक यनाथ-
पति तिरुवेङ्कटपति चेकॊनुगाक ॥॥वैष्णवु॥
vaiṣṇavulu gāni vāralevvaru lēru
viṣṇuprabhāva mī viśvamantayu gāna….vaiṣṇavu..
aṃtayu viṣṇumayambaṭa mari dēva-
tāntaramulu galavananēlā
bhrāntibondi yī bhāvamu bhāviñci
nantanē puṇyalavuṭa dappedu gāna ….vaiṣṇavu..
yevvari golicina nēmi gorata mari
yevvari dalacina nēmi
avvalivvala śrī hari rūpugāni vā -
revvaru lērani yerukadōcina jālu ….vaiṣṇavu..
ati cañcalambai nayātuma galigiñcu -
katamuna bahucitta gatulai
yitarula golicina yeḍayaka yanātha-
pati tiruvēṅkaṭapati cēkonugāka ….vaiṣṇavu..
There is none who is not a Vaishnava!
Since the entire Universe is filled with Vishnu’s glorious power!
When everything is pervaded by Vishnu,
why to say that there is distinction among Gods?
Out of delusion, whatever form one conceives in the mind,
finally, it will not prevent them from becoming meritorious!
Whosoever one worships, what is the shortcoming?
whosoever one contemplates on?
Here or there, everywhere, there is nothing that is not a
manifestation of SreeHari! If one understands this, it is enough!
Because of a very fickle mind,
getting wavering thoughts, even if one worships others
Lord TiruVenkatapathi, the refuge of the parentless
without letting go, takes everyone unto His fold!!!
182183

item.title: ०८८ मदमत्सरमु
item.description:
Madamatsaramu
मदमत्सरमु लेक मनसु पेदैपो
पदरिन यासलवाडु वो वैष्णवुडु ॥॥मद॥
इट्टुनट्टु दिरिगाडि येमैना जॆडनाडि
पॆट्टरण्टा बोयरण्टा बॆक्कुलाडि
यॆट्टिवारिनैना दूरि यॆव्वरिनैना जेरि
वट्टि यासलबडनि वाडुवो वैष्णवुडु ॥॥मद॥
गडनकॊरकु जिक्कि कौमुक विद्यल जॊक्कि
निडिवि नेमैना गनि निक्कि निक्कि
वॊडलिगुणमुतोड वुदुट विद्यल जाल
वडदाकि बडलनि वाडुवो वैष्णवुडु ॥॥मद॥
आवल वॊरुल जॆडनडग विनिविनि
चेवमीरि यॆव्वरिनि जॆडनाडक
कोविदु श्री वेङ्कटेशु गॊलिचि पॆद्दलकृप
वाविवर्तनगल वाडुवो वैष्णवुडु ॥॥मद॥
madamatsaramu lēka manasu pēdaipō
padarina yāsalavāḍu vō vaiṣṇavuḍu ….mada..
iṭṭunaṭṭu dirigāḍi yēmainā jeḍanāḍi
peṭṭaraṇṭā bōyaraṇṭā bekkulāḍi
yeṭṭivārinainā dūri yevvarinainā jēri
vaṭṭi yāsalabaḍani vāḍuvō vaiṣṇavuḍu ….mada..
gaḍanakoraku jikki kaumuka vidyala jokki
niḍivi nēmainā gani nikki nikki
voḍaliguṇamutōḍa vuduṭa vidyala jāla
vaḍadāki baḍalani vāḍuvō vaiṣṇavuḍu ….mada..
āvala vorula jeḍanaḍaga vinivini
cēvamīri yevvarini jeḍanāḍaka
kōvidu śrī vēṅkaṭēśu golici peddalakṛpa
vāvivartanagala vāḍuvō vaiṣṇavuḍu ….mada..
One whose mind is free from ego and envy,
One who reproves all desires, he alone is a Vaishnava!
One who does not wander about, who denounces everything,
who has no complaints that he has not been offered anything to eat or drink,
who does not mingle with anyone and everyone,
who is not attracted to ephemeral desires, he alone is a Vaishnava!
One who does not get caught in money earning spree, one who does not enjoy lustful ways
who does not aspire for everything that he sees,
who does not expend his energies in bodily pleasures and enjoyment,
he alone is a Vaishnava!
Even after having repeatedly heard others speak ill of someone,
one who does not indulge in the same,
one who worships Sree Venkatesha, and who by the grace of enlightened ones
has acquired good conduct, he alone is a Vaishnava!
184185

item.title: ०८९ दासोहमनु बुद्धि दलचरु
item.description:
Dāsōhamanu Buddhi Dalacaru
दासोहमनु बुद्धि दलचरु दानवुलु
यीसुलके पॆनगेरु यिप्पुडू गॊन्दरु !॥ दासो ॥
हरि चक्रमु दूषिञ्चे यट्टिवारे यसुरुलु
अरयदामॆ दिवमन्न वारु नसुरले
धर नर कासुरुडु ताने दैवमनि चॆडॆ
यिरवै यिदि मानरु यिप्पुडू गॊन्दरु !॥ दासो ॥
पुरुषोत्तमुनि पूज पॊन्त बोरु असुरुलु
सरवि विष्णुनि जपिञ्चनि वारु नसुरुले
हिरण्यकशिपुडु यीतनि नॊल्लक चॆडॆ
यिरवै यीतनि नॊल्लरिप्पुडू गॊन्दुरु !॥ दासो ॥
सुरुलुनु मुनुलुनु शुकादि योगुलुनु
परममु श्री वॆङ्कटपति यनुचु
शरणनि ब्रदिकेरु सरिनेडु वैष्णवुलु
यॆर परिकान बॊय्येरिप्पुडू गॊन्दरु !॥ दासो ॥
dāsōhamanu buddhi dalacaru dānavulu
yīsulakē penagēru yippuḍū gondaru !.. dāsō ..
hari cakramu dūṣiñcē yaṭṭivārē yasurulu
arayadāme divamanna vāru nasuralē
dhara nara kāsuruḍu tānē daivamani ceḍe
yiravai yidi mānaru yippuḍū gondaru !.. dāsō ..
puruṣōttamuni pūja ponta bōru asurulu
saravi viṣṇuni japiñcani vāru nasurulē
hiraṇyakaśipuḍu yītani nollaka ceḍe
yiravai yītani nollarippuḍū gonduru !.. dāsō ..
surulunu munulunu śukādi yōgulunu
paramamu śrī veṅkaṭapati yanucu
śaraṇani bradikēru sarinēḍu vaiṣṇavulu
yora parikāna boyyērippuḍū gondaru !.. dāsō ..
The thought of ‘Dasoham’1 never occurs to evil ones,
Some wish for evil, even now!
Those who speak ill of Hari’s Discus, they are the evil ones
Those who think of themselves as Gods, they are the evil ones
Narakasura who thought of himself as God was ruined
Here, some will not give up, even now!
They don’t even think of worshipping Purushottama, the evil ones
They don’t even come near to chanting Vishnu’s names, the evil ones
Hiranyakasipu, who went against Him, was ruined
Here, some will not accept Him, even now!
The Demigods, the sages and the Yogis like Shuka,
declare that Sree Venkatapathi is the supreme one!
Surrendering unto Him live the Vaishnavas,
but some who dislike Him are seen even now!
‘Dasoham’ means to be the servant of the Lord
186187

item.title: ०९० आरूपमुनके हरि
item.description:
Ārūpamunakē Hari
आरूपमुनके हरि नेनु मॊक्कॆदनु
चेरि विभीषणुनि शरणागतुडनि चेकॊनि सरि गाचितिवि ॥॥ आरूप ॥
पाललोचनुडु ब्रह्मय निन्द्रुडु
सोलि अग्नियनु सूर्य चन्द्रुलुनु
नीलो नुण्डग नॆरि गनॆ किरीटि
मूलभूतिवगु मूर्तिवि गान ॥॥ आरूप ॥
अनन्त शिरसुल अनन्त पदमुल
अनन्त नयनमुल अनन्त करमुल
घन नीरूपमु कनुगॊनॆ किरीटि
अनन्त मूरिति वन्निट गान ॥॥ आरूप ॥
जगमु लिन्नियनु सकल मुनीन्द्रुलु
अगु श्री वेङ्कट नाथुड निन्ने
पॊगडग किरीटि पॊडगनॆ नीरूपु
अगणित महिमुड वन्निट गान ॥॥ आरूप ॥
ārūpamunakē hari nēnu mokkedanu
cēri vibhīṣaṇuni śaraṇāgatuḍani cēkoni sari gācitivi .. .. ārūpa
phālalōcanuḍu brahmayu nindruḍu
sōli agniyunu sūrya candrulunu
nīlō nuṇḍaga neri gane kirīṭi
mūlabhūtivagu mūrtivi gāna . .. ārūpa ..
ananta śirasula ananta padamula
ananta nayanamula ananta karamula
ghana nīrūpamu kanugone kirīṭi
ananta mūriti vanniṭa gāna …. ārūpa ..
jagamu linniyunu sakala munīndrulu
agu śrī vēṅkaṭa nāthuḍa ninnē
pogaḍaga kirīṭi poḍagane nīrūpu
agaṇita mahimuḍa vanniṭa gāna …. ārūpa ..
I offer my salutations to that form of Yours, O Hari!
Accepting Vibheeshana as a Sharanagatha, You bestowed protection!
Lord Shiva, Lord Brahma, Indra
Agni-deva, the sun and the moon,
all these Gods, Arjuna realized that they exist within You,
since You are the Lord who is the Primal cause!
Innumerable heads, innumerable feet,
innumerable eyes, innumerable hands
This magnificent form of Yours Arjuna perceived,
since You are the Lord who is limitless!
All the worlds, all the enlightened sages,
when they praised You, O Lord of Sree Venkata,
so also did Arjuna praise Your form,
since You are the Lord who has innumerable glories!
188189

item.title: ०९१ ऒक्कडे दैवं बुन्नतु डितडु
item.description:
Okkaḍē Daivaṃ Bunnatu Ḍitaḍu
ऒक्कडे दैवं बुन्नतु डितडु
तक्किन तलपुलु तप्पु दॆरुवुलु!॥ ऒक्कडे ॥
पुरुषुल कॆल्ला बुरुषोत्तमुडु
सुरेन्द्रादुलकु सुरेन्द्रुडु
हरुनिकि नजुनिकि नव्वलि मूरिति
हरि यितडे पर मात्मुडु!॥ ऒक्कडे ॥
वेदान्तम्बुल वेद्युडीतडु
आदिकि नादिय नन नितडे
मेदिनि नरुलकु मेदि नीश्वरुडु
येदॆस जाचिन नीश्वरु डितडे!॥ ऒक्कडे ॥
यॆक्कुवुलकॆल्ल नॆक्कुव यीतडु
मक्कुव मरुनिकि मरुडितडु
यिक्कड श्री वेङ्कटेशुडै मिगुल
पक्कन निदिवो प्रत्यक्षमितडु!॥ ऒक्कडे ॥
okkaḍē daivaṃ bunnatu ḍitaḍu
takkina talapulu tappu deruvulu!.. okkaḍē ..
puruṣula kellā buruṣōttamuḍu
surēndrādulaku surēndruḍu
haruniki najuniki navvali mūriti
hari yitaḍē para mātmuḍu!.. okkaḍē ..
vēdāntambula vēdyuḍītaḍu
ādiki nādiyu nana nitaḍē
mēdini narulaku mēdi nīśvaruḍu
yēdesa jūcina nīśvaru ḍitaḍē!.. okkaḍē ..
yekkuvulakella nekkuva yītaḍu
makkuva maruniki maruḍitaḍu
yikkaḍa śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍai migula
pakkana nidivō pratyakṣamitaḍu!.. okkaḍē ..
He is the one and only Lord, the highest one He is!
Other thoughts lead to the wrong ways!
For all beings, He is the Supreme Being
For Indra and other heavenly beings, He is the supreme Lord
Even above Shiva and Brahma, He is the supreme deity
He is Hari! The supreme soul!
He is the one to be know from the Vedanta
He is the one who is to be referred to as the Origin of all origins
For the earthly beings, He is the Lord of the Earth
In which ever manner you perceive, He alone is the Lord!
Among the exalted, He is the most exalted
For Manmatha the love-god, He himself is the ‘Manmatha’
Here, Sree Venkatesha, the supreme one,
has manifested Himself within reach!
190191

item.title: ०९२ पाडैन यॆरुकतो बन्धमोक्षमुलॊक्क
item.description:
Pāḍaina Yerukatō Bandhamōkṣamulokka
पाडैन यॆरुकतो बन्धमोक्षमुलॊक्क
गाडि गट्टुट तॆलिवि गानके कादा!॥ पाडैन ॥
भाविञ्चि निनु परब्रह्ममनि वेदमुलु
वेवेलु विधुल मॊरवॆट्टगानु
केवलपु निन्नु दक्किन दैवमुलगूर्चि
सेविम्पुटिदि तप्पुसेयटे कादा!॥ पाडैन ॥
सरिलेनि निनु नुपनिषद्वाक्यमु लॆपरा
त्परुडवनि नलुगडल बलुकगानु
वरुसतो बॆक्कुदैवमुलु सङ्गडिनिन्नु
तॊरल गॊलुचुट महाद्रोहमे कादा!॥ पाडैन ॥
ऎन्दुजाचिन पुराणेति हासमुलु नी
चन्दमे यधिकमनि चाटगानु
कन्दर्पजनक वेङ्कटगिरि स्वामि नी
कन्दुवॆऱगनिदि यज्ञानमे कादा!॥ पाडैन ॥
pāḍaina yerukatō bandhamōkṣamulokka
gāḍi gaṭṭuṭa telivi gānakē kādā!.. pāḍaina ..
bhāviñci ninu parabrahmamani vēdamulu
vēvēlu vidhula moraveṭṭagānu
kēvalapu ninnu dakkina daivamulagūrci
sēvimpuṭidi tappusēyuṭē kādā!.. pāḍaina ..
sarilēni ninu nupaniṣadvākyamu leparā
tparuḍavani nalugaḍala balukagānu
varusatō bekkudaivamulu saṅgaḍininnu
torala golucuṭa mahādrōhamē kādā!.. pāḍaina
.
eṃdujūcina purāṇēti hāsamulu nī
candamē yadhikamani cāṭagānu
kandarpajanaka vēṅkaṭagiri svāmi nī
kanduveṟaganidi yajñānamē kādā!.. pāḍaina
With misguided knowledge, if attachments and salvation
are tied together to one yoke, is it not foolishness?
Comprehending You as the Supreme Brahman, though the Vedas
are proclaiming it in thousands of ways,
yet grouping You , the pristine one, along with other deities
and worshipping, is it not like committing a blunder?
The Upanishidic statements are proclaiming You,
the matchless one, as the Highest of the Highest!
Grouping You then in the same order as that of other Gods,
and worshipping, is it not a great treachery!
In what ever manner perceived, though the Puranas and Itihaasas
are declaring Your glory to be the Highest,
O father of Kandarpa, O Lord of Venkatagiri,
not knowing the path of devotion to You, is it not sheer ignorance!!
192193

item.title: ०९३ कलदु तिरुमन्त्रमु कलदिहमु
item.description:
Kaladu Tirumantramu Kaladihamu
कलदु तिरुमन्त्रमु कलदिहमु बरमु
कलिमि गलुगु माकु गडमे लेदु!॥ कलदु ॥
कमलाक्ष नीवु माकु गलिगियण्डग भूमि
नमरलेनिदॊकटि नव्वललेदु
नॆमकि नालुकमीद नीनाममु मॆलगग
तमितो बरुल वेड दा जोटु लेदु!॥ कलदु ॥
शौरि नी चक्रमु नाभुजमु मीदनुण्डगानु
मोरसपु बग लेदु यॆदुरू लेदु
चेरुव नी सेव नाचेतुलपै नुण्डगानु
तीरनि कर्मपु वॆट्टिदिनमू लेदु!॥ कलदु ॥
अच्चुत नीपै भक्तियातुमलो नुण्डगानु
रच्चल बुट्टिन यपराधिमू लेदु
निच्चलु श्री वॆङ्कटेश नीशरणागतुण्डगा
विच्चिन विरे कानि विचारमे लेदु!॥ कलदु ॥
kaladu tirumantramu kaladihamu baramu
kalimi galugu māku gaḍamē lēdu!.. kaladu ..
kamalākṣa nīvu māku galigiyuṇḍaga bhūmi
namaralēnidokaṭi navvalalēdu
nemaki nālukamīda nīnāmamu melagaga
tamitō barula vēḍa dā jōṭu lēdu!.. kaladu ..
śauri nī cakramu nābhujamu mīdanuṇḍagānu
mōrasapu baga lēdu yedurū lēdu
cēruva nī sēva nācētulapai nuṇḍagānu
tīrani karmapu veṭṭidinamū lēdu!.. kaladu ..
accuta nīpai bhaktiyātumalō nuṇḍagānu
raccala buṭṭina yaparādhimū lēdu
niccalu śrī veṅkaṭēśa nīśaraṇāgatuṇḍagā
viccina virē kāni vicāramē lēdu!.. kaladu ..
It is there, the Tirumantra, for here and hereafter!
There shall be prosperity for us, never any obstacles!
O lotus eyed one! When You are there for us,
there is nothing in the other worlds that will not be found here!
If your name ruminates upon the tongue,
there is no necessity to worship others eagerly!
O Showri! If the symbol of your Discus is upon my shoulder,
nobody can avenge or confront me!
If my hands are ever engaged in serving You,
I will never be enslaved by the limitless Karmas!
O Achyutha! If devotion to You is present within my ‘self’,
there will never be any faults born out of disputes!
Sree Venkatesha! When Sharanagati unto you is ever present,
it bestows a joyful state, without any sorrow!
194195

item.title: ०९४ तॆलुपग रादिदि देवुनि मायलु
item.description:
Telupaga Rādidi Dēvuni Māyalu
तॆलुपग रादिदि देवुनि मायलु
फलमॆऱुगरु यी पट्टिन वॆऱ्ऱि!॥ तॆलुपग ॥
पुट्टिरि दिविजुलु पुरुषोत्तमुनं
दट्टे यणगिरि यतनन्दु
यिट्टॆ यीतनि यिन्दरितो सरि
वॆट्टि कॊलुचुटे पॆनु वॆऱ्ऱि!॥ तॆलुपग ॥
हरिवरमुनने यन्दरु बदिकिरि
परुल वरमुलु गनि बडलिरि यसुरुलु
यिरवॆऱि गीतनि निन्दरि लोपल
सरिगा मॊक्कुट सहजपु वॆऱ्ऱि!॥ तॆलुपग ॥
जीवान्तरात्मुडु श्री वेङ्कटेशुडु
येवल श्री लक्ष्मि यीतनि देवुलु
वेवेलु सिरुलु वीरे योसगिरनि
भाविञ्चु वारिकि बट्टदु वॆऱ्ऱि!॥ तॆलुपग ॥
telupaga rādidi dēvuni māyalu
phalameṟugaru yī paṭṭina veṟṟi!.. telupaga ..
puṭṭiri divijulu puruṣōttamunaṃ
daṭṭē yaṇagiri yatanandu
yiṭṭe yītani yindaritō sari
veṭṭi kolucuṭē penu veṟṟi!.. telupaga ..
harivaramunanē yandaru badikiri
parula varamulu gani baḍaliri yasurulu
yiraveṟi gītani nindari lōpala
sarigā mokkuṭa sahajapu veṟṟi!.. telupaga ..
jīvāntarātmuḍu śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍu
yēvala śrī lakṣmi yītani dēvulu
vēvēlu sirulu vīrē yōsagirani
bhāviñcu vāriki baṭṭadu veṟṟi!.. telupaga ..
It cannot be explained, the Lords miracles!
The merits of it they do not know, because of foolishness!
The deities, having been born from Purushottama,
in the same manner, they merge into Him!
Then to equate Him with them,
and worship, is total foolishness!
By Haris grace alone all existed!
Seeking boons from others, the Asuras were weakened!
Even after knowing this, to worship Him
as one equal to others, is utter foolishness!
The inner self of all Jivas, Sree Venkatesha,
on either side are His consorts Sri-Lakshmi!
Innumerable wealth they alone have bestowed,
those who understand this, are never afflicted by foolishness!
196197

item.title: ०९५ अभय दायकुड वदॆ नीवे गति
item.description:
Abhaya Dāyakuḍa Vade Nīvē Gati
अभय दायकुड वदॆ नीवे गति
यिभ रक्षक ननु निपुडु गाववे!॥ अभय ॥
भयहर दैतेय भञ्जन केशव
जय जय नृसिंह सर्वेश्वरा
नियतमु माकिदॆ नी पादमुले गति
क्रियगा मम्मेलि किङ्क लुडुपवे!॥ अभय ॥
बन्ध विमोचन पाप विनाशन
सिन्धुर वरदाश्रितरक्षा
कन्धर वर्णुड गति नी नाममॆ
अन्ध कारमुल नणचि मनुपवे!॥ अभय ॥
दैव शिखामणि तत चक्रायध
श्री वॆङ्कटगिरि श्री रमणा
सावधान नी शरण्यमे गति
वेवेलकु ना विन्नप मिदिये!॥ अभय ॥
abhaya dāyakuḍa vade nīvē gati
yibha rakṣaka nanu nipuḍu gāvavē!.. abhaya ..
bhayahara daitēya bhañjana kēśava
jaya jaya nṛsiṃha sarvēśvarā
niyatamu mākide nī pādamulē gati
kriyagā mammēli kiṅka luḍupavē!.. abhaya ..
bandha vimōcana pāpa vināśana
sindhura varadāśritarakṣā
kandhara varṇuḍa gati nī nāmame
aṃdha kāramula naṇaci manupavē!.. abhaya ..
daiva śikhāmaṇi tata cakrāyudha
śrī veṅkaṭagiri śrī ramaṇā
sāvadhāna nī śaraṇyamē gati
vēvēlaku nā vinnapa midiyē!.. abhaya ..
O one who grants protection! You are the only means
O savior of the elephant king, do save me now!
O destroyer of fears, O vanquisher of demons, O Keshava!
Glory unto you O Narasimha, O lord of all!
Eternally for us, your feet alone are the means,
Do rule over and release us from all suffering!
O reliever of attachments, O destroyer of sins
O rescuer of the elephant, O protector of Sharanagatas
O one with the colour of a cloud, Your name alone is the means,
Dispelling the ignorance, do save me!
O Lord of all divinities, O wielder of the Chakra weapon
O Lord of Venkatagiri, O Lord of Sree!
O Lord, for me Your refuge alone is the means,
for thousands of times, this alone is my request!
198199

item.title: ०९६ यॆव्व रॆव्वरि वाडो यी जीवुण्डु
item.description:
Yevva Revvari Vāḍō Yī Jīvuṇḍu
यॆव्व रॆव्वरि वाडो यी जीवुण्डु चूड
नॆव्वरिकि नेवौनो यीजीवुण्डु!॥ यॆव्व ॥
ऎन्दरिकिं गॊडुकुगा दीजीवुण्डु वॆनु
कॆन्दरिकि दोबुट्टुण्डी जीवुण्डु
यॆन्दरिनि भ्रमयिञ्चण्डी जीवुण्डु दुःख
मॆन्दरिकि गाविम्पण्डी जीवुण्डु!॥ यॆव्व ॥
यॆक्कडॆक्कड दिरुगण्डी जीवुण्डु वॆनु
कॆक्कडो तन जन्ममी जीवुण्डु
यॆक्कडि चुट्टमु दनकु नीजीवुण्डु यॆप्पु
डॆक्कडिकि नेगुनो यी जीवुण्डु!॥ यॆव्व ॥
यॆन्नडुनुं जेटुलेनि जीवुण्डु वॆनु
कॆन्निदनुवुलु मोवण्डी जीवुण्डु
यॆन्नङ्गल तिरुवेङ्कटेशु मायलं दगिलि
यॆन्निपदमुलम्बॊन्दण्डी जीवुण्डु!॥ यॆव्व ॥
yevva revvari vāḍō yī jīvuṇḍu cūḍa
nevvariki nēmaunō yījīvuṇḍu!.. yevva ..
eṃdarikiṃ goḍukugā dījīvuṇḍu venu
kendariki dōbuṭṭuṇḍī jīvuṇḍu
yendarini bhramayiñcaṇḍī jīvuṇḍu duḥkha
mendariki gāvimpaṇḍī jīvuṇḍu!.. yevva ..
yekkaḍekkaḍa dirugaṇḍī jīvuṇḍu venu
kekkaḍō tana janmamī jīvuṇḍu
yekkaḍi cuṭṭamu danaku nījīvuṇḍu yeppu
ḍekkaḍiki nēgunō yī jīvuṇḍu!.. yevva ..
yennaḍunuṃ jēṭulēni jīvuṇḍu venu
kennidanuvulu mōvaṇḍī jīvuṇḍu
yennaṅgala tiruvēṅkaṭēśu māyalaṃ dagili
yennipadamulambondaṇḍī jīvuṇḍu!.. yevva ..
Who all does it belong to, this Jiva?
What will it be for whom, this Jiva?
For how many would it have been a son, this Jiva?
Previously, for how many would it have been a sibling, this Jiva?
How many would it have brought under delusion, this Jiva?
For how many would it have caused grief, this Jiva?
Where all would it have roamed, this Jiva?
Previously, where would its birth have been, this Jiva’s?
Where are its relatives, this Jiva’s?
When and where will it go, this Jiva?
It can never be harmed, this Jiva!
How many bodies did it bear, this Jiva?
Getting caught in the various Mayas of Tiruvenkateshwara,
how many roles did it assume, this Jiva??
200201

item.title: ०९७ नीवनग नॊक चोट निलिचि
item.description:
Nīvanaga Noka Cōṭa Nilici
नीवनग नॊक चोट निलिचि वुण्डुटलेदु
नीवनुचु गनुगॊन्न निजमॆल्ल नीवे !॥ नीवनग ॥
तनयात्मवलॆनॆ भूतमुल यातुम लॆल्ल
ननयम्बु गनुगॊन्न यतडे नीवु
तनुगन्न तल्लिगा तग नितर कान्तलनु
अनघुडैमदि जाचु नतडे नीवु!॥ नीवनग ॥
सतत सत्यव्रताचार सम्पन्नुडै
अतिशयम्बुग मॆलगुनतडे नीवु
धृति दूलि द्रव्यम्बु तृणमुगा भाविञ्चु
हतकामुकुडैन यतडे नीवु!॥ नीवनग ॥
मोदमुन सुखदुःखमुलु नॊक्करीतिगा
नादरिम्पुचु नुन्नयतडे नीवु
वेदोक्तमतियैन वेङ्कटाचलनाथ
आदियनु नन्त्यम्बुनन्तयनु नीवे!॥ नीवनग ॥
nīvanaga noka cōṭa nilici vuṇḍuṭalēdu
nīvanucu ganugonna nijamella nīvē !.. nīvanaga ..
tanayātmavalene bhūtamula yātuma lella
nanayambu ganugonna yataḍē nīvu
tanuganna talligā taga nitara kāntalanu
anaghuḍaimadi jūcu nataḍē nīvu!.. nīvanaga ..
satata satyavratācāra sampannuḍai
atiśayambuga melagunataḍē nīvu
dhṛti dūli dravyambu tṛṇamugā bhāviñcu
hatakāmukuḍaina yataḍē nīvu!.. nīvanaga ..
mōdamuna sukhaduḥkhamulu nokkarītigā
nādarimpucu nunnayataḍē nīvu
vēdōktamatiyaina vēṅkaṭācalanātha
ādiyunu nantyambunantayunu nīvē!.. nīvanaga ..
You are not the one who stands at one place!
If you are truly perceived, You are everywhere!
“As is the self in ones body, so is the self in all living creatures”
the one who thinks thus, he himself is like You!
Like ones mother who gave birth, if one sees all women thus
that sinless one, he himself is like You!
At all times unfailingly adhering to the vow of being truthful,
the one who conducts thus in a superior way, he himself is like You!
The one who considers all wealth as mere trifle,
and who has conquered desires, he himself is like You!
Joyfully viewing pleasures and pains with equanimity
one who accepts them thus, he himself is like You!
O Lord of Venkatachala, You who are proclaimed by the knowers of the Vedas,
You alone are the beginning, the end, and everything!!
202203

item.title: ०९८ दनुजुलु गनिरि तत्वमिदि
item.description:
Danujulu Ganiri Tatvamidi
दनुजुलु गनिरि तत्वमिदि
वनजाक्षुनि कृप वसिञ्चनेला!॥ दनु ॥
हरि परमात्मु डनादि पुरुषुडु
सुरलकु नरुलकु सुलभुडु
हरि कोपमुतो नन्युल वरमुलु
सरिगा वॆञ्चग जगमुललोन!॥ दनु ॥
वेदान्त विदुडु विष्णुडु कृष्णुडु
श्रीदेविकि बति शेखरुडु
पोदि बरस्तुति पुण्यमुकण्टे
पादुग हरि दिट्टे पापमु मेलु!॥ दनु ॥
नारायणु डुन्नतु डच्युतु डुप
कारुडु श्रीवॆङ्कटविभुडु
चेरि यीतडे शिक्षिञ्च रक्षिञ्च
ऒरदयिवमुलु वॊगि नितनि सरा!॥ दनु ॥
danujulu ganiri tatvamidi
vanajākṣuni kṛpa vasiñcanēlā!.. danu ..
hari paramātmu ḍanādi puruṣuḍu
suralaku narulaku sulabhuḍu
hari kōpamutō nanyula varamulu
sarigā veñcaga jagamulalōna!.. danu ..
vēdānta viduḍu viṣṇuḍu kṛṣṇuḍu
śrīdēviki bati śēkharuḍu
pōdi barastuti puṇyamukaṇṭē
pāduga hari diṭṭē pāpamu mēlu!.. danu ..
nārāyaṇu ḍunnatu ḍacyutu ḍupa
kāruḍu śrīveṅkaṭavibhuḍu
cēri yītaḍē śikṣiñca rakṣiñca
oradayivamulu vogi nitani sarā!.. danu ..
The demons propounded this philosophy,
(which questions…….)
“Why to live under the grace of the Lotus eyed one?”
(Reply….)
Hari is the supreme Lord, the ancient one
For Devas and humans, the easily attainable one!
Hari’s anger and others boons,
Can they ever be equated in this world?!
The one to be known through the Vedas, Vishnu! Krishna!
He is the Lord and consort of Sree-Devi!
Than the mountain like merits gained by praising others,
the sin accrued by the constant abuse of Hari is far better!!
Narayana, the Highest of the highest, the indestructible one
the all helpful Lord of Sree Venkata!
One the whole, He himself punishes and protects
Can other Gods ever be equal to Him?!!
204205

item.title: ०९९ इन्दुकु धृवादु लिटु साक्षि
item.description:
Iṃduku Dhṛvādu Liṭu Sākṣi
इन्दुकु धृवादु लिटु साक्षि
चॆन्दि नम्मवो जीवुड नीवु!॥ इन्दुकु ॥
कॊण्डलवण्टिवि फॆूरपापमुलु
खण्डिञ्चुनु हरि घन नामजपमु
निन्दिञ्चुनु मति नित्यानन्दमु
पण्डिञ्चुनपुडॆ परम पदम्बु!॥ इन्दुकु ॥
जलधुलवण्टिवि जनन बन्धमुलु
तॊलगिञ्चुनु हरितूरिन भक्तिदि
वॆलिगिञ्चुनु घन विज्ञानम्बुलु
चॆलगिञ्चुनु बहु सिरिसम्पदलु!॥ इन्दुकु ॥
तोवरानि बहु दुःखमु लणचुनु
श्रीवेङ्कटपति जेरिन शरणमु
पावनम्बुगा बचरिञ्चु गुणमु
कैवसमगु लोकमु लॆल्लानु!॥ इन्दुकु ॥
iṃduku dhṛvādu liṭu sākṣi
cendi nammavō jīvuḍa nīvu!.. iṃduku ..
koṇḍalavaṇṭivi ghōrapāpamulu
khaṇḍiñcunu hari ghana nāmajapamu
nindiñcunu mati nityānandamu
paṇḍiñcunapuḍe parama padambu!.. iṃduku ..
jaladhulavaṇṭivi janana bandhamulu
tolagiñcunu haritūrina bhaktidi
veligiñcunu ghana vijñānambulu
celagiñcunu bahu sirisampadalu!.. iṃduku ..
tōvarāni bahu duḥkhamu laṇacunu
śrīvēṅkaṭapati jērina śaraṇamu
pāvanambugā bacariñcu guṇamu
kaivasamagu lōkamu lellānu!.. iṃduku ..
For this, Dhruva and others are the proof
You believe in this truly, O Jiva!
Mountains like are the heinous sins,
chanting the glorious names of Hari cuts them asunder!
The mind may detest, but only upon being
constantly blissful, one attains Paramapada!
Oceans like are the attachments due to birth,
Bhakti for Hari drives them away!
It enlightens with profound knowledge,
and bestows wealth and prosperity!
The various overpowering sorrows are suppressed
by reaching and surrendering unto SreeVenkatapathi!
Conducting oneself in a pious manner,
enables one to win over the worlds!!
206207

item.title: १०० अनिशमु दलचरो
item.description:
Aniśamu Dalacarō
अनिशमु दलचरो अहोबलं
अनन्त फलदं अहोबलम् ॥॥ अनि ॥
हरि निजनिलयं अहोबलं
हर विरिञ्चि नुत महोबलं
अरुणमणिशिखर महोबलं
अरि दैत्यहरण महोबलम् ॥॥ अनि ॥
अतिशय शुभदं अहोबलं
अतुल मनोहर महोबलं
हत दुरितचयं अहोबलं
यतिमत सिद्धं अहोबलम् ॥॥ अनि ॥
अगु श्रीवेङ्कट महोबलं
अगम्यमसुरुल कहोबलं
अगपडु पुण्युल कहोबलं
अगकुलराजं अहोबलम् ॥॥ अनि ॥
aniśamu dalacarō ahōbalaṃ
ananta phaladaṃ ahōbalaṃ …. ani ..
hari nijanilayaṃ ahōbalaṃ
hara viriñci nuta mahōbalaṃ
aruṇamaṇiśikhara mahōbalaṃ
ari daityaharaṇa mahōbalaṃ …. ani ..
atiśaya śubhadaṃ ahōbalaṃ
atula manōhara mahōbalaṃ
hata duritacayaṃ ahōbalaṃ
yatimata siddhaṃ ahōbalaṃ …. ani ..
agu śrīvēṅkaṭa mahōbalaṃ
agamyamasurula kahōbalaṃ
agapaḍu puṇyula kahōbalaṃ
agakularājaṃ ahōbalaṃ …. ani ..
Always contemplate on Ahobalam!
The bestower of endless merits, Ahobalam!
The true abode of Hari, Ahobalam
Praised Lord Shiva and Brahma, Ahobalam
With peaks decorated by the rays of the rising sun, Ahobalam
Destroyer of the entire demon clan, Ahobalam!
Bestower of supreme auspiciousness, Ahobalam
Immeasurably magnificent, Ahobalam
Destroyer of sinful ways, Ahobalam
Yati-Matham1 is established here, Ahobalam!
That Sree Venkata Ahobalam!
Unperceivable by the wicked, Ahobalam
Perceived by the meritorious- Ahobalam
The king of all mountains – Ahobalam!
1. The philosophy of Ramanuja is known as Yati Matham because he is
known as Yatiraja, that is ‘the king among ascetics’.
208209

item.title: १०१ चूडुडिन्दरिकि
item.description:
Cūḍuḍindariki
चूडु डिन्दरिकि सुलभुडु हरि -
तोडु नीडयगु दॊरमुनि यितडु ॥॥ चूडु ॥
कैवल्यमुनकु गनकपु ता पल-
त्रोवै श्रुतुलकु दुदि पदमै
पावन मॊकरूपमै विरजकु
नावै यन्नाडिदॆ यितडु ॥॥ चूडु ॥
कापाडग लोकमुलकु सूज्ञान -
दीपमै जगतिकि तेजमै
पापा लडपग भवपयोधुलकु
तॆपै यन्नाडिदे यितडु ॥॥ चूडु ॥
करुणानिधि रङ्गपतिकि गाञ्ची -
वरुनकु वेङ्कटगिरिपतिकि
निरति नहोबलनृ केसरिकि त-
त्परुडगु शठगोप मुनि यितडु ॥॥ चूडु ॥
cūḍu ḍindariki sulabhuḍu hari -
tōḍu nīḍayagu doramuni yitaḍu …. cūḍu ..
kaivalyamunaku ganakapu tā pala-
trōvai śrutulaku dudi padamai
pāvana mokarūpamai virajaku
nāvai yunnāḍide yitaḍu …. cūḍu ..
kāpāḍaga lōkamulaku sūjñāna -
dīpamai jagatiki tējamai
pāpā laḍapaga bhavapayōdhulaku
tepai yunnāḍidē yitaḍu …. cūḍu ..
karuṇānidhi raṅgapatiki gāñcī -
varunaku vēṅkaṭagiripatiki
nirati nahōbalanṛ kēsariki ta-
tparuḍagu śaṭhagōpa muni yitaḍu …. cūḍu ..
Look! He is easily approachable by all!
Hari is the constant companion of this Lordly Sage!
Being the golden paved path to eternal beatitude,
being the final authority of the Vedas,
being the sole personification of purity,
being the boat to Viraja, here he is!
To save the worlds, being a brilliant lamp of true knowledge,
and filling the worlds with effulgence,
To absolve the sins of the ocean of Samsara,
being the raft, here he is!
The abode of compassion the Lord of Srirangam,
Lord Varada of Kanchi, Lord of the Venkata hill
eternally, Lord Narasimha of Ahobilam,
these being his supreme goal, Here he is, Sri Satakopa Muni!
This is a Sankirtana on Sri Adi Van Satakopa Yateendra Mahadesikan,
the first Jeer of Ahobilam mutt, who was also Annamacharyas
preceptor.
210211

item.title: १०२ इदिवो श्रुतिमूल मॆदुटने
item.description:
Idivō Śrutimūla Meduṭanē
इदिवो श्रुतिमूल मॆदुटने उन्नदि
सदरमुगा हरि चाटी नदिवो ॥॥ इदिवो ॥
यॆनसि पुण्यमुसेसि ये लोकमॆक्किन
मनिकै भूमियन्दु मगुड बॊडमुटे
पॊनिगि ““०या ब्रह्मभुवना लोकाः
पुनरावृत्ति’’ यनॆ बुरुषोत्तमुडु ॥॥ इदिवो ॥
तटुकुन श्रीहरि तन्नुने कॊलिचिन
पटुगतितो मोक्षपदमु सुलभमनॆ
घटन ““ममुपेत्यतु कौन्तेय’’ महिनि
नटन ““बुनर्जन्म न विद्यते’’ ॥॥ इदिवो ॥
यिन्निटा श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरु सेवॆ
पन्निनगति निहपरसाधन मदे
मन्निञ्चि यीतडे ““मन्मना भव’’ यनि
अन्निटा नन्दरि कानतिच्चॆगान ॥॥ इदिवो ॥
idivō śrutimūla meduṭanē unnadi
sadaramugā hari cāṭī nadivō …. idivō ..
yenasi puṇyamusēsi yē lōkamekkina
manikai bhūmiyandu maguḍa boḍamuṭē
ponigi “०yā brahmabhuvanā lōkāḥ
punarāvṛtti’’ yane buruṣōttamuḍu …. idivō ..
taṭukuna śrīhari tannunē kolicina
paṭugatitō mōkṣapadamu sulabhamane
ghaṭana “mamupētyatu kauntēya’’ mahini
naṭana “bunarjanma na vidyatē’’ …. idivō ..
yinniṭā śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaru sēve
panninagati nihaparasādhana madē
manniñci yītaḍē “manmanā bhava’’ yani
anniṭā nandari kānaticcegāna …. idivō ..
Here it is! Right in front is the authority of the Veda!
In a beautiful manner, Lord Hari is proclaiming this!
By accruing merits, whichever world we ascend to,
we return to exist upon this earth!
“Ya Brahma bhuvana lokaha punar-avrithi…”
said Lord Purushottama!
Lord Sree Hari declared that if He alone is worshipped,
only then attainment of Moksha becomes easy!
“Mam upetya tu kaunteya” He said,
“Punar Janma na vidyate”
Worshipping Sree Venkateshwara amongst all others
is the only means for here and hereafter!
Out of compassion, saying “Manmanabhava….”
He Himself advised thus to everyone!
212213

item.title: १०३ चण्ड प्रचण्डादि जय
item.description:
Caṇḍa Pracaṇḍādi Jaya
चण्ड प्रचण्डादि जय विजयलन्
अण्ड बूजिञ्चि हरिकटुगदा पूज ॥॥ चण्ड ॥
कूर्म भूम्यादुलनु गोरिक ब्रतिष्टिञ्चि
धर्ममुख्यम्बुल नधर्मादुलन्
कर्मगति जामर ग्राहिणुल बूजिञ्चि
मर्मम्बुगा हरिकि मरिकदा पूज ॥॥ चण्ड ॥
गरुडसेनेशुलनु घनुनि शेषुनि मरिय
वरमतुल बादसंवाहिनुलनु
करमॊप्प शङ्खचक्रगदासि शार्ङ्गमुल
अरसि पूजिञ्चि हरिकिन (रिक?) पुडुगा पूज ॥॥ चण्ड ॥
नवकिरीटमुनु गुण्डलहार कौस्तुभमु
लविरळपु बीताम्बरादुललर
विविधगति बूजिञ्चि वेङ्कटेश्वरु पूज
यिवद(ल?) दळिगलु पॆट्टुडिदिगदा पूज ॥॥ चण्ड ॥
caṇḍa pracaṇḍādi jaya vijayulan
aṃḍa būjiñci harikaṭugadā pūja …. caṇḍa ..
kūrma bhūmyādulanu gōrika bratiṣṭiñci
dharmamukhyambula nadharmādulan
karmagati jāmara grāhiṇula būjiñci
marmambugā hariki marikadā pūja …. caṇḍa ..
Purport:
“AA Brahma bhuvanan lokaha punaravartinorjuna”
‘All the worlds down from the realm of Brahma are subject
to return, O Arjuna’
All the worlds down from the realm of Brahma are destructible
during the dissolution of the entire creation. These worlds re-emerge
from the body of the Supreme Lord Narayana during the next creative
cycle. Those who attain such impermanent worls are subject to return.
The rulers of such worlds like Brahma, Indra and others are themselves
subject to return and so they are in no position to grant salvation to
anybody.
“Maam upetya tu Kaunteya Punar janma na Vidhyathe”
“But on reaching Me, there is no return”
The Supreme Lord Narayana is the Overlord of the entire Universe.
He is the one who sends forth the multitude of Universes from His
body. He creates the various Gods like Brahma and others. It is He
who sustains the entire Universe and also it is into Him that all worlds
merge at the time of dissolution. However, He Himself remains
unaffected through all this and remain as the Sovereign master whose
sport is creation, sustentation and dissolution. He remains in the same
unchanging true form at all times and is immutable. For this reason,
there is no destruction in case of those who reach Him. He is the sole
Lord capable of bestowing Moksha!
Thus, He Himself advices
“Manmanabhava madbhakto madyagi mam namaskuru
Mamevaisyasi satyam te pratijane priyoasi me”
Focus your mind on Me, Be My devotee, Be My worshipper,
prostrate before Me. To Me alone you shall come. I promise you
truly, for you are dear to me”
The Supremely compassionate Lord, out of utmost love for His dear
devotee Arjuna, declares that one can attain the highest only by
worshipping Him. Out of his overflowing compassion, He promises
the devotee that by worshipping Him, one can attain Him speedity.
Annamacharya has composed his kirtana out of his deep knowledge
of Ramanyjacharya’s Gita Bhasya. These verses quoted here find
their true elaborate meanings in the divine work of Ramanuja.
Annamayya here sings the essence!
214215
garuḍasēnēśulanu ghanuni śēṣuni mariyu
varamatula bādasaṃvāhinulanu
karamoppa śaṅkhacakragadāsi śārṅgamula
arasi pūjiñci harikina (rika?) puḍugā pūja …. caṇḍa ..
navakirīṭamunu guṇḍalahāra kaustubhamu
laviraḷapu bītāmbarādulalara
vividhagati būjiñci vēṅkaṭēśvaru pūja
yivada(la?) daḷigalu peṭṭuḍidigadā pūja …. caṇḍa ..
Chanda-Prachanda, Jaya-Vijaya and the others,
only after worshipping them first, is the worship of Hari!
Consecrating Kurma, Bhumi and others devoutly,
worshipping appropriately, important ones like Dharma, Adharma, and
others like the ones who bear the Chamaras,
only then follows the worship of Hari!
Garuda, Vishwaksena, the great Sesha,
those other blessed ones who massage the feet of the Lord,
the adorning weapons like Shanka, Chakra, Gada, Sharga and others,
only after worshipping them joyously, is the worship of Hari!
The ever resplendent crown, the bead necklaces, the Kousthubha,
the fine silk robes and other such adornments,
worshipping them first through various courtesies, and then submitting
the various offerings, follows the Pooja of Lord Venkateshwara!
The appropriate method of the Deity worship of Lord Vishnu has been
elaborately described in ‘Nitya’ written by Sri Ramanujacharya.
Annamacharya here sings the essence of the following verse which
salutes the nityas and muktas along with Lord Vishnu at Vaikuntam.
कुर्मादीन् दिव्यलोकं तदनुमणिमयं मण्टपं तत्रशेषम् ।
तस्मिन् धर्मादि पीढं तदुपरी कमलं चामरग्राहिणीश्च।
विष्णु देवी- भूषागणायुध मुरगं पादुके वैनतेयं।
सेनेशं द्वारपालान् कुमुदमुखगणान् विष्णुभक्तान् प्रपद्ये ॥
सव्रमन्न्गळमूर्तये सपरिवाराय श्रीमते नारायणाय नम-।
श्रीमन् नारायण चरणौ शरणं प्रपद्ये। श्रीमते नारायणाय नम-॥
kurmādīn divyalōkaṃ tadanumaṇimayaṃ maṇṭapaṃ tatraśēṣaṃ .
tasmin dharmādi pīḍhaṃ taduparī kamalaṃ cāmaragrāhiṇīśca.
viṣṇu dēvīḥ bhūṣāgaṇāyudha muragaṃ pādukē vainatēyaṃ.
sēnēśaṃ dvārapālān kumudamukhagaṇān viṣṇubhaktān prapadyē ..
savramanngaḷamūrtayē saparivārāya śrīmatē nārāyaṇāya namaḥ.
śrīman nārāyaṇa caraṇau śaraṇaṃ prapadyē. śrīmatē nārāyaṇāya namaḥ..
I salute Lord Narayana in the form of a Tortoise bearing on its back the entire
universe. I pay salutation to the fourteen worlds of the universe including the earth.
I salute the eternal Vaikunta, the mantap studded with jewels, the baseof the four
pillars of the mantap representing Dharma, Jnana, Vairagya, Aishwarya; the body of
the pillars representing Adharma, Ajnana, Avairagya, Anaishwarya; Sesha within the
mantap; the Lotus flower in the middle of Sesha, the eight ladies standing on the eight
petals, offering the service of Chamara (Fanning) to the lord; The supreme Lord who
is seated at the centre of the lotus along with His consorts - Sri, Bhu, Neela; the
Acharyas on the left side; the dress and ornaments worn by the Lord such as silk
cloth, crown, ear rings, waist belt; the weapons of the Lord such as the Conch,
Discuss, Mace, Bow, Sword, Lotus; the Paduka of the Lord; Vainateya (Garuda),
Vishwaksena; Guards at the door way such as Chanda-Prachanda, Bhadra-Subhadra,
Dhatra-Vidhatra; Jaya-Vijaya guarding the doors of Vaikuntam in the four directions;
the other armed guards protecting the eight directions of Vaikuntam, the other
devotees of Lord Vishnu such as Nityas and Muktas. I salute the auspicious form of
Lord Sriman Narayana with all his Paraphernalia.
216217

item.title: १०४ नदुलॊल्लवु नास्नानमु
item.description:
Nadulollavu Nasnānamu
नदुलॊल्लवु नास्नानमु कडु -
सदरमु नाकीस्नानमु ॥॥ नदु ॥
इरुवङ्कल नीयेचिन मुद्रलु
धरियिञ्चुटॆ ना स्नानमु
धरपै नीनिज दासुल दासुल -
चरण धूळि ना स्नानमु ॥॥ नदु ॥
तलपुलोन निनुदलचिन वारल
दलचुटी ना स्नानमु
वलनुग निनु गनुवारल श्री पाद -
जलमु ले ना स्नानमु ॥॥ नदु ॥
परम भगवत पादाम्बुजमुल -
दरुशनमे ना स्नानमु
तिरुवेङ्कटगिरि देव नी कथा -
स्मरणमे ना स्नानमु ॥॥ नदु ॥
nadulollavu nasnānamu kaḍu -
sadaramu nā kīsnānamu …. nadu ..
iruvaṅkala nīyēcina mudralu
dhariyiñcuṭe nā snānamu
dharapai nīnija dāsula dāsula -
caraṇa dhūḷi nā snānamu …. nadu ..
talapulōna ninudalacina vārala
dalacuṭī nā snānamu
valanuga ninu ganuvārala śrī pāda -
jalamu lē nā snānamu …. nadu ..
parama bhagavata pādāmbujamula -
daruśanamē nā snānamu
tiruvēṅkaṭagiri dēva nī kathā -
smaraṇamē nā snānamu …. nadu ..
A bath in the rivers is not acceptable!
Very satisfying is for me ‘this’ kind of bath!
Wearing Your divine mudras on both shoulders
is alone my bath!
On this earth, those true servants of Your servants,
touching the dust of their feet, is my bath!
Thinking of those who contemplate on You,
this alone is my bath!
Those who can perceive You with devotion,
partaking their Sree-pada Jala1 is my bath!
The mere sight of the lotus feet of Parama-Bhagavathas
is alone my bath!
O Tiruvenkatagiri Deva! Thinking about Your glories
is alone my bath!
1.Sree pada jala is the water that has been used to wash the feet of
devotees
218219

item.title: १०५ अन्निचोट्लबरमात्म
item.description:
Annicōṭlabaramātma
अन्निचोट्लबरमात्म नीवु
यिन्निरूपुल भ्रमयिन्तुवुगा ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
पालजलनिधि नुण्डि बदरीवनान नुण्डि
आलयमै गयलो ब्रयाग नुण्डि
भूलोकनिधियै पुरुषोत्तमान नुण्डि
वेलसङ्ख्यलरूपै विच्चेतुगा ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
वुत्तर मधुरलो नयोध्यलोपल नुण्डि
सत्तैननन्दव्रजान नुण्डि
चित्तगिञ्चि पञ्चवटि सिंहाद्रिलोन नुण्डि
वत्तुगा लोकमुलु पावनमु सेयगनु ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
कैवल्यमुन नुण्डि कमलजलोकान
मोवग श्रीरङ्गमुन नुण्डि
यीवल नावल नुण्डि यी वेङ्कटाद्रि पै
नीवे नीवे वच्चि नॆलकॊण्टिगा ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
annicōṭlabaramātma nīvu
yinnirūpula bhramayintuvugā …. anni ..
pālajalanidhi nuṇḍi badarīvanāna nuṇḍi
ālayamai gayalō brayāga nuṇḍi
bhūlōkanidhiyai puruṣōttamāna nuṇḍi
vēlasaṅkhyalarūpai viccētugā …. anni ..
vuttara madhuralō nayōdhyalōpala nuṇḍi
sattainanandavrajāna nuṇḍi
cittagiñci pañcavaṭi siṃhādrilōna nuṇḍi
vattugā lōkamulu pāvanamu sēyaganu …. anni ..
kaivalyamuna nuṇḍi kamalajalōkāna
mōvaga śrīraṅgamuna nuṇḍi
yīvala nāvala nuṇḍi yī vēṅkaṭādri pai
nīvē nīvē vacci nelakoṇṭigā …. anni ..
At all these places, O Lord, You alone are there!
In all these manifested forms, You fascinate us!
From the milky ocean, form the gardens of Badari,
from Gaya Your abode, from Prayaag, becoming the treasure
of this world, from the highest position of Purushottama,
You emerged in thousands of forms!
From Mathura, and from Ayodhya
from the blissful Nanda Vraja,
manifesting from Panchavati, and from Simhadri
You appeared to sanctify the worlds!
From eternal beatitude, sustaining Brahma-loka
and also from Sree Rangam,
from here and from there, and from everywhere
You and You alone came as the Lord to reside on this Venkatadri Hill!
220221

item.title: १०६ कलदन्देपो सर्वमु
item.description:
Kaladandēpō Sarvamu
कलदन्देपो सर्वमु गलदु कामितार्थमुनु गलदु
कलदु गलदु शरणागतुलकु हरिकैङ्कर्यम्बुन मोक्षमु गल दु ॥॥ कल ॥
आकाशम्बुन मोक्षमु वॆदकिन नन्दु लोपला लेदु
पैकॊनि तानॆन्त वॆदकि चूचिना पाताळम्बुन लेदु
यीकड धरलो मूलमूललनु यॆन्दु वॆदकिना लेदु
श्रीकान्तुनि मति जिन्तिञ्चि यासल जिक्कक तॊलगिन नन्त कलदु ॥॥ कल ॥
कोटि जन्ममुलु यॆत्तिन मुक्तिकि कान मॊदलेमिय गनरादु
वाटपु संसारमुलो गर्मपु वार्धि यीदिना गनरादु
कूटुवतो स्वर्गादिलोकमुल गोरि वॆदकिना गनरादु
गाटपु केशवभक्ति गलिगिते कैवल्यमु मतिगान वच्चुनु ॥॥ कल ॥
सकलशास्त्रमुलु चदिविना बरमु चक्कटि मार्गमु दॊरकदु
विकटापुल वेल्पुल नॆन्दरि गडुवॆदकि कॊलचिना दॊरकदु
अकलङ्कुडु श्री वेङ्कटगिरिपति अन्तरङ्गमुन नुन्नाडनुचुनु
प्रकटमुगा गरुडानति इच्चिन परमु सुत्तानमु तनलो दॊरकु ॥॥ कल ॥
kaladandēpō sarvamu galadu kāmitārthamunu galadu
kaladu galadu śaraṇāgatulaku harikaiṅkaryambuna mōkṣamu galadu …. kala ..
ākāśambuna mōkṣamu vedakina nandu lōpalā lēdu
paikoni tānenta vedaki cūcinā pātāḷambuna lēdu
yīkaḍa dharalō mūlamūlalanu yendu vedakinā lēdu
śrīkāntuni mati jintiñci yāsala jikkaka tolagina nanta kaladu …. kala ..
kōṭi janmamulu yettina muktiki kāna modalēmiyu ganarādu
vāṭapu saṃsāramulō garmapu vārdhi yīdinā ganarādu
kūṭuvatō svargādilōkamula gōri vedakinā ganarādu
gāṭapu kēśavabhakti galigitē kaivalyamu matigāna vaccunu …. kala ..
sakalaśāstramulu cadivinā baramu cakkaṭi mārgamu dorakadu
vikaṭāpula vēlpula nendari gaḍuvedaki kolacinā dorakadu
akalaṅkuḍu śrī vēṅkaṭagiripati aṃtaraṅgamuna nunnāḍanucunu
prakaṭamugā garuḍānati iccina paramu suttānamu tanalō doraku …. kala ..
Everything is there in it, even the realization of desires is there!
It is there! It is there! For Sharanagathas, Moksha is there in the service of Hari!
If we search for moksha in the sky, it is not even there
Even upon searching deeply, it is not there in the nether worlds
Here on earth, even upon searching in every nook and corner, it is not there
Only upon contemplating on the Lord of Sree, and driving away all desires, it is there!
Even upon taking birth crores of times, we cannot find the beginning or end of Moksha
In the attractive Samsara, even if we swim in the sea of Karmas, we cannot find it
Even upon collectively searching at ‘Swarga’ and other worlds, it cannot be found
When there is intense devotion for Keshava, eternal beatitude can be found in the mind!
Even upon studying the various Shastras, we do not get the path to the supreme
Even upon searching and worshipping many other inferior Gods, it cannot be got
Saying that the pristine Lord of SreeVenkatagiri resides within, as revealed by Guru,
one can find the right knowledge and the Supreme within oneself!
222223

item.title: १०७ छी छी वो जीवुडा
item.description:
Chī Chī Vō Jīvuḍā
छी छी वो जीवुडा चिन्तिञ्चुको जीवुडा
आ चन्दान कीचन्दमु अरुहमा जीवुडा ॥॥ छी छी ॥
वुत्तमुडयिन हरिवुण्डेटि यातुमलोन
तत्तरपु गान्तलनु तलपोसेदा
वॊत्ति नारायणनाम मुच्चरिञ्चेनोरनु
रुत्तयधरपुदोलु रुचिगॊनेदा ॥॥ छी छी ॥
पॊन्दुगा गोविन्दुनि बूजिञ्चेटि चेतलनु
सन्दडि जन्नुलमीद जाचबॊय्येदा
कन्दुव देवुनिरूपु कनुगॊने चूपुलु
मुन्दनि मर्मपुटङ्गमुल मीद बॆट्टॆदा ॥॥ छी छी ॥
वेवेलु विष्णकथलु विनियेटि चॆवुलनु
आवटिञ्चि याडसुद्दुलालकिञ्चेदा
श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरुनि सेविञ्चे यी जीवनमु
भाविञ्चक विषयालपालु सेसेदा ॥॥ छी छी ॥
chī chī vō jīvuḍā cintiñcukō jīvuḍā
ā candāna kīcandamu aruhamā jīvuḍā …. chī chī ..
vuttamuḍayina harivuṇḍēṭi yātumalōna
tattarapu gāntalanu talapōsēdā
votti nārāyaṇanāma muccariñcēnōranu
ruttayadharapudōlu rucigonēdā …. chī chī ..
pondugā gōvinduni būjiñcēṭi cētalanu
sandaḍi jannulamīda jācaboyyēdā
kanduva dēvunirūpu kanugonē cūpulu
mundani marmapuṭaṅgamula mīda beṭṭedā …. chī chī .
vēvēlu viṣṇakathalu viniyēṭi cevulanu
āvaṭiñci yāḍasuddulālakiñcēdā
śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaruni sēviñcē yī jīvanamu
bhāviñcaka viṣayālapālu sēsēdā …. chī chī ..
Fie upon You O Jiva! Analyze carefully O Jiva!
For something like that, is this befitting, O Jiva!
In the mind where the highest Lord Hari resides,
is it right to think about women in a sensual way?
With the mouth that pronounces the name of Narayana,
is it right to taste the lips of a woman which is but mere flesh!
With the hands that joyously worship Lord Govinda,
is it right to caress the breasts of women?
The eyes that eagerly behold the beautiful form of the Lord,
is it right to use them to see the private parts?
The ears which listen to the glories of Lord Vishnu thousands of times,
is it right to use them to hear mere gossips of women?
This life which is for the service of Lord Sree Venkateshwara,
thoughtlessly, why waste it indulging in material pleasures?
224225

item.title: १०८ सततं श्रीशं
item.description:
Satataṃ Śrīśaṃ
सततं श्रीशं
हितं परात्पर मीडे ॥॥ सततम् ॥
गदाधरं मेघगम्भीरनि -
नदं परमोन्नत शुभदं
मृदु तरगमनं मेदिनीधरं
हृदय निलय महमीडे ॥॥ सततम् ॥
नन्दकधरं जनार्दनं गो -
विन्दं चारु मुकुन्दं
नन्द गोपवर नन्दन कन्दं
यिन्दुर विनयन मीडे ॥॥ सततम् ॥
गरुडगमन मुरगशयन मधिकं
परमपदेशं पावनं
तिरुवेङ्कट गिरि देव मतुलं म-
हिरमणं स्धिर मीडे ॥॥ सततम् ॥
satataṃ śrīśaṃ
hitaṃ parātpara mīḍē …. satataṃ ..
gadādharaṃ mēghagambhīrani -
nadaṃ paramōnnata śubhadaṃ
mṛdu taragamanaṃ mēdinīdharaṃ
hṛdaya nilaya mahamīḍē …. satataṃ ..
nandakadharaṃ janārdanaṃ gō -
vindaṃ cāru mukundaṃ
nanda gōpavara nandana kandaṃ
yindura vinayana mīḍē …. satataṃ ..
garuḍagamana muragaśayana madhikaṃ
paramapadēśaṃ pāvanaṃ
tiruvēṅkaṭa giri dēva matulaṃ ma-
hiramaṇaṃ sdhira mīḍē …. satataṃ ..
Eternally unto the Lord of Sree,
the doer of good, the Supreme being, I surrender!
The wielder of the mace, the one with a voice like thunder
the bestower of supreme auspiciousness,
the one who moves gently, the Lord who bore the earth,
the one who resides in the heart, unto Him I surrender!
The wielder of Nandaka, Janardhana!
Govinda, the attractive one, Mukunda!
The one who blessed the Gopis of Nanda, that dear one of Nanda
the one with sun and moon as eyes, unto Him I surrender!
The one who moves mounted on Garuda, the one who reclines on the serpant,
the superior one, the Supreme Lord of Parama pada, the propitious one,
That Lord of TiruVenkatagiri, the matchless one, the Lord of Sesha
the eternal one, unto Him I surrender!
226227

item.title: १०९ परमपातकुड
item.description:
Paramapātakuḍa
परमपातकुड भवबन्धुड श्री -
हरि निनु दलच ने नरुहुडना ॥॥ परम ॥
अपवित्रुड ने नमंळुड गडु -
नपगत पुण्युड नलसुडनु
कपटकलुष परिकर हृदयड ने -
नपवर्गमुनकु नरुहुडना ॥॥ परम ॥
अतिदुष्णुड ने नधिक दूषितुड
हतविवेकमति नदयडनु
पतिलेनि रमापति मिमुदल चले-
नतुलगतिकि ने नरुहुडना ॥॥ परम ॥
अनुपम विषय पराधीनुड ने -
ननन्त मोहभयातुरुड
विनुतिम्पङ्ग दिरु वेङ्कटेश घनु-
लनघुलु गाक ने नरुहुडना ॥॥ परम ॥
paramapātakuḍa bhavabandhuḍa śrī -
hari ninu dalaca nē naruhuḍanā …. parama ..
apavitruḍa nē namaṃḷuḍa gaḍu -
napagata puṇyuḍa nalasuḍanu
kapaṭakaluṣa parikara hṛdayuḍa nē -
napavargamunaku naruhuḍanā …. parama ..
atiduṣṇuḍa nē nadhika dūṣituḍa
hatavivēkamati nadayuḍanu
patilēni ramāpati mimudala calē-
natulagatiki nē naruhuḍanā …. parama ..
anupama viṣaya parādhīnuḍa nē -
nananta mōhabhayāturuḍa
vinutimpaṅga diru vēṅkaṭēśa ghanu-
lanaghulu gāka nē naruhuḍanā …. parama ..
I am the highest sinner, caught in this material existence!
O Sree Hari, am I qualified to think of You?
Impure I am, inauspicious I am
I am meritorious only in the bad way, ignorant I am
My heart is full of deceit and sin,
Am I eligible for salvation?
Extremely wicked and highly blameworthy I am,
I lack wisdom and am uncompassionate
O Lord of Lakshmi, You who has no other Overlord
without thinking of You, am I eligible for the supreme abode?
I am controlled by many material desires,
I am gripped by limitless fear and passion
O Lord TiruVenkatesha! But for the sinless and
great ones, am I eligible to praise You?
228229

item.title: ११० ऎन्नडुदीरवु
item.description:
Ennaḍudīravu
ऎन्नडुदीरवु यी पनुलु
पन्निन नीमाय बहुळम्बाय ॥॥ ऎन्नडु ॥
पॆक्कुमतम्बुल पॆद्दलु नडचिरि
वॊक्कसम्मतै वॊडबडरु
पॆक्कु देवतलु पेरुवाडॆदरु
तक्कक घनुलमु तामेयनुचु ॥॥ ऎन्नडु ॥
पलिकॆटि चदुवुलु बहुमार्गम्बुलु
कलसि येकवाक्यत गादु
चल वादम्बुलु जनुलुनु मानरु
एलु तर्कम्बुलॆ पचरिञ्चेरु ॥॥ ऎन्नडु ॥
शरणागतुलकु श्री वेङ्कटेश्वर
तिरमुग नीवे तीर्चितिवि
परमवैष्णवुलु पट्टिरि व्रतमु
यिरुवुग नाचार्यु लॆरुगुदुरु ॥॥ ऎन्नडु ॥
ennaḍudīravu yī panulu
pannina nīmāya bahuḷambāya …. ennaḍu ..
pekkumatambula peddalu naḍaciri
vokkasammatai voḍabaḍaru
pekku dēvatalu pēruvāḍedaru
takkaka ghanulamu tāmēyanucu …. ennaḍu ..
palikeṭi caduvulu bahumārgambulu
kalasi yēkavākyata gādu
cala vādambulu janulunu mānaru
ēlu tarkambule pacariñcēru …. ennaḍu ..
śaraṇāgatulaku śrī vēṅkaṭēśvara
tiramuga nīvē tīrcitivi
paramavaiṣṇavulu paṭṭiri vratamu
yiruvuga nācāryu leruguduru …. ennaḍu ..
These kinds of deeds are never diminishing,
Your pervasive Maya is ever increasing!
Having tread the path of various doctrines
yet they do not prevail upon one thing.
They use the names of various Gods,
but still proclaim that they themselves are Gods!
Having studied the very many paths,
they do not proclaim one common statement.
People do not give up their rigid arguments,
yet they speak about logical reasoning!
For Sharanagathas, O Sree Venkateshwara,
You alone clear the overpowering doubts!
This is the vow being followed by Parama Vaishnavas,
and only the Acharyas understand it for certain!
Annamacharya here upholds the path of Sharanagathi, saying that
it is the path followed by Parama Vaishnavas and also by the
Acharyas. And that only they are capable of comprehending its true
glory!
230231

item.title: १११ ऎन्त सोदिञ्चि चूचिना
item.description:
Eṃta Sōdiñci Cūcinā
ऎन्त सोदिञ्चि चूचिना यॆन्नॆन्नि चदिविना
वन्तलै ननी मूर्ति वॆस दॆलिसेमा ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
लोकमुलो समुद्रमु लोतु चॆप्पगरादट
आकाश मिन्तन्तनि यनरादट
मे कानि भूरेणुवुलु मिति वॆट्टगरादट
श्रीकान्तुड नी महिम चॆप्पिचूप वशमा ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
अलगालि दॆच्चि मुडियगा गट्टगरादट
वॆलय गालमु गण्टु वेयरादट
कलय नलुदिक्कुल कड गानग रादट
जलजाक्ष नीरूपु तलपोयगलना ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
केवलमैन नी माय गॆलवनेरादट
भाविञ्चि मनसु जक्कबट्ट रादट
देव यलमेल्मङ्गपतिवि नी शरणे गति
श्री वेङ्कटेश निन्नु जेरि कॊल्ववशमा ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
eṃta sōdiñci cūcinā yennenni cadivinā
vantalai nanī mūrti vesa delisēmā …. eṃta ..
lōkamulō samudramu lōtu ceppagarādaṭa
ākāśa mintantani yanarādaṭa
mē kāni bhūrēṇuvulu miti veṭṭagarādaṭa
śrīkāntuḍa nī mahima ceppicūpa vaśamā …. eṃta ..
alagāli decci muḍiyagā gaṭṭagarādaṭa
velaya gālamu gaṇṭu vēyarādaṭa
kalaya naludikkula kaḍa gānaga rādaṭa
jalajākṣa nīrūpu talapōyagalanā …. eṃta ..
kēvalamaina nī māya gelavanērādaṭa
bhāviñci manasu jakkabaṭṭa rādaṭa
dēva yalamēlmaṅgapativi nī śaraṇē gati
śrī vēṅkaṭēśa ninnu jēri kolvavaśamā …. eṃta ..
How much ever one examines, how much ever one studies
can one understand the glory of Your wonderful form?
In this world, one cannot fathom the depth of the ocean
The extent of the sky cannot be told
The number of atoms of the earth cannot be counted
O Lord of Sree, is it ever possible to explain Your glory!
It is not possible to tie up the air into a bundle
One cannot obstruct the progress of time
One cannot perceive the ends of the four directions
O Lotus eyed Lord! Can one ever imagine Your true form!
One cannot win over Your absolute Maya
One cannot control the mind even upon resolving
O consort of Alamelumanga! Surrender unto You is the only means!
Sree Venkatesha! Is it possible to reach unto You and worship You?!
232233

item.title: ११२ इट्टि ब्राह्मण्य
item.description:
Iṭṭi Brāhmaṇya
इट्टि ब्राह्मण्य मॆक्कुडु यिन्निटिलोन
दट्टमै तदिय्यलकॆ तगुनु ब्राह्मण्यमु ॥॥ इट्टि ॥
हरिगॊलिचेवारि कमरु ब्राह्मण्यमु
परम वैष्णवमे ब्राह्मण्यमु
हरिणोर्ध्वपुण्ड्रदेहुलौटे ब्राह्मण्यमु
तिरुमन्त्रविधुलदे तेकुव ब्राह्मण्यमु ॥॥ इट्टि ॥
सतमै चक्राङ्कितुलचरिते ब्राह्मण्यमु
पतिशरणागतिये ब्राह्मण्यमु
वॆतलेनि वीरलसात्विकमे ब्राह्मण्यमु
तति द्वयाधिकारुले तप्परु ब्राह्मण्यमु ॥॥ इट्टि ॥
अञ्च बरमभागवताधीनमु ब्राह्मण्यमु
पञ्चसंस्कारादुलदे ब्राह्मण्यमु
यॆञ्चग श्री वेङ्कटेशुडितडे ब्रह्मण्युडु
मुञ्चि यीतनिवारौटे मॊदलि ब्राह्मण्यमु ॥॥ इट्टि ॥
iṭṭi brāhmaṇya mekkuḍu yinniṭilōna
daṭṭamai tadiyyulake tagunu brāhmaṇyamu …. iṭṭi ..
harigolicēvāri kamaru brāhmaṇyamu
parama vaiṣṇavamē brāhmaṇyamu
hariṇōrdhvapuṇḍradēhulauṭē brāhmaṇyamu
tirumantravidhuladē tēkuva brāhmaṇyamu …. iṭṭi ..
satamai cakrāṅkitulacaritē brāhmaṇyamu
patiśaraṇāgatiyē brāhmaṇyamu
vetalēni vīralasātvikamē brāhmaṇyamu
tati dvayādhikārulē tapparu brāhmaṇyamu …. iṭṭi ..
aṃca baramabhāgavatādhīnamu brāhmaṇyamu
pañcasaṃskārāduladē brāhmaṇyamu
yeñcaga śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍitaḍē brahmaṇyuḍu
muñci yītanivārauṭē modali brāhmaṇyamu …. iṭṭi ..
This kind of ‘Brahmanyamu’1 is the highest amongst all others
Profound and befitting is this ‘Brahmanyamu’ for Tadeeyas (Sharanagathas)!
To those who worship Hari, it is agreeable, this ‘Brahmanyamu’
Parama Vaishnavam2 is this ‘Brahmanyamu’
Wearing Hari’s Urdhva Pundaras3 on the body is ‘Brahmanyamu’
Chanting the ‘Tirumantra’4 dutifully is the resolute ‘Brahmanyamu’
Eternally those who wear the marks of the Chakra, their conduct is ‘Brahmanyamu’
Sharanagati5 unto the Lord alone is ‘Brahmanyamu’
Those who remain sorrowless, their Saatvik6 nature is ‘Brahmanyamu’
Those who are initiated into the Dvayam, they do not transgress this ‘Brahmanyamu’
If rightly appraised, being subservient to ParamaBhagavathas7 is ‘Brahmanyamu’
Getting initiated with Panchasamskara8 and the likes is ‘Brahmanyamu’
If understood, Sree Venkatesha alone is the Supreme Brahman
Totally becoming ‘His-own’ is the foremost ‘Brahmanyamu’
1. Brahmanyamu means the conduct of a true Brahmana
2. Parama Vaishnavam means the highest Vaishnava way of living
3. Urdhva Pundaras are naamams worn on the body, ie Tiruman-Sreechoornams
4. Tirumantra: “Om Namo Narayanaya”
5. Sharanagati means self-surrender
6. Mode of supreme goodness
7. Parama Bhagavathas are supreme devotees of Vishnu
8. Panchasamskara are the five purificatory rites performed during the initiation into
SreeVaishnavism
234235

item.title: ११३ कामधेनुविदे
item.description:
Kāmadhēnuvidē
कामधेनु विदे कल्प वृक्ष मिदे
प्रामण्यमुगल प्रपन्नुलकु ॥॥ काम ॥
हरिनामजपमे आभरणम्बुलु
परमात्मुनिनुति परिमळमु
धरणिधरु पादसेवे भोगमु
परमं बॆरगिन प्रपन्नुलकु ॥॥ काम ॥
देवुनिध्यानमु दिव्यान्नम्बुलु
श्रीविभुभक्ते जीवनमु
आविफ्णुकैङ्कर्यमे संसारमु
पापनुलगु यी प्रपन्नुलकु ॥॥ काम ॥
येपुन श्रीवॆङ्कटेशुडे सर्वमु
दापै यितनिवन्दनमे विधि
कापुग शरणागतुले चुट्टालु
पैपयि गॆलचिन प्रपन्नुलकु ॥॥ काम ॥
kāmadhēnu vidē kalpa vṛkṣa midē
prāmaṇyamugala prapannulaku …. kāma ..
harināmajapamē ābharaṇambulu
paramātmuninuti parimaḷamu
dharaṇidharu pādasēvē bhōgamu
paramaṃ beragina prapannulaku …. kāma ..
dēvunidhyānamu divyānnambulu
śrīvibhubhaktē jīvanamu
āviphṇukaiṅkaryamē saṃsāramu
pāpanulagu yī prapannulaku …. kāma ..
yēpuna śrīveṅkaṭēśuḍē sarvamu
dāpai yitanivandanamē vidhi
kāpuga śaraṇāgatulē cuṭṭālu
paipayi gelacina prapannulaku …. kāma ..
Kamadhenu1 this is! Kalpavruksha2 this is!
For the Prapannas3 who rely upon authority!
The chanting of Hari’s names itself are the adornments,
Praising Paramatma4 is the fragrance that emanates from them,
Servitude offered to the feet of Dharanidhara5 is their pleasure,
for Prapannas who know the supreme!
Contemplation on the Lord is like divine food,
Devotion to the Lord of Sree is but the living,
Kainkaryam6 to Vishnu is but their Samsara,
for the Prapannas who are pious!
SreeVenkatesha is ‘Everything’
Obeisances unto Him is the duty,
Protectively, Sharanagathas alone are the relatives,
for the Prapannas who win over easily!!
1.Kamadhenu is the wish yielding cow
2.Kalpavruksha is the wish yielding tree
3.Prapannas are those who have performed Sharanagati unto the
Lord
4.Paramatma means the Supreme Soul, ie the Lord
5.Dharanidhara is the one who held up the earth, ie Lord Varaha or
Vishnu
6.Kainkaryam means to offer servitude unto the Lord
236237

item.title: ११४ वादुलेल चदुवुलु
item.description:
Vādulēla Caduvulu
वादुलेल चदुवुलु वारु चॆप्पिनवे कावा
वादुलेल मीमाट वारिकण्टे नॆक्कुडा ॥॥ वादुलेल ॥
नालुगुवेदालब्रह्म नलि नॆव्वनिसुतुडु
वालिनपुराणालव्यासु डॆव्वनिदासुडु
लील रामायणपुवाल्मीकि वसिष्टुलु
आलकिं चॆव्वनि गॊल्चि रातडे पो देवुडु ॥॥ वादुलेल ॥
भारत मॆव्वनि कथ भागवतमु चॆप्पिन -
धीरुडैनशुकुडु येदेवुनिकिङ्करुडु
सारपुशास्त्रालु चूचि सन्यसिञ्चि नुडिगेटि -
नारायणनामपुनाथुडे पो देवुडु ॥॥ वादुलेल ॥
विष्णुवाज्ञयमनि चॆप्पे विधिसङ्कल्प मेडदि
विष्णुमाययनि चॆप्पे विश्वमन्ता नॆव्वनिदि
““विष्णुमयं सर्व’’ मने वेदवाक्य मॆव्वनिदि
विष्णुवु श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रिविभुडे आ देवुडु ॥॥ वादुलेल ॥
vādulēla caduvulu vāru ceppinavē kāvā
vādulēla mīmāṭa vārikaṇṭē nekkuḍā …. vādulēla
nāluguvēdālabrahma nali nevvanisutuḍu
vālinapurāṇālavyāsu ḍevvanidāsuḍu
līla rāmāyaṇapuvālmīki vasiṣṭulu
ālakiṃ cevvani golci rātaḍē pō dēvuḍu .. vādulēla
bhārata mevvani katha bhāgavatamu ceppina -
dhīruḍainaśukuḍu yēdēvunikiṅkaruḍu
sārapuśāstrālu cūci sanyasiñci nuḍigēṭi -
nārāyaṇanāmapunāthuḍē pō dēvuḍu …. vādulēla
viṣṇuvājñayamani ceppē vidhisaṅkalpa mēḍadi
viṣṇumāyayani ceppē viśvamantā nevvanidi
“viṣṇumayaṃ sarva’’ manē vēdavākya mevvanidi
viṣṇuvu śrīvēṅkaṭādrivibhuḍē ā dēvuḍu …. vādulēla
Why any arguments, when these people have only spoken the scriptures
Why any arguments? Is your word more authoritative than theirs?
The Brahma of the four Vedas, whose son is he?
Vyasa who authored the Puranas, whose Daasa is he?
Valmiki and Vasista of the glorious Ramayana, having comprehended,
the one to whom they offered their worship, He alone is the Supreme Lord!
Whose glory did the ‘Bhaaratha’1 speak of? The one who spoke the Bhagavatha
the great Suka, unto which deity did he offer servitude?
For those who examine all the shastras, renounce and then live by it,
the Lord by the name of Narayana, He alone is the Supreme God!
That Vishnu-Agnya2 which is called destiny and fate, from where does it originate?
That Vishnu-Maaya3 which is called as the Universe, whose possession is it?
The words of the Veda that declare “Vishnu mayam sarvam”, whose words are they?
That Vishnu, Lord SreeVenkateshwara, alone is that supreme Lord!!
Purport : Annamacharya declares here that the supremacy of Lord Narayana has been
established in the scriptures and also by great sages like Vyasa, Valmiki, Shuka , Vasista and
others who composed many works purely for the sake of imparting the true essence of the
Vedas. Thus, having the injunctions of the Vedas as the prime support, their words stand as the
authority!
1.Mahabharatha
2.The will of Lord Vishnu
3.The Triguna Maaya of Vishnu, by which the Universe is created
238239

item.title: ११५ अन्निटिकॆक्कुडुयीवि
item.description:
Anniṭikekkuḍuyīvi
अन्निटि कॆक्कुडुयिवि हरियिच्चेदि
मन्निञ्चुनातनिकण्टॆ मऱिलेरु दॊरलु ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
तगुब्रह्मलोकमुदाका नॆक्किचूचिन
मगुड बुट्टेलोकाले मनुजुलकु
तॆगि यिच्चे यिन्द्रादिदेवतल वरमुलु
यॆगुवदिगुवलनु यीसन्दिवे ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
मायलोन बुट्टेदि मायलोन बॆरिगेदि
कायदारुलकु नॆल्ला गलिगिनदे
सेयरानिपुण्यमॆल्ला जेसि गडिञ्चुकॊनेदि
चायल बहुरूपपुसंसारमे ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
चॆडनिवैकुण्ठ मिच्चु जेटुलेनिवर मिच्चु
वॆडमाय बॆडबापु विष्णुडीतडे
यॆडयक श्रीवेङ्कटेशुडै वुन्नाडु वीडॆ
जडिय कितडे काचु शरणण्टे जालुनु ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
anniṭi kekkuḍuyivi hariyiccēdi
manniñcunātanikaṇṭe maṟilēru doralu …. anni ..
tagubrahmalōkamudākā nekkicūcina
maguḍa buṭṭēlōkālē manujulaku
tegi yiccē yindrādidēvatala varamulu
yeguvadiguvalanu yīsandivē …. anni ..
māyalōna buṭṭēdi māyalōna berigēdi
kāyadārulaku nellā galiginadē
sēyarānipuṇyamellā jēsi gaḍiñcukonēdi
cāyala bahurūpapusaṃsāramē …. anni ..
ceḍanivaikuṇṭha miccu jēṭulēnivara miccu
veḍamāya beḍabāpu viṣṇuḍītaḍē
yeḍayaka śrīvēṅkaṭēśuḍai vunnāḍu vīḍe
jaḍiya kitaḍē kācu śaraṇaṇṭē jālunu …. anni ..
What Hari gives is higher than the rest!
There is no other ruling deity than Him, who is all forgiving!
Even after attaining Brahma-loka, if one understands
it is again a return to the mortal world for humans!
Akin to this, the profusely bestowed boons by Indra and other demigods
is but reaching higher worlds and coming back down!
Being born in Maya, growing in Maya
for those who bear the mortal body, this is but common
By doing immeasurable number of meritorious deeds,
all that one gains is the manifold samsara again!
Bestowing the eternal Vaikunta, bestowing benevolent boons
the one who dispels the powerful Maaya is Lord Vishnu alone!
He Himself exists here as Venkateshwara
without hesitation He alone protects, when one surrenders!!
240241

item.title: ११६ कल्लमाट दॊड्डमुद्र
item.description:
Kallamāṭa Doḍḍamudra
कल्लमाट दॊड्डमुद्र कटकटा
चॆल्लुबडिकल्ललु चॆप्पेरु लोकुलु ॥॥ कल्लमाड ॥
यिप्पुडेले ब्रह्मदेवुडिट्टे वुण्डग मीदटि -
वॊप्पगुब्रह्मपट्टमु वॊकरिकि वॆच्चपॆट्टि
अप्पटि मूडुमूर्तुलयन्दुलो नीतनि सरि -
चॆप्पबॊय्ये रीमाट चॆल्लुना लोकुलकु लोकुलु ॥॥ कल्लमाड ॥
कैलासमु रुद्रुडुगल ब्रह्माण्डकोट्लु
पोलि????0्चि विफ्णुडु कडुपुन निञ्चुकुण्डुगानु
चालि मूडुमूर्तुललो सरि यीतडण्टानु
कूळलै याडेरुगाक कूडुना लोकुलकु लोकुलु ॥॥ कल्लमाड ॥
घनुडीतनिपादमु गडिगॆ ब्रह्म देवुडु
मुनुमुट्टि शिरसुन मोचॆ शिवूडु
वॊनर मूडुमूर्तुलं दॊकडु श्रीवेङ्कटेशु-
डनुमाट यिदि तगववुना लोकुलकु लोकुलु ॥॥ कल्लमाड ॥
kallamāṭa doḍḍamudra kaṭakaṭā
cellubaḍikallalu ceppēru lōkulu …. kallamāḍa ..
yippuḍēlē brahmadēvuḍiṭṭē vuṇḍaga mīdaṭi -
voppagubrahmapaṭṭamu vokariki veccapeṭṭi
appaṭi mūḍumūrtulayandulō nītani sari -
ceppaboyyē rīmāṭa cellunā lōkulaku lōkulu ..kallamāḍa
kailāsamu rudruḍugala brahmāṇḍakōṭlu
pōlici viphṇuḍu kaḍupuna niñcukuṇḍugānu
cāli mūḍumūrtulalō sari yītaḍaṇṭānu
kūḷalai yāḍērugāka kūḍunā lōkulaku lōkulu ..kallamāḍa
ghanuḍītanipādamu gaḍige brahma dēvuḍu
munumuṭṭi śirasuna mōce śivūḍu
vonara mūḍumūrtulaṃ dokaḍu śrīvēṅkaṭēśu-
ḍanumāṭa yidi tagavavunā lōkulaku lōkulu ..kallamāḍa
What a pity! People are lying, and that lie is gaining value!
With authority, people are uttering only lies!
Even when the ruling Brahma is still existing,
He (Vishnu) confers that very post of Brahma to another befitting one!
Yet people say “He is just one among the trinity”
If they want to proclaim so to the world, is it right?
Kailasa, Lord Rudra and the crores of other Brahmandas
when Lord Vishnu has placed them within His stomach,
Yet they say “He is just one among the trinity”
Thus proclaim the wicked people! Is it right to do so to the world?
Lord Brahma washed the feet of this great Lord!
Touching His feet, Lord Shiva paid reverence by placing Him on his head!
Saying then, that Sree Venkatesha is just one among the trinity,
and proclaiming so to the world, is it right??
242243

item.title: ११७ सर्वोपायमुल जगति
item.description:
Sarvōpāyamula Jagati
सर्वोपायमुल जगति ना कितडे
वुर्वीधरुडु पुरुषोत्तमुं डितडे ॥॥ सर्वो ॥
सकल गङ्गानदि तीर्थस्नानफलमु लिवि
स्वामिपुष्करिणिजलमे नाकु
सकल पुण्यक्षेत्रावासयात्र लिवि
सरि वेङ्कटाचलविहार मिदिये
सकल वेदाध्यनशास्त्रपाठम्बु लिवि
शौरिसङ्कीर्तनं बिदिये नाकु
सकल कर्मानुष्ठानमुल यितनि किच्चट
जातुपडि कैङ्कर्य मिदिये ॥॥ सर्वो ॥
उपवासतपमु लिवि यितनिप्रसादम्बु -
लॊगि भुजिम्पुटे नाकु दिनदिनम्बु
जप रहस्योपदेशम्बु लितनि पाद -
जलजम्बुलु शरणनेटिसेव यॆकटे
उपमिम्प बुण्यपुरुषल दर्शनमु नाकु -
नॊगि निचटि बहुवृक्षदर्शनम्बु
यॆपुडु बुण्य कथाश्रवणम्बु लिच्चोटि
यॆन्नगल बहुपक्षिकलकलम्बु ॥॥ सर्वो ॥
तलपुगल योगम्बुलन्दु श्रीवैष्णवुल
दगुलु संवास सहयोगम्बु
वॆलय निण्डुमहोत्सवम्बु लिन्निय नितनि -
विभवम्बु लॆसगु तिरुनाळ्ळु नाकु
Lord Vishnu, the Supreme overlord of the entire universe, is the primal
Lord who is the origin of all including Brahma, Isha and the host of other
divinities. All Gods come into existance by His will alone.
Being the sole Lord, He is the one who bestows the post of Brahma to
a deserving one. Even when the Brahma of the present creative cycle
exists, He conferrs the next post of Brahma to another beffitting one.
At the time of dissolution, all worlds merge back into Him. He protects
the entire cosmos within His stomach. Even the higher worlds like
Brahmaloka and Kailasa are absorbed into Him. He protects Lord
Brahma and Lord Shiva by placing them within His Stomach.
When such is the case, it is a crime to consider Lord Narayana as just
one among the trinity. He is the soverign ruler of all, the seat of origin
and dissolution, and the base for preservation. He is the one who
bestows the post of Brahma and Shiva to deserving ones and so He
remains as their Overlord. He is that Lord who has never had and will
never ever have an equal. He is the Lord even to great ones like Brahma
and Isha. Lord Narayana dwells in Brahma and Shiva as their inner
soul and shows them the way. Thus they, Brahma and Isha, become
the creator & destroyer respectively. The vedas clearly extol the
transcendent supremacy of Lord Narayana. Annamacharya here
proclaims Lord Vishnu’s soverignity and supremacy.
Many Scriptures mention the Avatara of Vishnu in between Brahma and
Shiva. Lord Vishnu manifests as one among the trinity only because He
takes up the task of protecting His devotees unto Himself. For this reason
the scriptures mention Him to be the preserver, inbetween the creator
Brahma and the destroyer Shiva. Those who ignore this reason think
that Vishnu is placed between Brahma and Shiva because He is equal
to them! This is a wrong understanding because, the one who manifests
as Vishnu among the trinity is the Supreme Overlord Narayana Himself,
who is the creator of Brahma and Shiva also. It is He who exists as
their inner self and it is He who bestows upon them their respective
posts. He cannot be considered as just one among the trinity. It would
also be wrong to hold that the consort of Sree is the Supreme self
different from the Vishnu of the trinity. Having created Brahma and Shiva
to perform the task of creation and destruction respectively, the Supreme
Lord Narayana, the consort of Sree, Himself occupies the position of
Vishnu – the preserver. The reality is that He, Lord Sriman Narayana, is
the sole Overlord, even to Brahma and Shiva!
244245
चॆलगि यिटु देवताप्रार्थनिन्तय नाकु
श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि शरणागति
अलरु ना सम्पदलु यितनि पट्टपुराणि -
अलुमेलुमङ्ग कडकण्टिचूपु ॥॥ सर्वो ॥
sarvōpāyamula jagati nā kitaḍē
vurvīdharuḍu puruṣōttamuṃ ḍitaḍē …. sarvō ..
sakala gaṅgānadi tīrthasnānaphalamu livi
svāmipuṣkariṇijalamē nāku
sakala puṇyakṣētrāvāsayātra livi
sari vēṅkaṭācalavihāra midiyē
sakala vēdādhyanaśāstrapāṭhambu livi
śaurisaṅkīrtanaṃ bidiyē nāku
sakala karmānuṣṭhānamula yitani kiccaṭa
jātupaḍi kaiṅkarya midiyē …. sarvō ..
upavāsatapamu livi yitaniprasādambu -
logi bhujimpuṭē nāku dinadinambu
japa rahasyōpadēśambu litani pāda -
jalajambulu śaraṇanēṭisēva yokaṭē
upamimpa buṇyapuruṣala darśanamu nāku -
nogi nicaṭi bahuvṛkṣadarśanambu
yepuḍu buṇya kathāśravaṇambu liccōṭi
yennagala bahupakṣikalakalambu …. sarvō ..
talapugala yōgambulandu śrīvaiṣṇavula
dagulu saṃvāsa sahayōgambu
velaya niṇḍumahōtsavambu linniyu nitani -
vibhavambu lesagu tirunāḷḷu nāku
celagi yiṭu dēvatāprārthanintayu nāku
śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaruni śaraṇāgati
alaru nā sampadalu yitani paṭṭapurāṇi -
alumēlumaṅga kaḍakaṇṭicūpu …. sarvō ..
The means for everything in this world, to me, is He
The supporter of the entire universe, the supreme person, is He!
Like a holy bath in Ganga and other sacred rivers,
is the water of Swami Pushkarini, for me!
Like a pilgrimage to various sacred places,
is the pleasurable walk on Venkatachala hill!
Like a study of Vedas , shastras, and other scriptures,
is for me rendering Sowri’s Sankirtana!
Offering all our daily duties and ordained deeds unto Him,
is but His Kainkarya !
Fastings and penances are but His prasadam,
that I relish day after day!
Like all Japas and sacred incantations,
is surrendering unto His lotus –feet!
Like seeing holy people, is for me,
the sight of the host of trees!
Like constantly listening to the glorious pastimes of His,
is the sweet chirping of birds here!
Amongst the desirable Yogas is,
associating and living with SreeVaishnavas!
All these glorious festivities here, are like
auspicious days that bestow His grace!
Like the worship of all devatas, is for me,
performing Sharanagathi unto SreeVenkateshwara!
An ever-growing wealth of mine, is His reigning queen,
Alamelumanga’s one compassionate glance from the corner of Her eyes!
246247

item.title: ११८ चॆल्लबो यीजीवुलिल
item.description:
Cellabō Yījīvulila
चॆल्लबो यीजीवु लिल जेसिनपाप मॆन्तो
वुल्लमुन नुन्नहरि वूरके दव्वाय ॥॥ चॆल्लबो ॥
कन्नचोटने हरि कलडन्नवारिकि
विन्नचोटने विष्णुडु विवेकुलकु
वुन्नति गॊलुवलेक वॊद्दनुण्डगा गॊन्दरु
मिन्नुमीद वॆदकेरु मितिमीऱ जदिवि ॥॥ चॆल्लबो ॥
पट्टिनदे ब्रह्ममु परमार्थवेत्तलकु
तिट्टुलना दैवमु दिव्युलकुनु
मुट्टि चेत मॊक्कलेरु मुन्दटने वुण्डगानु
बट्टबयलु पाकेरु बहुकर्मविदुल ॥॥ चॆल्लबो ॥
ऊपिरिलो देवुडुन्नाडु योगीन्द्रुलकु
दापुन नुन्नाडु हरिदासुलकुनु
येपुन श्रीवेङ्कटेशु नेचि शरणनलेक
चापलान वॆदकेरु सकलदेवतल ॥॥ चॆल्लबो ॥
cellabō yījīvu lila jēsinapāpa mentō
vullamuna nunnahari vūrakē davvāya …. cellabō ..
kannacōṭanē hari kalaḍannavāriki
vinnacōṭanē viṣṇuḍu vivēkulaku
vunnati goluvalēka voddanuṇḍagā gondaru
minnumīda vedakēru mitimīṟa jadivi …. cellabō ..
paṭṭinadē brahmamu paramārthavēttalaku
tiṭṭulanā daivamu divyulakunu
muṭṭi cēta mokkalēru mundaṭanē vuṇḍagānu
baṭṭabayalu pākēru bahukarmavidula …. cellabō ..
ūpirilō dēvuḍunnāḍu yōgīndrulaku
dāpuna nunnāḍu haridāsulakunu
yēpuna śrīvēṅkaṭēśu nēci śaraṇanalēka
cāpalāna vedakēru sakaladēvatala …. cellabō ..
The sins committed by these Jivas with arrogance is so much
(that) Hari who resides in the heart, became distant!
Wherever they see, there is Hari, for those who say that Hari exists
Wherever they listen, it is ‘Vishnu’ for the learned
Not worshipping Him in the higher sense, though He is within
some seek Him in the sky, even after studying extensively!
Whatever they hold on to, it is Brahman, for the knowers of the supreme truth
Even in a curse there is divinity for the divine!
Some do not bow down and touch, even when (HE is) present in front
They seek all around, by performing various karmas
In the breath itself God exists, for the Yogis
Close by He exists for the Hari-daasas
Without surrendering unto Lord SreeVenkateshwara
some seek, with fickle-mindedness, all other Gods!!
248249

item.title: ११९ एटिमाटलिवि
item.description:
Ēṭimāṭalivi
एटिमाट लिवि विन निम्पय्यीना मदि -
नेटवॆट्टि दासुडौ टिदिसरिया ॥॥ एटिमाट ॥
जीवुडे देवुडनि चॆप्पुदुरु गॊन्दरु
दैवमुचेतलॆल्ला दम कुन्नवा
आवल गॊन्दरु कर्ममदि ब्रह्म मन्दुरु
रावणादु लवि सेसि रतिकॆक्किरा ॥॥ एटिमाट ॥
मिगुल गॊन्दरु दैवमे लेदनॆन्दुरु
तग नीप्रपञ्चमॆल्ला दनचेतला
गगन मतडु निराकार मन्दुरु गॊन्द -
रॆगुव बुरुषसूक्त मॆऱगरा तामु ॥॥ एटिमाट ॥
यॆनिमिदिगुणमुले यितनि वन्दुरु गॊन्द-
रनयमु मिगिलिन ववि दमवा
यॆनयग श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरुदासुलै
मनुट नित्यमुगाक मरि येमिनेला ॥॥ एटिमाट ॥
ēṭimāṭa livi vina nimpayyīnā madi -
nēṭaveṭṭi dāsuḍau ṭidisariyā …. ēṭimāṭa ..
jīvuḍē dēvuḍani ceppuduru gondaru
daivamucētalellā dama kunnavā
āvala gondaru karmamadi brahma manduru
rāvaṇādu lavi sēsi ratikekkirā …. ēṭimāṭa ..
migula gondaru daivamē lēdanenduru
taga nīprapañcamellā danacētalā
gagana mataḍu nirākāra manduru gonda -
reguva buruṣasūkta meṟagarā tāmu …. ēṭimāṭa
yenimidiguṇamulē yitani vanduru gonda-
ranayamu migilina vavi damavā
yenayaga śrīvēṅkaṭēśvarudāsulai
manuṭa nityamugāka mari yēminēlā …. ēṭimāṭa
What kind of words are these? Though pleasant to hear
Compromising with such statements and becoming a Daasa, is it right??
Some1 say that the Jiva itself is the Lord,
All that the Lord does can they perform?
Some2 others say that ‘Karma’ is Brahman
Thinking thus, did Ravana and others indulge in sexual pleasures?
Some3 others say that God does not exist!
Then all this world, is it their creation?
Some say that He is the formless Sky, up above
Don’t they know about the ‘PurushaSukta’?4
Some others say that He possesses only eight qualities!
Then all the other attributes5, is it theirs?
To live as SreeVenkateshwaras Daasas
is alone eternal! What else can be?
1.The Advaitins
2.The Sankhyans
3.The non believers
4.Some say that ‘Akasha’ denotes Brahman. But the Purusha Sukta declares
that the sky and everything else originates from Him alone. He is limitless,
but exists as the indweller in everything
5.The Lord is an ocean of limitless number of attributes and than too
supremely auspicious ones.
250251

item.title: १२० इपुडिटु कलगण्टि
item.description:
Ipuḍiṭu Kalagaṇṭi
इप्पुडिटु कलगण्टि नॆल्ललोकमुलकु
नप्पडगु तिरुवेङ्कटाद्रीशु गण्टि ॥॥ इपुडिटु ॥
अतिशयम्बैन शेषाद्रि शिखरमु गण्टि
प्रतिलेनि गोपुर प्रभलु गण्टि
शतकोटि सूर्यतेजमुलु वॆलुगग गण्टि
चतुरास्यु बॊडगण्टि चय्यन मेलुकण्टि ॥॥ इपुडिटु ॥
कनकरत्न कवाटकान्तु लिरुगड गण्टि
घनमैन दीप सङ्घमुलु गण्टि
अनुपम मणिमयमगु किरीटमु गण्टि
कनकाम्बरमु गण्टि गक्कन मेलु कण्टि ॥॥ इपुडिटु ॥
अरुदैन शङ्खचक्रादु लिरुगड गण्टि
सरिलेनि अभय हस्तमु गण्टि
तिरुवेङ्कटाचलाधिपुनि जाडग गण्टि
हरि गण्टि गुरु गण्टि नन्तट मेलुकण्टि ॥॥ इपुडिटु ॥
ippuḍiṭu kalagaṇṭi nellalōkamulaku
nappaḍagu tiruvēṅkaṭādrīśu gaṇṭi …. ipuḍiṭu .
atiśayambaina śēṣādri śikharamu gaṇṭi
pratilēni gōpura prabhalu gaṇṭi
śatakōṭi sūryatējamulu velugaga gaṇṭi
caturāsyu boḍagaṇṭi cayyana mēlukaṇṭi …. ipuḍiṭu .
kanakaratna kavāṭakāntu lirugaḍa gaṇṭi
ghanamaina dīpa saṅghamulu gaṇṭi
anupama maṇimayamagu kirīṭamu gaṇṭi
kanakāmbaramu gaṇṭi gakkana mēlu kaṇṭi … ipuḍiṭu ..
arudaina śaṅkhacakrādu lirugaḍa gaṇṭi
sarilēni abhaya hastamu gaṇṭi
tiruvēṅkaṭācalādhipuni jūḍaga gaṇṭi
hari gaṇṭi guru gaṇṭi nantaṭa mēlukaṇṭi …. ipuḍiṭu
I had a vision just now! In which I beheld,
The Overlord of all worlds, the Lord of TiruVenkatadri!
I saw the marvelous peak of Seshadri Hill
The unmatched glow of the gopura I saw
The light like that of the brilliance of crores of suns I saw
Lord Brahma I saw, with a startle I woke up!
The dazzle of the golden doors embedded with gems, from both sides I saw
The union of many brilliant lamps I saw
The crown studded with matchless gems I saw
The golden hued sky I saw, I woke up suddenly!
The unique Shanka-Chakra on either side I saw
The matchless Abhaya Hastam I saw
I could perceive the Lord of TiruVenkatachala
Hari I saw, my guru I saw! Just then I woke up!
252253

item.title: १२१ मेदिनिजीवुलगाव
item.description:
Mēdinijīvulagāva
मेदिनि जीवुलगाव मेलुकोवय्या
नीदये माकॆल्ल रक्ष निद्रमेलुकोवय्या ॥॥ मेदिनि ॥
तगु गोपिकल कन्नु दामरलु विकसिञ्चॆ
मिगुल सूर्यनेत्रुड मेलुकोवय्या
तॆगुव राक्षसुलने तिमिरमु विरियग
नॆगडिन परञ्ज्योति निद्र मेलुकोवय्या ॥॥ मेदिनि ॥
घनदुरितपु नल्लगलुवल विकसिञ्चॆ
मिनुकु शशिवर्णुड मेलुकोवय्या
पनिवडि वेदालने पक्षुलॆल्लाबलुकग
जनक याश्रितपारिजात मेलुकोवय्या ॥॥ मेदिनि ॥
वरलक्ष्मी कुचचक्रवाकमु लॊण्डण्टिराय
मॆलय दोषारहित मेलुकोवय्या
पॊरसि नीवु नित्य भोगमुलु भोगिञ्च
निरति श्री वॆङ्कटेश नेडु मेलुकोवय्या ॥॥ मेदिनि ॥
mēdini jīvulagāva mēlukōvayyā
nīdayē mākella rakṣa nidramēlukōvayyā …. mēdini ..
tagu gōpikala kannu dāmaralu vikasiñce
migula sūryanētruḍa mēlukōvayyā
teguva rākṣasulanē timiramu viriyaga
negaḍina parañjyōti nidra mēlukōvayyā …. mēdini ..
ghanaduritapu nallagaluvala vikasiñce
minuku śaśivarṇuḍa mēlukōvayyā
panivaḍi vēdālanē pakṣulellābalukaga
janaka yāśritapārijāta mēlukōvayyā …. mēdini ..
varalakṣmī kucacakravākamu loṇḍaṇṭirāya
melayu dōṣārahita mēlukōvayyā
porasi nīvu nitya bhōgamulu bhōgiñca
nirati śrī veṅkaṭēśa nēḍu mēlukōvayyā …. mēdini .
Wake up! To protect these Jivas on earth!
Your compassion is the protection for us. Wake up O Lord!
The lotus eyes of the Gopis are opening,
Do wake up, O Lord ‘Surya-Netra’1!
As the stubborn demoniac darkness is spreading
O ever increasing supreme effulgence, do wake up from Your sleep!
The great sins are blooming like dark water lilies
O shining moon-complexioned one, do wake up!
The birds called ‘Vedas’ are eagerly calling
O father of the worlds! O Parijatha of the seekers! Wake up!
Having been awakened by the touch of Lakshmi’s perfect
Chakravaka2 like breasts, O flawless one, do wake up!
As you enjoy the eternal pleasures,
O Lord Sree Venkatesha! Do wake up today!
1.The one with Sun as the eyes
2.Chakravaka is a beautiful bird
254255

item.title: १२२ अन्निटिकिनिदि
item.description:
Anniṭikinidi
अन्निटिकि निदि परवौषधमु
वॆन्नुनि नाममे विमलौषधमु ॥॥ अन्निटि ॥
चित्तशान्तिकिनि श्रीपति नाममॆ
हत्तिन निज दिव्यौषधमु
मॊत्तपु बन्धविमोचनम्बुनकु
चित्तजगुरुडे सिद्धौषधमु ॥॥ अन्निटि ॥
परिपरि विधमुल भवरोगमुलकु
हरि पादजलमे Еौषधमु
दुरितकर्ममुल दॊलगिञ्चुटकुनु
मुरहरु पूजे मुख्यौषधमु ॥॥ अन्निटि ॥
यिल निहपरमुल निन्दिराविभुनि
नलरि भजिम्पुटॆ Еौषधमु
कलिगिन श्रीवेङ्कटपति शरणमॆ
निलिचिन माकिदि नित्यौषधमु ॥॥ अन्निटि ॥
anniṭiki nidi paramauṣadhamu
vennuni nāmamē vimalauṣadhamu …. anniṭi ..
cittaśāntikini śrīpati nāmame
hattina nija divyauṣadhamu
mottapu bandhavimōcanambunaku
cittajaguruḍē siddhauṣadhamu …. anniṭi ..
paripari vidhamula bhavarōgamulaku
hari pādajalamē yauṣadhamu
duritakarmamula dolagiñcuṭakunu
muraharu pūjē mukhyauṣadhamu …. anniṭi ..
yila nihaparamula nindirāvibhuni
nalari bhajimpuṭe yauṣadhamu
kaligina śrīvēṅkaṭapati śaraṇame
nilicina mākidi nityauṣadhamu …. anniṭi ..
For everything, this is the Supreme medicine!
The name of ‘Vennudu’1 is the pristine medicine!
For peace of mind, Sree-Pathi’s name alone
is the true divine medicine!
For total release from all bondage,
the father of Manmatha is the remedial medicine!
For the various aliments of Samsara,
the Hari Pada-Jala2 is the medicine!
For driving away our evil Karmas,
the worship of Mura-Hara is the important medicine!
On this earth, for now and hereafter, joyously praising
the Lord of Lakshmi, is ‘The’ medicine!
Surrendering unto the manifest God Sree-Pathi
this alone is for us the eternal medicine!!!
1.Vennudu is Vishnu
2.Hari Pada-Jala is the water that has been used to worship Hari’s feet
256257

item.title: १२३ चेरि कॊल्वरो
item.description:
Cēri Kolvarō
चेरि कॊल्वरो यीतडु श्रीदेवुडु
यीरीति श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि निरवैन देवुडु ॥॥ चेरि ॥
अलमेलु मङ्ग नुरमं दिडुकॊन्न देवुडु
चॆलगि शङ्खचक्राल चेति देवुडु
कल वरदहस्तमु गटिहस्तपु देवुडु
मलसी श्रीवत्स वनमालिकल देवुडु ॥॥ चेरि ॥
घन मकरकुण्डल कर्णमुल देवुडु
कलन पीताम्बर शृङ्गार देवुडु
ननिचि ब्रह्मादुल नाभिगन्न देवुडु
जनिञ्चॆ बादाल गङ्ग सङ्गतैन देवुडु ॥॥ चेरि ॥
कोटि मन्मथाकार सङ्कुलमैन देवुडु
जाटपुगिरीटपु मिञ्चुल देवुडु
वाटपु सॊम्मुलतोडि वसुधापति देवुडु
यीटुलेनि श्री वेङ्कटेशुडैन देवुडु ॥॥ चेरि ॥
cēri kolvarō yītaḍu śrīdēvuḍu
yīrīti śrī vēṅkaṭādri niravaina dēvuḍu …. cēri ..
alamēlu maṅga nuramaṃ diḍukonna dēvuḍu
celagi śaṅkhacakrāla cēti dēvuḍu
kala varadahastamu gaṭihastapu dēvuḍu
malasī śrīvatsa vanamālikala dēvuḍu …. cēri ..
ghana makarakuṇḍala karṇamula dēvuḍu
kalana pītāmbara śṛṅgāra dēvuḍu
nanici brahmādula nābhiganna dēvuḍu
janiñce bādāla gaṅga saṅgataina dēvuḍu ..cēri ..
kōṭi manmathākāra saṅkulamaina dēvuḍu
jūṭapugirīṭapu miñcula dēvuḍu
vāṭapu sommulatōḍi vasudhāpati dēvuḍu
yīṭulēni śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍaina dēvuḍu …. cēri ..
Collectively offer worship! He is the Lord of Sree!
He is the Lord who resides on Sree Venkatadri!
