He is the Lord who has placed Alamelumanga on His chest
He is the Lord whose hands joyfully wield the Shanka-Chakra
He is the Lord with the Varada-Hasta1 and the Kati-Hasta2
He is the Lord who is adorned by the Srivathsa and Vanamala!
He is the Lord whose ears are adorned by fish shaped ear rings
He is the Lord whose is decorated in yellow sacred robes
He is the Lord whose navel is the origin of Brahma and others
He is the Lord from whose feet Ganga originated
He is the Lord whose form is the sum total of crores of Manmathas
He is the Lord who is resplendent with a shining crown
He is the consort of Vasudha, decorated with beautiful jewellery
He is the matchless Lord Sree Venkatesha !!
1.The boon bestowing hand
2.The hand placed upont the waist
258259

item.title: १२४ वॆडमन्त्रमिकनेल
item.description:
Veḍamantramikanēla
वॆडमन्त्रमिकनेल वेरु वॆल्लङ्कुलुनेल
पुडमि धरुडु माकु भुवनौषधमु ॥॥ वॆडमन्त्र ॥
हरि यच्युतायण्टे नणुगु बापमुलु
नरसिंह यनि यण्टे नाटिन दुःखमुलु मानु
पुरुषोत्तमा यण्टे बुण्ड्लुबूचुलु मानु
परवौषध मीतडे पाटिम्प माकु ॥॥ वॆडमन्त्र ॥
वासुदेव यनि यण्टे वदलु बन्धमु लॆल्ला
वासिकि गृष्णायण्टे वन्दल रोगालु मानु
श्री सतीश यनि यण्टे चिन्त लिन्नियनु मानु
गासि दीर नित डेपो घन दिव्यौषधमु ॥॥ वॆडमन्त्र ॥
गोविन्दा यनि यण्टे गूडुनु सम्पदलु
यीवल माधव यण्टे निहमु बरमु जेरु
देवनारायण यण्टे देहमु सुखियै यण्डु
श्री वेङ्कटेशुडे माकु सिद्धौषधमु ॥॥ वॆडमन्त्र ॥
veḍamantramikanēla vēru vellaṅkulunēla
puḍami dharuḍu māku bhuvanauṣadhamu .. veḍamantra ..
hari yacyutāyaṇṭē naṇugu bāpamulu
narasiṃha yani yaṇṭē nāṭina duḥkhamulu mānu
puruṣōttamā yaṇṭē buṇḍlubūculu mānu
paramauṣadha mītaḍē pāṭimpa māku ..veḍamantra ..
vāsudēva yani yaṇṭē vadalu bandhamu lellā
vāsiki gṛṣṇāyaṇṭē vandala rōgālu mānu
śrī satīśa yani yaṇṭē cinta linniyunu mānu
gāsi dīra nita ḍēpō ghana divyauṣadhamu .. veḍamantra ..
gōvindā yani yaṇṭē gūḍunu sampadalu
yīvala mādhava yaṇṭē nihamu baramu jēru
dēvanārāyaṇa yaṇṭē dēhamu sukhiyai yaṇḍu
śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍē māku siddhauṣadhamu .. veḍamantra
Why any other mantra? Why any other means?
The Lord who lifted the Earth, He alone is the Universal medicine!
“Hari! Achyuta!” if we say, all sins are suppressed
“Narasimha” if we say, the deep rooted sorrows will go
“Purushottama” if we say, all bodily sores, and fears will heal
He alone is the supreme medicine, if we follow!
“Vasudeva” if we say, all attachments are gone
“Krishna” if we say, hundreds of diseases will heal
“Sree-Sati Isha” if we say, all worries will vanish
Totally He alone is our great divine medicine!
“Govinda” if we say, wealth accumulates
“Madhava” if we say here, we can reach the Supreme
“Deva! Narayana!” if we say, the body shall remain comfortable
Sree Venkatesha alone is for us the remedial medicine!!!
260261

item.title: १२५ कदसियातडु
item.description:
Kadasiyātaḍu
कदसि यातडु मम्मु गाचुगाक
अदॆ यातनिकॆ शरणण्टॆ नण्टिनेनु ॥॥ कदिसि ॥
ऎव्वनि वुद्मुन निन्नि लोकमु लुण्डु
ऎव्वनि पादमु मोचॆनिल यिलनु
यॆव्वडु रक्षकुडायनी जन्तुकोट्लकु
अव्विभुनिकि शरणण्टे नण्टिनिप्पुडु ॥॥ कदिसि ॥
सभलो द्रौपदिगाचॆ सर्वेशुडॆव्वडु
अभय हस्तमॊसगॆ नातडॆव्वडु
इभ वरदुडॆव्वडु यीतनिकॆ वॊडिगट्टि
अभिनवमुग शरणण्टे नण्टिनिप्पुडु ॥॥ कदिसि ॥
शरणु चॊच्चिन विभीषणु गाचॆ नॆव्वडु
अरदि यजुनि तण्ड्रि यातडॆव्वडु
यिरवै श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रि यॆक्कि नातडितडे
अरसि यितनिके शरणण्टे नण्टिनिप्पुडु ॥॥ कदिसि ॥
kadasi yātaḍu mammu gācugāka
ade yātanike śaraṇaṇṭe naṇṭinēnu …. kadisi ..
evvani vudmuna ninni lōkamu luṇḍu
evvani pādamu mōcenila yilanu
yevvaḍu rakṣakuḍāyanī jantukōṭlaku
avvibhuniki śaraṇaṇṭē naṇṭinippuḍu …. kadisi ..
sabhalō draupadigāce sarvēśuḍevvaḍu
abhaya hastamosage nātaḍevvaḍu
ibha varaduḍevvaḍu yītanike voḍigaṭṭi
abhinavamuga śaraṇaṇṭē naṇṭinippuḍu …. kadisi ..
śaraṇu coccina vibhīṣaṇu gāce nevvaḍu
aradi yajuni taṇḍri yātaḍevvaḍu
yiravai śrīvēṅkaṭādri yekki nātaḍitaḍē
arasi yitanikē śaraṇaṇṭē naṇṭinippuḍu …. kadisi ..
Coming to us, may He protect us!
If we surrender unto Him, which I did!
In whose stomach are all these worlds present?
Whose foot supports the earth?
Who is the savior of the crores of life forms?
Unto that Lord we should surrender, which I did now!
Who is that Lord who protected Draupadi in the royal assemblage?
Who is the one with the Abhaya-Hasta?1
Who is the one who saved the elephant king?
One must surrender oneself unto Him totally, which I did anew!
Who is the one who had protected Vibeeshana who had surrendered?
Who is the father of the wonderful Manmatha?
Who is the one who has made SreeVenkatadri His abode?
Totally one must surrender unto Him, which I did!!
1. Boon bestowing hand
262263

item.title: १२६ एमरक
item.description:
Ēmaraka
एमरक तलचरो यिदे चालु
कामिञ्चिनवि यॆल्ल गक्कुननॆ कलुगु ॥॥ एमरक ॥
दुरितमुलॆल्ल दीरु दुःखमुलॆल्ल नणगु
हरि यनि वॊक माटु अन्नाजालु
सुरलु पूजिन्तुरु सिरुलॆल्ल जेरुनु
मरुगुरुनि नाममटु पेरुकॊन्नजालु ॥॥ एमरक ॥
भवमुलन्निय बाय परमु निहमुजेरु
आवल नारायण यन्नाजालु
भुवियॆल्ला दानेलु पुण्यमुलन्निय जेरु
तविलि गोविन्दुनात्म दरचिन जालु ॥॥ एमरक ॥
आनन्दमु गलुगु नज्ञानमॆल्ल बाय
आनुक श्री वेङ्कटेश यन्नजालु
यी नॆपान नारदादु लिन्दरु निन्दकु साक्षि
दानवारि मन्त्र जपतपमे चालु ॥॥ एमरक ॥
ēmaraka talacarō yidē cālu
kāmiñcinavi yella gakkunane kalugu …. ēmaraka
duritamulella dīru duḥkhamulella naṇagu
hari yani voka māṭu annājālu
suralu pūjinturu sirulella jērunu
maruguruni nāmamaṭu pērukonnajālu …. ēmaraka
bhavamulanniyu bāyu paramu nihamujēru
āvala nārāyaṇa yannājālu
bhuviyellā dānēlu puṇyamulanniyu jēru
tavili gōvindunātma daracina jālu …. ēmaraka
ānandamu galugu najñānamella bāyu
ānuka śrī vēṅkaṭēśa yannajālu
yī nepāna nāradādu lindaru nindaku sākṣi
dānavāri mantra japatapamē cālu …. ēmaraka
Without forgetting, do think (of Him). This alone suffices!
All that one desires will be instantly bestowed!
All sins get absolved, all sorrows are suppressed
uttering even once, the name of ‘Hari’, is enough!
Even the demigods will revere, all riches accumulate
mentioning the name of the father of Madana is enough!
All sorrows will go, the supreme will be attained
saying ‘Narayana’ alone is enough!
One can rule over the earth, all merits can be obtained
calling out ‘Govinda’ from our inner self is enough!
Bliss will be obtained, ignorance will go
‘Sree Venkatesha’ if we say, it is enough
For this, Narada and the others are the proof
Mantra, Japa, and Tapa1 of Vishnu alone is enough!!!
1. Mantras are incantations, Japa is chanting, Tapa is meditation
264265

item.title: १२७ ऎक्कुव कुलजुडैन
item.description:
Ekkuva Kulajuḍaina
ऎक्कुव कुलजुडैन हीनकुलजाडैन
निक्कमॆरिगिन महानित्युडे घनुडु ॥॥ ऎक्कुव ॥
वेदमुलु चदिवियनु विमुखुडै हरिभक्ति
यादरिञ्चनि सोमयाजिकण्टॆ
येदियनु लेनि कुलहीनुडैननु विष्णु
पादमुलु सेविञ्चु भक्तुडे घनुडु ॥॥ ऎक्कुव ॥
परममगु वेदान्त पठन दॊरिकिय सदा
हरिभक्तिलेनि सन्यासिकण्टॆ
सरवि मालिन यन्त्यजाति कुलजुडैन
नरसिविष्णुनि वॆदकु नातडे घनुडु ॥॥ ऎक्कुव ॥
विनिय जदिवियनु श्री विभुनि दासुडुगाक
तनुवु वेपुचुनुण्डु तपसिकण्टॆ
ऎनलेनि तिरुवेङ्कटेशु प्रसादान्न
मनुभविञ्चिन यातडप्पुडे घनुडु ॥॥ ऎक्कुव ॥
ekkuva kulajuḍaina hīnakulajūḍaina
nikkamerigina mahānityuḍē ghanuḍu ..ekkuva ..
vēdamulu cadiviyunu vimukhuḍai haribhakti
yādariñcani sōmayājikaṇṭe
yēdiyunu lēni kulahīnuḍainanu viṣṇu
pādamulu sēviñcu bhaktuḍē ghanuḍu …. ekkuva..
paramamagu vēdānta paṭhana dorikiyu sadā
haribhaktilēni sanyāsikaṇṭe
saravi mālina yantyajāti kulajuḍaina
narasiviṣṇuni vedaku nātaḍē ghanuḍu …. ekkuva
viniyu jadiviyunu śrī vibhuni dāsuḍugāka
tanuvu vēpucunuṇḍu tapasikaṇṭe
enalēni tiruvēṅkaṭēśu prasādānna
manubhaviñcina yātaḍappuḍē ghanuḍu …. ekkuva
Whether of a high caste, or of a low caste
the one who knows the truth, he alone is the great one!
A Somayaji1 well versed in the Vedas, but averse
to Hari-Bhakti, better than him is
the great one who has nothing, and is of a low caste
but worships the feet of Lord Vishnu!
A Sanyasi who has access to the study of the great Vedanta,
but does not have constant Hari-Bhakti, better than him is
the great one who is disorderly and is of the lowest caste
but closely seeks Vishnu!
An Ascetic who having heard and studied, yet who does not become
a Hari-daasa but who tortures his body, better than him is
the one who has partaken and relished the prasada of TiruVenkatesha!
Such a person becomes great at once!
1. Somayaji is one who performs Yagnas or sacrifices
266267

item.title: १२८ इन्नि जन्ममु
item.description:
Inni Janmamu
इन्नि जन्ममु लेटिकि हरिदासु
लुन्न वूर दानुण्डिन जालु ॥॥ इन्नि ॥
हरिभक्तुल यिण्टि यन्नमु गॊनुवारि
वरुवुडै यण्डवलॆनन्न जालु
परमभागवत भवनम्बुल जॆड्ड
पुरुवु दानयि पॊडमिन जालु ॥॥ इन्नि ॥
वासुदेवुनि भक्तवरुल दासुलु मुन्नु
रोसिन यॆङ्गिलि रुचिगॊन्नजालु
श्री सतीशुनि दलञ्चिनवारि दासान
दासुडैवुण्ड दलचिन जालु ॥॥ इन्नि ॥
श्रीवेङ्कटेशु जाचिनवारि श्रीपाद
सेवकुडै यण्डजेजेरिन जालु
ई विभुदासुल हितुल पादधूळि
पावनमै सोकि ब्रदिकिन जालु ॥॥ इन्नि ॥
inni janmamu lēṭiki haridāsu
lunna vūra dānuṇḍina jālu …. inni ..
haribhaktula yiṇṭi yannamu gonuvāri
varuvuḍai yuṇḍavalenanna jālu
paramabhāgavata bhavanambula jeḍḍa
puruvu dānayi poḍamina jālu …. inni ..
vāsudēvuni bhaktavarula dāsulu munnu
rōsina yeṅgili rucigonnajālu
śrī satīśuni dalañcinavāri dāsāna
dāsuḍaivuṇḍa dalacina jālu …. inni ..
śrīvēṅkaṭēśu jūcinavāri śrīpāda
sēvakuḍai yuṇḍajējērina jālu
ī vibhudāsula hitula pādadhūḷi
pāvanamai sōki bradikina jālu …. inni ..
These many births, of what use are they?
If we reside in a town inhabited by Hari-daasas, that alone is sufficient!
Those who partake food from the house of Hari-bhaktas
to think of being their servant, it is sufficient!
In the houses of Parama Bhagavathas
even if one lives with low esteem, it is enough!
Those who are the servants of the devotees of Vasudeva
even to taste their leftover food, it is enough!
Those who are the servants of the servants of the ones who contemplate on SreePathi
to even think of becoming their servants, it is enough!
Those who have perceived Sree Venkatesha
to even think of serving their respectable feet, it is enough!
Those well wishers who are the Daasas of this Lord
touching the dust of their feet, becoming pious, and living thus is enough!!!
268269

item.title: १२९ इदिये वेदान्त
item.description:
Idiyē Vēdānta
इदिये वेदान्त मिन्दुकण्टॆ लेदु
इदिये श्री वेङ्कटेशुनि मतमु ॥॥ इदिये ॥
विरतिये लाभमु विरतिये सौख्यमु
विरतियेपो विज्ञानमु
विरतिचे घनुलैरि वॆनक वारॆल्ल
विरति बॊन्दकुन्न वीडदु भवमु ॥॥ इदिये ॥
चित्तमे पापमु चित्तमे पुण्यमु
चित्तमे मोक्षसिद्धियनु
चित्तमु वलॆने श्रीहरि निलुचुनु
चित्तशान्ति लेक चेरदु परमु ॥॥ इदिये ॥
ऎन्त चदिविना ऎन्त वॆदकिना
यिन्तकण्टॆ मरियिक लेदु
यिन्तट श्रीवेङ्कटेशु दासुलौट
यॆन्तवारिकैन यिदिये तॆरुवु ॥॥ इदिये ॥
idiyē vēdānta mindukaṇṭe lēdu
idiyē śrī vēṅkaṭēśuni matamu …. idiyē ..
viratiyē lābhamu viratiyē saukhyamu
viratiyēpō vijñānamu
viraticē ghanulairi venaka vārella
virati bondakunna vīḍadu bhavamu …. idiyē ..
cittamē pāpamu cittamē puṇyamu
cittamē mōkṣasiddhiyunu
cittamu valenē śrīhari nilucunu
cittaśānti lēka cēradu paramu …. idiyē ..
eṃta cadivinā eṃta vedakinā
yintakaṇṭe mariyika lēdu
yintaṭa śrīvēṅkaṭēśu dāsulauṭa
yentavārikaina yidiyē teruvu …. idiyē ..
This is the Vedanta, there is nothing else!
This itself is SreeVenkatesha’s religion!
Detachment itself is gainful, detachment itself is comforting
detachment itself is the special knowledge!
By being detached, earlier many have become great
without being detached, sorrows will not let go!
Mind itself is sinful, mind itself is meritorious
Mind itself is the (cause of) attainment of Moksha!
As ones mind is, so is Hari perceived
without peace of mind, the supreme cannot be reached!
How much ever one studies, how much ever one searches
there is nothing else other than this!
For all this, being Daasas of SreeVenkatesha
is the only way, for whoever it may be!
270271

item.title: १३० इद्दरिकिद्दरे सरि
item.description:
Iddarikiddarē Sari
इद्दरि किद्दरे सरि यीडुकु जोडुकु दगु
गद्दरिकन्नुल जाड गलिगॆगा मनकु ॥॥ इद्दरि ॥
पन्तपु चॆलिचन्नुलु (ल?) पसिडि कान्तुलकु
कान्तुनि पीताम्बरपु कान्तुलु सरि
दॊन्तुल चॆलिनीलपु तुरुमु कान्तुलकु
वन्तुल मेनि नीलवर्णमु सरि ॥॥ इद्दरि ॥
जलजाक्षि वॆललेनि जघनचक्रमुनकु
चलमरिवलन केलिचक्रमु सरि
कुलिकेटि यी यिन्ति कुत्तिक शङ्खमुनकु
चलिवाय रमणुनि शङ्खमु सरि ॥॥ इद्दरि ॥
कमलाक्षि श्री वेङ्कटपति गूडुटकु
रमणु डण्टिन समरतुलु सरि
तमितोडि निद्दरिकि तारुकाणलैनट्टि
समुकपु मोहमुल सन्तसमुलु सरि ॥॥ इद्दरि ॥
iddari kiddarē sari yīḍuku jōḍuku dagu
gaddarikannula jūḍa galigegā manaku …. iddari ..
pantapu celicannulu (la?) pasiḍi kāntulaku
kāntuni pītāmbarapu kāntulu sari
dontula celinīlapu turumu kāntulaku
vantula mēni nīlavarṇamu sari …. iddari ..
jalajākṣi velalēni jaghanacakramunaku
calamarivalana kēlicakramu sari
kulikēṭi yī yinti kuttika śaṅkhamunaku
calivāya ramaṇuni śaṅkhamu sari …. iddari ..
kamalākṣi śrī vēṅkaṭapati gūḍuṭaku
ramaṇu ḍaṇṭina samaratulu sari
tamitōḍi niddariki tārukāṇalainaṭṭi
samukapu mōhamula santasamulu sari …. iddari ..
They match each other! They are perfect together in everyway!
We have clever eyes to perceive them!
For the golden radiance of His consort’s breasts,
the golden glow of the Lord’s yellow silk robes are the perfect match!
For the thick blue radiance of the lady’s shining hair,
the shine from His blue body is the perfect match!
For the precious beautifully rounded hips of the lotus eyed Goddess,
the discus wielded by the Lord of Lakshmi is the perfect match!
For the conch like neck of the graceful lady,
the conch wielded by the Lord of Lakshmi is the perfect match!
For the lotus eyed lady and Sree Venkatapathi to untie,
the Lord’s insatiable desire is the right match!
These are the examples proving that both are
equal in passions, happiness, and are a ‘perfect match’!
272273

item.title: १३१ अटुवण्टिवाडुवो
item.description:
Aṭuvaṇṭivāḍuvō
अटुवण्टिवाडुवो हरिदासुडु
अटमटालु विडिचि नातडे सुखि ॥॥ अटुवण्टि ॥
तिट्टेटि माटलुनु दीविञ्चे माटलुनु
अट्टे सरेनि तलचिनातडे सुखि
पट्टि चम्पेवेळनु पट्टमुगट्टेवेळ
अट्टु निट्टु चलिञ्चनि यातडे सुखि ॥॥ अटुवण्टि ॥
चेरिपञ्चदारिडिन जेदु दॆच्चिपॆट्टिनानु
आरगिञ्चि तनिवॊन्दे यतडे सुखि
तेरकाण्ड्लजाचिन तॆगरानि चुट्टमुल
नारय सरिगाजाचे यातडे सुखि ॥॥ अटुवण्टि ॥
पॊन्दि पुण्यमु वच्चिन पॊरिबापमु वच्चिन
नन्दलि फलमॊल्लनि यातडे सुखि
विन्दुगा श्री वेङ्कटाद्रिविभुनि दासुलजेरि
अन्दरानि पदमन्दि नातडे सुखि ॥॥ अटुवण्टि ॥
aṭuvaṇṭivāḍuvō haridāsuḍu
aṭamaṭālu viḍici nātaḍē sukhi …. aṭuvaṇṭi
tiṭṭēṭi māṭalunu dīviñcē māṭalunu
aṭṭē sarēni talacinātaḍē sukhi
paṭṭi campēvēḷanu paṭṭamugaṭṭēvēḷa
aṭṭu niṭṭu caliñcani yātaḍē sukhi …. aṭuvaṇṭi
cēripañcadāriḍina jēdu deccipeṭṭinānu
āragiñci tanivondē yataḍē sukhi
tērakāṇḍlajūcina tegarāni cuṭṭamula
nāraya sarigājūcē yātaḍē sukhi …. aṭuvaṇṭi
pondi puṇyamu vaccina poribāpamu vaccina
nandali phalamollani yātaḍē sukhi
vindugā śrī vēṅkaṭādrivibhuni dāsulajēri
aṃdarāni padamandi nātaḍē sukhi …. aṭuvaṇṭi
This is how a Hari-daasa should be!
One who lets go of dualities, he alone is happy!
Words of castigation, words of benediction
one who takes them as equal, he alone is happy!
At times of threat for life, at times of attaining reward
one who remains unmoved, he alone is happy!
When given sweet sugar, or when given something bitter
one who eats and feels satisfied, he alone is happy!
Upon meeting a stranger, or a close relative
one who sees them as equal, he alone is happy!
Upon attaining merits, upon getting sins
one who does not accept the fruits thereof, he alone is happy!
Having joyously associated with the servants of the Lord of Sree,
one who considers that state to be the highest, he alone is happy!
274275

item.title: १३२ नेनॊक्कडलेकुण्डिते
item.description:
Nēnokkaḍalēkuṇḍitē
ने नॊक्कड लेकुण्डिते नी कृपकु पात्र मेदि?
पूनि नावल्लने कीर्ति पॊन्देवु नीवु!॥ ने नॊक्कड॥
अति मूढुललोन नग्रेसरुड नेनु;
प्रति लेनि घनगर्व पर्वतमनु;
तति पञ्चेन्द्रियमुलु धनवन्तुडनु नेनु;
वॆतकि नावण्टिवानि विडुवग जॆल्लुना?॥ ने नॊक्कड॥
महिलो संसारपु साव्रूज्य मेलेवाड नेनु;
इहमुन कर्मवहि कॆक्किति नेनु;
बहु योनिकूपसम्पद देलेवाड नेनु;
वहिञ्चुक नावण्टि वानि दे नोपेना?॥ ने नॊक्कड॥
भाविञ्चि नावण्टि नीचु बट्टि काचिनप्पुडुगा
एवङ्क नीकीर्ति कडु नॆन्तुरु भुवि;
नावल्ल नीकु पुण्यमु, नीवल्ल ने ब्रदुकुदु,
श्री वेङ्कटेशुड! इन्त चेरॆ सुम्मी मेलु.॥ ने नॊक्कड॥
nē nokkaḍa lēkuṇḍitē nī kṛpaku pātra mēdi?
pūni nāvallanē kīrti pondēvu nīvu!.. nē nokkaḍa..
ati mūḍhulalōna nagrēsaruḍa nēnu;
prati lēni ghanagarva parvatamanu;
tati pañcēndriyamulu dhanavantuḍanu nēnu;
vetaki nāvaṇṭivāni viḍuvaga jellunā?.. nē nokkaḍa..
mahilō saṃsārapu sāmrājya mēlēvāḍa nēnu;
ihamuna karmavahi kekkiti nēnu;
bahu yōnikūpasampada dēlēvāḍa nēnu;
vahiñcuka nāvaṇṭi vāni dē nōpēnā?.. nē nokkaḍa..
bhāviñci nāvaṇṭi nīcu baṭṭi kācinappuḍugā
ēvaṅka nīkīrti kaḍu nenturu bhuvi;
nāvalla nīku puṇyamu, nīvalla nē bradukudu,
śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍa! iṃta cēre summī mēlu. ..nē nokkaḍa..
If I were not to exist, what would be the object of Your grace?
It is because of me, You attain fame!!
Amongst the highly ignorant, I am the first and foremost
I am a matchless mountain of excessive pride
I am affluent with the wealth of the five senses
Is it right then to let go of one like me?
On this earth, I am the one who reigns over the kingdom called Samsara
Here I am bound by the debts of Karma
I am one who goes through the births, born of many wombs
Will You not bear with a worthy one like me?
Only upon gracing a sinner like me,
on this earth, You will attain fame!
Because of me You will earn merit, because of You I will survive
SreeVenkatesha! Like this we are mutually benefited!!
276277

item.title: १३३ नीवे नेरवु गानि
item.description:
Nīvē Nēravu Gāni
नीवे नेरवु गानि, निन्नु पण्डिञ्चेमु नेमु.
दैवमा! नीकण्टॆ नी दासुले नेर्परुलु!॥ नीवे ॥
वट्टि भक्ति नीमीद वळुकु वेसि निन्नु
पट्टि तॆच्चि मदिलोन पॆट्टुकॊण्टिमि;
पुट्टॆडु तुलसि नी पादमुलपै पॆट्टि
जट्टिकॊनिरि मोक्षमु, जाणलु नी दासुलु!॥ नीवे ॥
नीवु निर्मिञ्चिनवॆ नीके समर्पण सेसि,
सोवल नीकृप यॆल्ल चूरगॊण्टिमि;
भाविं चॊक म्रॊक्कु म्रॊक्कि भारमु नीपै वेसिरि,
पावनपु नी दासुले पन्तपु चतुरुलु!॥ नीवे ॥
चॆरुवुल नीळ्ळु तॆच्चि चेरॆडु नीपै चल्लि,
वरमु वडसितिमि वलसिनट्टु;
इरवै श्रीवेङ्कटेश! इटुवण्टि विद्यलने
दरि चेरि मिञ्चिरि, नी दासुले पो घनुलु!॥ नीवे ॥
nīvē nēravu gāni, ninnu paṇḍiñcēmu nēmu.
daivamā! nīkaṇṭe nī dāsulē nērparulu!.. nīvē ..
vaṭṭi bhakti nīmīda vaḷuku vēsi ninnu
paṭṭi tecci madilōna peṭṭukoṇṭimi;
puṭṭeḍu tulasi nī pādamulapai peṭṭi
jaṭṭikoniri mōkṣamu, jāṇalu nī dāsulu!.. nīvē ..
nīvu nirmiñcinave nīkē samarpaṇa sēsi,
sōvala nīkṛpa yella cūragoṇṭimi;
bhāviṃ coka mrokku mrokki bhāramu nīpai vēsiri,
pāvanapu nī dāsulē pantapu caturulu!.. nīvē ..
ceruvula nīḷḷu tecci cēreḍu nīpai calli,
varamu vaḍasitimi valasinaṭṭu;
iravai śrīvēṅkaṭēśa! iṭuvaṇṭi vidyalanē
dari cēri miñciri, nī dāsulē pō ghanulu!.. nīvē ..
You do not know of it! We reap rich harvests out of You!
O Lord! Your devotees are more tactful than You!
We enchanted You with our mere devotion
caught hold of You and placed You within our hearts
Placing but a small measure of Tulasi at Your feet
we buy Moksha! So clever are Your devotees!
That which You alone created, offering the same unto You
easily we stole all Your limitless grace!
Merely bowing down in salutations just once, we place all our burdens upon You
Your pious devotees are obstinately cleverer!
Fetching water from the river, sprinkling a fistful on You
we get whatever we seek!
SreeVenkatesha! In these kind of arts, we excel!
Your devotees are truly great!!
278279

item.title: १३४ नारायणाच्युतानन्त
item.description:
Nārāyaṇācyutānanta
नारायणाच्यु तानन्त गोविन्दा
नेररादु विज्ञानमु नी विय्यक लेदु ॥॥ नारायणा ॥
निगमान्तविदुलैते निन्नॆऱुगुदुरुगाक
मृगसमानुलकेल मीमीदि भक्ति
वॆगटुगा गृपतोड विश्वरूपु चूपिनावु
पगटुदुर्योधनुडु बहुरूप मनडा ॥॥नारायणा ॥
चिरपुण्युलैते मीसेवलु सेतुरुगाक
दुरितचित्तुलकु मीत्रोव येटिकि
गरिम ब्रत्यक्षमै कम्बमुलो गलिगिना
हिरण्यकशिपुडु मि म्मॆञ्चि शरणनॆना ॥॥नारायणा ॥
देवतलयिते मिम्मु दॆलियनेर्तुरुगाक
येवल नसुरलु मिम्मॆऱिगेरा
श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रिमीद सिरितो नी वुण्डगानु
केवलसंसारु लॆऱिगियनु मऱवरा ॥॥ नारायणा ॥
nārāyaṇācyu tānanta gōvindā
nērarādu vijñānamu nī viyyaka lēdu ..nārāyaṇā ..
nigamāntavidulaitē ninneṟugudurugāka
mṛgasamānulakēla mīmīdi bhakti
vegaṭugā gṛpatōḍa viśvarūpu cūpināvu
pagaṭuduryōdhanuḍu bahurūpa manaḍā .. nārāyaṇā..
cirapuṇyulaitē mīsēvalu sēturugāka
duritacittulaku mītrōva yēṭiki
garima bratyakṣamai kambamulō galiginā
hiraṇyakaśipuḍu mi mmeñci śaraṇanenā .. nārāyaṇā ..
dēvatalayitē mimmu deliyanērturugāka
yēvala nasuralu mimmeṟigērā
śrīvēṅkaṭādrimīda siritō nī vuṇḍagānu
kēvalasaṃsāru leṟigiyunu maṟavarā .. .. nārāyaṇā ..
Narayana! Achyutha! Anantha! Govinda!
Do not find fault! The special knowledge will not come if You do not bestow!
The knowers of the Vedas, they will be knowing You
those who are like animals, why do they need Bhakti for You?
Out of compassion, You showed the Divine form
but Duryodhana proclaimed it as various ordinary forms!!
The eternally meritorious ones will offer their servitude
The evil minded, why do they need Your path?
Even when from the pillar You emerged gloriously
did Hiranyakashupu accept and surrender to You??
The Demigods know and comprehend You
How can the Asuras ever understand You?
(So too) On SreeVenkatadri, though You are there with Sree
the mere householders, even upon knowing You, will they not forget??
The message is that unless God bestows His grace, one will not be devoted to God.
280281

item.title: १३५ ऎन्त चदिवि चूचिन
item.description:
Eṃta Cadivi Cūcina
ऎन्त चदिवि चूचिन नीतडे घनमुगाक
यिन्तय नेलेटिदैव मिक वेरे कलरा ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
मॊदल जगमुलकु मूलमैनवाडु
तुद ब्रळयमुनाडु तोचेवाडु
कदिसि नडुम निण्डि कलिगिवुण्डॆडिवाडु
मदनगुरुडेकाक मऱि वेरे कलरा ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
परमाणुवैनवाडु ब्रह्माण्डमैनवाडु
सुरलकु नरुलकु जोटयिनवाडु
परमैनवाडु प्रपञ्चमैनवाडु
हरि यॆक्कडेकाक अव्वलनु गलरा ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
पुट्टुगुलयिनवाडु भोगमोक्षालैनवाडु
यॆट्टनॆदुर लोननु यिन्निटिवाडु
गट्टगा श्रीवेङ्कटद्रि कमलादेवितोडि -
पट्टपुदेवुडेकाक परुलिकगलरा ॥॥ ऎन्त ॥
eṃta cadivi cūcina nītaḍē ghanamugāka
yintayu nēlēṭidaiva mika vērē kalarā …. eṃta ..
modala jagamulaku mūlamainavāḍu
tuda braḷayamunāḍu tōcēvāḍu
kadisi naḍuma niṇḍi kaligivuṇḍeḍivāḍu
madanaguruḍēkāka maṟi vērē kalarā …. eṃta ..
paramāṇuvainavāḍu brahmāṇḍamainavāḍu
suralaku narulaku jōṭayinavāḍu
paramainavāḍu prapañcamainavāḍu
hari yokkaḍēkāka avvalanu galarā …. eṃta ..
puṭṭugulayinavāḍu bhōgamōkṣālainavāḍu
yeṭṭanedura lōnanu yinniṭivāḍu
gaṭṭagā śrīvēṅkaṭadri kamalādēvitōḍi -
paṭṭapudēvuḍēkāka parulikagalarā …. eṃta ..
How much ever one studies and examines, isn’t He the greatest?
To rule over everything, can there be any other God?
Even for the first worlds, the one who is the origin
At the end, during the apocalypse, the one who will still be seen
In between also, the one who pervades and rules over
The father of Madana1 is the one, who else can be?!
The one who is supremely subtle, the one who is the Universe itself
The one who is the abode of all Gods and humans
The Supreme one, who is but the world itself
Hari alone is the one, can there be any other?!
The one who is the cause of birth, the one who bestows prosperity and Moksha
The one who is in front and also within, the Lord of all!
Firmly upon SreeVenkatadri, along with Kamala-Devi2
the royal deity is He, can others ever be?!
1.Lord Vishnu is the father of Madana (Manmatha)
2.Godess Lakshmi
282283

item.title: १३६ कोरि माभुजमुल
item.description:
Kōri Mābhujamula
कोरि माभुजमुल डागुलु मोचुकुन्नारमु
धारुणिलोपल मम्मु दयजाचुगाक ॥॥ कोरि ॥
सततमु हरिचेतिशङ्खचक्रमुले
गतियै मापालनुण्डि काचुगाक
अतिरयमैनट्टि अच्युतुनि आयधाले
हितवुग मम्मु निट्टॆ येलुगाक गाक ॥॥ कोरि ॥
कमलापति चेतुलगदापद्ममुलु
ममकारमुतो ममु मन्निञ्चुगाक
समरविजयमैन शार्ज्गादिशरमुलु
तमितोड माकु दापुदण्डै वुण्डुगाक गाक ॥॥ कोरि ॥
मुञ्चि श्रीवेङ्कटेशुडु मॊलगट्टिनकठारु
अञ्चॆल माकॆल्ल रक्षै अमरुगाक
अञ्च नीतनिकै दुवुलमरिनहस्तमुलु
पञ्चल माकिट्टॆ वज्रपञ्जरालवुगाक गाक ॥॥ कोरि ॥
kōri mābhujamula ḍāgulu mōcukunnāramu
dhāruṇilōpala mammu dayajūcugāka …. kōri ..
satatamu haricētiśaṅkhacakramulē
gatiyai māpālanuṇḍi kācugāka
atirayamainaṭṭi acyutuni āyudhālē
hitavuga mammu niṭṭe yēlugāka gāka …. kōri ..
kamalāpati cētulagadāpadmamulu
mamakāramutō mamu manniñcugāka
samaravijayamaina śārjgādiśaramulu
tamitōḍa māku dāpudaṇḍai vuṇḍugāka gāka …. kōri ..
muñci śrīvēṅkaṭēśuḍu molagaṭṭinakaṭhāru
aṃcela mākella rakṣai amarugāka
aṃca nītanikai duvulamarinahastamulu
pañcala mākiṭṭe vajrapañjarālavugāka gāka …. kōri ..
We are those who have yearned for, and have worn the impressions on our shoulders1
May mercy be showered upon us, on this earth!
Eternally the Shanka-Chakra in Hari’s hands,
being our only means, may they be by our side and protect us!
The speedy weapons of Achyutha,
may they benevolently rule over us!
The mace and lotus in Kamala-Pathi’s hands
affectionately, may they bless us!
The bow Sharga and others which are ever victorious in battle
may they readily protect us closely!
The dagger that SreeVenkateshwara has tied upon His waist,
may all these weapons protect all of us closely!
Those adorable hands of His which are adorned by these weapons
may they closely surround us like diamond cages!!
1.Refers to the wearing of the marks of the Conch and Discus upon the
shoulders, signifying that one is a devotee of Vishnu.
284285

item.title: १३७ ध्रुववरदा संस्तुतवरदा
item.description:
Dhruvavaradā Saṃstutavaradā
ध्रुववरदा संस्तुतवरदा
नवमैनयार्तुनि नन्नु गाववे ॥॥ ध्रुव ॥
करिराजवरदा काकासुरवरदा
शरणागतविभीषणवरदा
सिरुल वेदालु निन्नु जॆप्पगा विनीनि
मरिगि मऱगुचॊच्चे मम्मु गाववे ॥॥ ध्रुव ॥
अक्रूरवरदा अम्बरीषवरदा
शत्रादिदिविजनिचयवरदा
विक्रमिञ्चि यिन्निटा नीवे घनमनि नीकु
चक्रधर शरणण्टि सरि गाववे ॥॥ ध्रुव ॥
द्रौपदीवरदा तग नर्जुनवरदा
श्रीपति प्रह्लादशिशुवरदा
येपुन श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रि निटु नेनु नागुरुडु
चूपगा गॊलिचे नच्चुग गाववे ॥॥ ध्रुव ॥
dhruvavaradā saṃstutavaradā
navamainayārtuni nannu gāvavē …. dhruva ..
karirājavaradā kākāsuravaradā
śaraṇāgatavibhīṣaṇavaradā
sirula vēdālu ninnu jeppagā vinīni
marigi maṟagucoccē mammu gāvavē …. dhruva ..
akrūravaradā aṃbarīṣavaradā
śatrādidivijanicayavaradā
vikramiñci yinniṭā nīvē ghanamani nīku
cakradhara śaraṇaṇṭi sari gāvavē …. dhruva ..
draupadīvaradā taga narjunavaradā
śrīpati prahlādaśiśuvaradā
yēpuna śrīvēṅkaṭādri niṭu nēnu nāguruḍu
cūpagā golicē naccuga gāvavē …. dhruva ..
O one who blessed Dhruva! O protector of those who praise You!
The distressed one now is me, do protect!
O savior of the elephant! O one who blessed Kaakasura!
O one who blessed Vibheeshana, who had surrendered
The priceless Vedas- as they praise You, listening to them
we seek your refuge, do protect us!
O one who blessed Akrura! O one who protected Ambareesha!
O one who blessed Indra and other divinities!
Comprehending Your valor and greatness amongst all others
O one who wields the Chakra weapon, I surrender unto You, do protect me!
O protector of Draupadi! O one who blessed Arjuna!
O Lord of Sree, who protected the child Prahalada
The pristine SreeVenkatadri Hill, as to me my Guru showed
I worshipped! Pleasingly do protect me!!
286287

item.title: १३८ इट्टिजीवुलकिङ्कनेदि
item.description:
Iṭṭijīvulakiṅkanēdi
इट्टि जीवुल किङ्क नेदि वाटि
दट्टमै देवुड नीवे दयजातुगाका ॥॥ इट्टि ॥
तनजन्मविदु(धु?) लनु दलचु नॊक्कॊकवेळ
वॊनर मऱचु नट्टॆ वॊक्कॊकवेळ
विनु बुराणकथलु विवरिञ्चि यॆकवेळ
पॆनचि सन्देहमुलॆ पॆञ्चु नॊकवेळ ॥॥ इट्टि ॥
विसिगि संसारमन्दु विरतुडौ नॊकवेळ
वॊसगि यन्दॆ मत्तुडौ नॊकवेळ
पसिगॊनि यिन्द्रियालबण्टै वुण्डु नॊकवेळ
मुसिपितो दैवानकु मॊक्कु नॊक्कवेळ ॥॥ इट्टि ॥
कोरि तपमुलु चेसि गुणिЕौ ता नॊकवेळ
वूरके अलसिवुण्डु नॊक्कवेळ
यीरीति श्रीवेङ्कटेश यॆदलो नी वुण्डगानु
बीरान नीके मॊऱवॆट्टु नॊकवेळ ॥॥ इट्टि ॥
iṭṭi jīvula kiṅka nēdi vāṭi
daṭṭamai dēvuḍa nīvē dayajūtugākā …. iṭṭi ..
tanajanmavidu(dhu?) lanu dalacu nokkokavēḷa
vonara maṟacu naṭṭe vokkokavēḷa
vinu burāṇakathalu vivariñci yokavēḷa
penaci sandēhamule peñcu nokavēḷa …. iṭṭi ..
visigi saṃsāramandu viratuḍau nokavēḷa
vosagi yande mattuḍau nokavēḷa
pasigoni yindriyālabaṇṭai vuṇḍu nokavēḷa
musipitō daivānaku mokku nokkavēḷa …. iṭṭi ..
kōri tapamulu cēsi guṇiyau tā nokavēḷa
vūrakē alasivuṇḍu nokkavēḷa
yīrīti śrīvēṅkaṭēśa yedalō nī vuṇḍagānu
bīrāna nīkē moṟaveṭṭu nokavēḷa …. iṭṭi ..
For these kind of Jivas, where is the steadiness?
Until You, O Lord, bestow Your grace abundantly!
Thinking about one’s life duties at times
Quickly forgetting the same at other times!
Ardently listening to the Puranic stores at times
Nurturing only doubts (in the mind) at other times!
Having become vexed with Samsara, attaining dispassion at times
Becoming intoxicated by the same at other times!
Getting attracted and becoming a slave of the senses at times
Becoming fatigued and bowing down to the Lord at other times!
Wishfully engaging in penance and becoming good natured at times
Becoming indolent at other times!
O Venkatesha, even when You reside within the heart
feebly, unto You, we plead only at times!!
288289

item.title: १३९ सकलबलम्बुलु नीवे
item.description:
Sakalabalambulu Nīvē
सकलबलम्बुलु नीवे सर्वेश्वर नाकु
अकलङ्कम्बगुसुखमे अन्निट निदे नाकु ॥॥ सकल ॥
पॊन्दुग जक्राङ्कितमे बुजबल मिदॆ नाकु
अन्दिनहरि नीचिन्ते आत्मबलमु नाकु
सन्दडि बेरुबलमु केशवनाममु नाकु
यिन्दुनु नन्दुनु भवभय मिक ले दिदे नाकु नाकु ॥॥ सकल ॥
अङ्गपुदिरुमणु लिवि पञ्चाङ्गबलमु नाकु
सङ्गति नीपै पाटलॆ स्वरबलि मिदे नाकु
रङ्गुग नी गुणरासुले रासिबलमु नाकु
यिङ्गितमुग निहपरमुल कॆदुरे दिदे नाकु ॥॥ सकल ॥
कनुगॊनु नीविग्रहमे ग्रहबलि मिदॆ नाकु
विनु नीदासुलसेवे वॆनुबलि मिदॆ नाकु
तनरिन श्रीवेङ्कटपति दैवबलमु नाकु
घनमे चॆप्पग निन्तट गलिगॆबो यिदे नाकु ॥॥ सकल ॥
sakalabalambulu nīvē sarvēśvara nāku
akalaṅkambagusukhamē anniṭa nidē nāku .. sakala ..
ponduga jakrāṅkitamē bujabala mide nāku
aṃdinahari nīcintē ātmabalamu nāku
sandaḍi bērubalamu kēśavanāmamu nāku
yindunu nandunu bhavabhaya mika lē didē nāku nāku.. sakala
aṃgapudirumaṇu livi pañcāṅgabalamu nāku
saṅgati nīpai pāṭale svarabali midē nāku
raṅguga nī guṇarāsulē rāsibalamu nāku
yiṅgitamuga nihaparamula kedurē didē nāku .. sakala ..
kanugonu nīvigrahamē grahabali mide nāku
vinu nīdāsulasēvē venubali mide nāku
tanarina śrīvēṅkaṭapati daivabalamu nāku
ghanamē ceppaga nintaṭa galigebō yidē nāku .. sakala ..
You alone are the all round strength for me, O Lord of all!
The pristine joy is only this, for me!
The beautiful mark of the Chakra is the ‘Bhuja-bala’1 for me
O Hari! Your thoughts alone are the ‘Atma-bala’2 for me
Joyously, Keshava’s name alone is the ‘root-strength’ for me
Now and hereafter, the fear of Samsara is never there for me!!
On the body, the marks of the Tiruman alone are the ‘Panchanga-balamu’3 for me
Songs on You are the ‘voice strength’ for me
The effulgence of Your abundant qualities alone are the ‘Rasi-balamu’4 for me
For this reason, ‘here’ and ‘hereafter’, where are any obstacles for me?!
Beholding Your Vigraham5 alone is the ‘Graha-bala’6 for me
Servitude to Your daasas is the ‘back-bone strength’ for me
The ever exalted SreeVenkatapathi is the ‘Daiva-balamu’7 for me
To be able to say all this, is a great privilege for me!!
1.Arm strength
2.Soul strength
3.Strength of the five sense organs
4.Strength of Astrological signs
5.Worshippable form
6.Planetary strength
7.Divine strength
290291

item.title: १४० निर्मलुलु वीरु
item.description:
Nirmalulu Vīru
निर्मलुलु वीरु नित्यसुखुलु
कर्मदूरुलु विष्णुकैङ्कर्यपरुलु ॥॥ निर्मलुलु ॥
परमज्ञानसम्पन्नुलगु वारिकिनि
अरुदुगा दिचटिमहादैश्वर्यमु
हरिकृपाधनमु चेनब्बिन महात्मुलकु
सरकुगाकुण्डु पञ्चल निधानमुलु ॥॥ निर्मलुलु ॥
बलिमिनि वेदान्तपट्टभद्रुलकु निल
बलुराज्यपदवु लिरुगडबण्ट्लु
ललिमीरि हरिचक्रलाञ्छनपु शूरुलकु
यॆलमि विजयमुलॆल्ल निण्टिलो नुण्डु ॥॥ निर्मलुलु ॥
यीवलनु श्रीवेङ्कटेशुशरणागतुल-
कावटिञ्चिन पुण्य मडुवुगादु
दैवज्ञुलयिन या धर्मस्वरूपुलकु
वेवेलु भोगमुलु वॆनुतगुलुचुण्डु ॥॥ निर्मलुलु ॥
nirmalulu vīru nityasukhulu
karmadūrulu viṣṇukaiṅkaryaparulu …. nirmalulu ..
paramajñānasampannulagu vārikini
arudugā dicaṭimahādaiśvaryamu
harikṛpādhanamu cēnabbina mahātmulaku
sarakugākuṇḍu pañcala nidhānamulu …. nirmalulu ..
balimini vēdāntapaṭṭabhadrulaku nila
balurājyapadavu lirugaḍabaṇṭlu
lalimīri haricakralāñchanapu śūrulaku
yelami vijayamulella niṇṭilō nuṇḍu …. nirmalulu ..
yīvalanu śrīvēṅkaṭēśuśaraṇāgatula-
kāvaṭiñcina puṇya maḍuvugādu
daivajñulayina yā dharmasvarūpulaku
vēvēlu bhōgamulu venutagulucuṇḍu …. nirmalulu ..
Pure are these people, eternally joyful!
Unbounded by karmas are those who offer ‘Kainkaryam’1 to Vishnu!
For them who are endowed with ‘Parama-Jnana’2
it is not rare to find here the supreme wealth!
Those great beings who are blessed with the wealth of Hari’s grace
they do not care for the available material wealth!
Those resolute ones who are learned in Vedanta
take the many Kingly posts to be nothing but shackles!
To those great ones who wear the marks of Hari’s Chakra3 with exceeding joy
all victories remain happily in their houses!
Here Sharanagathas who have surrendered unto SreeVenkatesha
the merits they have earned can never be destroyed!
For those embodiments of Dharma who are divine
thousands of comforts will closely follow!!
The message is that those who offer servitude to Lord Vishnu and perform Sharanagati unto
Him, they are blessed with all prosperity, they alone are divine!
1.Servitude
2.Supreme knowledge
3.Wearing of the permanent marks of the Conch and Discus (mudras)
292293

item.title: १४१ अतिसुलभम्बिदॆ श्रीपति
item.description:
Atisulabhambide Śrīpati
अतिसुलभं बिदॆ श्रीपति शरणमु अन्दुकु नारदादुलु साक्षि
प्रतिले दिदिये नित्यानन्दमु बहुवेदम्बुलॆ यिवे साक्षि ॥॥ अति ॥
वेसरकुमी जीवुडा वॆदकि वॆदकि दैवमुनु
आसनपाटुगा हरि यन्नाडिदॆ अन्दुकु ब्रह्लादुडु साक्षि
मोसपोकुमी जन्ममा मुञ्चिनयनुमानमुलनु
सेसिन भक्तिकि जेटु लेदु यी नेत कॆल्ल ध्रुवुडे साक्षि ॥॥ अति ॥
तमकिञ्चकुमी देहमा तगुसुखदुःखम्बुल नलसि
अमितमु नरहरिकरुण नम्मिते नन्दुकु नर्जनुडे साक्षि
भ्रमयकुमी विवेकमा बहुकालम्बुलु यीदीदि
तमितो दास्यमु तनु रक्षिञ्चुनु दानिकि बलीन्द्रुडे साक्षि ॥॥ अति ॥
मरिगिवुण्डुमी वोजिह्व मरि श्रीवेङ्कटपतिनुतुलु
अरयग निदिये यीडेरिञ्चुनु आन्दुकु व्यासादुलॆ साक्षि
तिरगकुमी विज्ञानमा द्रिष्टपुमायलकेनु लोगि
सरिले दितनिपादसेवकुनु सनकादुलब्रदुके साक्षि ॥॥ अति ॥
atisulabhaṃ bide śrīpati śaraṇamu aṃduku nāradādulu sākṣi
pratilē didiyē nityānandamu bahuvēdambule yivē sākṣi .. ati ..
vēsarakumī jīvuḍā vedaki vedaki daivamunu
āsanapāṭugā hari yunnāḍide aṃduku brahlāduḍu sākṣi
mōsapōkumī janmamā muñcinayanumānamulanu
sēsina bhaktiki jēṭu lēdu yī nēta kella dhruvuḍē sākṣi.. ati ..
tamakiñcakumī dēhamā tagusukhaduḥkhambula nalasi
amitamu naraharikaruṇa nammitē nanduku narjanuḍē sākṣi
bhramayakumī vivēkamā bahukālambulu yīdīdi
tamitō dāsyamu tanu rakṣiñcunu dāniki balīndruḍē sākṣi .. ..ati ..
marigivuṇḍumī vōjihva mari śrīvēṅkaṭapatinutulu
arayaga nidiyē yīḍēriñcunu āṃduku vyāsādule sākṣi
tiragakumī vijñānamā driṣṭapumāyalakēnu lōgi
sarilē ditanipādasēvakunu sanakādulabradukē sākṣi .. .. ati ..
This is the most easy- Surrender unto SreePathi! For this Narada and others are the proof!
This alone is matchless, the eternally blissful! For this, the Vedas are the proof!
O Jiva, do not fret constantly searching for the lord,
Hari is there to be desired! For this, Prahalada is the proof!
O life, do not be fooled by the overpowering doubts,
Devotion never goes wasteful! For this, Dhruva alone is the proof!
Do not be in a haste, O body, getting fatigued by pleasures and sorrows,
Limitless is Nara-Hari’s compassion, if you believe! For this, Arjuna is the proof!
O intellect, do not be deluded, swimming constantly through the many births,
Eagerly if one offers servitude, He protects! For this, king Bali is the proof!
O tongue, do get addicted to the praises of SreeVenkatapathi,
Totally, this alone will fulfill! For this, Vyasa and others are the proof!
O knowledge, do not get misled by the ‘Maaya’,
Serving ‘His’ feet is alone matchless! For this, the life of Sanaka and others is the proof!
294295

item.title: १४२ विडुवरा दॆन्तैना
item.description:
Viḍuvarā Dentainā
विडुवरा दॆन्तैना वॆऱ्ऱिवाडनैन नीकु
कडवारु नव्वकण्डा गाचुको नन्नुनु ॥॥ विडुवरा ॥
ज्ञानमु नेनॆऱग नज्ञानमु ने नॆऱगनु
माननु विषयमुलु मरिगॆन्तैना
नीनाममु नॊडिगि नीदासुड ननुकॊन्दु
दीनिके वहिञ्चुकॊनि तिद्दुको नन्नुनु ॥॥ विडुवरा ॥
अकर्ममु नॆऱगनु सुकर्ममु नॆऱगनु
प्रकटसंसारमुपै पाटु माननु
वॊकपनिवाडनै वूनि मुद्रधारिनैति
मॊकमोडि यिन्दुके गोमुन नेलु नन्नुनु ॥॥ विडुवरा ॥
वॆनक गाननु मुन्दु विचारिञ्चि काननु
निनुपै देहधारिनै नीकु मॊक्केनु
घनुड श्रीवेङ्कटेश कन्नुलॆदुट बडिति
कनि पोविडुवरादु करुणिञ्चु नन्नुनु ॥॥ विडुवरा ॥
viḍuvarā dentainā veṟṟivāḍanaina nīku
kaḍavāru navvakaṇḍā gācukō nannunu …. viḍuvarā ..
jñānamu nēneṟaga najñānamu nē neṟaganu
mānanu viṣayamulu marigentainā
nīnāmamu noḍigi nīdāsuḍa nanukondu
dīnikē vahiñcukoni tiddukō nannunu …. viḍuvarā ..
akarmamu neṟaganu sukarmamu neṟaganu
prakaṭasaṃsāramupai pāṭu mānanu
vokapanivāḍanai vūni mudradhārinaiti
mokamōḍi yindukē gōmuna nēlu nannunu ..viḍuvarā ..
venaka gānanu mundu vicāriñci kānanu
ninupai dēhadhārinai nīku mokkēnu
ghanuḍa śrīvēṅkaṭēśa kannuleduṭa baḍiti
kani pōviḍuvarādu karuṇiñcu nannunu ..viḍuvarā ..
Do not let go of me whatever it may be, I am madly devoted to You
Lest others laugh at me, do protect me!
I do not know what knowledge is, what ignorance is
I never let go of the material things, having become addicted to them
But chanting Your name, I consider myself as Your Dasa
For this reason, bearing with me, do correct my ways!
I do not know of inaction, nor of right action
The struggles for samsara, I never let go
But with one reason I have worn the Mudras1
For this reason, do rule over me affectionately!
I do not think of the past, nor do I worry about the future
But bearing this body, I bow down to You
O magnanimous SreeVenkatesha! I stood before You
Having seen me, You should not let go! Do shower Your compassion!
1.The permanent marks of Shanka-Chakra worn on the shoulders.
296297

item.title: १४३ नाकुनन्दुकेमि वोदु नन्नु
item.description:
Nākunandukēmi Vōdu Nannu
नाकु नन्दु केमि वोदु नन्नु नीवेमि चूचेवु
नी करुण गलिगिते निञ्चि चूपवय्य ॥॥ नाकु ॥
फॆूरमैन देहपु दुर्गुणमेमि गलिगिन
अरसि ब्रकृतिबोयि अडुगवय्य
नेरनिनाजन्ममुतो (लो?) नेरुपेमिगल्ला नन्नु
धारुणि बुट्टिञ्चिनविधात नडुगवय्य ॥॥ नाकु ॥
पञ्चेन्द्रियमुललोनि पापमेमि गलिगिना
अञ्चॆलगामुनिबोयि अडुगवय्य
मुञ्चिननाकर्ममुलो मोसमेमि गलिगिना
मञ्चितनान जेयिञ्चेमाय नडुगवय्य ॥॥ नाकु ॥
अन्निटा ना वॆनकटि अपराध मेमिगल्ला
मन्निञ्चि नागुरुजाचि मानवय्य
मिन्नक श्री वेङ्कटेश मीदिपनुलेमिगल्ला
निन्नु जाचुकॊनि नन्नु नीवे येलवय्य ॥॥ नाकु ॥
nāku nandu kēmi vōdu nannu nīvēmi cūcēvu
nī karuṇa galigitē niñci cūpavayya …. nāku ..
ghōramaina dēhapu durguṇamēmi galigina
arasi brakṛtibōyi aḍugavayya
nēraninājanmamutō (lō?) nērupēmigallā nannu
dhāruṇi buṭṭiñcinavidhāta naḍugavayya …. nāku ..
pañcēndriyamulalōni pāpamēmi galiginā
aṃcelagāmunibōyi aḍugavayya
muñcinanākarmamulō mōsamēmi galiginā
mañcitanāna jēyiñcēmāya naḍugavayya …. nāku ..
anniṭā nā venakaṭi aparādha mēmigallā
manniñci nāgurujūci mānavayya
minnaka śrī vēṅkaṭēśa mīdipanulēmigallā
ninnu jūcukoni nannu nīvē yēlavayya …. nāku ..
None of these comes from me. Why do You look at me?
If You have compassion for me, do bestow it fully!
Whatever be the vices of this heinous body
do ask the ‘Prakriti’ about it!
The birth which I do not know about, if there are any virtues,
do ask the Creator who created me on this earth!
Whatever be the sins associated with the five sense organs,
do ask the handsome Kama Deva about it!
Whatever deceit exists in all my actions, do ask the ‘Maaya’
which lures us with seeming goodness, into committing them!
If there are any sins that I have committed in the past,
forgive me, and seeing my Guru, do pardon me fully!
Sree Venkatesha! Whatever be the deeds in future,
seeing Yourself (within me), do rule over me!!
298299

item.title: १४४ इविसेयग ने नलसुड
item.description:
Ivisēyaga Nē Nalasuḍa
इवि सेयग ने नलसुड यॆटुवलॆ मोक्षं बडिगॆदनु
विवरमुतोडुत नीवु सुलभुडवु विष्णुड निन्ने कॊलिचॆदगाक ॥॥ इवि ॥
जपयज्ञ दानकर्मम्बुलु यॆञ्चग जिरकालफलम्बुलु
यॆपुडु बुण्यतीर्थस्नानमुलु यिल पापविमोचनमुलु
अपरिमित देवतान्तरभजनलु आयालोकप्राप्तुलु
वुपवासादिनियमव्रतमुलु तपोनिष्ठकु गारणम्बुलु ॥॥ इवि ॥
रविचन्द्रग्रहताराबलमुलु भुविलो गाम्यफलमुलु
तविलिनपञ्चेन्द्रियनिग्रहम्बुलु तनुधरुलकु दुर्लभमुलु
अविरळधर्मार्थकामम्बुलु मऱियैश्वर्यमुलकु मूलमुलु
अवलग्रहणकालानुष्ठानमु लधिकफलम्बुलु आशामयमु ॥॥ इवि ॥
परग सप्तसन्तानब्राह्मणतर्पणमुलु ख्यातिसुकृतमुलु
अरय बुत्रदार क्षेत्रसङ्ग्रह मन्दरिकिनि संसारभोगमु
हरि नरहरि श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरा अखिलमु नॊसगॆडि दातवु
सरुगन नीवे दयतो रक्षिञ्चजालुदु वेकालमुनु मम्मुनु ॥॥ इवि ॥
ivi sēyaga nē nalasuḍa yeṭuvale mōkṣaṃ baḍigedanu
vivaramutōḍuta nīvu sulabhuḍavu viṣṇuḍa ninnē kolicedagāka. ivi
japayajña dānakarmambulu yeñcaga jirakālaphalambulu
yepuḍu buṇyatīrthasnānamulu yila pāpavimōcanamulu
aparimita dēvatāntarabhajanalu āyālōkaprāptulu
vupavāsādiniyamavratamulu tapōniṣṭhaku gāraṇambulu. ivi
ravicandragrahatārābalamulu bhuvilō gāmyaphalamulu
tavilinapañcēndriyanigrahambulu tanudharulaku durlabhamulu
aviraḷadharmārthakāmambulu maṟiyaiśvaryamulaku mūlamulu
avalagrahaṇakālānuṣṭhānamu ladhikaphalambulu āśāmayamu. ivi
paraga saptasantānabrāhmaṇatarpaṇamulu khyātisukṛtamulu
araya butradāra kṣētrasaṅgraha mandarikini saṃsārabhōgamu
hari narahari śrīvēṅkaṭēśvarā akhilamu nosageḍi dātavu
sarugana nīvē dayatō rakṣiñcajāludu vēkālamunu mammunu. ivi
To do all these, I am very indolent! How can I even seek moksha?
But, since You are the easily attainable one, O Vishnu, I worship You alone!
Japa, Yagna, Daana1, if rightly appraised, give eternal fruits
Bathing in sacred teerthas frees one of all sins
By unending worship of various Gods, one attains the respective worlds
Fasting and other such austere practices are the cause of devout penance
The effects of the sun, moon, planets, stars, bestow the object of desire upon this earth
Trying to control the five senses, for one with a physical body, is very difficult
Constantly engaging in Dharma, Artha, Kaama2, is the means for material wealth
Performing the rituals during the eclipses bestow fruits born of desires
Offering ‘Tarpanas’ to Brahmanas bestows fame and fortune
Becoming attracted to children, wife, lands, is for everyone the pleasure of samsara
Hari! Nara-Hari! SreeVenkateshwara! You alone bestow everything!
Out of compassion, You should protect us at all times!
The purport is that Surrendering unto Sree Venkatesha will easily bestow all fruits that are
obtained by various other means which are stringent and difficult.
1.Japa is meditation, Yagna is sacrifice, Daana is charity
2.Dharma is righteousness, Artha is material wealth, Kaama is desire
300301

item.title: १४५ अतडे परब्रह्ममतडे
item.description:
Ataḍē Parabrahmamataḍē
अतडे परब्रह्ममतडे लोकनायकुडु
अतनि कण्टे मरि अधिकुलु वेरय्या ॥॥ अतडे ॥
कमलवासिनि लक्ष्मि कलदा यॆव्वरिकैना
कमलनाभुनि ऒक्कनिके काक
कमलुजुडैन ब्रह्म कलडा यॆव्वनि नाभि -
नमर वन्द्युडु मा हरिकेकाक ॥॥ अतडे ॥
अन्दरु नुण्डॆडि भूमि अन्युलकु गलदा
अन्दपु गोविन्दुनिके आलायगाक
चॆन्दिन भागीरथी श्रीपादाल गलदा
मन्दर धरुडयिन माधवुनिकि गाक ॥॥ अतडे ॥
निच्चलु अभयमिच्चे नेरुपु यॆन्दुगलदा
अच्चुगा नारायणुनियन्देकाक
रच्चल शरणागतरक्षण मॆन्दु गलदा
तच्चिन श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि दैवानिकेकाक ॥॥ अतडे ॥
ataḍē parabrahmamataḍē lōkanāyakuḍu
atani kaṇṭē mari adhikulu vērayyā …. ataḍē ..
kamalavāsini lakṣmi kaladā yevvarikainā
kamalanābhuni okkanikē kāka
kamalujuḍaina brahma kalaḍā yevvani nābhi -
namara vandyuḍu mā harikēkāka …. ataḍē ..
aṃdaru nuṇḍeḍi bhūmi anyulaku galadā
aṃdapu gōvindunikē ālāyagāka
cendina bhāgīrathī śrīpādāla galadā
mandara dharuḍayina mādhavuniki gāka ..ataḍē ..
niccalu abhayamiccē nērupu yendugaladā
accugā nārāyaṇuniyandēkāka
raccala śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇa mendu galadā
taccina śrī vēṅkaṭādri daivānikēkāka .. ataḍē ..
He alone is the Parabrahman! The Lord of the worlds!
There is nobody greater than Him!
Lakshmi who resides in the lotus, is she there for anybody else
but for the lotus naveled Lord alone!
Brahma who is born of the lotus, is he in anybody else’s navel
but for our Hari, who is revered by all Gods!
The earth on which everybody exists, is she there for anybody else
but for the handsome Govinda, whose wife she is!
Is Bhageerathi at anybody else’s auspicious feet
but for Madhava, who is the one who held up the Mandara mountain!
Who else has the skill to bestow refuge at all times
but for Narayana, who possess it!
Where else is there protection for Sharanagathas
but with the Lord of SreeVenkatadri!
302303

item.title: १४६ इन्दिरारमणुदॆच्चियिय्यरो
item.description:
Iṃdirāramaṇudecciyiyyarō
इन्दिरारमणुदॆच्चि यिय्यरो माकिटुवलॆ
पॊन्दि यीतनि पूजिञ्च पॊद्दाय निपुडु ॥॥ इन्दिरा ॥
धारुणि मैरावणु दण्डिञ्चि रामुदॆच्चि
नेरुपुन मिञ्चिन अञ्जनीतनया
फॆूर नागपाशमुल कॊट्टिवेसि यीतनि
कारुण्य मन्दिनट्टि खगराज गरुडा ॥॥ इन्दिरा ॥
नानादेवतलकु नरसिंहु कम्भमुलो
पानिपट्टि चूपिनट्टि प्रह्लादुडा
मानवुडै (डौ?) कृष्णमहिमल विश्वरूपु
पूनि बण्डि नुञ्चुकॊन्न पोटुबण्टु अर्जुना ॥॥ इन्दिरा ॥
श्रीवल्लभुनकु अशेष कैङ्कर्यमुल
श्री वेङ्कटाद्रिवैन शेषमूरिती
कैवसमैनयट्टि कार्तवीर्यार्जुनुडा
देवुनि नीवेळ निट्टॆ तॆच्चि माकु निय्यरे ॥॥ इन्दिरा ॥
iṃdirāramaṇudecci yiyyarō mākiṭuvale
pondi yītani pūjiñca poddāya nipuḍu …. iṃdirā ..
dhāruṇi mairāvaṇu daṇḍiñci rāmudecci
nērupuna miñcina aṃjanītanayā
ghōra nāgapāśamula koṭṭivēsi yītani
kāruṇya mandinaṭṭi khagarāja garuḍā …. iṃdirā ..
nānādēvatalaku narasiṃhu kambhamulō
pānipaṭṭi cūpinaṭṭi prahlāduḍā
mānavuḍai (ḍau?) kṛṣṇamahimala viśvarūpu
pūni baṇḍi nuñcukonna pōṭubaṇṭu arjunā …. iṃdirā ..
śrīvallabhunaku aśēṣa kaiṅkaryamula
śrī vēṅkaṭādrivaina śēṣamūritī
kaivasamainayaṭṭi kārtavīryārjunuḍā
dēvuni nīvēḷa niṭṭe tecci māku niyyarē …. iṃdirā ..
Bring back and give me the Lord of Indira!
It is now time for me to worship Him.
Punishing Mairavana who was in the nether world and
bringing back Rama with expertise, you O son of Anjana!
Rescuing from the dangerous clutches of the snakes,
you who got the Lord blessing, O king of birds, Garuda!
Having shown to all Devas, the manifested form of
Lord Narasimha from the pillar, you O Prahalada!
You who could perceive the glorious Universal form of
Lord Krishna, O steadfast devotee Arjuna!
Performing endless servitude to the Lord of Sree,
by becoming the Venkatadri Hill, you O Lord Sesha!
O one with a thousand hands, Kartiviryarjuna!
At this moment you must bring back to us our Lord!!
304305

item.title: १४७ ई पादमे कदा यिलमॆल्ल
item.description:
Ī Pādamē Kadā Yilamella
ई पादमे कदा यिलमॆल्ल गॊलिचिनदि
ई पादमे कदा यिन्दिरा हस्तमुल कितवैनदि ॥॥ ई पादमे ॥
ई पादमे कदा इन्दरुनु म्रॊक्कॆडिदि
ई पादमे कदा यी गगनगङ्ग पुट्टिनदि
ई पादमे कदा यॆलमि पॆम्पॊन्दिनदि
ई पादमे कदा यिन्निटिकि यॆक्कुडैनदि ॥॥ ई पादमे ॥
ई पादमे कदा यिभराजु दलचिनदि
ई पादमे कदा यिन्द्रादुलॆल्ल वॆदकिनदि
ई पादमे कदा यी ब्रह्म कडिगिनदि
ई पादमे कदा यॆगसि ब्रह्माण्डमण्टिनदि ॥॥ ई पादमे ॥
ई पादमे कदा यिहपरमु लॊसगॆडिदि
ई पादमे कदा यिल नहल्यकु कोरिकैनदि
ई पादमे कदा यीक्षिम्प दुर्लभमु
ई पादमे कदा यी वेङ्कटाद्रिपै निरवैनदि ॥॥ ई पादमे ॥
ī pādamē kadā yilamella golicinadi
ī pādamē kadā yindirā hastamula kitavainadi ..ī pādamē
ī pādamē kadā iṃdarunu mrokkeḍidi
ī pādamē kadā yī gaganagaṅga puṭṭinadi
ī pādamē kadā yelami pempondinadi
ī pādamē kadā yinniṭiki yekkuḍainadi ..ī pādamē
ī pādamē kadā yibharāju dalacinadi
ī pādamē kadā yindrādulella vedakinadi
ī pādamē kadā yī brahma kaḍiginadi
ī pādamē kadā yegasi brahmāṇḍamaṇṭinadi ..ī pādamē
ī pādamē kadā yihaparamu losageḍidi
ī pādamē kadā yila nahalyaku kōrikainadi
ī pādamē kadā yīkṣimpa durlabhamu
ī pādamē kadā yī vēṅkaṭādripai niravainadi ..ī pādamē
This is the foot that measured the whole Universe,
These are the feet that befit the hands of Lakshmi!
These are the feet unto which everybody prostrates,
these are the feet from where Ganga took birth,
these are the feet that sustain the earth,
these are the feet that are higher than the highest!
These are the feet worshipped by the elephant King,
these are the feet sought by Indra and others,
these are feet that Brahma worshipped,
these are the feet that covered the entire Brahmanda!
These are the feet that bestow ‘here’ and ‘hereafter’
these are the feet that satisfied Ahalya’s wishes,
these are the feet which are difficult to behold,
these are the feet sanctifying Sree Venkatadri!
306307

item.title: १४८ ए कुलजुडेमि यॆव्वडैननेमि
item.description:
Ē Kulajuḍēmi Yevvaḍainanēmi
ए कुलजुडेमि यॆव्वडैननेमि
आकड नातडॆ हरिनॆऱिगिनवाडु जीवुडु ॥॥ ए कुलजु ॥
परगिन सत्यसम्पन्नुडैन वाडे
परनिन्दसेय तत्परुडु कानि वाडु
अरुदैन भूतदयानिधि यगुवाडे
परुलु तानेयनि भाविञ्चुवाडु ॥॥ ए कुलजु ॥
निर्मलुडै यात्मनियति गलुगुवाडे
धर्मतत्पर बुद्धि तगिलिनवाडु
कर्ममार्गमुलु कडवनिवाडे
मर्ममै हरिभक्ति मऱवनिवाडु ॥॥ ए कुलजु ॥
जगतिपै हितमुगा चरियिञ्चुवाडे
पगलेक मतिलोन ब्रदिकिनवाडु
तॆगि सकलमु नात्म तॆलिसिनवाडे
तगिलि वॆङ्कटेशु दासुडयिनवाडु ॥॥ ए कुलजु ॥
ē kulajuḍēmi yevvaḍainanēmi
ākaḍa nātaḍe harineṟiginavāḍu jīvuḍu …. ē kulaju ..
paragina satyasampannuḍaina vāḍē
paranindasēya tatparuḍu kāni vāḍu
arudaina bhūtadayānidhi yaguvāḍē
parulu tānēyani bhāviñcuvāḍu …. ē kulaju ..
nirmaluḍai yātmaniyati galuguvāḍē
dharmatatpara buddhi tagilinavāḍu
karmamārgamulu kaḍavanivāḍē
marmamai haribhakti maṟavanivāḍu …. ē kulaju ..
jagatipai hitamugā cariyiñcuvāḍē
pagalēka matilōna bradikinavāḍu
tegi sakalamu nātma telisinavāḍē
tagili veṅkaṭēśu dāsuḍayinavāḍu …. ē kulaju ..
To what caste one belongs, how does it matter? Whoever it is, how does it matter?
He should be the one who realized Hari!
(He should be…….)
The one who possess the treasure of Truth,
who does not engage in decrying others,
who has the unique quality of compassion for all living creatures,
who sees all others as himself!
The one who is pure and shows self restraint,
who remains steadfast to righteousness,
who never transgresses the path of Karma,
who never forgets profound devotion to Hari!
The one who lives in the world with benevolence,
who lives with a mind free from malice,
who knows everything as the ‘Self’,
who remains a steadfast servant of Sree Venkatesha!
308309

item.title: १४९ एमुको चिगुरटधरमुन
item.description:
Ēmukō Ciguraṭadharamuna
एमुको चिगुरटधरमुन यॆडनॆड कस्तुरिनिण्डॆनु
भामिनि विभुनकु व्रासिन पत्रिक कादु कदा ॥॥ एमुको ॥
कलिकि चकोराक्षिकि कडकन्नुलु कॆम्पै तोचिन
चॆलुवं बिप्पुडिदेमो चिन्तिम्परॆ चॆलुलु
नलुवुन प्राणेश्वरुपै नाटिन या कॊनचूपुलु
निलुवुन पॆरुकग नण्टिन नॆत्तुरु कादु कदा ॥॥ एमुको ॥
पडतिकि चनुगुव मॆऱुगुलु पैपै पय्यॆदवॆलुपल
कडु मिञ्चिन विधमेमो कनुगॊनरे चॆलुलु
उडुगनि वेडुकतो प्रियडॊत्तिन नखशशिरेखलु
वॆडलग वेसविकालपु वॆन्नॆल कादु कदा ॥॥ एमुको ॥
मुद्दिय चॆक्कुल कॆलकुल मुत्यपु जल्लुल चेर्पुल
वॊद्दिकलागु लिवेमो वूहिम्परे चॆलुलु
गद्दरि तिरुवेङ्कटपति कामिनि वदनाम्बुजमुन
अद्दिन सुरतपु चॆमटल आन्दमु कादु कदा ॥॥ एमुको ॥
ēmukō ciguraṭadharamuna yeḍaneḍa kasturiniṇḍenu
bhāmini vibhunaku vrāsina patrika kādu kadā ..ēmukō ..
kaliki cakōrākṣiki kaḍakannulu kempai tōcina
celuvaṃ bippuḍidēmō cintimpare celulu
naluvuna prāṇēśvarupai nāṭina yā konacūpulu
niluvuna perukaga naṇṭina netturu kādu kadā ..ēmukō ..
paḍatiki canuguva meṟugulu paipai payyedavelupala
kaḍu miñcina vidhamēmō kanugonarē celulu
uḍugani vēḍukatō priyuḍottina nakhaśaśirēkhalu
veḍalaga vēsavikālapu vennela kādu kadā ..ēmukō ..
muddiya cekkula kelakula mutyapu jallula cērpula
voddikalāgu livēmō vūhimparē celulu
gaddari tiruvēṅkaṭapati kāmini vadanāmbujamuna
addina suratapu cemaṭala āṃdamu kādu kadā ..ēmukō ..
Why on Her tender lips there is musk smudged all over?
Could it be a letter by this lady to Her divine lover ?
When the corners of Her chakora like eyes turn red as rubies,
Wonder how that beauty is? O Companions!
It may be, Her looks which penetrated deep into Her beloved
when forcefully drawn out, are blood-smeared.
When the beauty of Her breasts is growing beyond the veil
How is it so? You find out friends!
With unsated passion, Her Lord left crescent moon nail indent marks,
and it may be from them, the summer moon light is glowing!
When from the edges of this lovable lady’s cheeks there is this drizzle of pearls,
Wonder how it is? O Companions!
Tiru Venkatapathi in His amorous passion, must have smeared on Her lotus face,
the beauty of the sweat drops of love-making! Is it not?!
1.Chakora is a beautiful bird.
310311

item.title: १५० तन्दनान अहि तन्दनान पुरॆ
item.description:
Tandanāna Ahi Tandanāna Pure
तन्दनान अहितन्दनान पुरॆ
तन्दनान भळा तन्दनान
ब्रह्ममॊकटॆ परब्रह्ममॊकटॆ पर
ब्रह्ममॊकटॆ परब्रह्ममॊकटे
कन्दुवगु हीनाधिकमु लिन्दु लेवु
अन्दरिकि श्रीहरे अन्तरात्म
इन्दुलो जन्तुकुल मिन्ता नॊकटे
अन्दरिकि श्रीहरे अन्तरात्म
निण्डार राजु निद्रिञ्चु निद्रय नॊकटे
अण्डने बण्टुनिद्र अदिय नॊकटे
मॆण्डैन ब्राह्मणुडु मॆट्टुभूमि यॆकटे
चण्डालुडुण्डेटि सरिभूमि यॆकटॆ
अनुगु देवतलकुनु अलकाम सुखमॊकटे
घनकीट पशुवुलकु कामसुखमॊकटॆ
दिन महोरात्रमुलु तॆगि धनाढ्युन कॊकटे
वॊनर निरुबेदकुनु वॊक्कटे अविय
कॊरलि शिष्टान्नमुलु गॊनु नाक लॊकटे
तिरुगु दुष्टान्नमुलु दिनु नाक लॊकटे
परग दुर्गन्धमुलपै वाय नॊकटे
वरुस बरिमळमुपै वाय नॊकटे
कडगि येनुगु मीद गाय यॆण्डॊकटे
पुडमि शुनकमु मीद बॊलय नॆण्डॊकटे
कडु बुण्युलनु बाप कर्मुलनु सरिगाव
जडिय श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरु नाम मॊकटे
tandanāna ahitandanāna pure
tandanāna bhaḷā tandanāna
brahmamokaṭe parabrahmamokaṭe para
brahmamokaṭe parabrahmamokaṭē
kanduvagu hīnādhikamu lindu lēvu
aṃdariki śrīharē aṃtarātma
iṃdulō jantukula mintā nokaṭē
aṃdariki śrīharē aṃtarātma
niṇḍāra rāju nidriñcu nidrayu nokaṭē
aṃḍanē baṇṭunidra adiyu nokaṭē
meṇḍaina brāhmaṇuḍu meṭṭubhūmi yokaṭē
caṇḍāluḍuṇḍēṭi saribhūmi yokaṭe
anugu dēvatalakunu alakāma sukhamokaṭē
ghanakīṭa paśuvulaku kāmasukhamokaṭe
dina mahōrātramulu tegi dhanāḍhyuna kokaṭē
vonara nirubēdakunu vokkaṭē aviyu
312313
korali śiṣṭānnamulu gonu nāka lokaṭē
tirugu duṣṭānnamulu dinu nāka lokaṭē
paraga durgandhamulapai vāyu nokaṭē
varusa barimaḷamupai vāyu nokaṭē
kaḍagi yēnugu mīda gāyu yeṇḍokaṭē
puḍami śunakamu mīda bolayu neṇḍokaṭē
kaḍu buṇyulanu bāpa karmulanu sarigāva
jaḍiyu śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaru nāma mokaṭē
Tandanaa na ahi Tandanaa na pure!
Tandanaa na bhala Tandanaa na!
Brahman is One! The Supreme Brahman is One!
Brahman is One! The Supreme Brahman is One!
There is no disparity of high and low,
for every one it is Sree Hari who is the inner self1
The genus of all creatures is only one,
Sree Hari is the supreme inner self of everyone!
The royal undisturbed sleep of the emperor is similar,
to the sleep of an ordinary soldier!
The ‘high’ ground which a noble Brahmin treads,
is similar to the ‘low’ ground where an untouchable lives!
The sexual pleasure of the demigods,
and that of insects and animals, is same!
Day and night are same for the affluent,
and so also for the destitute!
The hunger felt by those who can afford to buy good food,
is same as that felt by one who lives on condemned food!
The breeze that carries foul smell,
is also the one that carries fragrance!
The sun shines equally on an elephant,
and on a street cur!
For the virtuous and the vicious alike,
the Savior is only Sree Venkateshwara’s sacred name!
314315

item.title: १५१ जोवच्युतानन्द जोजो मुकुन्द
item.description:
Jōvacyutānanda Jōjō Mukunda
जोवच्युतानन्द जोजो मुकुन्द
रावॆ परमानन्द रामगोविन्द
नन्दु निण्टनु जेरि नयमु मीऱङ्ग
चन्द्रवदनलु नीकु सेव चेयङ्ग
वन्दमुग वारिण्ड्ल नाडुचुण्डग
मन्दलकु दॊङ्ग मा मुद्दुरङ्ग
पालवाराशिलो पवळिञ्चिनावु
बालुगा मुनुल कभयमिच्चिनावु
मेलुगा वसुदेवु कुदयिञ्चिनावु
बालुडै यण्डि गोपालुडैनावु
अट्टुगट्टिन मीग डट्टॆ तिन्नाडे
पट्टि कोडलु मूतिपै रासिनाडे
अट्टॆ तिनॆननि यत्तयडुग विन्नाडे
गट्टिगा निदि दॊङ्ग कॊट्टुमन्नाडे
गॊल्लवारिण्ड्लकुनु गॊब्बुनकु बोयि
कॊल्ललुगा त्रावि कुण्डलनु नेयि
चॆल्लुना मगवाण्ड्र जॆलिगि यी शायी
चिल्लतनमुलु सेयजॆल्लुनटवोयि
रेपल्लॆ सतुलॆल्ल गोपम्बुतोनु
गोपम्म मी कॊडुकु मा यिण्ड्ललोनु
मापुगाने वच्चि मा मानमुलनु
नी पापडे चॆऱिचॆ नेमन्दुमम्म
ऒकनि यालिनि दॆच्चि नॊकनि कडबॆट्टि
जगडमुलु गलिपिञ्चि सतिपतुल बट्टि
पगलु नलु जामुलनु बालुडैनट्टि
मगनाण्ड्र जेपट्टि मदनुडै नट्टि
अङ्गजुनि गन्न मा यन्न यिटु रारा
बङ्गारु गिन्नॆलोन बालु पोसेरा
दॊङ्ग नीवनि सतुलु पॊङ्गुचुन्नारा
मुङ्गिट नाडरा मोहनाकार
गोवर्धनं बॆल्ल गॊडुगुगा बट्टि
कावरम्मुन नुन्न कंसुबडगॊट्टि
नीवु मधुरापुरमु नेल जेपट्टि
ठीवितो नेलिन देवकीपट्टि
अङ्गुगा दाळ्ळपाकन्नमय्य चाल
शृङ्गगा रचनगा जॆप्पॆ नी जोल
सङ्गतिग सकल सम्पदल नीवेळ
मङ्गळमु तिरुपट्ल मदन गोपाल
316317
jōvacyutānanda jōjō mukunda
rāve paramānanda rāmagōvinda
nandu niṇṭanu jēri nayamu mīṟaṅga
candravadanalu nīku sēva cēyaṅga
vandamuga vāriṇḍla nāḍucuṇḍaga
mandalaku doṅga mā mudduraṅga
pālavārāśilō pavaḷiñcināvu
bālugā munula kabhayamiccināvu
mēlugā vasudēvu kudayiñcināvu
bāluḍai yuṇḍi gōpāluḍaināvu
aṭṭugaṭṭina mīga ḍaṭṭe tinnāḍē
paṭṭi kōḍalu mūtipai rāsināḍē
aṭṭe tinenani yattayaḍuga vinnāḍē
gaṭṭigā nidi doṅga koṭṭumannāḍē
gollavāriṇḍlakunu gobbunaku bōyi
kollalugā trāvi kuṇḍalanu nēyi
cellunā magavāṇḍra jeligi yī śāyī
cillatanamulu sēyajellunaṭavōyi
rēpalle satulella gōpambutōnu
gōpamma mī koḍuku mā yiṇḍlalōnu
māpugānē vacci mā mānamulanu
nī pāpaḍē ceṟice nēmandumamma
okani yālini decci nokani kaḍabeṭṭi
jagaḍamulu galipiñci satipatula baṭṭi
pagalu nalu jāmulanu bāluḍainaṭṭi
maganāṇḍra jēpaṭṭi madanuḍai naṭṭi
aṃgajuni ganna mā yanna yiṭu rārā
baṅgāru ginnelōna bālu pōsērā
doṅga nīvani satulu poṅgucunnārā
muṅgiṭa nāḍarā mōhanākāra
gōvardhanaṃ bella goḍugugā baṭṭi
kāvarammuna nunna kaṃsubaḍagoṭṭi
nīvu madhurāpuramu nēla jēpaṭṭi
ṭhīvitō nēlina dēvakīpaṭṭi
aṃgugā dāḷḷapākannamayya cāla
śṛṅgagā racanagā jeppe nī jōla
saṅgatiga sakala sampadala nīvēḷa
maṅgaḷamu tirupaṭla madana gōpāla
318319
Jo Achyutanada, Jo Jo Mukunda!
Come over O supremely blissful one, Rama-Govinda!
Being the child of Nandas house, growing in beauty
With beautiful moon-faced women serving you
Happily playing in their houses,
You thief among cowherds! Our dear Ranga!
O one who reclines in the ocean of milk!
As a small child you blessed the sages,
You who have dawned for the good of Vasudeva
Being a young lad, you tended the cows as Gopala!
O one who ate butter from the hanging pots,
Catching hold of a daughter-in-law you smeared it on her mouth
You heard the mother-in-law ask ‘Who ate it?’
You shouted loudly “Here is the thief, beat her” !
Going to the house of cowherds quickly,
Drinking lots and lots of ghee from the pots
Do you ever get tired of sporting with the menfolk?
You can get away with playing any of your pranks!
The ladies of Repalle with anger (said)
“O mother , your son, entering our houses
at night time, with our modesty
he (this child) played, what more can we say?”
Placing one mans wife next to another man
You instigated fights between man and wife
During the four durations of the day, being a child
You caught the menfolk in a spell, being a ‘Madana’
O one who gave birth to Angaja1, come over here!
In a golden vessel, I offer you milk
Puffed up in anger, the women are calling you as “thief”
Play in the courtyard! O handsome one!
Holding the entire Govardhana Hill as an umbrella
Vanquishing the arrogant Kamsa
You won over the land of Mathura city
And ruled over it with royal majesty, O dear of Devaki!
In a very beautiful manner, Tallapaka Annayya
Is singing this lullaby as a romantic poem.
With these ‘all time treasures’ as its content
Praises unto you, O Tirupati Madanagopala!
320321
1.Angaja - Manmatha

item.title: १५२ कलिगॆ माकुनिदि कैवल्यं
item.description:
Kalige Mākunidi Kaivalyaṃ
कलिगॆ माकु निदि कैवल्यं
कलकालमु हरिकथाश्रवणम् ॥॥ कलिगॆ ॥
अचिन्त्य मद्भुत मानन्दं
प्रचुरं दिव्यं पावनं
सुचरित्रं श्रुति शोभितं
अचलं बिदिवो हरिकीर्तनम् ॥॥ कलिगॆ ॥
निरतं नित्यं निखिल शुभकरं
दुरितं हर भवदूरं
परम मङ्गळं भावातीतं
करिवरदं निजकैङ्कर्यम् ॥॥ कलिगॆ ॥
सुलभं सुकरं शोकनाशनं
फलदं ललितं भयहरणं
कलितं श्री वेङ्कटपति शरणं
जलजोदर निच्च स्तोत्रम् ॥॥ कलिगॆ ॥
kalige māku nidi kaivalyaṃ
kalakālamu harikathāśravaṇaṃ …. kalige ..
acintya madbhuta mānandaṃ
pracuraṃ divyaṃ pāvanaṃ
sucaritraṃ śruti śōbhitaṃ
acalaṃ bidivō harikīrtanaṃ …. kalige ..
nirataṃ nityaṃ nikhila śubhakaraṃ
duritaṃ hara bhavadūraṃ
parama maṅgaḷaṃ bhāvātītaṃ
karivaradaṃ nijakaiṅkaryaṃ …. kalige ..
sulabhaṃ sukaraṃ śōkanāśanaṃ
phaladaṃ lalitaṃ bhayaharaṇaṃ
kalitaṃ śrī vēṅkaṭapati śaraṇaṃ
jalajōdara nicca stōtraṃ …. kalige ..
Bestowed upon us is this beatitude,
the constant hearing of the stories of Hari!
Free from worries, extraordinary, blissful
the famed, divine, pious
the blessed story, glorified by the Vedas,
the constant one is this, the praising of Lord Hari!
Eternal, forever, the all benevolent,
destroyer of sins, remover of difficulties
supremely auspicious, beyond all mundane passions,
the savior of the elephant, the true servitude!
Easy, beneficent, destroyer of sorrows,
fruitful, tender, remover of all fears,
teaching surrender unto Venkatapathi
this is the eternal verse praising the Lord with lotus navel!
322323

item.title: १५३ केशवदासि नैति गॆलिचिति
item.description:
Kēśavadāsi Naiti Geliciti
केशवदासि नैति गॆलिचिति नन्निटानु
यी शरीरपु नेरालिकनेल वॆदक ॥॥ केशव ॥
निच्चलु कोरिकलिय्य नीनाममे चालु
तॆच्चि पुनीतुचेय नीतीर्थमे चालु
पच्चिपापालणच नी प्रसादमे चालु
यॆच्चु कॊन्दु वुपायालु इकनेल वॆदक ॥॥ केशव ॥
घनुनि चेयगनु नी कैङ्कर्यमे चालु
मॊनसि रक्षिञ्चनु नी मुद्रले चालु
मनिषि कावग तिरुमणि लाञ्छनमे चालु
यॆनसॆनु दिक्कुदॆस इकनेल वॆदक ॥॥ केशव ॥
नॆलवैन सुखमिय्य नी ध्यानमे चालु
अल दापुदण्डकु नी यर्चने चालु
यिलपै श्रीवेङ्कटेश यिन्निटा माकु कलवु
यॆलमि नितरमुलु यिकनेल वॆदक ॥॥ केशव ॥
kēśavadāsi naiti geliciti nanniṭānu
yī śarīrapu nērālikanēla vedaka …. kēśava ..
niccalu kōrikaliyya nīnāmamē cālu
tecci punītucēya nītīrthamē cālu
paccipāpālaṇaca nī prasādamē cālu
yeccu kondu vupāyālu ikanēla vedaka …. kēśava ..
ghanuni cēyaganu nī kaiṅkaryamē cālu
monasi rakṣiñcanu nī mudralē cālu
maniṣi kāvaga tirumaṇi lāñchanamē cālu
yenasenu dikkudesa ikanēla vedaka …. kēśava ..
nelavaina sukhamiyya nī dhyānamē cālu
ala dāpudaṇḍaku nī yarcanē cālu
yilapai śrīvēṅkaṭēśa yinniṭā māku kalavu
yelami nitaramulu yikanēla vedaka …. kēśava ..
Keshava’s servant I became, I won over everything!
Why should I ponder over the sins of my body?
To fulfill wishes eternally, Your name alone is enough
To purify, Your teertha alone is enough
To destroy heinous sins, Your prasadam is enough
Why should I search for any other means?
To make me exalted, Your Kainkaryam (servitude) is enough
To rescue me, wearing Your mudras alone is enough
To protect the human body, wearing the mark of the Tiruman alone is enough
These being everywhere, why should I seek in any other direction?
To bestow eternal happiness, Your contemplation alone is enough
For saving me ‘here’ and ‘hereafter’, Your worship alone is enough
On this earth, Sree Venkatesha, in all these ways you exist for us
Being totally satisfied, why should I search for anything else??
324325

item.title: १५४ कॊलुवुडी भक्तिकॊण्डल
item.description:
Koluvuḍī Bhaktikoṇḍala
कॊलुवुडी भक्तिकॊण्डल कोनेटि
निलयनि श्री निधियैन वानि ॥॥ कॊलु ॥
आदि देवुनि अभवुनि साम
वेदनाद विनोदुनि नॆर -
वादि जित प्रियनि निर्मल तत्त्व -
वादुल जीवनमैन वानि ॥॥ कॊलु ॥
देवदेवुडैन दिव्युनि सर्व
भावातीत स्वभावुनि
श्रीवेङ्कटगिरि देवुडैन पर -
देवुनि भूदेव तत्परुनि ॥॥ कॊलु ॥
koluvuḍī bhaktikoṇḍala kōnēṭi
nilayuni śrī nidhiyaina vāni …. kolu ..
ādi dēvuni abhavuni sāma
vēdanāda vinōduni nera -
vādi jita priyuni nirmala tattva -
vādula jīvanamaina vāni …. kolu ..
dēvadēvuḍaina divyuni sarva
bhāvātīta svabhāvuni
śrīvēṅkaṭagiri dēvuḍaina para -
dēvuni bhūdēva tatparuni …. kolu ..
Worship with devotion, this lord residing on the hills, by the ‘Koneru’
The one who is a treasure for Sree!
The primeval Lord, The unborn
The enjoyer of the melody of Sama veda
The one who loves those who have conquered the state of perfection
The one who is but the way of life for the pious natured!
(Worship with devotion)
The Lord of lords, the supreme divinity,
The one with a nature beyond all passion
The lord of Sree Venkatagiri, the supreme Overlord
The lord of the earth, the highest of the highest!
(Worship with devotion)
326327

item.title: १५५ गरुडाद्रि वेदाद्रि कलिमि
item.description:
Garuḍādri Vēdādri Kalimi
गरुडाद्रि वेदाद्रि कलिमि ईपॆ
सिरुलॊसगी चूडरो चिन्तामणि ईपॆ ॥॥ ईपॆ ॥
पालजलधि पुट्टिन पद्मालय ईपॆ
लालित श्री नारसिंहु लक्ष्मि ईपॆ
मेलिमि लोकमातयै मिञ्चिन मगुव ईपॆ
ई लील लोकमुलेले इन्दिर ईपॆ ॥॥ ईपॆ ॥
घन सम्पदलॊसगु कमलाकान्त ईपॆ
मनसिजुगनिन रमासति ईपॆ
अनिशमु बायनि महा हरिप्रिय ईपॆ
धन धान्य रूपपु श्री तरुणि ईपॆ॥॥ ईपॆ ॥
रच्चल वॆलसिनट्टि रमावनित ईपॆ
मच्चिक गल अलमेल्मङ्ग ईपॆ
इच्चटि वेङ्कटाद्रि नी अहोबलमु नन्दु
निच्चलु तावुकॊनिन निधानमु ईपॆ॥॥ ईपॆ ॥
garuḍādri vēdādri kalimi īpe
sirulosagī cūḍarō cintāmaṇi īpe …. īpe ..
pālajaladhi puṭṭina padmālaya īpe
lālita śrī nārasiṃhu lakṣmi īpe
mēlimi lōkamātayai miñcina maguva īpe
ī līla lōkamulēlē iṃdira īpe …. īpe ..
ghana sampadalosagu kamalākānta īpe
manasijuganina ramāsati īpe
aniśamu bāyani mahā haripriya īpe
dhana dhānya rūpapu śrī taruṇi īpe…. īpe ..
raccala velasinaṭṭi ramāvanita īpe
maccika gala alamēlmaṅga īpe
iccaṭi vēṅkaṭādri nī ahōbalamu nandu
niccalu tāvukonina nidhānamu īpe…. īpe ..
The prosperity of Garudadri, and Vedadri She is!
Bestower of treasures, Chintamani She is!
Born from the milky ocean, the one who resides in the Lotus She is
One who is caressed by Narasimha, Lakshmi She is
The supreme most mother of the worlds, the glorious lady She is
In this manner, the one who reigns over the worlds, Indira She is!
One who bestows great wealth, lotus lady She is
Mother of Manmatha, Goddess Rama She is
Eternally inseparable from Him, the great love of Hari She is
The embodiment of wealth and prosperity, Goddess Sree She is!
The one who manifested before everybody, Goddess Rama She is
The one who is supremely affectionate, Alamelumanga She is!
Here, in Venkatadri and in Ahobilam,
eternally all pervading, a treasure She is!!
328329

item.title: १५६ चेरि यशोदकु शिशुवितडु
item.description:
Cēri Yaśōdaku Śiśuvitaḍu
चेरि यशोदकु शिशु वितडु
धारुणि ब्रह्मकुतण्ड्रिय नितडु ॥॥ चेरि ॥
सॊलसि चूचिननु सूर्यचन्द्रुलनु
ललि वॆदचल्लॆडु लक्ष्मणुडु
निलिचिन निलुवुन निखिलदेवतल
कलिगिञ्चु सुरलगनिवो यितडु ॥॥ चेरि ॥
माटलाडिननु मरि यजाण्डमुलु
कोटुलु वॊडमेटि गुणराशि
नीटगुनूर्पुल निखिलवेदमुलु
चाटुव नूरेटि समुद्र मितडु ॥॥ चेरि ॥
मुङ्गिट पॊलसिन मोहन मात्मुल
पॊङ्गिञ्चे घनपुरुषुडु
सङ्गति मावण्टि शरणागतुलकु
नङ्गमु श्री वेङ्कटाधिपु डितडु ॥॥ चेरि ॥
cēri yaśōdaku śiśu vitaḍu
dhāruṇi brahmakutaṇḍriyu nitaḍu …. cēri ..
solasi cūcinanu sūryacandrulanu
lali vedacalleḍu lakṣmaṇuḍu
nilicina niluvuna nikhiladēvatala
kaligiñcu suralaganivō yitaḍu …. cēri ..
māṭalāḍinanu mari yajāṇḍamulu
kōṭulu voḍamēṭi guṇarāśi
nīṭagunūrpula nikhilavēdamulu
cāṭuva nūrēṭi samudra mitaḍu …. cēri ..
muṅgiṭa polasina mōhana mātmula
poṅgiñcē ghanapuruṣuḍu
saṅgati māvaṇṭi śaraṇāgatulaku
naṅgamu śrī vēṅkaṭādhipu ḍitaḍu …. cēri ..
He is the baby of Yashoda, and at the same time He is
the father of Brahma, who is the creator of the earth!
Even with a casual look, He sprinkles the effulgence
of sun and moon, Such are His glances!
From His tall stature, He creates all the Devathas
Such a mine of Gods He is!
When He speaks, crores of Universes emerge
Such an assemblage of attributes He is!
From His exhalation of pure breaths spring the Vedas
Such an expansive ocean He is!
He is the supremely attractive form in front of us
He is the great Purusha who makes the Jivas swell with joy
For Sharanagathas like us who have reached unto Him
He is the only means, this Lord of Venkata!
330331

item.title: १५७ दाचुको नी पादालकु
item.description:
Dācukō Nī Pādālaku
दाचुको नी पादालकु तगने जेसिन पूजलिवि
पूचि नीकीरिति रूप पुष्पमु लिवि अय्या ॥॥ दाचुको ॥
वॊक्क सङ्कीर्तने चालु वॊद्दिकै मम्मु रक्षिञ्चग
तक्किनवि भण्डारान दाचि वुण्डनी
वॆक्कसमगु नी नाममु वॆल सुलभमु फलमधिकमु
दिक्कै नन्नेलितिविक अवि तीरनि नाधनमय्या ॥॥ दाचुको ॥
ना नालिकपै नुण्डि नाना सङ्कीर्तनलु
पूनि नाचे निन्नु पॊगडिञ्चितिवि
वे नामाल वॆन्नुडा विनुतिञ्च नॆन्तवाड
कानिम्मनि ना कीपुण्यमु गट्टिति विन्ते अय्या ॥॥ दाचुको ॥
यीमाट गर्वमुगादु नी महिमे कॊनियाडितिगानि
चेमुञ्चि नास्वातन्त्र्यमु चॆप्पिन वाडगानु
नेमान पाडेवाडनु नेरमु लॆञ्चकु मी
श्रीमाधव नी दासुड श्रीवेङ्कटेशुडवय्या अय्या ॥॥ दाचुको ॥
dācukō nī pādālaku taganē jēsina pūjalivi
pūci nīkīriti rūpa puṣpamu livi ayyā ..dācukō ..
vokka saṅkīrtanē cālu voddikai mammu rakṣiñcaga
takkinavi bhaṇḍārāna dāci vuṇḍanī
vekkasamagu nī nāmamu vela sulabhamu phalamadhikamu
dikkai nannēlitivika avi tīrani nādhanamayyā ..dācukō ..
nā nālikapai nuṇḍi nānā saṅkīrtanalu
pūni nācē ninnu pogaḍiñcitivi
vē nāmāla vennuḍā vinutiñca nentavāḍa
kānimmani nā kīpuṇyamu gaṭṭiti vintē ayyā ..dācukō ..
yīmāṭa garvamugādu nī mahimē koniyāḍitigāni
cēmuñci nāsvātantryamu ceppina vāḍagānu
nēmāna pāḍēvāḍanu nēramu leñcaku mī
śrīmādhava nī dāsuḍa śrīvēṅkaṭēśuḍavayyā ayyā.. dācukō
Preserve these offerings unto Your feet, performed by me as Your worship
These blossoms are but flowers representing Your fame!
One Sankirtana suffices, to protect us with ease,
let the remaining ones be preserved in the Bhandaram!
Satisfying is Your name, low in price but high in merits
Since You are the only means of protection, this is my limitless wealth!
Through the means of my tongue, in very many sankirtanas,
You had yourself praised by me!
O one with a thousand names! O Vennuda! Who am I to praise You?
Taking pity, unto me You Yourself bestowed this fortune!
This I am not saying out of pride, I have only extolled Your glories,
not saying anything independently out of my own free will!
I am a follower of the rules, please do not find fault
O Sri Madhava! I am your servant and you ‘Sri Venkatesha’!
332333

item.title: १५८ देवदेवं भजे
item.description:
Dēvadēvaṃ Bhajē
देवदेवं भजे दिव्यप्रभावं
रावणासुरवैरि रणपुङ्गवम् ॥॥ देव ॥
राजवरशेखरं रविकुल सुधाकरं
आजानुबाहुं नीलाभ्रकायं
राजारि कोदण्ड राज दीक्षागुरुं
राजीवलोचनं रामचन्द्रम् ॥॥ देव ॥
नीलजीमुत सन्निभ शरीरं घन वि -
शालवक्षं विमल जलजनाभं
तालाहिनगहरं धर्मसंस्थापनं
भूललनाधिपं भोगिशयनम् ॥॥ देव ॥
पङ्कजासन विनुत परमनारायणं
शङ्करार्जित जनकचाप दळनं
लङ्का विशोषणं लालित विभीषणं
वॆङ्कटेशं साधु विबुध विनुतम् ॥॥ देव ॥
dēvadēvaṃ bhajē divyaprabhāvaṃ
rāvaṇāsuravairi raṇapuṅgavaṃ …. dēva ..
rājavaraśēkharaṃ ravikula sudhākaraṃ
ājānubāhuṃ nīlābhrakāyaṃ
rājāri kōdaṇḍa rāja dīkṣāguruṃ
rājīvalōcanaṃ rāmacandraṃ …. dēva ..
nīlajīmuta sannibha śarīraṃ ghana vi -
śālavakṣaṃ vimala jalajanābhaṃ
tālāhinagaharaṃ dharmasaṃsthāpanaṃ
bhūlalanādhipaṃ bhōgiśayanaṃ …. dēva ..
paṅkajāsana vinuta paramanārāyaṇaṃ
śaṅkarārjita janakacāpa daḷanaṃ
laṅkā viśōṣaṇaṃ lālita vibhīṣaṇaṃ
veṅkaṭēśaṃ sādhu vibudha vinutaṃ …. dēva ..
Praises to the Lord of Gods, the divinely glorious one!
To the enemy of the demon Ravana, to the lion in the battlefield!
To the prominent one among kings, the moon of the sun-clan,
the one with long beautiful arms upto the knee, the one with a body like the blue ocean,
the one who wields the bow of the enemy of kings (Parashurama), the king initiated one
the one with lotus eyes, Lord Ramachandra!
To the one with a body like that of a blue cloud,
the one with a great broad chest, the one with a navel of pure lotus,
……………………………………… , the protector of Dharma,
the Lord of the one born of the earth (Sita), the one who reclines on the serpent!
To the one praised by Brahma, that Parama Narayana!
The one who broke the bow of Janaka which was obtained from Shankara,
the one who conquered Lanka, the one adored by Vibheeshana,
Lord Venkatesha, who is praised by sages and learned ones!
334335

item.title: १५९ देहिनित्युडु देहमुलु
item.description:
Dēhinityuḍu Dēhamulu
देहिनित्युडु देहमुलु अनित्यालु
ईवल नामनसा इदि मरुवकु मी ॥॥ देहि ॥
गुदि पातचीर मानि कॊत्तचीर गट्टिनट्टु
मुदिमेनु मानि देहिमॊगि गॊत्त मेनिमोचु
अदन चम्पग लेवु आयधम्मु लीतनि
कदिसि अग्निय नीरु गालिय चम्पगलेवु ॥॥ देहि ॥
यीतडु नरकुवडडु यीतडग्नि कालडु
यीतडु नीट मुनगडु यीतडु गालिबोडु
चेतनुडै सर्वगतुडौ चॆलियिञ्चडेमिटनु
यीतल ननादि यीतडिरुवु गदलडु ॥॥ देहि ॥
चेरिकानरानिवाडु चिन्तिञ्चरानिवाडु
भारपु विकाराल पासिन वाडी आत्म
अरय श्री वेङ्कटेशुनाधीन मीतडनि
सारमु तॆलियटे सत्यं ज्ञानमु ॥॥ देहि ॥
dēhinityuḍu dēhamulu anityālu
īvala nāmanasā idi maruvaku mī …. dēhi ..
gudi pātacīra māni kottacīra gaṭṭinaṭṭu
mudimēnu māni dēhimogi gotta mēnimōcu
adana campaga lēvu āyudhammu lītani
kadisi agniyu nīru gāliyu campagalēvu …. dēhi ..
yītaḍu narakuvaḍaḍu yītaḍagni kālaḍu
yītaḍu nīṭa munagaḍu yītaḍu gālibōḍu
cētanuḍai sarvagatuḍau celiyiñcaḍēmiṭanu
yītala nanādi yītaḍiruvu gadalaḍu …. dēhi ..
cērikānarānivāḍu cintiñcarānivāḍu
bhārapu vikārāla pāsina vāḍī ātma
araya śrī vēṅkaṭēśunādhīna mītaḍani
sāramu teliyuṭē satyaṃ jñānamu …. dēhi ..
The soul is eternal, the body is impermanent
O mind full of desires, forget this not!
Just as continuously discarding the old saree, and wearing a new one,
discarding the old body, the soul quickly assumes a new one
It cannot be killed by any weapon,
nor by fire, water, air!
It cannot be cut, nor can it be burnt by fire
It cannot be drowned in water, nor blown away by wind
It is sentient, all pervading, unmoved by anything
It is ancient and eternal!
It cannot be perceived, cannot be comprehended by thought
It is free from all passions, the soul
It is under the control of Lord Venkatesha
To know this quintessence, is itself the Truth and Knowledge!
336337

item.title: १६० नमो नमो लक्ष्मी नरसिंहा
item.description:
Namō Namō Lakṣmī Narasiṃhā
नमो नमो लक्ष्मी नरसिंहा
नमो नमो सुग्रीवनरसिंहा ॥॥ नमो ॥
वरद सुलभ भक्तवत्सल नरसिंह
नरमृगवेष श्री नरसिंहा
परमपुरुष सर्व परिपूर्ण नरसिंह
गिरिगुहवास सुग्रीवनरसिंहा ॥॥ नमो ॥
भयहर प्रह्लादपालन नरसिंह
नयनत्रयारविन्द नरसिंह
जय जय सुरमुनिसंस्तुत नरसिंह
क्रिया कलाप सुग्रीवनरसिंहा ॥॥ नमो ॥
अति कृपानिलय मोहनरूप नरसिंह
नत पितामह मुख्य नरसिंह
सतत श्री वेङ्कटेश्वर दिव्य नरसिंह
कितवारिभञ्जन सुग्रीवनरसिंहा ॥॥ नमो ॥
namō namō lakṣmī narasiṃhā
namō namō sugrīvanarasiṃhā …. namō ..
varada sulabha bhaktavatsala narasiṃha
naramṛgavēṣa śrī narasiṃhā
paramapuruṣa sarva paripūrṇa narasiṃha
giriguhavāsa sugrīvanarasiṃhā …. namō ..
bhayahara prahlādapālana narasiṃha
nayanatrayāravinda narasiṃha
jaya jaya suramunisaṃstuta narasiṃha
kriyā kalāpa sugrīvanarasiṃhā …. namō ..
ati kṛpānilaya mōhanarūpa narasiṃha
nata pitāmaha mukhya narasiṃha
satata śrī vēṅkaṭēśvara divya narasiṃha
kitavāribhañjana sugrīvanarasiṃhā …. namō ..
Salutations to You, O Lakshmi Narasimha!
Salutations to You, O Sugreeva Narasimha!
One who bestows boons easily, who is affectionate towards his devotees, Narasimha!
The one who is in the form of man and beast, Narasimha!
The Supreme Purusha with completely perfect attributes, Narasimha!
The one who resides in the cave in the mountain, Sugreeva Narasimha!
The one who dispels fears, the one who blessed Prahalada, Narasimha!
With three lotus like eyes, Narasimha!
Victory unto You who is praised by Gods and sages, O Narasimha!
O one who ordains all deeds, Sugreeva Narasimha!
O abode of extreme compassion, O handsome one, Narasimha!
Even the great Brahma prostrates before You, O Narasimha!
Eternally You are SreeVenkateshwara, O divine Narasimha!
Destroyer of evil ones, O Narasimha!
338339

item.title: १६१ नारायण नी नाममॆ गति
item.description:
Nārāyaṇa Nī Nāmame Gati
नारायण नी नाममॆ गति यिक
कोरिकलु नाकु कॊनसागुटकु ॥॥ नारा ॥
पैपै मुन्दट भवजलधि
दापु वॆनक चिन्ताजलधि
चापलमु नडुम संसार जलधि
तेप येदि इवि तॆग नीदुटकु ॥॥ नारा ॥
पण्डॆनु ऎडम पापपुराशि
अण्डनु गुडिनि पुण्यपु राशि
कॊण्डनु नडुम त्रिगुणराशि - यिवि
निण्ड कुडुचुटकु निलुकड येदि ॥॥ नारा ॥
किन्दि लोकमुलु कीडु नरकमुलु
अन्देटि स्वर्गालवॆ मीद
चॆन्दि अन्तरात्म श्रीवेङ्कटेश नी -
यन्दॆ परमपद मवल मरेदि ॥॥ नारा ॥
nārāyaṇa nī nāmame gati yika
kōrikalu nāku konasāguṭaku …. nārā ..
paipai mundaṭa bhavajaladhi
dāpu venaka cintājaladhi
cāpalamu naḍuma saṃsāra jaladhi
tēpa yēdi ivi tega nīduṭaku …. nārā ..
paṇḍenu eḍama pāpapurāśi
aṃḍanu guḍini puṇyapu rāśi
koṇḍanu naḍuma triguṇarāśi - yivi
niṇḍa kuḍucuṭaku nilukaḍa yēdi …. nārā ..
kindi lōkamulu kīḍu narakamulu
aṃdēṭi svargālave mīda
cendi aṃtarātma śrīvēṅkaṭēśa nī -
yande paramapada mavala marēdi …. nārā ..
Narayana! Your name alone is the means, now
for my wishes to become fulfilled!
Over and over again, in front is the ocean of sorrow
Near and behind is the ocean of worries
Amidst the fickleness is the ocean of samsara
Which is the raft for me to crossover these?
Onto the left is the pile of growing sins,
Close by, in the shrine, is the abundance of virtue
Midway on the Hill is the heap of Trigunas
To savor in total, where is the determination?
Below are the worlds which are hells of evil
Reachable are the heavens which are up there
When Sree Venkatesha is your inner self,
where in the outside is the supreme abode?
340341

item.title: १६२ नित्यपूजलिविवो नेरिचिन
item.description:
Nityapūjalivivō Nēricina
नित्यपूजलिविवो नेरिचिन नोहो
प्रत्यक्षमैनट्टि परमात्मुनिकि ॥॥ नित्य ॥
तनुवे गुडियट तलये शिखरमट
पॆनुहृदयमे हरि पीठमट
कनुगॊन चूपुले घनदीपमुलट
तन लोपलि अन्तर्यामिकिनि ॥॥ नित्य ॥
पलुके मन्त्रमट पादैन नालिके
कलकलमनु पिडि घण्टयट
नलुवैन रुचुले नैवेद्यमुलट
तलपु लोपल नुन्न दैवमुनकु ॥॥ नित्य ॥
गमन चेष्टले अङ्गरङ्गगतियट
तमिगल जीवुडे दासुडट
अमरिन वूर्पुले आलवट्टमुलट
क्रममुतो श्री वेङ्कटरायनिकि ॥॥ नित्य ॥
nityapūjalivivō nēricina nōhō
pratyakṣamainaṭṭi paramātmuniki …. nitya ..
tanuvē guḍiyaṭa talayē śikharamaṭa
penuhṛdayamē hari pīṭhamaṭa
kanugona cūpulē ghanadīpamulaṭa
tana lōpali aṃtaryāmikini …. nitya ..
palukē mantramaṭa pādaina nālikē
kalakalamanu piḍi ghaṇṭayaṭa
naluvaina ruculē naivēdyamulaṭa
talapu lōpala nunna daivamunaku …. nitya ..
gamana cēṣṭalē aṃgaraṅgagatiyaṭa
tamigala jīvuḍē dāsuḍaṭa
amarina vūrpulē ālavaṭṭamulaṭa
kramamutō śrī vēṅkaṭarāyaniki …. nitya ..
These are the daily obeisance, which I have learnt
For the Lord, who has manifested!
The body is itself the shrine, the head the adorning pinnacle,
the large heart is itself the seat for Sree Hari,
the vision of the eyes are the bright lamps,
for the Lord who resides within!
Speech itself is the incantation, the firm tongue’s
resonant sounds are like the ringing of bells,
the varied tastes are the food offerings,
to the Lord who is ever present in our thoughts !
The walk itself is like taking the Lord on a procession,
the eager Jiva is itself the ‘dasa’
the process of breathing is itself the waving of the fan,
in this manner is the constant worship of Sree Venkataraya!
This is a description of Maanasika Pooja.
342343

item.title: १६३ नी कथामृतमु निरत
item.description:
Nī Kathāmṛtamu Nirata
नी कथामृतमु निरत सेवन नाकु
चेकॊनुट सकलसुखसेवनम्बटु गान ॥॥ नी कथा ॥
इदियॆ मन्त्रराजमु नाकु नेप्रॊद्दु
निदियॆ वेदसंहित पाठमु
इदियॆ बहुशास्त्रमॆल्ल चदवुट नाकु
इदियॆ सन्ध्य नाकिदियॆ जपमटु गान ॥॥ नी कथा ॥
इदियॆ ब्रह्मविद्योपदेशमु नाकु
इदियॆ दुःखविरहित मार्गमु
इदियॆ बहुलोकहित भेषजमु नाकु
इदियॆ वुपनिषद्वाक्य पद्धति गान ॥॥ नी कथा ॥
इदियॆ दानफलमिय्यजालुनु नाकु
इदियॆ तपविरहित कर्ममु
इदियॆ तिरुवेङ्कटेश्वरुनि संस्मरण
इदियॆ यिदियॆ यिन्नियनु नटु गान ॥॥ नी कथा ॥
nī kathāmṛtamu nirata sēvana nāku
cēkonuṭa sakalasukhasēvanambaṭu gāna ..nī kathā
idiye mantrarājamu nāku nēproddu
nidiye vēdasaṃhita pāṭhamu
idiye bahuśāstramella cadavuṭa nāku
idiye sandhya nākidiye japamaṭu gāna .. nī kathā ..
idiye brahmavidyōpadēśamu nāku
idiye duḥkhavirahita mārgamu
idiye bahulōkahita bhēṣajamu nāku
idiye vupaniṣadvākya paddhati gāna …. nī kathā
idiye dānaphalamiyyajālunu nāku
idiye tapavirahita karmamu
idiye tiruvēṅkaṭēśvaruni saṃsmaraṇa
idiye yidiye yinniyunu naṭu gāna …. nī kathā
The nectar of your glorious legends is for me, eternal servitude!
Receiving it, is itself a worship totally pleasurable for me!
This itself is the highest mantra, for me, at all times
This itself is a lesson of the Veda-Samhitas
This itself is a study of all scriptures, for me
This itself is ‘Sandhya’, for me, this itself is the ‘Japa’!
This itself is the initiation of Brahma Vidya (highest knowledge) for me
This itself is the route without any sorrow
This itself is the universally benevolent medicine, for me
This itself is the way of the Upanishidic statements!
This itself can bestow the fruits of charity, for me
This itself is the work without any penance
This itself is ‘TiruVenkateshas’ remembrance
This , and only This, is everything !!!
344345

item.title: १६४ नी दासुल भङ्गमुलु
item.description:
Nī Dāsula Bhaṅgamulu
नी दासुल भङ्गमुलु नीवु जुतुरा
एदेनि चूचेवु नीकु ऎच्चरिञ्चवलॆना ॥॥ नी दासुल ॥
पालसमुद्रमु मीद पव्वळिञ्चिनट्टि नीकु
बेललै सुरलु मॊरवॆट्टिन यट्टु
वेळतो मा मनवुलु विन्नविञ्चितिमि नीकु
एल निद्दिरिञ्चेवु मम्मिट्टे रक्षिञ्चरादा ॥॥ नी दासुल ॥
द्वारका नगरमुलो तग नॆत्तमाडे नीकु
बीरान द्रौपदि मॊरवॆट्टिनयट्टु
फॆूरपु राजसभल कुन्दि विन्नविञ्चितिमि
येरीति पराकु नीकु इङ्का रक्षिञ्चरादा ॥॥ नी दासुल ॥
ऎनसि वैकण्ठमुलो इन्दिरकूडुन्न नीकु
पॆनगि गजमु मॊरवॆट्टिन यट्टु
चनवुतो मा कोरिकॆ सारॆ विन्नविञ्चितिमि
विनि श्री वेङ्कटेशुण्ड वेग रक्षिञ्चरादा ॥॥ नी दासुल ॥
nī dāsula bhaṅgamulu nīvu juturā
ēdēni cūcēvu nīku eccariñcavalenā …. nī dāsula ..
pālasamudramu mīda pavvaḷiñcinaṭṭi nīku
bēlalai suralu moraveṭṭina yaṭṭu
vēḷatō mā manavulu vinnaviñcitimi nīku
ēla niddiriñcēvu mammiṭṭē rakṣiñcarādā …nīdāsula .
dvārakā nagaramulō taga nettamāḍē nīku
bīrāna draupadi moraveṭṭinayaṭṭu
ghōrapu rājasabhala kundi vinnaviñcitimi
yērīti parāku nīku iṃkā rakṣiñcarādā …. nīdāsula
enasi vaikaṇṭhamulō iṃdirakūḍunna nīku
penagi gajamu moraveṭṭina yaṭṭu
canavutō mā kōrike sāre vinnaviñcitimi
vini śrī vēṅkaṭēśuṇḍa vēga rakṣiñcarādā ..nī dāsula
Humiliation of your servants, are you merely going to watch?
What is it that you witness? Do you need to be prompted?
For you who are reclining on the milky ocean,
just as the helpless Devas sought your help,
so too we have pleaded with you, very much in time!
