Why is it that you are still asleep? Can’t you rescue us just now?
To you who were playing dice at Dwaraka,
just as the distressed Draupadi cried out for help,
so too we, suffering in the courts of wicked kings, have sought your help!
Why this indifference from You? Can’t you save us just now?
To you who were at Vaikunta, in the joyous company of Lakshmi,
just as the battling elephant sought your help,
so too we, with total faith, have expressed our desire!
Listening, O Sree Venkatesha! Won’t you speedily rescue us?
346347

item.title: १६५ पलुकु तेनॆल तल्लि
item.description:
Paluku Tēnela Talli
पलुकु तेनॆल तल्लि पवळिञ्चॆनु
कलिकितनमुल विभुनि कलसिनदिगान ॥॥ पलुकु ॥
निगनिगनि मोमुपै नॆरुलु गॆलकुलु चॆदर
पगलैनदाका चॆलि पवळिञ्चॆनु
तॆगनि परिणतुलतो तॆल्लवारिन दाक
जगदेकपति मनसु जट्टिगॊनॆ गान ॥॥ पलुकु ॥
कॊङ्गु जारिन मॆरगु गुब्बलॊलयग तरुणि
बङ्गारु मेडपै पवळिञ्चॆनु
चॆङ्गलुव कनुगॊनल सिङ्गारमुलु दॊलक
अङ्गजगुरुनितोड अलसिनदि गान ॥॥ पलुकु ॥
मुरिपॆम्पु नटनतो मुत्यालमलगुपै
परवशम्बुन तरुणि पवळिञ्चॆनु
तिरुवेङ्कटाचलाधिपुनि कौगिट गलसि
अरविरै नुनुचॆमट नण्टिनदि गान ॥॥ पलुकु ॥
paluku tēnela talli pavaḷiñcenu
kalikitanamula vibhuni kalasinadigāna …. paluku ..
niganigani mōmupai nerulu gelakulu cedara
pagalainadākā celi pavaḷiñcenu
tegani pariṇatulatō tellavārina dāka
jagadēkapati manasu jaṭṭigone gāna …. paluku ..
koṅgu jārina meragu gubbalolayaga taruṇi
baṅgāru mēḍapai pavaḷiñcenu
ceṅgaluva kanugonala siṅgāramulu dolaka
aṃgajagurunitōḍa alasinadi gāna …. paluku ..
muripempu naṭanatō mutyālamalagupai
paravaśambuna taruṇi pavaḷiñcenu
tiruvēṅkaṭācalādhipuni kaugiṭa galasi
aravirai nunucemaṭa naṇṭinadi gāna …. paluku ..
The mother with honey sweet speech, is resting!
As she with Her feminine charms spent the night with Her Lord!
With curls in her hair disheveled on Her shiny brow,
till late in the day she is resting!
Matching with His unending passion till the break of the dawn,
winning over the heart of the supreme Lord, she is resting!
With her displaced veil revealing the beauty of Her breasts,
in the golden mansion, she is resting!
From the corner of Her lotus bud eyes, with grace overflowing
after an exhausting time with Her Lord - the father of Manmatha, she is resting!
On the pearly bed, with joyful ecstacy,
with a contended look, She is resting!
As She was embraced strongly by Her Lord, Sree Venkatesha,
With blossoms of sweat all over, she is resting!
348349

item.title: १६६ पुरुषोत्तमुडवीवु
item.description:
Puruṣōttamuḍavīvu
पुरुषोत्तमुड वीवु पुरुषाधमुड नेनु
धरलोन नायन्दु मञ्चितनमेदि ॥॥ पुरुषोत्त ॥
अनन्तापराधमुलु अटु नेनु सेसेवि
अनन्तमैन दय अदि नीदि
निनु नॆरुग कुण्डेटि नीचगुणमु नादि
ननु नॆडय कुण्डेटि गुणमु नीदि ॥॥ पुरुषोत्त ॥
सकल याचकमे सरुस नाकु पनि
सकल रक्षकत्वमु सरि नी पनि
प्रकटिञ्चि निन्नु दूरे पलुके नाकॆप्पुडुनु
वॆकलिवै ननुकाचे विधमु नीदि ॥॥ पुरुषोत्त ॥
नेरमिन्तय नादि नेरुपिन्तय नीदि
सारॆकु अज्ञानि नेनु ज्ञानिवि नीवु
ई रीति वेङ्कटेश इट्टॆ नन्नु नेलितिवि
धारुणिलो निण्डॆनु प्रतापमु नीदि ॥॥ पुरुषोत्त ॥
puruṣōttamuḍa vīvu puruṣādhamuḍa nēnu
dharalōna nāyandu mañcitanamēdi …. puruṣōtta ..
anantāparādhamulu aṭu nēnu sēsēvi
anantamaina daya adi nīdi
ninu neruga kuṇḍēṭi nīcaguṇamu nādi
nanu neḍaya kuṇḍēṭi guṇamu nīdi …. puruṣōtta ..
sakala yācakamē sarusa nāku pani
sakala rakṣakatvamu sari nī pani
prakaṭiñci ninnu dūrē palukē nākeppuḍunu
vekalivai nanukācē vidhamu nīdi …. puruṣōtta ..
nēramintayu nādi nērupintayu nīdi
sāreku ajñāni nēnu jñānivi nīvu
ī rīti vēṅkaṭēśa iṭṭe nannu nēlitivi
dhāruṇilō niṇḍenu pratāpamu nīdi …. puruṣōtta ..
Supreme most being You are! The lowest of beings I am!
What good, in this world, do I possess?
Innumerable sins are what I have committed,
Limitless mercy is what You possess!
So lowly I am, I do not even know You,
Your nature is such, You never let go of me!
Begging everything, such is my way,
Bestowing eternal protection, that is Your way!
Though I abuse you openly, at all times,
yet, Your way is such that you rescue me mercifully !
Heinous acts are what I commit, Perfect is what You are!
Eternally ignorant is what I am, All-Knower is what You are!
In this manner, O Venkatesha, you ruled over me,
Your valor alone pervades this world !!
350351

item.title: १६७ मनुजुडै पुट्टि मनुजुनि
item.description:
Manujuḍai Puṭṭi Manujuni
मनुजुडै पुट्टि मनुजुनि सेविञ्चि
अनुदिनमुनु दुःख मन्दनेला ॥॥ मनु ॥
जुट्टॆडु कडुपुकै चॊरनिचोट्लुचॊच्चि
पट्टॆडु कूटिकै बतिमालि
पुट्टिन चोटिके पॊरलि मनसुवॆट्टि
वट्टि लम्पटमु वदलनेरडु गान ॥॥ मनु ॥
अन्दरिलो पुट्टि अन्दरिलो पॆरिगि
अन्दरि रूपमु लटु तानै
अन्दमैन श्री वेङ्कटाद्रीशु सेविञ्चि
अन्दरानि पदमु अन्दॆनटुगान ॥॥ मनु ॥
manujuḍai puṭṭi manujuni sēviñci
anudinamunu duḥkha mandanēlā …. manu ..
juṭṭeḍu kaḍupukai coranicōṭlucocci
paṭṭeḍu kūṭikai batimāli
puṭṭina cōṭikē porali manasuveṭṭi
vaṭṭi lampaṭamu vadalanēraḍu gāna …. manu ..
aṃdarilō puṭṭi aṃdarilō perigi
aṃdari rūpamu laṭu tānai
aṃdamaina śrī vēṅkaṭādrīśu sēviñci
aṃdarāni padamu aṃdenaṭugāna …. manu ..
Being born as a human, serving another human!
Why endure that pain constantly?
For a small stomach, going to forbidden places,
pleading for a handful of food !
We become slaves of the mind, for the sake of this world,
as we cannot let go of our attachments !
Being born within everybody, growing up within them,
HE assumes all forms!
It is only by serving glorious Lord of SreeVenkata hill,
That the unattainable can be attained!
352353

item.title: १६८ वलॆननु वारिदे वैष्णवमु
item.description:
Valenanu Vāridē Vaiṣṇavamu
वलॆननु वारिदे वैष्णवमु यिदि
वलपु देनॆवो वैष्णवमु ॥॥ वलॆ ॥
कोरिक लुडुगुचु गुऱि निन्निटिपै
वैराग्यमॆपो वैष्णवमु
सारॆकु कोपमु चलमुनु तनलो
वारिञ्चुटवो वैष्णवमु ॥॥ वलॆ ॥
सुडिगॊनु देहपु सुखदुःखमुलो
वडि चॊरनिदॆ पो वैष्णवमु
मुडिवडि यिन्द्रियमुल किङ्करुडै
वडबड निदॆ पो वैष्णवमु ॥॥ वलॆ ॥
वुदुटुन तन सकलोपायम्बुलु
वदलुट पो निजवैष्णवमु
यॆदुटनु श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरु नाममु
वदनमु चेर्चुट वैष्णवमु ॥॥ वलॆ ॥
valenanu vāridē vaiṣṇavamu yidi
valapu dēnevō vaiṣṇavamu …. vale ..
kōrika luḍugucu guṟi ninniṭipai
vairāgyamepō vaiṣṇavamu
sāreku kōpamu calamunu tanalō
vāriñcuṭavō vaiṣṇavamu …. vale ..
suḍigonu dēhapu sukhaduḥkhamulō
vaḍi coranide pō vaiṣṇavamu
muḍivaḍi yindriyamula kiṅkaruḍai
vaḍabaḍa nide pō vaiṣṇavamu …. vale ..
vuduṭuna tana sakalōpāyambulu
vadaluṭa pō nijavaiṣṇavamu
yeduṭanu śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaru nāmamu
vadanamu cērcuṭa vaiṣṇavamu …. vale ..
Whosoever desires, it is theirs, this Vaishnavism!
Honey like adorable Vaishnavism!
Giving up all desires, keeping You (the Lord) as the aim,
attaining Vairagya, is Vaishnavism!
Anger and fickleness that occur within us from time to time
suppressing them, is Vaishnavism!
The whirlpools of pleasures and pains of the material body
not being drawn into them, is Vaishnavism!
Getting entangled by becoming a slave of the senses
not to tremble when being overpowered by them, is Vaishnavism!
To quickly let go of all other means
is truly the Vaishnavism!
The one who is in front of us, SreeVenkateshwara
reciting His name is Vaishnavism!
354355

item.title: १६९ वाडे वॆङ्कटेशुडने वाडे वीडु
item.description:
Vāḍē Veṅkaṭēśuḍanē Vāḍē Vīḍu
वाडे वॆङ्कटेशुडने वाडे वीडु
वाडि चुट्टुकैदुव वलचेतिवाडु ॥॥ वाडे ॥
कारिमारसुतुनि चक्कनि माटलकु चॊक्कि
चूरगा वेदालगुट्टु चूपिनवाडु
तीरनि वेडुकतो तिरुमङ्गैयाळुवारि
आरडि मुच्चिमिकूटिकि आसपड्डवाडु ॥॥ वाडे ॥
पॆरियाळुवारिबिड्ड पिसिकि पै वेसिन
विरुल दण्डल मॆडवेसिनवाडु
तरुणि चेयिवेसिन, दग्गरि, बुजमु चाचि
परवशमै चॊक्कि पायलेनि वाडु ॥॥ वाडे ॥
पामरुल दनमीदि पाटलॆल्ला पाडुमण्टा
भूमिकॆल्ला नोर नूरि पोसिनवाडु
मामकूतुरलमेलुमङ्ग नाञ्चारियदानु
गीमुगाने वेङ्कटगिरि नुण्डेवाडु ॥॥ वाडे ॥
vāḍē veṅkaṭēśuḍanē vāḍē vīḍu
vāḍi cuṭṭukaiduva valacētivāḍu …. vāḍē ..
kārimārasutuni cakkani māṭalaku cokki
cūragā vēdālaguṭṭu cūpinavāḍu
tīrani vēḍukatō tirumaṅgaiyāḷuvāri
āraḍi muccimikūṭiki āsapaḍḍavāḍu …. vāḍē ..
periyāḷuvāribiḍḍa pisiki pai vēsina
virula daṇḍala meḍavēsinavāḍu
taruṇi cēyivēsina, daggari, bujamu cāci
paravaśamai cokki pāyalēni vāḍu …. vāḍē ..
pāmarula danamīdi pāṭalellā pāḍumaṇṭā
bhūmikellā nōra nūri pōsinavāḍu
māmakūturalamēlumaṅga nāñcāriyudānu
gīmugānē vēṅkaṭagiri nuṇḍēvāḍu …. vāḍē ..
He alone is the one who is called as Venkatesha!
He is the one holding the sharp weapon- the discus!
Immensely liking the beautiful words of the son of Kari and Mara1
He is the one who readily revealed the secrets of Vedas to him!
With great joy, Tirumangai Alwars food offerings
which were procured by looting, He desired to partake!
The garland of flowers worn by Peri Alwars daughter2
that crumpled garland, He wore around His neck!
When she offered her hand, he extended His arms in embrace
with delightful ecstasy, and remained inseparable (from her)!
To make even ignorant ones sing His praises,
He filled the earth with His grace!
Along with His consort Alamelumanga
He alone is the one who made Venkatagiri His abode!!!
1.Nammalwar is the son of Kari and Mara
2.Goda devi
356357

item.title: १७० विनरो भाग्यमु विष्णुकथ
item.description:
Vinarō Bhāgyamu Viṣṇukatha
विनरो भाग्यमु विष्णुकथ
वॆनुबलमिदिवो विष्णुकथ ॥॥ विनरो ॥
आदि नुण्डि सन्ध्यादि विधुललो
वेदम्बयिनदि विष्णुकथ
नादिञ्चीनिदे नारदादुलचे
वीधि वीधुलने विष्णुकथ ॥॥ विनरो ॥
वदलक वेदव्यासुलु नुडिविन
विदित पावनमु विष्णुकथ
सदनम्बैनदि सङ्कीर्तनयै
वॆदकिनचोटने विष्णुकथ ॥॥ विनरो ॥
गॊल्लॆतलु चल्ललु गॊनकॊनि चिलकग
वॆल्लि विरियायॆ विष्णुकथ
यिल्लिदे श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरु नाममु
वॆल्लिगॊलिपॆ नी विष्णुकथ ॥॥ विनरो ॥
vinarō bhāgyamu viṣṇukatha
venubalamidivō viṣṇukatha …. vinarō ..
ādi nuṇḍi sandhyādi vidhulalō
vēdambayinadi viṣṇukatha
nādiñcīnidē nāradādulacē
vīdhi vīdhulanē viṣṇukatha …. vinarō ..
vadalaka vēdavyāsulu nuḍivina
vidita pāvanamu viṣṇukatha
sadanambainadi saṅkīrtanayai
vedakinacōṭanē viṣṇukatha …. vinarō ..
golletalu callalu gonakoni cilakaga
velli viriyāye viṣṇukatha
yillidē śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaru nāmamu
velligolipe nī viṣṇukatha …. vinarō ..
O listen! It is a fortune, the Vishnu Katha!
Support like a backbone, is this, Vishnu Katha!
From the primeval times, in rituals like Sandhya,
akin to the Vedas, is Vishnu Katha!
Sung by sages like Narada,
in streets and lanes, is Vishnu Katha!
Constantly praised by VedaVyasa,
is this famed , pristine, Vishnu Katha!
Eternally present as Sankirtana,
wherever searched for, is Vishnu Katha!
When cowherd lasses churned the curds,
it emerged, the Vishnu Katha!
In this manner, Sree Venkateshwaras sacred name,
reveals this Vishnu Katha!
358359

item.title: १७१ वॆदकिन निदिये वेदार्थमु
item.description:
Vedakina Nidiyē Vēdārthamu
वॆदकिन निदिये वेदार्थमु
मॊदलु तुदलु हरिमूलम्बु ॥॥ वॆदकिन ॥
मुनुकॊनि अवयवमुलु यॆन्नैना
पनिवडि शिरसे प्रधानमु
यॆनलेनि सुरलु यॆन्दरु कलिगिन
मुनपटि हरिये मूलम्बु ॥॥ वॆदकिन ॥
मोवनि यिन्द्रियमुलु यॆन्नैना
भावपु मनसे प्रधानमु
यीवल मतमुलु यॆन्निकलिगिना
मूवुरलो हरि मूलम्बु ॥॥ वॆदकिन ॥
यॆरवगु गुणमुलु यॆन्नि कलिगिना
परम ज्ञानमु प्रधानमु
यिरवुग श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरु नाममे
सरवि मन्त्रमुल सारम्बु ॥॥ वॆदकिन ॥
vedakina nidiyē vēdārthamu
modalu tudalu harimūlambu …. vedakina ..
munukoni avayavamulu yennainā
panivaḍi śirasē pradhānamu
yenalēni suralu yendaru kaligina
munapaṭi hariyē mūlambu …. vedakina ..
mōvani yindriyamulu yennainā
bhāvapu manasē pradhānamu
yīvala matamulu yennikaliginā
mūvuralō hari mūlambu …. vedakina ..
yeravagu guṇamulu yenni kaliginā
parama jñānamu pradhānamu
yiravuga śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaru nāmamē
saravi mantramula sārambu …. vedakina ..
If understood, this itself is the teaching of the Vedas
At the beginning and at the end, Hari alone is the origin!
Amongst all the organs present in the body,
for executing work, the Head is the important one!
Amongst the numberless Gods,
Hari, who existed from before, is alone the origin!
Amongst all the functional organs,
the thoughtful mind is the important one!
Here, how many ever doctrines exist,
amongst the Trinity, Hari alone is the origin!
How many ever intellectual traits one has,
the supreme Knowledge is the important one!
The name of Sree Venkateshwara, which is with us,
that alone is the essence of all mantras!
360361

item.title: १७२ श्रीमन्नारायण
item.description:
śrīmannārāyaṇa
श्रीमन्नारायण श्रीमन्नारायण
श्रीमन्नारायण नी श्रीपादमे शरणु ॥॥श्रीमन्नारायण॥
कमलासतीमुखकमल कमलहित
कमलप्रिय कमलेक्षण
कमलासनहित गरुडगमन श्री
कमलनाभ नी पदकमलमे शरणु ॥॥श्रीमन्नारायण॥
परमयोगिजन भागधेय श्री
परम पुरुष परात्परा
परमात्मा परमाणुरूप श्री
तिरुवेङ्कटगिरि देवा शरणु ॥॥श्रीमन्नारायण॥
śrīmannārāyaṇa śrīmannārāyaṇa
śrīmannārāyaṇa nī śrīpādamē śaraṇu …śrīmannārāyaṇa..
kamalāsatīmukhakamala kamalahita
kamalapriya kamalēkṣaṇa
kamalāsanahita garuḍagamana śrī
kamalanābha nī padakamalamē śaraṇu …śrīmannārāyaṇa..
paramayōgijana bhāgadhēya śrī
parama puruṣa parātparā
paramātmā paramāṇurūpa śrī
tiruvēṅkaṭagiri dēvā śaraṇu ….śrīmannārāyaṇa..
Sriman Narayana, Sriman Narayana
Sriman Narayana, our refuge is at your divine feet!
O one who is the pleasure giver for Kamala-Sati’s lotus like face,
O one who loves the lotus, O lotus eyed one!
O one who sustains Brahma, O one who moves mounted on Garuda
O one with a lotus navel! Our refuge is at your lotus-feet!
O one who is the destiny for the exalted Yogis,
O Parama Purusha! O one who is higher than the highest!
O Supreme self, also the one in the most subtle form,
O Lord of Tiru Venkatagiri! You are ‘THE’ refuge!
362363

item.title: १७३ सहजवैष्णवाचार वर्तनुल
item.description:
Sahajavaiṣṇavācāra Vartanula
सहजवैष्णवाचार वर्तनुल
सहवासमॆ मा सन्ध्य ॥॥ सहज ॥
अतिशयमगु श्रीहरि सङ्कीर्तन
सततम्बुनु मा सन्ध्य
मतिरामानुजमतमे माकुनु
चतुरतमॆरसिन सन्ध्य ॥॥ सहज ॥
परम भागवतपद सेवनमे
सरवि नॆन्न मा सन्ध्य
सिरिवरुमहिमलु चॆलुवॊन्दग वे -
सरक विनुटे मा सन्ध्य ॥॥ सहज ॥
मन्तुकॆक्क तिरुमन्त्रपठनमे
सन्ततमुनु मा सन्ध्य
कन्तु गुरुडु वेङ्कटगिरिरायनि
सन्तर्पणमे मा सन्ध्य ॥॥ सहज ॥
sahajavaiṣṇavācāra vartanula
sahavāsame mā sandhya …. sahaja ..
atiśayamagu śrīhari saṅkīrtana
satatambunu mā sandhya
matirāmānujamatamē mākunu
caturatamerasina sandhya …. sahaja ..
parama bhāgavatapada sēvanamē
saravi nenna mā sandhya
sirivarumahimalu celuvondaga vē -
saraka vinuṭē mā sandhya …. sahaja ..
mantukekka tirumantrapaṭhanamē
santatamunu mā sandhya
kantu guruḍu vēṅkaṭagirirāyani
santarpaṇamē mā sandhya …. sahaja ..
Those who follow the Vaishnava code of conduct innately,
their association itself is our Sandhya!
Passionately singing Sankirtanas of SreeHari,
is always our Sandhya!
Understanding the philosophy of Ramanuja is our
glowing intellectual Sandhya!
Serving the feet of Parama Bhagavathas,
habitually, is our Sandhya!
Listening to the glories of the Lord of Sree,
joyously and untiringly, is itself our Sandhya!
Chanting the glorious ‘Tirumantra’,
constantly, is our Sandhya!
The father of Manmatha, the Lord of Venkata hill,
pleasing Him only, is our Sandhya!
364365

item.title: १७४ जय जय राम समर
item.description:
Jaya Jaya Rāma Samara
जय जय राम समर विजय राम
भयहर निज भक्त पारीण रामा ॥॥ जय ॥
जलधि बन्धिञ्चिन सौमित्रि रामा
सॆलविल्लु विरचिन सीतारामा
अल सुग्रीवु नेलिन अयोध्य रामा
कलिगि यज्ञमु काचॆ कौसल्य रामा ॥॥ जय ॥
अरि रावणान्तक आदित्यकुल रामा
गुरु वौनुलनु गाचे कोदण्ड रामा
धर नहल्य पालिटि दशरथ रामा
हरुराणि नुतुल लोकाभि रामा ॥॥ जय ॥
अति प्रतापमुल मायामृगान्तक रामा
सुत कुशलव प्रिय सुगुण रामा
वितत महिमल श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि रामा
मतिलोन बायनि मनुवंश रामा ॥॥ जय ॥
jaya jaya rāma samara vijaya rāma
bhayahara nija bhakta pārīṇa rāmā …. jaya ..
jaladhi bandhiñcina saumitri rāmā
selavillu viracina sītārāmā
ala sugrīvu nēlina ayōdhya rāmā
kaligi yajñamu kāce kausalya rāmā …. jaya ..
ari rāvaṇāntaka ādityakula rāmā
guru maunulanu gācē kōdaṇḍa rāmā
dhara nahalya pāliṭi daśaratha rāmā
harurāṇi nutula lōkābhi rāmā …. jaya ..
ati pratāpamula māyāmṛgāntaka rāmā
suta kuśalava priya suguṇa rāmā
vitata mahimala śrī vēṅkaṭādri rāmā
matilōna bāyani manuvaṃśa rāmā …. jaya ..
Praises unto Him, the victor in the battlefield, Rama!
The one who vanquishes fear and protects devotees, Rama!!
The one who took the ocean into captivity, Soumitri Rama
The one who broke the reputed bow, Sita Rama
The one who reigned over Sugriva, Ayodhya Rama
The one who guarded the yagna ritual, Kausalya Rama!
The one who killed the enemy Ravana, Aditya kula Rama
The one who is the savior of sages, Kodanda Rama
The one who blessed Ahalya, Dasharatha Rama
The one who is praised eternally by the consort of Shiva, that Lokabhi Rama!
The valiant one who killed the magical deer, Rama
The one loved by Kusha and Lava, Suguna Rama
The performer of great miracles, Sri Venkatadri Rama
The one who is eternally inseparable from our thoughts, Manu Vamsha Rama!!
366367

item.title: १७५ षोडश कळानिधिकि
item.description:
ṣōḍaśa Kaḷānidhiki
षोडश कळानिधिकि षोडशोपचारमुलु
जाडतोड निच्चलुनु समर्पयामि ॥॥ षोडश ॥
अलरु विश्वात्मकुनकु आवाहनमिदॆ सर्व -
निलयनकु आसनमु नॆम्मिनिदे
अल गङ्गाजनकुनकु अर्घ्यपाद्याचमनालु
जलधि शायिकिनि मज्जनमिदॆ ॥॥ षोडश ॥
वरपीताम्बरुनकु वस्त्रालङ्कारमिदॆ
सरि श्रीमन्तुनकु भूषणमुलिवॆ
धरणीधरुनकु गन्धपुष्प धूपमुलु
तिरिमिदे कोटिसूर्यतेजुनकु दीपमु ॥॥ षोडश ॥
अमृत मधनुनकु अदिवो नैवेद्यमु
गमिचन्द्रनेत्रुनकु कप्पुरविडॆमु
अमरिन श्री वेङ्कटाद्रिमीदि देवुनकु
तमितो प्रदक्षिणालु दण्डमुलु इविगो ॥॥ षोडश ॥
ṣōḍaśa kaḷānidhiki ṣōḍaśōpacāramulu
jāḍatōḍa niccalunu samarpayāmi …. ṣōḍaśa ..
alaru viśvātmakunaku āvāhanamide sarva -
nilayunaku āsanamu nemminidē
ala gaṅgājanakunaku arghyapādyācamanālu
jaladhi śāyikini majjanamide …. ṣōḍaśa ..
varapītāmbarunaku vastrālaṅkāramide
sari śrīmantunaku bhūṣaṇamulive
dharaṇīdharunaku gandhapuṣpa dhūpamulu
tirimidē kōṭisūryatējunaku dīpamu …. ṣōḍaśa ..
amṛta madhanunaku adivō naivēdyamu
gamicandranētrunaku kappuraviḍemu
amarina śrī vēṅkaṭādrimīdi dēvunaku
tamitō pradakṣiṇālu daṇḍamulu ivigō …. ṣōḍaśa ..
To the Lord of sixteen divine attributes, I offer sixteen ways of obeisance!
With great care and devotion, I offer constantly my obeisances!
I welcome the Lord who is the indweller of the whole universe!
To the Lord who is all pervading I offer a throne humbly!
To the origin of the holy Ganges, I offer holy water as ‘arghya, padya and achamneya’!
To the one who is reclining on the ocean, I offer the auspicious bath!
To the Lord who is always in yellow silk robes, I offer “vastra” (cloth) as adornment!
To the most prosperous one, I offer ornaments!
To the one who lifted the earth, I offer sandal, flowers and incense!
To Him who is as brilliant as a million suns, I light this lamp of oil!
To Him who churned the ‘Amrutha’, I offer ‘Naivedyam’!
To the one who has the moon as eyes, I offer camphor Aarati!
To the Lord who adorns the Sree Venkatadri hill,
eagerly I circumambulate, and prostrate before Him!
368369

item.title: १७६ अन्तय नीवे हरि
item.description:
Aṃtayu Nīvē Hari
अन्तय नीवे हरि पुण्डरीकाक्ष
चॆन्त नाकु नीवे श्री रघुरामा ॥॥ अन्तय ॥
कुलमुनु नीवे गोविन्दुडा, ना -
कलिमिय नीवे करुणानिधी,
तलपुनु नीवे धरणीधरा, ना -
नॆलवुनु नीवे नीरजनाभा ॥॥ अन्तय ॥
तनुवुनु नीवे दामोदरा, ना -
मनिकिय नीवे मधुसूदना,
विनिकिय नीवे विट्टलुडा ना -
वॆनकमुन्दु नीवे विष्टुदेवुडा ॥॥ अन्तय ॥
पुट्टुगु नीवे पुरुषोत्तमा कॊन
नट्टनडुम नीवे नारायण
यिट्टॆ श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरुडा नाकु
नॆट्टन गति यिङ्क नीवे नीवे ॥॥ अन्तय ॥
aṃtayu nīvē hari puṇḍarīkākṣa
centa nāku nīvē śrī raghurāmā …. aṃtayu ..
kulamunu nīvē gōvinduḍā, nā -
kalimiyu nīvē karuṇānidhī,
talapunu nīvē dharaṇīdharā, nā -
nelavunu nīvē nīrajanābhā …. aṃtayu ..
tanuvunu nīvē dāmōdarā, nā -
manikiyu nīvē madhusūdanā,
vinikiyu nīvē viṭṭaluḍā nā -
venakamundu nīvē viṣṭudēvuḍā …. aṃtayu ..
puṭṭugu nīvē puruṣōttamā kona
naṭṭanaḍuma nīvē nārāyaṇa
yiṭṭe śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaruḍā nāku
neṭṭana gati yiṅka nīvē nīvē …. aṃtayu ..
Everywhere You are! O Hari! The lotus eyed!
Close by me, You are, O Sree Raghu Rama!
My clan you are, O Govinda!
My wealth, You are, O treasure of compassion!
Thought You are, O Dharanidhara!
My dwelling place, You are, O lotus naveled one!
Body also You are, O Dhamodhara!
My living, You are, O Madhusudhana!
Sense of hearing You are, O Vittala!
In front and at my back, You are, O Vishnu deva!
Birth You are, O Purushottama!
At the end, and in between, only You, O Narayana!
In this manner, O Sree Venkateshwara, for me
the final destination is You and only You!!
370371

item.title: १७७ अन्तरङ्गमॆल्ल श्रीहरिकि
item.description:
Aṃtaraṅgamella Śrīhariki
अन्तरङ्गमॆल्ल श्रीहरिकि ऒप्पिञ्चकुण्टॆ
विन्त विन्त विधमुल वीडुना बन्धमुलु ॥॥ अन्त ॥
मनुजुडै फलमेदि मरिज्ञानि Еौदाका
तनुवॆत्ति फलमेदि दयगलुगुदाका
धनिकुडै फलमेदि धर्ममु सेयदाका
पनिमालि मुदिसिते पासॆना भवमु ॥॥ अन्त ॥
चदिविय फलमेदि शान्तमु कलुगुदाका
पॆदवॆत्ति फलमेदि प्रियमाडु दाका
मदिगल्गि फलमेदि माधवु दलचुदाका
यॆदुट तानु राजैते एलुना परमु ॥॥ अन्त ॥
पावनुडै फलमेदि भक्ति कलिगिन दाका
जीविञ्चि फलमेदि चिन्त दीरुदाका
वेवेल फलमेदि वेङ्कटेशुगन्नदाका
भाविञ्चि ता देवुडैते प्रत्यक्षवौना ॥॥ अन्त ॥
aṃtaraṅgamella śrīhariki oppiñcakuṇṭe
vinta vinta vidhamula vīḍunā bandhamulu …. aṃta ..
manujuḍai phalamēdi marijñāni yaudākā
tanuvetti phalamēdi dayagalugudākā
dhanikuḍai phalamēdi dharmamu sēyudākā
panimāli mudisitē pāsenā bhavamu …. aṃta ..
cadiviyu phalamēdi śāntamu kalugudākā
pedavetti phalamēdi priyamāḍu dākā
madigalgi phalamēdi mādhavu dalacudākā
yeduṭa tānu rājaitē ēlunā paramu …. aṃta ..
pāvanuḍai phalamēdi bhakti kaligina dākā
jīviñci phalamēdi cinta dīrudākā
vēvēla phalamēdi vēṅkaṭēśugannadākā
bhāviñci tā dēvuḍaitē pratyakṣamaunā …. aṃta ..
The mind, if not surrendered to Sree Hari,
the varied attachments, will they let go?
Being a human is of what use, until one become enlightened!
Possessing a body is of what use, until one becomes compassionate!
Being wealthy is of what use, until one becomes charitable!
Abstaining from work, if one grows old, can samsara be transgressed?
Being learned is of what use, until one becomes tranquil!
Being able to speak is of what use, until one becomes sweet tongued!
Possessing a mind is of what use, until one thinks of Madhava!
Even if one becomes a king, can one rule over hereafter?
Being pious is of what use, until one acquires true devotion!
Mere living is of what use, until one wins over worries!
What is the use of thousands upon thousands, until we perceive Venkatesha!
By merely thinking that one is divine, will God become manifest?
372373

item.title: १७८ अदॆ चूडरे मोहन
item.description:
Ade Cūḍarē Mōhana
अदॆ चूडरे मोहन रूपं
पदि कोट्लु गल भावज रूपम् ॥॥ अदॆ ॥
वॆलयग पदारुवेल मगुवलनु
अलमिन घनमोहन रूपं
वलचिन नन्दव्रजमु गॊल्लॆतल
कुलुकु चूपुलकु गुरियगु रूपं॥॥ अदॆ ॥
इन्दिर वनित नॆप्पुडु तन वुर -
मन्दु निलिपिन मोहन रूपं
कन्दुव भूसति कौगिट सॊम्पुल
विन्दुलु मरिगिन वेडुक रूपम् ॥॥ अदॆ ॥
त्रिपुर सतुल बोधिञ्चि रमिञ्चिन
अपुरूपपु मोहन रूपं
कपुरुल श्री वेङ्कटपतियै इल
उपमिञ्चगरानि वुन्नत रूपम् ॥॥ अदॆ ॥
ade cūḍarē mōhana rūpaṃ
padi kōṭlu gala bhāvaja rūpaṃ …. ade ..
velayaga padāruvēla maguvalanu
alamina ghanamōhana rūpaṃ
valacina nandavrajamu golletala
kuluku cūpulaku guriyagu rūpaṃ…. ade ..
iṃdira vanita neppuḍu tana vura -
mandu nilipina mōhana rūpaṃ
kanduva bhūsati kaugiṭa sompula
vindulu marigina vēḍuka rūpaṃ …. ade ..
tripura satula bōdhiñci ramiñcina
apurūpapu mōhana rūpaṃ
kapurula śrī vēṅkaṭapatiyai ila
upamiñcagarāni vunnata rūpaṃ …. ade ..
Behold this bewitchingly handsome form!
A beautiful form like ten crores of Manmathas!
This is the bewitching form which
captivated sixteen thousand women!
This is the form that is looked at
lovingly by the Nanda Vraja women folk!
This is the handsome form which has
Lakshmi seated on the breast!
This is the glorious form which is addicted
to the feast of Bhu-sati’s embrace!
This is the extraordinarily handsome form that
taught the women of the three worlds!
This is the matchless supreme form
that has assumed the form of Sree Venkatapathi!
374375

item.title: १७९ अन्नि मन्त्रमुलु
item.description:
Anni Mantramulu
अन्नि मन्त्रमुलु इन्दे आवहिञ्चॆनु
वॆन्नतो नाकु कलिगॆ वेङ्कटेशुमन्त्रमु ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
नारदुडु जपियिञ्चॆ नारायणमन्त्रमु
चेरे प्रह्लादुडु नारसिंहमन्त्रमु
कोरि विभीषणुडु चेकॊनॆ राममन्त्रमु
वेरॆ नाकुगलिगॆ वेङ्कटेशुमन्त्रमु॥॥ अन्नि ॥
रङ्गगु वासुदेवमन्त्रमु ध्रुवुडुजपियिञ्चॆ
अङ्गविञ्चॆ कृष्टमन्त्रमु अर्जुनुडु
मुङ्गिट विष्टुमन्त्रमु मॊगि शुकुडु पठिञ्चॆ
विङ्गडमैनाकु नब्बॆ वेङ्कटेशुमन्त्रमु ॥॥ अन्नि ॥
इन्नि मन्त्रमुलकॆल्ल इन्दिरानाथुडे गुरि
पन्निनदिदिये परब्रह्ममन्त्रमु
नन्नु कावगलिगॆपो नाकु गुरुडिय्यगानु
वॆन्नॆल वण्टिदि श्री वेङ्कटेशुमन्त्रमु॥॥ अन्नि ॥
anni mantramulu iṃdē āvahiñcenu
vennatō nāku kalige vēṅkaṭēśumantramu …. anni ..
nāraduḍu japiyiñce nārāyaṇamantramu
cērē prahlāduḍu nārasiṃhamantramu
kōri vibhīṣaṇuḍu cēkone rāmamantramu
vēre nākugalige vēṅkaṭēśumantramu…. anni ..
raṅgagu vāsudēvamantramu dhruvuḍujapiyiñce
aṃgaviñce kṛṣṭamantramu arjunuḍu
muṅgiṭa viṣṭumantramu mogi śukuḍu paṭhiñce
viṅgaḍamaināku nabbe vēṅkaṭēśumantramu …. anni ..
inni mantramulakella iṃdirānāthuḍē guri
panninadidiyē parabrahmamantramu
nannu kāvagaligepō nāku guruḍiyyagānu
vennela vaṇṭidi śrī vēṅkaṭēśumantramu…. anni ..
All mantras are inherently possessed by this
Easily I obtained this Venkatesha mantra!
Chanted by Narada, the Narayana mantra
Attained by Prahlada, the Narasimha mantra
Desired and attained by Vibheeshana, the Rama mantra
Specially, I got this Venkatesha mantra!
The glorious Vasudeva mantra that Dhruva chanted,
The Krishna mantra in which Arjuna excelled in delight,
The important Vishnu mantra which Shuka endeavored and recited
With grace I imbibed this Venkatesha mantra!
For all these mantras, the Lord of Lakshmi is the aim,
This is the joining link, the ParaBrahma mantra!
This which could protect me, as it was bestowed by my Guru
Soothing Like moonlight is this Venkatesha mantra!!
376377

item.title: १८० अरसि नन्नु गाचिन
item.description:
Arasi Nannu Gācina
अरसि नन्नु गाचिनातनिकि शरणु
परमु निहमु नेले पतिकिनि शरणु ॥॥अरसि॥
वेदमुलु दॆच्चिनट्टि विभुनिकि शरणु
अदिमूलमण्टे वच्चिनतनिकि शरणु
येदॆसा तानैयन्न यीतनिकि शरणु
श्रीदेवि मगडैन श्रीपतिकि शरणु ॥॥अरसि॥
अन्दरिकि प्राणमैन अतनिकि शरणु
मुन्दु मूडु मूर्तुल मूर्तिकि शरणु
दिन्दुपडि देवतल देवुनिकि शरणु
अन्दि मिन्नु नेलनेकमैनतनिकि शरणु॥॥अरसि॥
ताने चैतन्यमैन दैवानकु शरणु
नानाब्रह्माण्डालनाथुनिकि शरणु
आनुक श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि यन्दुनुण्डि वरमुलु
दीनुल किन्दरिकिच्चे देवुनिकि शरणु ॥॥अरसि॥
arasi nannu gācinātaniki śaraṇu
paramu nihamu nēlē patikini śaraṇu ….arasi..
vēdamulu deccinaṭṭi vibhuniki śaraṇu
adimūlamaṇṭē vaccinataniki śaraṇu
yēdesā tānaiyunna yītaniki śaraṇu
śrīdēvi magaḍaina śrīpatiki śaraṇu ….arasi..
aṃdariki prāṇamaina ataniki śaraṇu
mundu mūḍu mūrtula mūrtiki śaraṇu
dindupaḍi dēvatala dēvuniki śaraṇu
aṃdi minnu nēlanēkamainataniki śaraṇu….arasi..
tānē caitanyamaina daivānaku śaraṇu
nānābrahāmāṇḍālanāthuniki śaraṇu
ānuka śrī vēṅkaṭādri yandunuṇḍi varamulu
dīnula kindarikiccē dēvuniki śaraṇu ….arasi..
The one who protects me closely, unto Him I surrender
The one who rules over ‘here and hereafter’, unto that Lord I surrender!
The one who retrieved the Vedas, unto that God I surrender
The one who appeared upon calling out for ‘Adimoola’, unto Him I surrender
The one who Himself is present in all directions, unto Him I surrender
The one who is the consort of Sree Devi, unto that Sreepathi I surrender!
The one who is the ‘life-force’ for everyone, unto Him I surrender
The primal one who existed even before the trinity, unto that deity I surrender
The one who is the Lord for all these Devathas, unto that God I surrender
The one who could reach earth and sky at once, unto Him I surrender!
The one who Himself is ‘pure consciousness’, unto that divinity I surrender
The one who is the Lord of the innumerable universes, unto that Lord I surrender
After which, residing at Sree Venkatadri Hill,
the Lord who bestows boons to the helpless, unto that Lord I surrender!
378379

item.title: १८१ अलरुल कुरियग
item.description:
Alarula Kuriyaga
अलरुल कुरियग नाडॆनदे
अलकल कुलुकुल नलमेल्मङ्ग ॥॥अल॥
अरविरि सॊबगुल नतिवलु मॆच्चग
अरतॆर मरगुन नाडॆनदे
वरुसग पूर्वदुवाळपु तिरुपुल
हरिकरगिम्पुचु नलमेल्मङ्ग ॥॥अल॥
मट्टपु मलपुल मट्टॆल कॆलपुल
तट्टॆडि नडपुल दाटॆनदे
पॆट्टिन वज्रपु पॆण्डॆपुतळुकुलु
अट्टिटु चिम्मुचु नलमेल्मङ्ग ॥॥अल॥
चिन्दुल पाटल सिरिपॊलयाटल
अन्दॆल व्रॆूतल नाडॆनदे
कन्दुव तिरु वेङ्कटपति मॆच्चग
अन्दपु तिरुपुल नलमेल्मङ्ग ॥॥अल॥
alarula kuriyaga nāḍenadē
alakala kulukula nalamēlmaṅga ….ala..
araviri sobagula nativalu meccaga
aratera maraguna nāḍenadē
varusaga pūrvaduvāḷapu tirupula
harikaragimpucu nalamēlmaṅga ….ala..
maṭṭapu malapula maṭṭela kelapula
taṭṭeḍi naḍapula dāṭenadē
peṭṭina vajrapu peṇḍeputaḷukulu
aṭṭiṭu cimmucu nalamēlmaṅga ….ala..
cindula pāṭala siripolayāṭala
aṃdela mrōtala nāḍenadē
kanduva tiru vēṅkaṭapati meccaga
aṃdapu tirupula nalamēlmaṅga ….ala..
Sprinkling her beauty around, She danced!
With graceful movements, Alamelumanga!
With the charm of a half bloomed flower, when women around praised Her,
behind the translucent screens, She danced.
Stepping with the speed of lightning,
Melting the heart of Hari, Alamelumanga! (She danced)
With Her proportionate postures, with rubies in Her toe-rings
She crossed over thresholds,
With the shimmer of diamonds of Her anklets
spreading around, Alamelumanga! (She danced)
With Jig and songs, playfully,
with jingling anklets, She danced!
The passionate Lord Tiru Venkatapathi appreciating,
swirling gracefully, Alamelumanga! (She danced)
380381

item.title: १८२ अलमेलुमङ्ग
item.description:
Alamēlumaṅga
अलमेलुमङ्ग नी वभिनव रूपमु
जलजाक्षु कन्नुलकु चवुलिच्चेवम्मा ॥॥अल॥
गरुडाचलधीशु घनवक्षमुन नुण्डि
परमानन्द सम्भरितवै
नॆरतनमुलु चूपि निरन्तरमु नाथुनि
हरुषिञ्चग जेसिति गदम्मा ॥॥अल॥
शशिकिरणमुलकु चलुवल चूपुलु
विशदमुगा मीद वॆदचल्लुचु
रसिकतपॆम्पुन करगिञ्चि यॆप्पुडु नी
वशमु चेसुकॊण्टि वल्लभु नोयम्मा ॥॥अल॥
रट्टडि श्री वेङ्कट रायनिकि नीवु
पट्टपुराणिवै परगुचु
वट्टि माकु लिगरिञ्चु वलपुमाटल विभु-
जट्टिगॊनि वुरमुन सतमैतिवम्मा ॥॥अल॥
alamēlumaṅga nī vabhinava rūpamu
jalajākṣu kannulaku cavuliccēvammā ….ala..
garuḍācaladhīśu ghanavakṣamuna nuṇḍi
paramānanda sambharitavai
neratanamulu cūpi nirantaramu nāthuni
haruṣiñcaga jēsiti gadammā ….ala..
śaśikiraṇamulaku caluvala cūpulu
viśadamugā mīda vedacallucu
rasikatapempuna karagiñci yeppuḍu nī
vaśamu cēsukoṇṭi vallabhu nōyammā ….ala..
raṭṭaḍi śrī vēṅkaṭa rāyaniki nīvu
paṭṭapurāṇivai paragucu
vaṭṭi māku ligariñcu valapumāṭala vibhu-
jaṭṭigoni vuramuna satamaitivammā ….ala..
O Alamelumanga! Your ever youthful form gives
immense pleasure to the lotus eyes of His!
Residing on the majestic chest of the Lord of Garudachala,
overflowing with blissful ecstasy,
eternally showing Your feminine charms,
You enchant Your Lord with happiness!
Your glances which are as cool as moonbeams,
by casting them on Him abundantly,
and melting His heart with increasing passion,
You make Your Lord lovingly submissive!
For the amorous Lord Sree Venkataraya,
You being the eternal reigning queen,
with Your sweet love talks which are ever rejuvenating,
You win Him over and reside on His chest eternally!
382383

item.title: १८३ आकटिवेळल
item.description:
Ākaṭivēḷala
आकटि वेळल अलपैन वेळलनु
तेकुव हरिनाममे दिक्कुमरि लेदु ॥॥आकटि॥
कॊऱमालियन्न वेळ कुलमु चॆडिन वेळ
चॆऱवडि वॊरुल चेजिक्किनवेळ
वॊऱपैन हरिनाममॊक्कटे गतिगाक
मऱचि तप्पिननैन मऱिलेदु तॆरगु ॥॥आकटि॥
आपद वच्चिन वेळ आरडिबडिन वेळ
पापपु वेळल भयपडिन वेळ
वोपिनन्त हरिनाममॊक्कटे गतिगाक
मापुदाका पॊरलिन मरिलेदु तॆरगु ॥॥आकटि॥
सङ्कॆल बॆट्टिन वेळ चम्पबिलिचिन वेळ
अङ्किलिगा नप्पुल वारागिन वेळ
वॆङ्कटेशु नाममे विडिपिञ्चगतिगाक
मङ्कुबुद्धि पॊरलिन मरिलेदु तॆरगु ॥॥आकटि॥
ākaṭi vēḷala alapaina vēḷalanu
tēkuva harināmamē dikkumari lēdu ….ākaṭi..
koṟamāliyunna vēḷa kulamu ceḍina vēḷa
ceṟavaḍi vorula cējikkinavēḷa
voṟapaina harināmamokkaṭē gatigāka
maṟaci tappinanaina maṟilēdu teragu ….ākaṭi..
āpada vaccina vēḷa āraḍibaḍina vēḷa
pāpapu vēḷala bhayapaḍina vēḷa
vōpinanta harināmamokkaṭē gatigāka
māpudākā poralina marilēdu teragu ….ākaṭi..
saṅkela beṭṭina vēḷa campabilicina vēḷa
aṃkiligā nappula vārāgina vēḷa
veṅkaṭēśu nāmamē viḍipiñcagatigāka
maṅkubuddhi poralina marilēdu teragu ….ākaṭi..
When hungry, when fatigued,
The valiant Hari’s name is the only way!
When feeling worthless, when facing rejection,
when imprisoned at the hands of others,
if not for the expedient name of Hari,
even when one becomes oblivious, there is no other way !
During times of danger, during times of distress,
when evil takes over, when frightened,
if not for the strength giving name of Hari,
even upon searching, there is no other way !
When bound in chains, when sentenced to death,
when encountering demanding creditors,
if not for the liberating name of Venkatesha,
however obstinate one is, there is no other way!
384385

item.title: १८४ इन्दरिकि न भयम्बुलिच्चु
item.description:
Iṃdariki Na Bhayambuliccu
इन्दरिकि न भयम्बु लिच्चु चेयि
कन्दुवगु मञ्चि बङ्गारु चेयि ॥॥इन्द॥
वॆललेनि वेदमुलु वॆदकि तॆच्चिनचेयि
चिलुकु गुब्बलि किन्द चेर्चु चेयि
कलिकि यगु भूकान्त कौगलिञ्चिनचेयि
वलनैन कॊनगोळ्ळ वाडिचेयि ॥॥इन्द॥
तनिवोक बलिचेत दानमडिगिन चेयि
ऒनरङ्ग भूदान मॊसगु चेयि
मॊनसि जलनिधि यम्मुमॊनकु दॆच्चिन चेयि
ऎनय नागेलु धरियिञ्चु चेयि ॥॥इन्द॥
पुरसतुल मानमुलु पॊल्लसेसिन चेयि
तुरगम्बुबरपॆडि दॊड्डचेयि
तिरुवेङ्कटाचलधीशुडै मोक्षम्बु -
तॆरुवु प्राणुलकॆल्ल तॆलिपॆडि चेयि ॥॥इन्द॥
iṃdariki na bhayambu liccu cēyi
kanduvagu mañci baṅgāru cēyi ….iṃda..
velalēni vēdamulu vedaki teccinacēyi
ciluku gubbali kinda cērcu cēyi
kaliki yagu bhūkānta kaugaliñcinacēyi
valanaina konagōḷḷa vāḍicēyi ….iṃda..
tanivōka balicēta dānamaḍigina cēyi
onaraṅga bhūdāna mosagu cēyi
monasi jalanidhi yammumonaku deccina cēyi
enaya nāgēlu dhariyiñcu cēyi ….iṃda..
purasatula mānamulu pollasēsina cēyi
turagambubarapeḍi doḍḍacēyi
tiruvēṅkaṭācaladhīśuḍai mōkṣambu -
teruvu prāṇulakella telipeḍi cēyi ….iṃda..
The hand that grants boons to all,
The divine hand which dazzles with golden hue!
The hand that searched and brought back the priceless Vedas
The hand that held up and supported the hill
The hands that have embraced the beautiful mother Earth
The hands of His, with beautiful nails!
The hands that sought alms from Bali
The hands that elegantly gave away gifts of land
The hands that commanded the ocean with one arrow
The hands that are armed with the plough!
The hands that played with the modesty of women (of Vrindavan)
The powerful hands that control the horse
The hands which show that the Lord of Tiru Venkatachala
is for all aspirants of Moksha, the only refuge!
386387

item.title: १८५ इतडॊकडे सर्वेश्वरुडु
item.description:
Itaḍokaḍē Sarvēśvaruḍu
इतडॊकडे सर्वेश्वरुडु
सितकमलाक्षुडु श्री वेङ्कटेशुडु ॥॥इत॥
परमयोगुलकु भावनिधानमु
अरय निन्द्रादुल कैश्वर्यमु
गरिम गॊल्लॆतल कौगिटि सौख्यमु
सिरुलॊसगे ई श्री वेङ्कटेशुडु ॥॥इत॥
कलिगि यशोदकु कन्नमाणिकमु
तलचिन करिकिनि तगुदिक्कु
अलद्रौपदिकिनि आपद्भन्दुडु
चॆलरेगिन ई श्री वेङ्कटेशुडु ॥॥इत॥
तगिलिन मुनुलकु तपमुल सत्फलमु
मुगुरु वेल्पुलकु मूलमु
ऒगि नलमेल्मङ्ग कॊनरिन पति यितडु
जिगिमिञ्चिन ई श्री वेङ्कटेशुडु ॥॥इत॥
itaḍokaḍē sarvēśvaruḍu
sitakamalākṣuḍu śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍu ….ita..
paramayōgulaku bhāvanidhānamu
araya nindrādula kaiśvaryamu
garima golletala kaugiṭi saukhyamu
sirulosagē ī śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍu ….ita..
kaligi yaśōdaku kannamāṇikamu
talacina karikini tagudikku
aladraupadikini āpadbhanduḍu
celarēgina ī śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍu ….ita..
tagilina munulaku tapamula satphalamu
muguru vēlpulaku mūlamu
ogi nalamēlmaṅga konarina pati yitaḍu
jigimiñcina ī śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍu ….ita..
He alone is the Supreme Lord of all!
The lotus eyed Sree Venkateshwara!
He is the treasure in the thoughts of exalted Sages,
For heavenly beings like Indra , He is immense wealth,
For the blessed cowherds, He is like the comfort of an embrace,
The one who bestows all round prosperity, is He, Lord Venkateshwara!
Being there for mother Yashoda, He is her precious gem
To the elephant king who contemplated on Him, He became the only means
Previously, to the troubled Draupadi, He was the Soul-savior
This valiant Lord, Sree Venkateshwara!
He is the benevolent result of hermits’ penance
He is the origin of the divine trinity
He is the compatible consort to Alamelumanga
He is the supremely effulgent Lord Venkateshwara!
388389

item.title: १८६ इतनि कण्टॆ मरि
item.description:
Itani Kaṇṭe Mari
इतनि कण्टे मरिदैवमु कानमु यॆक्कड वॆदकिन नितडे
अतिशयमगु महिमलतो वॆलसॆनु अन्निटिकाधारमुतानॆ ॥॥इतनि॥
मदि जलधुल नॊकदैवमु वॆदकिन मत्स्यावतारम्बितडु
अदिवो पाताळमन्दु वॆदकिते आदिकूर्म मी विष्णुडु
पॊदुगॊनि यडवुल वॆदकि चूचिते भूवराहमनिकण्टिमि
चॆदरक कॊण्डल गुहल वॆदकिते श्री नरसिंहम्बुन्नाडु ॥॥इतनि॥
तॆलिसि भूनभोन्तरमुन वॆदकिन त्रिविक्रमाकृति निलिचिनदि
पलुवीरुललो वॆदकि चूचितॆ परशुरामुडॊकडैनाडु
तलपुन शिवुडुनु पार्वति वॆदकिन तारक ब्रह्ममु राघवुडु
कॆलकुल नावुलमन्दल वॆदकिन कृष्णुडु रामुडुनैनाडु ॥॥इतनि॥
पञ्चि असुरकान्तललो वॆदकिन बुद्धावतारम्बैनाडु
मिञ्चिन कालमु कडपट वॆदकिन मीदटकल्क्यावतारमु
अञ्चॆल जीवुललोपल वॆदकिन अन्तर्यामै मॆरसॆनु
यॆञ्चुक इहमुन परमुन वॆदकिन अन्तर्यामै मॆरसॆनु
यॆञ्चुक इहमुन परमुन वॆदकिन यीतडे श्रीवेङ्कटविभुडु ॥ ।इतनि॥
itani kaṇṭē maridaivamu kānamu yekkaḍa vedakina nitaḍē
atiśayamagu mahimalatō velasenu anniṭikādhāramutāne.. itani..
madi jaladhula nokadaivamu vedakina matsyāvatārambitaḍu
adivō pātāḷamandu vedakitē ādikūrma mī viṣṇuḍu
podugoni yaḍavula vedaki cūcitē bhūvarāhamanikaṇṭimi
cedaraka koṇḍala guhala vedakitē śrī narasiṃhambunnāḍu. ..itani.
telisi bhūnabhōntaramuna vedakina trivikramākṛti nilicinadi
paluvīrulalō vedaki cūcite paraśurāmuḍokaḍaināḍu
talapuna śivuḍunu pārvati vedakina tāraka brahmamu rāghavuḍu
kelakula nāvulamandala vedakina kṛṣṇuḍu rāmuḍunaināḍu. .itani.
pañci asurakāntalalō vedakina buddhāvatārambaināḍu
miñcina kālamu kaḍapaṭa vedakina mīdaṭakalkyāvatāramu
aṃcela jīvulalōpala vedakina aṃtaryāmai merasenu
yeñcuka ihamuna paramuna vedakina yītaḍē śrīvēṅkaṭavibhuḍu . itani..
We cannot see another God like Him! Wherever we seek, He alone is!
Having manifested with increasing glory, He is the support for all!
If one seeks the Lord in the ocean of thoughts, He is the Matsya Avatara!
If one looks for Him in the nether worlds, He is Adi Kurma, this Vishnu!
If one looks for Him in the forests with intent, He will be seen as Bhu Varaha!
If one resolutely looks for Him in caves and mountains, He is there as Sree Narasimha!
If one understands and seeks Him in the vast universes, He is there in the form of Trivikrama!
If one looks for Him amongst the mighty, Parashurama is one among them!
In the thoughts of Lord Shiva and Parvathi, He exists as Lord Raghava of the Taraka mantra!
If one looks for Him amongst the herds of cows, He is there as Krishna and Balarama!
If one looks for Him amongst the women of the Asura clan, He is there as Lord Buddha!
If one looks for Him at the end of the cycle of time, He is the Kalki Avatara!
If one seeks Him within the Jivas, He shines as the Antaryami!
If one seeks Him here and hereafter, He exists as Lord Sree Venkata!
390391

item.title: १८७ इतरुलकु निनु नॆरगतरमा
item.description:
Itarulaku Ninu Neragataramā
इतरुलकु निनु नॆऱगतरमा
सतत सत्यव्रतुलु सम्पूर्णमोहविर-
हितुलॆऱुगुदुरु निनु निन्दिरारमण ॥॥इत॥
नारीकटाक्षपटुनाराचभयरहित -
शूरुलॆऱुगुदुरु निनु चूचेटि चूपु
फॆूरसंसार सङ्कुलपरिच्छेदुलगु-
धीरुलॆऱुगुदुरु नीदिव्यविग्रहमु ॥॥इत॥
रागभोगविदूररञ्जितात्मुलु महा-
भागुलॆरुगुदुरु निनु प्रणतिञ्चु विधमु
आगमोक्तप्रकारभिगम्युलु महा-
योगुलॆऱुगुदुरु नीवुण्डेटिवुनिकि ॥॥इत॥
परमभागवत पदपद्मसेवानिजा-
भरणुलॆऱुगुदुरु नी पलिकेटिपलुकु
परगुनित्यानन्दपरिपूर्ण मानस-
स्थिरुलॆऱुगुदुरु निनु तिरुवेङ्कटेश ॥॥इत॥
itarulaku ninu neṟagataramā
satata satyavratulu sampūrṇamōhavira-
hituleṟuguduru ninu nindirāramaṇa ….ita..
nārīkaṭākṣapaṭunārācabhayarahita -
śūruleṟuguduru ninu cūcēṭi cūpu
ghōrasaṃsāra saṅkulaparicchēdulagu-
dhīruleṟuguduru nīdivyavigrahamu ….ita..
rāgabhōgavidūrarañjitātmulu mahā-
bhāguleruguduru ninu praṇatiñcu vidhamu
āgamōktaprakārabhigamyulu mahā-
yōguleṟuguduru nīvuṇḍēṭivuniki ….ita..
paramabhāgavata padapadmasēvānijā-
bharaṇuleṟuguduru nī palikēṭipaluku
paragunityānandaparipūrṇa mānasa-
sthiruleṟuguduru ninu tiruvēṅkaṭēśa ….ita..
Is it possible for others to know You?
Those who constantly adhere to the vow of truthfulness, those who
are totally dispassionate, only they can know You, O Lord of Lakshmi!
Those who do not get swayed by the charms of women, the fearless
and the courageous, they alone can know how to perceive You!
Those brave ones who break the shackles of the frightful Samsara,
only they can know Your Divya Vigraham!
Those who are far from desires and pleasures, those elevated souls,
those great devotees, they alone know how to praise You!
Those great Yogis who follow the injunctions of the Agamas
only they can realize Your presence!
Those true gem like people who worship the lotus feet
of Parama Bhagavathas, they alone know Your divine speech!
Those resolute ones who are eternally supremely blissful, those
completely perfect ones, only they can perceive You, O TiruVenkatesha!
392393

item.title: १८८ कण्टि नखिलाण्डकर्त
item.description:
Kaṇṭi Nakhilāṇḍakarta
कण्टि नखिलाण्डतति कर्तनधिकुनि गण्टि
कण्टि नघमुलु वीडुकॊण्टि निजमूर्ति गण्टि ॥॥कण्टि॥
महनीय घन फणामणुल शैलमु गण्टि
बहु विभवमुल मण्टपमुलु गण्टि
सहजनवरत्न काञ्चनवेदिकलु गण्टि
रहिवहिञ्चिन गोपुरम्बुलवॆ कण्टि ॥॥कण्टि॥
पावनम्बैन पापविनाशमु गण्टि
कैवशम्बगु गगनगङ्ग गण्टि
दैविकपु पुण्य तीर्थमुलॆल्ल पॊडगण्टि
कोविदुलु कॊनियाडु कोनेरुगण्टि ॥॥कण्टि॥
परमयोगीन्द्रुलकु भावगोचरमैन
सरिलेनि पादाम्बुजमुलु गण्टि
तिरमैन गिरिचूपु दिव्य हस्तमु गण्टि
तिरुवेङ्कटाचलधिपु चूडगण्टि ॥॥कण्टि॥
kaṇṭi nakhilāṇḍatati kartanadhikuni gaṇṭi
kaṇṭi naghamulu vīḍukoṇṭi nijamūrti gaṇṭi ….kaṇṭi..
mahanīya ghana phaṇāmaṇula śailamu gaṇṭi
bahu vibhavamula maṇṭapamulu gaṇṭi
sahajanavaratna kāñcanavēdikalu gaṇṭi
rahivahiñcina gōpurambulave kaṇṭi ….kaṇṭi..
pāvanambaina pāpavināśamu gaṇṭi
kaivaśambagu gaganagaṅga gaṇṭi
daivikapu puṇya tīrthamulella poḍagaṇṭi
kōvidulu koniyāḍu kōnērugaṇṭi ….kaṇṭi..
paramayōgīndrulaku bhāvagōcaramaina
sarilēni pādāmbujamulu gaṇṭi
tiramaina giricūpu divya hastamu gaṇṭi
tiruvēṅkaṭācaladhipu cūḍagaṇṭi ….kaṇṭi..
I saw, the creator of all creation, the supreme-most, I saw!
I saw, and was absolved of all sins, the real Being I saw!
The magnificent mountain of Seshas gems, I saw
The splendid mantapas, I saw
The golden altars studded with natural nine gems, I saw
The gopurams covered by Sesha, I saw!
The pure and sacred ‘Papavinashanam’, I saw
The ‘Akashaganga’ which can be received into the hands, I saw
The divinity of all auspicious ‘teerthas’, here-itself I saw
The ‘Koneru’ that is praised by the learned, I saw!
For the exalted sages , which can be perceived in their minds,
that matchless lotus like feet, I saw
The divine hands which show the eternal hills, I saw
The Lord of Venkatachala, thus, I saw!
394395

item.title: १८९ कण्टिमि नेडिदॆ
item.description:
Kaṇṭimi Nēḍide
कण्टिमि नेडिदॆ गरुडाचलपति
यिण्टि वेलुपगु यीश्वरुडितडु ॥॥कण्टिमि॥
श्री नरसिंहुडु चिन्मयकान्तुडु
दानवान्तकुडु दयानिधि
नाना महिमल नम्मिनवारिनि
पूनुक काचे पोषकुडितडु ॥॥कण्टिमि॥
देवादि देवुडु दिनकर तेजुडु
जीवान्तरङ्गुडु श्रीविभुडु
दैव शिखामणि तलचिन वारिनि
सेवलुगॊनि काचे विभुडितडु ॥॥कण्टिमि॥
परममूर्ति हरि प्रह्लाद वरदुडु
करुणानिधि बुधकल्पमु
परगु श्री वेङ्कटपति तनदासुल
नरुदुग काचे अनन्तुडितडु ॥॥कण्टिमि॥
kaṇṭimi nēḍide garuḍācalapati
yiṇṭi vēlupagu yīśvaruḍitaḍu ….kaṇṭimi..
śrī narasiṃhuḍu cinmayakāntuḍu
dānavāntakuḍu dayānidhi
nānā mahimala namminavārini
pūnuka kācē pōṣakuḍitaḍu ….kaṇṭimi..
dēvādi dēvuḍu dinakara tējuḍu
jīvāntaraṅguḍu śrīvibhuḍu
daiva śikhāmaṇi talacina vārini
sēvalugoni kācē vibhuḍitaḍu ….kaṇṭimi..
paramamūrti hari prahlāda varaduḍu
karuṇānidhi budhakalpamu
paragu śrī vēṅkaṭapati tanadāsula
naruduga kācē anantuḍitaḍu ….kaṇṭimi..
Today we beheld the lord of Garudachala!
Our family deity He is! The Lord He is!
Sree Narasimha! The lord of beatific effulgence
the destroyer of demons, the ocean of compassion!
Those who believe in His various glories,
He willingly protects them, this Supreme nourisher!
The Lord of lords, the one with the effulgence of the sun
the in-dweller within Jivas, the Lord consort of Sree!
The crest jewel among Gods, those who contemplate on Him
He accepts their worship and protects! The Lord He is!
The supreme deity Hari, the one who blessed Prahalada
the ocean of mercy, the wish yielding tree for the learned!
As the all pervading Sree Venkatapathi He protects
His dasas uniquely! The flawless one He is!
396397

item.title: १९० अनि यानतिच्चॆ कृष्णुडर्जुनुनितो
item.description:
Ani Yānaticce Kṛṣṇuḍarjununitō
अनि यानतिच्चॆ कृष्णुडर्जुनुनितो
विनि यातनि भजिञ्चु विवेकमा ॥॥अनि॥
भूमिलोनु चॊच्चि सर्वभूत प्राणुलनॆल्ल
दीमपान मोचेटि देवुड नेनु
कामिञ्चि सस्यमुलु कलिगिञ्चि चन्द्रुडनै
तेमल पण्डिञ्चेटि देवुड नेनु ॥॥अनि॥
दीपनाग्निनै जीवदेहमुल अन्नमुलु
तीपुल नरगिञ्चेटि देवुड नेनु
एपुन निन्दरिलोनि हृदयमुलोन नुन्दु
दीपिन्तु तलपु मरपै देवुड नेनु ॥॥अनि॥
वेदमु लन्निटिचेत वेदान्तवेत्तलचे
अदि ने नॆरगतगिन आ देवुडनु
श्रीदेवितो गूडि श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि मीद
पादैन देवुडनु भाविञ्च नेनु ॥॥अनि॥
ani yānaticce kṛṣṇuḍarjununitō
vini yātani bhajiñcu vivēkamā ….ani..
bhūmilōnu cocci sarvabhūta prāṇulanella
dīmapāna mōcēṭi dēvuḍa nēnu
kāmiñci sasyamulu kaligiñci candruḍanai
tēmala paṇḍiñcēṭi dēvuḍa nēnu ….ani..
dīpanāgninai jīvadēhamula annamulu
tīpula naragiñcēṭi dēvuḍa nēnu
ēpuna nindarilōni hṛdayamulōna nundu
dīpintu talapu marapai dēvuḍa nēnu ….ani..
vēdamu lanniṭicēta vēdāntavēttalacē
adi nē neragatagina ā dēvuḍanu
śrīdēvitō gūḍi śrī vēṅkaṭādri mīda
pādaina dēvuḍanu bhāviñca nēnu ….ani..
In this manner, Krishna advised Arjuna!
Listen and worship Him, O intellect!
“Descending onto the earth, sustaining all creatures and living beings,
with fortitude, the Lord I am!
Out of love, nurturing the crops as the moon,
sprinkling cool moon-beams, the Lord I am!”
“As the bright fire within the bodies of the Jivas
digesting the food consumed, the Lord I am!
In full glory, residing in the hearts of everybody
shining brightly as ‘the thought’ and ‘the oblivion’, the Lord I am”
“Through the Vedas, and by the knowledgeable Vedantins
the Primal one to be known, that Lord I am!
Together with SreeDevi, permanently residing at SreeVenkatadri,
know me to be that Worshipable Lord!!”
398399

item.title: १९१ इतनिकण्टॆ घनुलिक लेरु
item.description:
Itanikaṇṭe Ghanulika Lēru
इतनिकण्टॆ घनुलिक लेरु
यितर देवतल यिन्दरिलोन ॥॥इतनि॥
भूपति ईतडॆ पॊदिगि कॊलुवरो
श्रीपति ईतडे चेकॊनरो
येपुन बलुवुडु नीतडे चेररो
पैपै वेङ्कटपति यैनाडु ॥॥इतनि॥
मरुगुरुडितडे मति नम्मगदरो
परमात्मुडितडे भाविञ्चरो
करिवरदुडितडे गतियनि तलचरो
परग श्री वेङ्कटपतियैनाडु ॥॥इतनि॥
तल्लिय नितडे तण्ड्रिय नितडे
वॆल्लिविरै यिक विडुवकुरो
चल्लगा नितनि शरणनि ब्रतुकरो
अल्लन श्री वेङ्कटहरि अयिनाडु ॥॥इतनि॥
itanikaṇṭe ghanulika lēru
yitara dēvatala yindarilōna ….itani..
bhūpati ītaḍe podigi koluvarō
śrīpati ītaḍē cēkonarō
yēpuna baluvuḍu nītaḍē cērarō
paipai vēṅkaṭapati yaināḍu ….itani..
maruguruḍitaḍē mati nammagadarō
paramātmuḍitaḍē bhāviñcarō
karivaraduḍitaḍē gatiyani talacarō
paraga śrī vēṅkaṭapatiyaināḍu ….itani..
talliyu nitaḍē taṇḍriyu nitaḍē
vellivirai yika viḍuvakurō
callagā nitani śaraṇani bratukarō
allana śrī vēṅkaṭahari ayināḍu ….itani..
There is none who can excel Him in any aspect
amongst all other deities!
He is the Lord of the earth, worship Him in total
The consort of Sree is He, delight in Him
Supremely strong one He is, reach unto Him
High up there He has assumed the form of Venkatapathi!
The father of Love God He is, believe Him in your mind
The supreme soul He is, contemplate on Him
The savior of the elephant king He is, seek Him as your means
He became the all-pervading Venkatapathi!
Mother He is, Father He is,
know Him, and never let go
Surrender unto Him and live life blessedly,
Behold! there He has assumed the form of Sree Venkatapathi!
400401

item.title: १९२ चूड पिन्नवाडु गानि जाटुदनाल
item.description:
Cūḍa Pinnavāḍu Gāni Jūṭudanāla
चूड पिन्नवाडु गानि जाटुदनाल नॆक्कुडु
येड चूचिना तानु यी विट्ठलुण्डे ॥॥चूड॥
गोवुललो विहरिञ्चे गोविन्दुडु पॆक्कु
वावुल गोपिकलकु वल्लभुडु
चेवमीरि मुद्दुल श्रीकृष्णुडु
येवल्लजाचिनानु यी विट्ठलुडे ॥॥चूड॥
रासक्रीडललोनि राजीवाक्षुडु
आस पदारुवेल पॆण्ड्लाडिनवाडु
बासतो रुक्मिणी सत्यभामासमेतुडु
यी सुद्दुल वॆलसी नी विट्ठलुडे ॥॥चूड॥
विन्त मधुराङ्गनल वेडुककाडु
चॆन्त कॊलनि सतुल सिग्गुलवाडु
कान्त लक्ष्मीपति श्री वेङ्कटेश्वरुडु
यिन्तटा विनोदिञ्ची नी विठलुडे ॥॥चूड॥
cūḍa pinnavāḍu gāni jūṭudanāla nekkuḍu
yēḍa cūcinā tānu yī viṭṭhaluṇḍē ….cūḍa..
gōvulalō vihariñcē gōvinduḍu pekku
vāvula gōpikalaku vallabhuḍu
cēvamīri muddula śrīkṛṣṇuḍu
yēvallajūcinānu yī viṭṭhaluḍē ….cūḍa..
rāsakrīḍalalōni rājīvākṣuḍu
āsa padāruvēla peṇḍlāḍinavāḍu
bāsatō rukmiṇī satyabhāmāsamētuḍu
yī suddula velasī nī viṭṭhaluḍē ….cūḍa..
vinta madhurāṅganala vēḍukakāḍu
centa kolani satula siggulavāḍu
kānta lakṣmīpati śrī vēṅkaṭēśvaruḍu
yintaṭā vinōdiñcī nī viṭhaluḍē ….cūḍa..
To look at, He is a mere child! Yet His mischievous qualities are great!
Wherever we see, there He is, this Vittala!
He moves about with the cows, this Govinda!
Related to the Gopis in many ways, He is their Vallabha!
Exceedingly lovable is this Sree Krishna!
Wherever we see, there He is, this Vittala!
In His amorous plays, He is the lotus eyed one!
With ardor, He married sixteen thousand wives
this one who is bound in love with Rukmini-satyabhama!
In this manner, He shone splendidly, this Vittala!
The one who delighted with beautiful damsels
The one who put women to shame by the riverside
The consort of Lakshmi, SreeVenkatesha
Everywhere He sported, this Vittala!!
402403

item.title: १९३ दीनुड नेनु देवुडवु नीवु
item.description:
Dīnuḍa Nēnu Dēvuḍavu Nīvu
दीनुड नेनु देवुडवु नीवु
नी निज महिमे नॆरुपुट गाक ॥॥दीनुड॥
मति जनन मॆरुग मरणं बॆरुगनु
इतवुग निनुनिक नॆरिगेना
क्षितिपुट्टिञ्चिन श्रीपतिविनीवे
तति नापै दय दलतुवु गाक ॥॥दीनुड॥
तलचपापमनि तलचपुण्यमनि
तलपुन इक निनुतलचेना
आलरिन नालो अन्तर्यामिवि
कलुष मॆडय ननु गातुवु गाक ॥॥दीनुड॥
तडव ना हेयमु तडव ना मलिनमु
तडयक नी मेलु तडवेना
विडुवलेनि श्रीवेङ्कट विभुडवु
कडदाक निकगातुवुगाक ॥॥दीनुड॥
dīnuḍa nēnu dēvuḍavu nīvu
nī nija mahimē nerupuṭa gāka ….dīnuḍa..
mati janana meruga maraṇaṃ beruganu
itavuga ninunika nerigēnā
kṣitipuṭṭiñcina śrīpativinīvē
tati nāpai daya dalatuvu gāka ….dīnuḍa..
talacapāpamani talacapuṇyamani
talapuna ika ninutalacēnā
ālarina nālō aṃtaryāmivi
kaluṣa meḍayu nanu gātuvu gāka ….dīnuḍa..
taḍava nā hēyamu taḍava nā malinamu
taḍayaka nī mēlu taḍavēnā
viḍuvalēni śrīvēṅkaṭa vibhuḍavu
kaḍadāka nikagātuvugāka ….dīnuḍa..
Lowly I am, Lordly you are!
Your true magnificence is all pervasive!
I am neither aware of birth , nor of death
How can I ever know you?
Creator of the earth, Sree-Pathi you are,
At this moment, may your blessings be showered on me!
I don’t think of sins, and also of merits
How can I even think of You?
Present within me fully, the indweller you are,
Whatever be my sins, may you protect me!
Hateful at times, sinful at times,
how then can I spontaneously think of Your grace?
You who never let go of me, Lord Venkatesha!
till the very end, may you protect me
404405

item.title: १९४ सकलसङ्ग्रहमु सकल सञ्चयमु
item.description:
Sakalasaṅgrahamu Sakala Sañcayamu
सकलसङ्ग्रहमु सकल सञ्चयमु
अकृतसुकृत मिदि हरिनामम् ॥॥सकल॥
सकल वेदशास्त्रमुलसार मिदि
सकलमन्त्र राजम्बु निदि
सकलपुराण रसमुलमधुर मिदि
अकुटिलपावनं हरिनामम् ॥॥सकल॥
सकलतत्व संशयखण्डन मिदि
सकलकर्मनिश्चयमु निदि
सकल विधिरहस्यप्रधान मिदि
अकारणहितं हरिनामम् ॥॥सकल॥
सकल देवतास्वामिप्रियं बिदि
सकललोक रक्षणमु निदि
प्रकटं वेङ्कटपतिनामाङ्कित-
मकिञ्चनधनं हरिनामम् ॥॥सकल॥
sakalasaṅgrahamu sakala sañcayamu
akṛtasukṛta midi harināmaṃ ….sakala..
sakala vēdaśāstramulasāra midi
sakalamantra rājambu nidi
sakalapurāṇa rasamulamadhura midi
akuṭilapāvanaṃ harināmaṃ ….sakala..
sakalatatva saṃśayakhaṇḍana midi
sakalakarmaniścayamu nidi
sakala vidhirahasyapradhāna midi
akāraṇahitaṃ harināmaṃ ….sakala..
sakala dēvatāsvāmipriyaṃ bidi
sakalalōka rakṣaṇamu nidi
prakaṭaṃ vēṅkaṭapatināmāṅkita-
makiñcanadhanaṃ harināmaṃ ….sakala..
An assemblage of everything, a union of everything,
a naturally bestowed reward, is the name of Hari!
This is the quintessence of the entire Veda-Shastras,
this is the highest of all mantras,
this is the sweet elixir of all the Puranas,
the flawless and pristine one, the name of Hari!
This is the one that cuts asunder the doubts about the eternal truths,
this is the one that ordains all Karmas,
this is the important one amongst all esoteric deeds,
this is the unconditionally benevolent one, the name of Hari!
This is the one that pleases all Gods,
this is the protector of all the worlds,
this is the one that is revealed by the name of Venkatapathi,
the wealth of the destitute, is this name of Hari!
406407

item.title: १९५ एमि वलसिन निच्चु नॆप्पुडैननु
item.description:
Ēmi Valasina Niccu Neppuḍainanu
एमि वलसिन निच्चु नॆप्पुडैननु
एमऱक कॊलचिन नीतडे दैवमु ॥॥एमि॥
घनमुगा निन्दऱिकि गन्नु लिच्चु गाळ्ळिच्चु
पनिसेय जेतु लिच्चु बलियडै
तनु गॊलुवुमनि चित्तमु लिच्चु गरुणिञ्चि
वॊनर लोकानकॆल्ल नॊक्कडे दैवमु ॥॥एमि॥
मच्चिक तनु गॊलुव मनसिच्चु माटलिच्चु
कुच्चितमुलेनि कॊडुकुल निच्चुनु
चॊच्चिन चोटे चॊच्चि शुभ मिच्चु सुख मिच्चु
निच्चलु लोकानकॆल्ल निजमैन दैवमु ॥॥एमि॥
पन्तमाडि कॊलिचिन ब्राण मिच्चु प्राय मिच्चु
यॆन्तटि पदवुलैन निट्टॆ यिच्चु
विन्तविन्त विभवाल वेङ्कटेशु डिदे मा-
यन्तरङ्गमुन नुण्डे अरचेति दैवमु ॥॥एमि॥
ēmi valasina niccu neppuḍainanu
ēmaṟaka kolacina nītaḍē daivamu ….ēmi..
ghanamugā nindaṟiki gannu liccu gāḷḷiccu
panisēya jētu liccu baliyuḍai
tanu goluvumani cittamu liccu garuṇiñci
vonara lōkānakella nokkaḍē daivamu ….ēmi..
maccika tanu goluva manasiccu māṭaliccu
kuccitamulēni koḍukula niccunu
coccina cōṭē cocci śubha miccu sukha miccu
niccalu lōkānakella nijamaina daivamu ….ēmi..
pantamāḍi kolicina brāṇa miccu prāya miccu
yentaṭi padavulaina niṭṭe yiccu
vintavinta vibhavāla vēṅkaṭēśu ḍidē mā-
yantaraṅgamuna nuṇḍē aracēti daivamu ….ēmi..
He bestows at any time whatever is necessary,
if we worship Him without forgetting! He alone is the Lord!
Magnanimously He gives everyone eyes and limbs,
He gives hands with strength to engage in work
Compassionately He gives the heart for the purpose of worshipping Him
He alone is the Lord for the entire world!
To worship Him fondly, He gives the mind and speech
He is the one who gives good guileless progeny
Having entered within us, He bestows auspiciousness and happiness
Eternally for all the worlds, He is the true Lord!
If we worship Him assiduously, He bestows life and youth
The highest post, He easily bestows!
He is Lord Venkatesha, who is full of glories
He is the easily attainable Lord who resides in our innermost hearts!
408409

item.title: १९६ अतडु लक्ष्मीकान्तु डन्निय
item.description:
Ataḍu Lakṣmīkāntu Ḍanniyu
अतडु लक्ष्मीकान्तु डन्निय नॊसगुगाक
यितरुलवेडुकॊण्टे नेमि गलदु? ॥॥अतडु॥
मोदमुतो नॊकमानि मॊदलबोसिन नीरु
पादुकॊनि कॊनकॆक्कि फलिञ्चुगाक
आदिमूलमगु हरि नातुम सेविञ्चक
ये दैवमुलगन्ना नेमि सॆलवु? ॥॥अतडु॥
तल्लि भुजिञ्चिन वॆल्ला तगु गर्भमु शिशुवु
कॆल्लगाग बरिणाम मिच्चुगाक
उल्लमुलोपलि हरि कॊसगनि पूजलॆल्ला
वॆल्लि जिन्तपण्टिवलॆ वृथा वृथा ! ॥॥अतडु॥
ओलिनॆन्त जारिपड्ड नूरके यॆव्वरिकैना
नेले याधारमै निलुचुगाक,
तालिमि श्री वेङ्कटेशु दलचक तलचिना
पालिञ्च नातडेकाक परुलकु वशमा? ॥॥अतडु॥
ataḍu lakṣmīkāntu ḍanniyu nosagugāka
yitarulavēḍukoṇṭē nēmi galadu? ….ataḍu..
mōdamutō nokamāni modalabōsina nīru
pādukoni konakekki phaliñcugāka
ādimūlamagu hari nātuma sēviñcaka
yē daivamulagannā nēmi selavu? ….ataḍu..
talli bhujiñcina vellā tagu garbhamu śiśuvu
kellagāga bariṇāma miccugāka
ullamulōpali hari kosagani pūjalellā
velli jintapaṇṭivale vṛthā vṛthā ! ….ataḍu..
ōlinenta jāripaḍḍa nūrakē yevvarikainā
nēlē yādhāramai nilucugāka,
tālimi śrī vēṅkaṭēśu dalacaka talacinā
pāliñca nātaḍēkāka parulaku vaśamā? ….ataḍu..
He is the Lord of Lakshmi, who can bestow everything!
Pleading with others is of what use?
Only by joyously watering the base of a plant, the
water makes way to the top and bears fruit,
So too, without serving Hari, the primal cause (Adimoola)
worshipping other Gods is of what use?
Just as the food that the mother consumes, to the
baby in her womb, it reaches and nourishes,
So too, without offering worship to Hari, who is present within,
all goes wasteful, as a tamarind washed away in floods!
From wherever one slips and falls, whoever it may be
the ground remains the final support,
So too, whether you think or not, Sree Venkatesha
is the only savior, Can anybody else be??
Purport:
Just as watering the root of the plant is the only beneficial act, rather than watering each
flower separately, so too, only serving the supreme origin of all creation, Lord Vishnu, is
beneficial!
Just as the baby in the womb can be fed only through the mother, so too, there is no use
trying to worship all other Gods who are sustained by Lord Sree Hari!
410411

item.title: १९७ ऎदुरुलेक चरिन्तु रॆट्टैना
item.description:
Edurulēka Carintu Reṭṭainā
ऎदुरुलेक चरिन्तु रॆट्टैना श्री वैष्णवुलु
मदिञ्चि नेनुगुलकु मट्टुमेर वुन्नदा? ॥॥ऎदुरु॥
भागीरथिलोन बापमुन्नदा पुण्य
भोगपु वेदमुललो बॊङ्कु लुन्नवा?
सागरपु टमृतपु चविलो जे दुन्नदा?
आगति हरिदासुल कपराध मुन्नदा? ॥॥ऎदुरु॥
आकसमुलोन नॆरु सन्दुन्नदा भूमि
जेकॊनि रवि यॆदुट जीकटुन्नदा
यीकड गामधेनुवु किय्यरानि वुन्नवा?
कैकॊन्न प्रपन्नुलनु गरिहिञ्च नुन्नदा? ॥॥ऎदुरु॥
हरिनाम मन्त्रमुलो नौगामुलुन्नवा?
गुरुकृप गलिगिय गॊरतुन्नदा?
सरवि श्री वेङ्कटेशु शरणन्नवारिकि
विरसम्बु लन्दुलो वॆदकग गलदा? ॥॥ऎदुरु॥
edurulēka carintu reṭṭainā śrī vaiṣṇavulu
madiñci nēnugulaku maṭṭumēra vunnadā? ….eduru..
bhāgīrathilōna bāpamunnadā puṇya
bhōgapu vēdamulalō boṅku lunnavā?
sāgarapu ṭamṛtapu cavilō jē dunnadā?
āgati haridāsula kaparādha munnadā? ….eduru..
ākasamulōna neru sandunnadā bhūmi
jēkoni ravi yeduṭa jīkaṭunnadā
yīkaḍa gāmadhēnuvu kiyyarāni vunnavā?
kaikonna prapannulanu garihiñca nunnadā? ….eduru..
harināma mantramulō naugāmulunnavā?
gurukṛpa galigiyu goratunnadā?
saravi śrī vēṅkaṭēśu śaraṇannavāriki
virasambu landulō vedakaga galadā? ….eduru..
Without any fear of opposition, they move about, the Sree Vaishnavas!
For the mighty elephant, is there any limit?
Is there any sin in the pure Ganges?
Are there any lies in the sacred Vedas?
Is there any bitterness in the nectar born of the ocean?
In this manner, is there any sin for the servants of Hari?
Is there any breach in the expansive sky?
Will there be any darkness in front of the sun?
Is there anything that Kamadhenu cannot bestow?
So too, can any blame befall those who willingly become Prappannas?
In the pristine name of Hari, can there be any dualities?
Even after begetting the grace of a Guru, can there be any shortcomings?
For those who have surrendered to Sree Venkatapathi,
can there be any ill-will even if you search?
412413

item.title: १९८ कण्टिगण्टि निलुवु चक्कनिमेनु
item.description:
Kaṇṭigaṇṭi Niluvu Cakkanimēnu
कण्टिगण्टि निलुवु चक्कनिमेनु दण्डलुनु
नण्टुजापुलनु जाचे नव्वुमोमुदेवुनि॥॥कण्टि॥
कनकपु बादमुलु गज्जॆलु नन्दॆलुनु
घनपीताम्बरमु पैकट्टु कटारि
मॊनसि यॆड्डाणपु मॊगपुल मॊलनूलु
ऒनर नाभीकमल मुदरबन्धमुलु॥॥कण्टि॥
गरिम वरदहस्त कटिहस्तमुलुनु
सरस नॆत्तिन शङ्खचक्रहस्तमुलु
उरमु पै कौस्तुभ मॊप्पगु हारमुलु
… … … … …. …. ….॥कण्टि॥
कट्टिन कण्टसरुल घनभुजकीर्तुलु
कट्टाणिमुत्याल सिङ्गारनाममु
नॆट्टन श्रीवेङ्कटेश नीकु गर्णपत्रमुलु-
नट्टॆ सिरसुमीद नमरे किरीटमु ॥॥कण्टि॥
kaṇṭigaṇṭi niluvu cakkanimēnu daṇḍalunu
naṇṭujūpulanu jūcē navvumōmudēvuni….kaṇṭi..
kanakapu bādamulu gajjelu nandelunu
ghanapītāmbaramu paikaṭṭu kaṭāri
monasi yoḍḍāṇapu mogapula molanūlu
onara nābhīkamala mudarabandhamulu….kaṇṭi..
garima varadahasta kaṭihastamulunu
sarasa nettina śaṅkhacakrahastamulu
uramu pai kaustubha moppagu hāramulu
… … … … …. …. ……kaṇṭi..
kaṭṭina kaṇṭasarula ghanabhujakīrtulu
kaṭṭāṇimutyāla siṅgāranāmamu
neṭṭana śrīvēṅkaṭēśa nīku garṇapatramulu-
naṭṭe sirasumīda namarē kirīṭamu ….kaṇṭi..
I saw! I saw! The tall beautiful body decorated with garlands!
The one who casts mesmerizing looks, the Lord with the smiling face!
(I saw)
The golden feet, and the dazzling anklets with small bells
The golden couloured silk robes, the dagger tied over it! (I saw)
The beautiful waist belt and the clasping waist thread
For the stomach with a lotus like navel, a befitting belt! (I saw)
The great Varada Hasta and the Kati Hasta!
The hands that have upheld the Shanka-Chakra
The Kaustubha on the chest, and the befitting garlands (I saw)
————————————-——————————————
The closely tied necklaces, the great shoulder ornaments
The beautiful Tirunamam seeming like a string of pure pearls
Sree Venkatesha! For You there are these attractive ear-rings
Likewise, the befitting crown on Your head! (I saw)
414415

item.title: १९९ आदिमूलमे माकु अङ्गरक्ष
item.description:
Ādimūlamē Māku Aṃgarakṣa
आदिमूलमे माकु अङ्गरक्ष
श्रीदेवुडे माकु जीवरक्ष॥॥आदि॥
भूमिदेवि पतियैन पुरुषोत्तमुडॆ माकु
भूमिपै नेड नुण्डिन भूमिरक्ष
आमनि जलधिशायियैन देवुडे माकु
सामीप्यमन्दुन्न जलरक्ष॥॥आदि॥
व्रॆूयचु नग्निलो यज्ञमूर्तियैन देवुडु
आयमुलु ताककुण्ड अग्निरक्ष
वायसुतु नेलिनट्टि वनजनाभुडे माकु
वायवन्दु कन्दकुण्ड वायरक्ष॥॥आदि॥
पादमाकाशमुनकु पारजाचे विष्णुवे
गादिलियै माकु आकाशरक्ष
साधिञ्चि श्रीवेङ्कटाद्रि सर्वेश्वरुडॆ माकु
सादरमु मीरिनट्टि सर्वरक्ष॥॥आदि॥
ādimūlamē māku aṃgarakṣa
śrīdēvuḍē māku jīvarakṣa….ādi..
bhūmidēvi patiyaina puruṣōttamuḍe māku
bhūmipai nēḍa nuṇḍina bhūmirakṣa
āmani jaladhiśāyiyaina dēvuḍē māku
sāmīpyamandunna jalarakṣa….ādi..
mrōyucu nagnilō yajñamūrtiyaina dēvuḍu
āyamulu tākakuṇḍa agnirakṣa
vāyusutu nēlinaṭṭi vanajanābhuḍē māku
vāyuvandu kandakuṇḍa vāyurakṣa….ādi..
pādamākāśamunaku pārajācē viṣṇuvē
gādiliyai māku ākāśarakṣa
sādhiñci śrīvēṅkaṭādri sarvēśvaruḍe māku
sādaramu mīrinaṭṭi sarvarakṣa….ādi..
The Primal one (Adimoola) alone is our body protection
The Lord of Sree alone is our life protection!
The consort of Bhudevi, the Supreme Being, wherever we are
upon this earth, He is our earth protection!
The one who reclines on the vast ocean, that Lord alone
who is closely present with us, is our water protection!
The Lord present within the fire as the sacrificial deity
protecting our bodies from fire, He alone is our fire protection!
The Lord of the son of Wind God, the lotus naveled one alone
protecting us from being weathered, He is our wind protection!
The one who extended His foot into the sky, that Vishnu alone,
with total compassion, is our sky protection!
The Lord of Venkatadri, the Lord of all,
with supreme benevolence , He is our all-round protection!
416417

item.title: २०० इहमेगानि इक परमेगानि
item.description:
Ihamēgāni Ika Paramēgāni
इहमेगानि इक परमेगानि
बहुळमै हरि नीपै भक्ते चालु॥॥इहमे॥
ऎन्दु जनिञ्चिन नेमि यॆच्चोट नुन्ननेमि
कन्दुव नी दास्यमु गलिगिते चालु
अन्दि स्वर्गमेगानि अल नरकमेगानि
अन्दपु नी नाममु ना कब्बुटे चालु॥॥इहमे॥
दॊरयैन जालुगडु तुच्छपुबण्टैन जालु
करिगि निन्नु दलच गलिगिते चालु
परुलु मॆच्चिन मेलु पम्मि दूषिञ्चिन मेलु
हरि नी सेवापरुडौटे चालु॥॥इहमे॥
इल चदुवुलुरानी इटु राक माननी
तलपु नी पादमुल तगुले चालु
यॆलमि श्री वेङ्कटेश येलितिवि नन्नु निट्टॆ
चलपट्टि नाकु नी शरणमे चालु॥॥इहमे॥
ihamēgāni ika paramēgāni
bahuḷamai hari nīpai bhaktē cālu….ihamē..
eṃdu janiñcina nēmi yeccōṭa nunnanēmi
kanduva nī dāsyamu galigitē cālu
aṃdi svargamēgāni ala narakamēgāni
aṃdapu nī nāmamu nā kabbuṭē cālu….ihamē..
dorayaina jālugaḍu tucchapubaṇṭaina jālu
karigi ninnu dalaca galigitē cālu
parulu meccina mēlu pammi dūṣiñcina mēlu
hari nī sēvāparuḍauṭē cālu….ihamē..
ila caduvulurānī iṭu rāka mānanī
talapu nī pādamula tagulē cālu
yelami śrī vēṅkaṭēśa yēlitivi nannu niṭṭe
calapaṭṭi nāku nī śaraṇamē cālu….ihamē..
Whether here, or whether hereafter,
In many ways, O Hari, devotion for you is enough!
Where we are born, where we live, how does it matter?
A token of servitude to you, if possessed, is enough!
Be it heaven, or be it hell, how does it matter?
Your glorious name, if acquired, is enough!
Whether a ruler, or a lowly slave, how does it matter?
Being overcome by emotion, if I think about you, it is enough!
If praised by others, or spurned by others, how does it matter?
O Hari! Offering service unto you is enough!
Whether I am learned, or I am not, how does it matter?
If my thoughts reach unto your holy feet, it is enough!
Joyously, Sree Venkatesha, as you have reigned over me
constantly for me, your refuge alone is enough!
418419

item.title: २०१ एमिसेतु निन्दुकु मन्देमैन
item.description:
Ēmisētu Ninduku Mandēmaina
एमिसेतु निन्दुकु मन्देमैन बोयरादा
सामज गुरुड नीतो सङ्गमॊल्लदेटिके?॥एमि॥
मायल संसारमु मरिगिन कर्ममु
यी यॆड निनु मरुग देटिको हरि
कायज केलिपै दमि गलिगिन मनसु
कायजुतण्ड्रि नीपै गलुगु ददेटिके?॥एमि॥
नाटकपु गककमु नमकमिनट्टि बदुकु
येटिकि नी भक्ति नम्मदेले हरि
गूट बडे पदवुलु गोरेटि जीवुडु
कूटुवैन निजमुक्ति गोरिदि(डि)दि येटिकी?॥एमि॥
पाप पुण्यमुलकॆ पालुबड्ड नेनु
येपुन नीपाल जिक्कि नेलको हरि
श्रीपति नालोनि श्री वेङ्कटेशुड
नी पेरि वाड नाकु निण्डु मायलेटिकि?॥एमि॥
ēmisētu ninduku mandēmaina bōyarādā
sāmaja guruḍa nītō saṅgamolladēṭikē?..ēmi..
māyala saṃsāramu marigina karmamu
yī yeḍa ninu maruga dēṭikō hari
kāyaja kēlipai dami galigina manasu
kāyajutaṇḍri nīpai galugu dadēṭikē?..ēmi..
nāṭakapu gakakamu namakaminaṭṭi baduku
yēṭiki nī bhakti nammadēlē hari
gūṭa baḍē padavulu gōrēṭi jīvuḍu
kūṭuvaina nijamukti gōridi(ḍi)di yēṭikī?..ēmi..
pāpa puṇyamulake pālubaḍḍa nēnu
yēpuna nīpāla jikki nēlakō hari
śrīpati nālōni śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍa
nī pēri vāḍa nāku niṇḍu māyalēṭiki?..ēmi..
What can I do for this? Will You not give me some medicine?
Why do I never seek Your company, O father of Manmatha!
The karmas have become addicted to the Samsara which is full of Maya,
Likewise, why do I not get addicted to You, O Hari?
The mind which is eager to indulge in bodily pleasures,
Why does it not feel the same eagerness for You, O father of Manmatha!
The life which believes in the deceptive wealth of gold,
Why does it never believe in devotion for You, O Hari?
The Jiva which desires impermanent posts,
Why does it never desire the true eternal salvation?
Me who is engaged in both sinful and virtuous deeds
Why do I never come into Your fold, O Hari?
Sree-Pathi! O one who resides within! Sree Venkatesha!
When I possess (the power of) Your name, why this strong maya for me?
420421

item.title: २०२ तॆलिसिनं दॆलियण्डु तॆलियनि
item.description:
Telisinaṃ Deliyaṇḍu Teliyani
तॆलिसिनं दॆलियण्डु तॆलियनि वारलु
दॊलगुण्डु ब्रह्मादुलॆ यॆरुङ्गुदुरु!॥तॆलिसि॥
वरदं डखिल देवतलकु वन्द्युडु
गरडुं डसुरलकु गण्टकुण्डु
परमात्मुं डम्बुज भव शिवादुलकु
बरुलकॆल्ल मुव्वुरिलो नॊकण्डु !॥तॆलिसि॥
देवुण्डु सनकादि मुनुलकुनु बर
दैव मखिल वेदमुलकुनु
कैवल्यमॊसङ्गु घन निधि विधिकि
महाविधि जडुलकु यादवकुलुण्डु !॥तॆलिसि॥
आद्युं डचलुण्डु महाभूत मितं ड
भेद्युं डसाध्युण्डु भीकरुण्डु
सद्यः फलदुण्डु सकल मुनुलकुनु
वेद्युं डितण्डॆवो वेङ्कट विभुडु !॥तॆलिसि॥
telisinaṃ deliyaṇḍu teliyani vāralu
dolaguṇḍu brahmādule yeruṅguduru!..telisi..
varadaṃ ḍakhila dēvatalaku vandyuḍu
garaḍuṃ ḍasuralaku gaṇṭakuṇḍu
paramātmuṃ ḍambuja bhava śivādulaku
barulakella muvvurilō nokaṇḍu !..telisi..
dēvuṇḍu sanakādi munulakunu bara
daiva makhila vēdamulakunu
kaivalyamosaṅgu ghana nidhi vidhiki
mahāvidhi jaḍulaku yādavakuluṇḍu !..telisi..
ādyuṃ ḍacaluṇḍu mahābhūta mitaṃ ḍa
bhēdyuṃ ḍasādhyuṇḍu bhīkaruṇḍu
sadyaḥ phaladuṇḍu sakala munulakunu
vēdyuṃ ḍitaṇḍevō vēṅkaṭa vibhuḍu !..telisi..
Even upon knowing, He will not be known! Those who do not know,
move away! Only Brahma and other such beings will know!
He is the bestower of boons to all other deities,
object of reverence for Garuda, destroyer of the demons,
the supreme God even to Brahma and Shiva !
But for others, He is just one among the trinity!
He is the Lord for Sanaka and other sages
For the entire Vedas, He alone is the Supreme Lord
He is the Supreme treasure bestowed by salvation! For fate itself, He is
the Supreme fate! But for the ignorant He is just one of the Yadava clan!
The Primal one, the Unwavering, the Supreme Spirit
The Indestructible, the Extraordinary, the Terrifying one!
The one who bestows fruits instantly, for all sages He alone
is the object of Knowledge, this Venkata Vibhudu!!!
422423

item.title: २०३ नडवरॊ जडियक नव्यमार्गमिदि
item.description:
Naḍavaro Jaḍiyaka Navyamārgamidi
नडवरॊ जडियक नव्यमार्गमिदि
मडुगदि वैष्णव मार्गमिदि !॥नड॥
घन शुकमुख्युलु गन्न मार्गमिदि
जनकादुल निश्चल मार्गमिदि
सनत्कुमारुडु जरपु मार्गमिदि
मनुवुल वैष्णव मार्गमिदि !॥नड॥
नलुगड वसिष्ठु नडुचु मार्गमिदि
यिल वेद व्यासुल मार्गम्बिदि
बलिमिगलुगु धृवपट्टपु मार्गमु
मलसिन वैष्णव मार्गमिदि !॥नड॥
परम मार्गम्बिदॆ प्रपञ्च मार्गमु
गुरु मार्गम्बिदॆ गोप्यमिदे
गरिमॆल श्री वेङ्कटपति माकुनु
मरिपॆनु वैष्णव मार्गमिदि !॥नड॥
naḍavaro jaḍiyaka navyamārgamidi
maḍugadi vaiṣṇava mārgamidi !..naḍa..
ghana śukamukhyulu ganna mārgamidi
janakādula niścala mārgamidi
sanatkumāruḍu jarapu mārgamidi
manuvula vaiṣṇava mārgamidi !..naḍa..
nalugaḍa vasiṣṭhu naḍucu mārgamidi
yila vēda vyāsula mārgambidi
balimigalugu dhṛvapaṭṭapu mārgamu
malasina vaiṣṇava mārgamidi !..naḍa..
parama mārgambide prapañca mārgamu
guru mārgambide gōpyamidē
garimela śrī vēṅkaṭapati mākunu
maripenu vaiṣṇava mārgamidi !..naḍa..
Tread upon this fearlessly, a new path this is!
The path which is pure, the Vaishnava marga!
This is the path perceived by great ones like Shuka and others
This is the constant path of Janaka and others
This is the path followed by Sanat-Kumara
This is the Vaishnava marga of the fourteen Manus!
This is the path that Vasista followed
This is the path of Veda Vyasa and others
This is the path firmly adopted by Dhruva
This is the superior Vaishnava marga!
This is the supreme path, the path of the world
This is the path of Guru1, the secretive one!
The great Sree Venkatapathi Himself
bestowed upon us, this Vaishnava marga!
1. Sree Ramanujacharya
424425

item.title: २०४ कलियगम्बुनकु गलदिदिये
item.description:
Kaliyugambunaku Galadidiyē
कलियगम्बुनकु गलदिदिये
वॆलसिन पञ्चमवेदमॆ कलिगॆ॥॥कलि॥
बोधल हरि नुति पॊडमॆनु शूद्र
स्साधनि कलिदोषमु मान्प
राधामाधव रचन सकलजन
साधुवेदमे जगमुन गलिगॆ ॥॥कलि॥
परमगु वेदमु बहुळमु चदिविय
हरिनॆरिगिन वा ररुदनुचु
तिरुवामुडियै दिव्यमन्त्रमै
वॆलसिन (?) पञ्चम वेदमॆ कलिगॆ॥॥कलि॥
बिङ्कपु मनुजुलु पॆक्कुलु चदिविय
सङ्कॆदीरदॆच्चट ननुचु
सङ्कीर्तनमे सकललोकमुल
वॆङ्कटेश्वरुनि वेदमॆ कलिगॆ॥॥कलि॥
kaliyugambunaku galadidiyē
velasina pañcamavēdame kalige….kali..
bōdhala hari nuti poḍamenu śūdra
ssādhani kalidōṣamu mānpa
rādhāmādhava racana sakalajana
sādhuvēdamē jagamuna galige ….kali..
paramagu vēdamu bahuḷamu cadiviyu
harinerigina vā rarudanucu
tiruvāmuḍiyai divyamantramai
velasina (?) pañcama vēdame kalige….kali..
biṅkapu manujulu pekkulu cadiviyu
saṅkedīradeccaṭa nanucu
saṅkīrtanamē sakalalōkamula
veṅkaṭēśvaruni vēdame kalige….kali..
This is there for us in Kaliyuga!
It has manifested as the ‘Panchama Veda’!
It filled the mind with the knowledge of Hari
to prevent the lowly practices of the evil Kali-yuga!
Preaching Radha-Madhava’s tattva
it appeared in the world as the benevolent Veda!
Even after studying extensively the supreme Vedas
those who can know Hari are rare!
So the Sankirtana appeared in the form of the Tiruvaimozi
as the Divya-mantra and as the Panchama-Veda!
Even after studying greatly, the doubts of the rigid people
can never be clarified!
So the Sankirtana filled all the worlds
and appeared as Sree Venkateshwara’s Veda!
426427

item.title: २०५ इतर मॆरग गति यिदियॆ शरण्यमु
item.description:
Itara Meraga Gati Yidiye Śaraṇyamu
इतर मॆरग गति यिदियॆ शरण्यमु
सतत पूर्णुनिकि शरण्यमु ॥॥इतर॥
सर्व लोकमुल साक्षै काचिन
सर्वेश्वरुनकु शरण्यमु
उर्विकि मिण्टिकि नॊक्कट बॆरगिन
सार्वभौमुनकु शरण्यमु ॥॥इतर॥
श्रीकान्त नुरमु चॆङ्गट निलिपिन
साकारुनकुनु शरण्यमु
पैकॊनि वॆलिगॆटि परं ज्योतियै (Еौ)
सौकुमारुनकुनु शरण्यमु ॥॥इतर॥
तग निहपरमुलु दासुल कॊसगॆटि
जगदीश्वरुनकु शरण्यमु
नगु श्री वॆङ्कट नाधुड नीकु
सगुण मूर्ति यिदॆ शरण्यमु ॥॥इतर॥
itara meraga gati yidiye śaraṇyamu
satata pūrṇuniki śaraṇyamu ….itara..
sarva lōkamula sākṣai kācina
sarvēśvarunaku śaraṇyamu
urviki miṇṭiki nokkaṭa beragina
sārvabhaumunaku śaraṇyamu ….itara..
śrīkānta nuramu ceṅgaṭa nilipina
sākārunakunu śaraṇyamu
paikoni veligeṭi paraṃ jyōtiyai (yau)
saukumārunakunu śaraṇyamu ….itara..
taga nihaparamulu dāsula kosageṭi
jagadīśvarunaku śaraṇyamu
nagu śrī veṅkaṭa nādhuḍa nīku
saguṇa mūrti yide śaraṇyamu ….itara..
I know not any other thing, the means is only this, Surrender unto Him!
The eternally perfect one, Surrender unto Him!
The one who is the witness of all worlds, the Protector,
the Lord of all, Surrender unto Him!
The one who measured the earth and sky in one step,
the emperor of the universe, Surrender unto Him!
The one who placed Goddess Sree closely onto His chest,
the one who possess a true form, Surrender unto Him!
High above, the one who shines brilliantly as the Supreme effulgence,
the eternally youthful one, Surrender unto Him!
The one who blesses His daasas here and hereafter,
the Lord of all the worlds, Surrender unto Him!
O Lord Sree Venkatanatha, O Saguna deity,
unto You I surrender!
428429

item.title: २०६ अन्निटिकि मूलं बतडु
item.description:
Anniṭiki Mūlaṃ Bataḍu
अन्निटिकि मूलं बतडु
वॆन्नुनि कण्टॆनु वेल्पुलु लेरु !॥अन्नि॥
पञ्च भूतमुल प्रपञ्च मूलमु
मुञ्चिन ब्रह्मकु मूलमु
पॊञ्चिन जीवुल पुट्टुगु मूलमु
यॆञ्चग दैवमु यितडे काडा !॥अन्नि॥
वॆनुकॊनि पॊगडॆटि वेदाल मूलमु
मुनुल तपमुलकु मूलमु
घन यज्ञादुल कर्मपु मूलमु
यॆनलेनि दैवमितडे काडा !॥अन्नि॥
अगपडि सुरलकु नमृत मूलमु
मुगुरु मूर्तुलकु मूलमु
नगु श्री वॆङ्कट नाथुडे मूलमु
यॆगुव लोकपति यितडे काडा !॥अन्नि॥
anniṭiki mūlaṃ bataḍu
vennuni kaṇṭenu vēlpulu lēru !..anni..
pañca bhūtamula prapañca mūlamu
muñcina brahmaku mūlamu
poñcina jīvula puṭṭugu mūlamu
yeñcaga daivamu yitaḍē kāḍā !..anni..
venukoni pogaḍeṭi vēdāla mūlamu
munula tapamulaku mūlamu
ghana yajñādula karmapu mūlamu
yenalēni daivamitaḍē kāḍā !..anni..
agapaḍi suralaku namṛta mūlamu
muguru mūrtulaku mūlamu
nagu śrī veṅkaṭa nāthuḍē mūlamu
yeguva lōkapati yitaḍē kāḍā !..anni..
For everything, He is the origin
But for Vennudu1, there are no other Gods!
For the five elements and the whole universe, being the origin,
For the Primal Brahma, being the origin,
For the birth of all Jivas, being the origin,
To seek, is ‘He’ not the God!
For the Vedas that constantly praise(Him), being the origin,
For the penance of the sages, being the basis,
For the various works such as Yagnas, being the object of worship
Is ‘He’ not the matchless God!
For the Devathas to perceive the amrutha, being the cause,
For the divine trinity, being the Primal Cause!
He who is all this, that Sree Venkateshwara, is ‘The Origin’
Is He not the Lord of the higher worlds!
1. Vennudu is Lord Krishna
430431

item.title: २०७ मूडे माटलु
item.description:
Mūḍē Māṭalu
मूडे माटलु मूडुमूण्ड्लु तॊम्मिदि
वेडुकॊनि चदुवरो वेदान्त रहस्यमु ॥॥मूडे॥
जीवस्वरूपमु चिन्तिञ्चि ऎन्त तानु
देवुनि वैभवमु तॆलिसि
भाविञ्चि प्रकृति सम्पद इदि यॆरुगुटे
वेवेल विधमुल वेदान्त रहस्यमु ॥॥मूडे॥
तनलोनि ज्ञानमु तप्पकुण्डा तलपोसि
पनितोड नन्दुवल्ल भक्ति निलिपि
मनिकिगा वैराग्यमु मरुवकुण्डुटे
विनवलसिनयट्टि वेदान्त रहस्यमु॥॥मूडे॥
वेडुकतो नाचार्य विश्वासमु गलिगि
जाडल शरणागति साधनमुतो
कूडि श्रीवेङ्कटेश्वरु गॊलिचि दासुडौटे
वीडनि ब्रह्मानन्द वेदान्त रहस्यमु॥॥मूडे॥
mūḍē māṭalu mūḍumūṇḍlu tommidi
vēḍukoni caduvarō vēdānta rahasyamu ….mūḍē..
jīvasvarūpamu cintiñci eṃta tānu
dēvuni vaibhavamu telisi
bhāviñci prakṛti sampada idi yeruguṭē
vēvēla vidhamula vēdānta rahasyamu ….mūḍē..
tanalōni jñānamu tappakuṇḍā talapōsi
panitōḍa nanduvalla bhakti nilipi
manikigā vairāgyamu maruvakuṇḍuṭē
vinavalasinayaṭṭi vēdānta rahasyamu….mūḍē..
vēḍukatō nācārya viśvāsamu galigi
jāḍala śaraṇāgati sādhanamutō
kūḍi śrīvēṅkaṭēśvaru golici dāsuḍauṭē
vīḍani brahmānanda vēdānta rahasyamu….mūḍē..
Only three words! Three threes are nine!
With utmost delight, study this secret of Vedanta!
Contemplating about the nature of the self,
and comprehending the glory of the Lord
realizing this as the wealth of Prakriti,
this itself, in thousands of ways, is the secret of Vedanta!
Relying on the knowledge that lies within oneself,
continuing to perform work daily and yet engaging in Devotion,
being wise and never forgetting to be dispassionate,
this itself is the secret of Vedanta that needs to be heard and followed!
With utmost fervor, placing total faith in Acharya,
here itself performing ‘Sharanagati’, also,
worshipping Sree Venkateswara, becoming His dasa,
this itself is the unchanging supremely blissful secret of Vedanta!
432433

item.title: २०८ तॆरवकुपतिवैतिवि
item.description:
Teravakupativaitivi
तॆऱवकुबतिवै तिवि गाक
गऱिसिञ्चिनगडुघनमा नीवु॥॥तॆऱ॥
चूचिनवॆल्ला सॊम्पुमुत्यमुलु
पूचिनपुव्वुलॆ पुन्नमुलु
लाचिनवॆल्ला लागवेगमुलु
यी चॆलि सॊबगुल कॆदुरा नीवु ॥॥तॆऱ॥
पलिकिनवॆल्ला पसनि वज्रमुलु
निलुवुनदुरमे नीलमुलु
कलिगिनपुलकलॆ कनकपु मॊलकलु
जलजलोचनकु सरिया नीवु ॥॥तॆऱ॥
कौगिटिवॆल्ला गन्तुनिरचनलु
मूगिनरति निनु मुञ्चॆ निदॆ
चेगल चिगुरुल श्रीवेङ्कटपति
वी गेटिरमणिकि विन्ता नीवु ॥॥तॆऱ॥
teṟavakubativai tivi gāka
gaṟisiñcinagaḍughanamā nīvu….teṟa..
cūcinavellā sompumutyamulu
pūcinapuvvule punnamulu
lācinavellā lāgavēgamulu
yī celi sobagula kedurā nīvu ….teṟa..
palikinavellā pasani vajramulu
niluvunaduramē nīlamulu
kaliginapulakale kanakapu molakalu
jalajalōcanaku sariyā nīvu ….teṟa..
kaugiṭivellā gantuniracanalu
mūginarati ninu muñce nide
cēgala cigurula śrīvēṅkaṭapati
vī gēṭiramaṇiki vintā nīvu ….teṟa..
Since You are the Lord of Sree,
You became the supremely great one, is it not?
Whatever you behold in Her are perfect pearls,
She is like the full bloomed flowers, like the full moon!
Her ever pervading beauty is all attractive,
Are You a match for Her beauty!
All the words She speaks are like tough diamonds,
Her tresses are like blue sapphire,
Her goose flesh is like golden saplings,
Are You a match for this lotus eyed goddess?
Her embraces are enticed by Manmatha,
She floods you with amorous love making!
O capable Lord Sree Venkatapathi,
are You a match for this proud lady?
434435

item.title: २०९ चालदाहरिनाम सौख्यामृतमु
item.description:
Cāladāharināma Saukhyāmṛtamu
चालदाहरिनाम सौख्यामृतमु दमकु
चालदा हितवैन चवुलॆल्ल नॊसग ॥॥चालदा॥
इदियॆकटि हरिनाम मिन्तैन जालदा
चॆदर की जन्ममुल चॆऱलु विडिपिञ्च
मदि नॊकटॆ हरिनाममन्त्र मदि चालदा
पदिवेलु नरककूपमुल वॆडलिञ्च ॥॥चालदा॥
कलदॊकटि हरिनामकनकाद्रि चालदा
तॊलगुमनि दारिद्यदोषम्बु चॆऱच
तॆलिवॊकटि हरिनामदीप मदि चालदा
कलुषम्पु कठिन चीकटि पारद्रोल॥॥चालदा॥
तगुवेङ्कटेशु कीर्तन मॊकटि चालदा
जगमुलो कल्पभूजम्बुवलॆ नुण्ड
सॊगिसि यी विभुनि दासुल करुण चालदा
नगवु जापुलनु नुन्नत मॆपुडु जाप ॥॥चालदा॥
cāladāharināma saukhyāmṛtamu damaku
cāladā hitavaina cavulella nosaga ….cāladā..
idiyokaṭi harināma mintaina jāladā
cedara kī janmamula ceṟalu viḍipiñca
madi nokaṭe harināmamantra madi cāladā
padivēlu narakakūpamula veḍaliñca.. ..cāladā..
kaladokaṭi harināmakanakādri cāladā
tolagumani dāridyadōṣambu ceṟaca
telivokaṭi harināmadīpa madi cāladā
kaluṣampu kaṭhina cīkaṭi pāradrōla….cāladā..
taguvēṅkaṭēśu kīrtana mokaṭi cāladā
jagamulō kalpabhūjambuvale nuṇḍa
sogisi yī vibhuni dāsula karuṇa cāladā
nagavu jūpulanu nunnata mepuḍu jūpa ….cāladā..
Does it not suffice, the pleasurable nectar of the name of Hari, for you?
Does it not suffice, to bestow all benevolent wishes?
This one name of Hari, is it not enough,
to free us from the shackles of this birth?
This one name of Hari, is it not enough, when present in the heart,
to liberate us from even thousands of dungeons of hell?
The one which is there, the golden mountain like name of Hari,
is it not enough to abolish the curse of penury?
The knowledge called the lamp of the name of Hari, is it not enough
to drive away the imperfections of the deep darkness of ignorance?
Just one benevolent Venkatesha Kirtana, does it not suffice,
being the wish yielding tree in this world?
Joyfully, the compassion of the Lord’s devotees, is it not enough
to bestow eternal prosperity?
436437

item.title: २१० तॆलिसिनवारिकि देवुण्डितडे
item.description:
Telisinavāriki Dēvuṇḍitaḍē
तॆलिसिनवारिकि देवुण्डितडे
वलवनि दुष्टुल वादमुलेल ॥॥तॆलि॥
पुरुषुललोपल पुरुषोत्तमुडु
नरुललोन नरनारायणुडु
परदैवमुलकु परमेश्वरुडु
वरुसमूढुल कॆव्वरोयितडु ॥॥तॆलि॥
पलुब्रह्मलकुनु परब्रह्ममु
मलयनीशुलकु महेशुडितडु
इलनात्मललो निटुपरमात्मुडु
खलुलकॆट्लुण्डुनो कानमु यितडु ॥॥तॆलि॥
वेदम्बुललो वेदान्तवेद्युडु
सोदिञ्चकरिगाचुचो नादिमूलमु
यीदॆस श्री वेङ्कटेशुडिन्दरिकि
गादिलिमतुलनु गैकॊनडितडु ॥॥तॆलि॥
telisinavāriki dēvuṇḍitaḍē
valavani duṣṭula vādamulēla ….teli..
puruṣulalōpala puruṣōttamuḍu
narulalōna naranārāyaṇuḍu
paradaivamulaku paramēśvaruḍu
varusamūḍhula kevvarōyitaḍu ….teli..
palubrahmalakunu parabrahmamu
malayunīśulaku mahēśuḍitaḍu
ilanātmalalō niṭuparamātmuḍu
khalulakeṭluṇḍunō kānamu yitaḍu ….teli..
vēdambulalō vēdāntavēdyuḍu
sōdiñcakarigācucō nādimūlamu
yīdesa śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍindariki
gādilimatulanu gaikonaḍitaḍu ….teli..
For those who are learned, He is ‘THE’ Lord,
With the evil who cavil, why argue?
Within the beings, He is the Supreme Being
Within (Naras) humans, He is ‘Narayana’
For the supreme Gods, He is the Supreme Overlord!
To the utterly ignorant, what could He be?
For the innumerable Brahmas*, He is the ‘Supreme Brahman’
For the numerous Shivas* of the mountains, He is the ‘Maheswara’
For these numerous individual selves here, He is the Supreme self
For the lowly sinners, what He is, is beyond our comprehension!
He is the one to be known from the Vedas and Vedanta
He is the ‘Adimoola’ who saved the pleading elephant!
In this manner, is Sree Venkatesha for everybody
Ignorant minds, He will not accept!
* A plural is used here because a new Shiva and a new Brahma appear
in each creative cycle and there are an infinite number of them. The
use of plural thus shows the impossibility of identity between these
numerous deities and the Lord who is unique. The Lord is thus different
from all other Gods and is superior to them.
438439

item.title: २११ गरुडध्वजं बॆक्कॆ कमलाक्षु पॆण्ड्लिकि
item.description:
