Garuḍadhvajaṃ Bekke Kamalākṣu Peṇḍliki
गरुडध्वजं बॆक्कॆ कमलाक्षु पॆण्ड्लिकि
परुष लदिवो वच्चॆ बैपै सेविञ्चनु॥॥गरुड॥
पाडिरि सोबाननदे भारतिय गिरिजय
आडिरि रम्भादुलैन अच्चरलॆल्ल
कूडिरि देवत लॆल्ल गुम्पुलै श्री वॆङ्कटाद्रि
वेडुकलु मीरग श्री विभुनि पॆण्ड्लिकिनि॥॥गरुड॥
कुरिसॆ बुव्वल वान कुप्पलै यॆन्दु चूचिन
मॊरसॆ देवदुन्दुभि व्रॆूतलॆल्लनु
बॆरसॆ सम्पदलॆल्ल पण्टलै श्री वेङ्कटाद्रि
तिरमै मिञ्चिन देवदेवुनि पॆण्ड्लिकिनि ॥॥गरुड॥
वेसिरि कानुकलॆल्ल वेवेलु कॊप्पॆरल
पोसि रदे तलबालु पुण्यसतुलु
आसल श्री वेङ्कटेशुडल मेलु मङ्गादासु
सेसलु वॆट्टिनयट्टि सिङ्गारपु पॆण्ड्लिकि ॥॥गरुड।
garuḍadhvajaṃ bekke kamalākṣu peṇḍliki
paruṣa ladivō vacce baipai sēviñcanu….garuḍa..
pāḍiri sōbānanadē bhāratiyu girijayu
āḍiri rambhādulaina accaralella
kūḍiri dēvata lella gumpulai śrī veṅkaṭādri
vēḍukalu mīraga śrī vibhuni peṇḍlikini….garuḍa..
kurise buvvala vāna kuppalai yendu cūcina
morase dēvadundubhi mrōtalellanu
berase sampadalella paṇṭalai śrī vēṅkaṭādri
tiramai miñcina dēvadēvuni peṇḍlikini ….garuḍa..
vēsiri kānukalella vēvēlu kopperala
pōsi radē talabālu puṇyasatulu
āsala śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍala mēlu maṅgādāsu
sēsalu veṭṭinayaṭṭi siṅgārapu peṇḍliki ….garuḍa.
The Garuda flags were hoisted for the wedding of the lotus eyed Lord
Behold! The eminent ones are here to serve Him!
Goddess Saraswathi and Goddess Parvathi sang the benedictions,
Rambha and other celestial nymphs danced gracefully,
All the Devathas gathered in groups upon Sree Venkatadri hill,
to participate in the auspicious wedding ceremony of the Lord of Sree!
There was a shower of flowers forming heaps all around,
The sounds of the divine trumpets resonated,
All riches spread out like vast fields on Venkatadri hill,
For the Supreme, Eternal Lord’s wedding!
Thousands and thousands of gifts were offered,
The yellow rice grains were showered on them by blessed women,
Sree Venkatesha and Sree Alamelumanga lovingly showered upon
each other, the yellow rice grains, during their beautiful wedding!
440441

item.title: २१२ हरिनाममु कडु आनन्दकरमु
item.description:
Harināmamu Kaḍu Ānandakaramu
हरिनाममु कडु आनन्दकरमु
मरगवो, मरुगवो, मरुगवो मनसा ॥॥हरि॥
नळिनाक्षुनि श्रीनाममु
कलिदोष हरमु कैवल्यमु
फलसारमु बहु बन्ध मोचनमु
तलचवो, तलचवो, तलचवो मनसा ॥॥हरि॥
नगधरुनाममु, नरक हरणमु
जगदेक हितमु सम्मतमु
सगुण निर्गुणमु, साक्षात्कारमु
पॊगडवो, पॊगडवो, पॊगडवो मनसा ॥॥हरि॥
कडगि श्री वेङ्कटपति नाममु
बडि बडिसे सम्पत्करमु
अडियालम्बिल अति सुखमूलमु
तडववो, तडववो, तडववो मनसा ॥॥हरि॥
harināmamu kaḍu ānandakaramu
maragavō, marugavō, marugavō manasā ….hari..
naḷinākṣuni śrīnāmamu
kalidōṣa haramu kaivalyamu
phalasāramu bahu bandha mōcanamu
talacavō, talacavō, talacavō manasā ….hari..
nagadharunāmamu, naraka haraṇamu
jagadēka hitamu sammatamu
saguṇa nirguṇamu, sākṣātkāramu
pogaḍavō, pogaḍavō, pogaḍavō manasā ….hari..
kaḍagi śrī vēṅkaṭapati nāmamu
baḍi baḍisē sampatkaramu
aḍiyālambila ati sukhamūlamu
taḍavavō, taḍavavō, taḍavavō manasā ….hari..
The name of ‘Hari’ is supremely blissful!
Take shelter, take shelter, take shelter O mind!
The divine name of the Lotus eyed one,
the destroyer of the sins of ‘kali’, the beatitude bestowing one
the fruitful one, the one which delivers from many attachments
Contemplate, contemplate, contemplate O mind!
The name of the one who held up the mountain, the destroyer of hell
the only one which is benevolent for the entire world, the agreeable one
the one with attributes beyond the gunas, the manifested one
Praise, praise, praise O mind!
The purifying name of Sree Venkateshwara,
the one which instantly bestows prosperity,
the great support here, the origin of supreme bliss,
Seek, seek, seek O mind!!
442443

item.title: २१३ पलिकॆडि वेदमे
item.description:
Palikeḍi Vēdamē
पलिकॆडि वेदमे प्रमाणमु
तलचिन वारिकि तत्वमु सुण्डी॥॥पलिकॆडि॥
नरहरि यजाण्ड नायकुडु
सुरलित निने संस्तुञ्चिरि
पुरुषोत्तमुडु इदे भूमिकि
ई हरि कॊलवनिवारु असुरुलु सुण्डी॥॥पलिकॆडि॥
कमलारमणुडे घनुडु
अमरुले म्रॊक्कुदुरातनिकि
विमतुल तुनिमे विष्णुडु
तमि पूजिञ्चगा तगु गतिलेदु॥॥पलिकॆडि॥
भावज जनकुडु ब्रह्ममु
त्रोवगा कॊलिचिरि शुकादुलु
श्री वेङ्कटपति चॆलुवुडु
दैवशिखामणि तलचरा विबुडु॥॥पलिकॆडि॥
palikeḍi vēdamē pramāṇamu
talacina vāriki tatvamu suṇḍī….palikeḍi..
narahari yajāṇḍa nāyakuḍu
suralita ninē saṃstuñciri
puruṣōttamuḍu idē bhūmiki
ī hari kolavanivāru asurulu suṇḍī….palikeḍi..
kamalāramaṇuḍē ghanuḍu
amarulē mrokkudurātaniki
vimatula tunimē viṣṇuḍu
tami pūjiñcagā tagu gatilēdu….palikeḍi..
bhāvaja janakuḍu brahmamu
trōvagā koliciri śukādulu
śrī vēṅkaṭapati celuvuḍu
daivaśikhāmaṇi talacarā vibuḍu….palikeḍi..
The words proclaimed by the Vedas are the authority!
For those who understand and accept it, it is the eternal truth!
Lord Nara-Hari is the sole ruler of the cosmic egg,
all the divinities praise this Lord alone!
He is the Purushottama for this earth,
those who do not worship this Lord Hari are but demoniac in nature!
The consort of Lakshmi is the supremely great one,
the celestial divinities themselves offer their salutations to Him!
Vishnu is the one who cuts asunder the evil ones,
there is no other appropriate means other than worshipping Him!
The father of Manmatha is the Supreme Brahman!
Taking Him alone as the means, sage Suka and others worshipped Him!
Sree Venkatapathi is the true friend,
the learned ones seek this crest jewel among Gods!
Annamacharya sings here the essence of the works of Ramanujacharya like
The Sree-Bhasya, The Vedanta Sara, The Vedartha Samgraha etc, to prove that the
Vedas are the supreme authority, and thus Lord Vishnu, having been glorified by the
Vedas, qualifies as the Supreme Brahman.
444445

item.title: २१४ सतुलाल चूडरे श्रावण
item.description:
Satulāla Cūḍarē Śrāvaṇa
सतुलाल चूडरे श्रावण बहुळाष्टमि
कतलाय नडुरेयि कलिगॆ श्रीकृष्णुडु ॥॥सतुलाल॥
पुट्टेयपुडे चतुर्भुजालु शङ्खुचक्रालु
ऎट्टु धरियिञ्चॆने यी कृष्णुडु
अट्टे किरीटमु आभरणालु धरिञ्चि
ऎट्ट ऎदुट वुन्नाडु ई कृष्णुडु ॥॥सतुलाल॥
वच्चि ब्रह्मयरुद्रुडु वाकिट नुतियिञ्चगानु
इच्चगिञ्चि विनुचुन्नाडी कृष्णुडु
मुच्चटाडी देवकितो मुञ्चि वसुदेवुनितो
हॆच्चिन महिमलतो ई कृष्णुडु ॥॥सतुलाल॥
कॊददीर मरि नन्दगोपुनकु यशोदकु
इदिवो ता बिड्डडायॆ नी कृष्णुडु
अदन श्री वेङ्कटेशुडै अलमेल्मङ्गगूडि
ऎदुटने वुन्नाडु ई कृष्णुडु ॥॥सतुलाल॥
satulāla cūḍarē śrāvaṇa bahuḷāṣṭami
katalāya naḍurēyi kalige śrīkṛṣṇuḍu ….satulāla..
puṭṭēyapuḍē caturbhujālu śaṅkhucakrālu
eṭṭu dhariyiñcenē yī kṛṣṇuḍu
aṭṭē kirīṭamu ābharaṇālu dhariñci
eṭṭa eduṭa vunnāḍu ī kṛṣṇuḍu ….satulāla..
vacci brahmayurudruḍu vākiṭa nutiyiñcagānu
iccagiñci vinucunnāḍī kṛṣṇuḍu
muccaṭāḍī dēvakitō muñci vasudēvunitō
heccina mahimalatō ī kṛṣṇuḍu ….satulāla..
kodadīra mari nandagōpunaku yaśōdaku
idivō tā biḍḍaḍāye nī kṛṣṇuḍu
adana śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍai alamēlmaṅgagūḍi
eduṭanē vunnāḍu ī kṛṣṇuḍu ….satulāla..
Behold O women folk! It is Sravana bahula Astami!
He was born at midnight, this Sree Krishna!
Even from birth he had four arms and
weilded the Shanka-Chakra, this Krishna!
So too, wearing the crown and ornaments
He is right in front, this Krishna!
Even as Lord Shiva and Brahma praise Him at the doorway,
He is listening and enjoying, this Krishna!
Sharing some banter with Devaki and immersing
Vasudeva in joy, with great glory is this Krishna!
He was born as a son to Nanda-Gopa and Yashoda
making up for their want of a child!
As Sree Venkatesha He united with Alamelumanga,
He is the one standing right in front, this Krishna!
446447

item.title: २१५ चूडरम्मा सतुलाल
item.description:
Cūḍarammā Satulāla
चूडरम्मा सतुलाल सोबान पाडरम्म
कूडुन्नदि पति चूडिकुडुत नाञ्चारि ॥॥चूडरम्मा॥
श्रीमहालक्ष्मि यट सिङ्गारालके मरुदु
कामुनि तल्लियट चक्कदनालके मरुदु
सोमुनि तोबुट्टवट सॊम्पु कळलके मरुदु
कोमलाङ्गि ई चूडिकुडुत नाञ्चारि ॥॥चूडरम्मा॥
कलशाब्धि कूतुरट गम्भीरालके मरुदु
तलप लोकमातयट दय मरि एमरुदु
जलज निवासिनियट चल्लदन मेमरुदु
कॊलदि मीर ई चूडिकुडुत नाञ्चारि ॥॥चूडरम्मा॥
अमर वन्दितयट अट्टे महिम एमरुदु
अमृतमु चुट्टमट आनन्दालकेमरुदु
तमितो श्री वेङ्कटेशु तानॆ वच्चि पॆण्ड्लाडे
कॊमॆर वयस्सु ई चूडिकुडुत नाञ्चारि ॥॥चूडरम्मा॥
cūḍarammā satulāla sōbāna pāḍaramma
kūḍunnadi pati cūḍikuḍuta nāñcāri ….cūḍarammā..
śrīmahālakṣmi yaṭa siṅgārālakē marudu
kāmuni talliyaṭa cakkadanālakē marudu
sōmuni tōbuṭṭavaṭa sompu kaḷalakē marudu
kōmalāṅgi ī cūḍikuḍuta nāñcāri ….cūḍarammā..
kalaśābdhi kūturaṭa gambhīrālakē marudu
talapa lōkamātayaṭa daya mari ēmarudu
jalaja nivāsiniyaṭa calladana mēmarudu
koladi mīra ī cūḍikuḍuta nāñcāri ….cūḍarammā..
amara vanditayaṭa aṭṭē mahima ēmarudu
amṛtamu cuṭṭamaṭa ānandālakēmarudu
tamitō śrī vēṅkaṭēśu tāne vacci peṇḍlāḍē
komera vayassu ī cūḍikuḍuta nāñcāri ….cūḍarammā..
Behold O women folk! Sing the songs of benediction!
She is alongside Her Lord, this divine consort with lustrous hair!
As She Herself is Sree Mahalakshmi, can there be any dearth for adornments?
As She is the mother of Manmatha, can there be any dearth for beauty?
She being the co-born of the Moon, can there be any dearth for elegant grace?
She is the one with a tender body, this divine consort with lustrous hair!
Since She is the daughter of the ocean, can Her sublimity ever fall short?
She being the mother of all the worlds, can Her compassion ever fall short?
As She resides the lotus, can Her cool nature ever fall short?
The limitless one is She, this divine consort with lustrous hair!
Since She is the one worshipped even by divinities, can Her glory ever fall short?
Since Amrutha is Her relative, can Her joy & bliss ever fall short?
Eagerly, Lord Sree Venkatesha Himself came to wed Her,
this young damsel is the divine consort with lustrous hair!
448449

item.title: २१६ तिरुवीधुल मॆरसी देवदेवुडु
item.description:
Tiruvīdhula Merasī Dēvadēvuḍu
तिरुवीधुल मॆरसी देवदेवुडु
गरिमल मिञ्चिन सिङ्गारमुल तोडनु ॥॥तिरु॥
तिरुदण्डॆल पैनेगी देवुडिदे तॊलिनाडु
सिरुल रॆण्डवनाडु शेषुनि मीद
मुरिपेन मूडॊनाडु मुत्यालपन्दिरिक्रिन्द
पॊरि नालुगोनाडु पुव्वु कोविल लोनु॥॥तिरु॥
गक्कन ऐदवनाडु गरुडुनि मीद
ऎक्कॆनु आरवनाडु येनुगु मीद
चॊक्कमै एडवनाडु सूर्यप्रभलोननु
यिक्कुव तेरुनु गुर्र मॆनिमिदोनाडु॥॥तिरु॥
कनकपुटन्दलमु कदिसि तॊम्मिदोनाडु
पॆनचि पदोनाडु पॆण्ड्लिपीट
ऎनसि श्री वेङ्कटेशुडिन्ति अलमेल्मङ्गतो
वनितल नडुमनु वाहनाल मीदनु ॥॥तिरु॥
tiruvīdhula merasī dēvadēvuḍu
garimala miñcina siṅgāramula tōḍanu ….tiru..
tirudaṇḍela painēgī dēvuḍidē tolināḍu
sirula reṇḍavanāḍu śēṣuni mīda
muripēna mūḍonāḍu mutyālapandirikrinda
pori nālugōnāḍu puvvu kōvila lōnu….tiru..
gakkana aidavanāḍu garuḍuni mīda
ekkenu āravanāḍu yēnugu mīda
cokkamai ēḍavanāḍu sūryaprabhalōnanu
yikkuva tērunu gurra menimidōnāḍu….tiru..
kanakapuṭandalamu kadisi tommidōnāḍu
penaci padōnāḍu peṇḍlipīṭa
enasi śrī vēṅkaṭēśuḍinti alamēlmaṅgatō
vanitala naḍumanu vāhanāla mīdanu ….tiru..
In the sacred streets when taken on procession, He dazzles, this Lord of Lords,
excelling in His glory along with various embellishments!
On the first day, the Lord moves seated on the golden palanquin
on the second day, with all grandeur, He mounts Sesha
on the third day, He is taken in a bower of pearls
on the fourth day, He is seated in the flower-mantap during the procession.
On the fifth day, He mounts Garuda
and on the sixth day, He mounts the Elephant
On the seventh day, He moves on the Surya Prabha Vahana
and mounts the horse for the procession of the eighth day!
On the ninth day, He mounts the golden chariot
and on the tenth day, He ascends the wedding seat!
Sree Venkatesha along with His consort Alamelumanga,
dazzles amidsts the womenfolk and on all these Vahanas!
450451

item.title: २१७ मङ्गळमु गोविन्दुनकु
item.description:
Maṅgaḷamu Gōvindunaku
मङ्गळमु गोविन्दुनकु जय - मङ्गळमु गरुडध्वजुनकु
मङ्गळमु सर्वात्मकुनकु धर्म स्वरूपुनकू जय जय॥॥मङ्ग॥
आदिकि नादैनदेवुन कच्युतुन कम्भोज नाभुन
कादिकूर्मम्बैन जगदाधार मूर्तिकिनि
वेदरक्षकुनकुनु सन्तत वेदमार्ग विहारुनकु बलि
भेदिकिनि सामादिगान प्रियविहारुनकु॥॥मङ्ग॥
हरिकि परमेश्वरुनकु श्रीधरुनकुनु कालान्तकुनकुनु
परम पुरुषोत्तमुनकु बहुबन्ध दूरुनकुनु
सुरमुनि स्तोत्रुनकु देवा सुरगण श्रेष्टुनकु गरुणा
करुनकुनु कात्यायनीनुत कलित नामुनकु॥॥मङ्ग॥
पङ्कजासन वरदुनकु भवपङ्क विच्छेदुनकु भवुनकु
शङ्करुन कव्यक्तुनकु नाश्चर्य रूपुनकु
वेङ्कटाचल वल्लभुनकु विश्वमूर्तिकि नीश्वरुनकुनु
पङ्कजाकुचकुम्भ कुङ्कुम पङ्कलोलुनकु जयजय॥॥मङ्ग॥
maṅgaḷamu gōvindunaku jaya - maṅgaḷamu garuḍadhvajunaku
maṅgaḷamu sarvātmakunaku dharma svarūpunakū jaya jaya.. ..maṅga..
ādiki nādainadēvuna kacyutuna kambhōja nābhuna
kādikūrmambaina jagadādhāra mūrtikini
vēdarakṣakunakunu santata vēdamārga vihārunaku bali
bhēdikini sāmādigāna priyavihārunaku….maṅga..
hariki paramēśvarunaku śrīdharunakunu kālāntakunakunu
parama puruṣōttamunaku bahubandha dūrunakunu
suramuni stōtrunaku dēvā suragaṇa śrēṣṭunaku garuṇā
karunakunu kātyāyanīnuta kalita nāmunaku….maṅga..
paṅkajāsana varadunaku bhavapaṅka vicchēdunaku bhavunaku
śaṅkaruna kavyaktunaku nāścarya rūpunaku
vēṅkaṭācala vallabhunaku viśvamūrtiki nīśvarunakunu
paṅkajākucakumbha kuṅkuma paṅkalōlunaku jayajaya….maṅga..
Benedictions to Lord Govinda, Victory to the Lord with the Garuda flag!
Benedictions to the indweller of all, Victory to the embodiment of Dharma!
To the Lord who is the origin of all origins, to Achyutha, the lotus naveled one,
to the Lord who supports the world as the Adi Kurma,
to the one who protected the Vedas, the one who joyously treads the path of the Vedas,
to the Lord who vanquished king Bali, to the enjoyer of the Sama-gaana,
many benedictions!
To Hari, the Supreme Lord, to Sreedhara, to the one who is above time,
to the Supreme Purushottama, to the one who cuts off various attachments,
to the one praised by the sages, to the best one among divinities,
to the compassionate one, to the one whose name is praised by Goddess Parvathi,
many benedictions!
To the one who blessed Brahma, to the one who destroys the mire of existence,
to the one who is not known even by Brahma and Shiva, to that marvelous form,
to the Lord of Venkatachala, to the Universal deity, to the Supreme ruler,
to the one who is enamored by the vermillion from the beautiful breasts of Lakshmi,
many praises and benedictions!!
452453

item.title: २१८ मरलि मरलि जयमङ्गळमु
item.description:
Marali Marali Jayamaṅgaḷamu
मरलि मरलि जयमङ्गळमु
सॊरदिनिच्चलुनु शुभमङ्गळमु ॥॥मरलि॥
कमला रमणिकि कमलाक्षुनकुनु
ममतल जयजयमङ्गळमु
अमरजननिकिनिअमरवन्द्युनकु
सुमुहूर्तमुतो शुभमङ्गळमु ॥॥मरलि॥
जलधिकन्यकुनु जलधिशायिकिनि
मलयचुनु शुभमङ्गळमु
कलिमिकान्त काकलिकि विभुनिकिनि
सुळुवुल यारति शुभमङ्गळमु ॥॥मरलि॥
चित्तजु तल्लिकि श्री वेङ्कटपतिकि
मत्तिल्लिन जय मङ्गळमु
यित्तल नत्तल यिरुवुरकौगिटि
जॊत्तुल रतुलकु शुभमङ्गळमु ॥॥मरलि॥
marali marali jayamaṅgaḷamu
soradiniccalunu śubhamaṅgaḷamu ….marali..
kamalā ramaṇiki kamalākṣunakunu
mamatala jayajayamaṅgaḷamu
amarajananikiniamaravandyunaku
sumuhūrtamutō śubhamaṅgaḷamu ….marali..
jaladhikanyakunu jaladhiśāyikini
malayucunu śubhamaṅgaḷamu
kalimikānta kākaliki vibhunikini
suḷuvula yārati śubhamaṅgaḷamu ….marali..
cittaju talliki śrī vēṅkaṭapatiki
mattillina jaya maṅgaḷamu
yittala nattala yiruvurakaugiṭi
jottula ratulaku śubhamaṅgaḷamu ….marali..
Again and again, victory and benedictions to You!
Constantly and eternally, propitious benedictions to You!
To the lotus lady and to the lotus eyed Lord,
affectionately, many benedictions!
To the divine mother and to the Lord praised by the divinities,
at this auspicious hour, many benedictions!
To the daughter of the ocean, to the Lord who reclines on the ocean,
we offer many benedictions!
To the Goddess of wealth, and to Her Lord,
with the waving of lamps, many auspicious benedictions!
To the mother of Manmatha, and to Sree Venkatapathi,
over and over again, many benedictions!
For their loving embraces and amorous love making,
for now and ever, many propitious benedictions!
454455
